Seven maps offer roads with potholes, big ramps, a truck for crushing other cars, a mountain where you drop vehicles down the slope, and a crash test area with map objects to use. Fuel barrels can explode. Ski jumps, pits, spiked gaps, and
realistic-monster-truck-offroad-simulato: Realistic Monster Truck Offroad Simulator puts you behind the wheel of a big truck built for rough ground. The game looks sharp, with detailed monster truck surfaces, trees that look true to life, and thick patches of grass that fill the landscape. You will face rugged terrain and natural barriers as you push through an carefully crafted world.

Driving is simple: use the W, A, S, and D keys to control the truck. The focus is on a lifelike feel and steady, tense offroad action, so each trip over the bumps and hills asks for care. It is a good pick if you enjoy realistic driving games with a rough, outdoor setting.
asphalt-legend: Asphalt Legend is a car driving simulator with 3D racing elements, made for fans of driving games. You can take the wheel of several kinds of famous sports cars and get a feel for each one on the road.
Your goal is to complete missions, because every one you finish helps you earn a vehicle for your garage. Use the WASD keys to move your car and head toward whatever challenge comes next.
candy-egg-blast: Candy Egg Blast is a puzzle game where you line up colorful eggs to make them hatch. Each hatch releases a little bird, and your job is to rescue these birds before danger reaches them. Along the way you will meet tricky challenges that reward quick thinking, while a storyline runs alongside the action to give your progress some context.

Chaining moves together, known as combos, helps you clear levels and keep the birds safe. The game takes place in a bright, busy world full of creatures, so every stage feels lively. It carries the Match 3 style, while the story and challenges give it a flavor of its own.
obby-prison-barry-escape: Picture yourself locked inside the most secure prison in the world, where a guard named Barry is supposed to keep watch but spends much of his shift not paying attention. That lapse is your chance to slip away. Your goal is to get past a range of challenging obstacles and reach the helicopter waiting to carry you out.

Along the way, you can customize your character by unlocking new costumes and accessories, building a look that is entirely your own. On a computer, use WASD to move, drag the mouse to rotate the camera, press Space to jump, and hit Tab to pause. On a phone, control your character with the joysticks and buttons on the screen.
robby-mini-games: Robby Mini Games gives you several entertaining modes to explore. The central lobby is a hub where you can play soccer, run through a light round, or enjoy a ride on the swing. More than 20 mini-games are waiting beyond it, and you can compete against rivals or take them on solo. Along the way, you collect coins, gather game gifts, and buy accessories to dress up your character.

On a computer, move with WASD, look around with the mouse, jump with Space, and pause with Tab or Esc. Press E to open the tutorial. On a phone, use the on-screen interface to control your character, move freely in any direction, and adjust the camera view.
butterfly-matching: Butterfly Matching is a puzzle game that rewards sharp eyes and quick reactions. Your task is to spot butterflies with identical wing patterns and pair them together. The collection includes hundreds of different species, so there is plenty of variety to work through. Bright, colorful artwork fills the screen, and the quick pace keeps your perception and reflexes busy the whole time.

It is a match-3 puzzle, listed under Puzzles and tagged Match 3. Progress depends on telling identical patterns apart and responding fast. If you enjoy games that test how closely you look and how quickly you act, this one puts both skills to work.
stack-sort: Stack Sort is a puzzle game that turns a jumbled board into a neat arrangement of colors. You begin with a grid of mixed-up blocks, and your task is to shift them around until each color has a column of its own. Every column must hold blocks of only one matching color. The graphics are bright and three-dimensional, and the animations run smoothly, so each move is pleasant to watch.

The game suits a quiet break after a long day or a short workout for your brain. As you advance, the puzzles become trickier and call for clever strategies and sharp spatial awareness. It tests your logic and your sense of matching, so you will need to plan a few moves ahead. Can you work out how to finish every stack?
hop-ballz-3d: Hop Ballz 3D turns you into a master of magical ball games. You guide a bouncing ball as it hops across music tiles that move with the beat drops. The rhythm gets tricky, so this is not a simple music game. If you miss a tile, the ball falls.

Along the way, collect stars and spend them in the shop to buy new balls. Your scores can also climb the leaderboards, where you can try to beat the best results. Controls are simple: play with touch or the mouse.
graffiti-time: Graffiti Time puts you in the shoes of Cap, an alien who carries a can of spray paint and leaves his mark across city streets. In this 2D platformer, you must slip past high-tech guards while covering walls in color. Careful planning of each jump and step is central, and the game blends creativity with stealth.

Along the way, you can collect cash and use it to open new paint styles. The clock is always ticking, so you need to hurry while staying one step ahead of the patrols. Your goal is a bold act of artistic rebellion against the rules of the city.
cube-snake-2048: Cube Snake 2048 drops you into a large arena filled with cube snakes and numbered cubes. Your snake begins small, so you gather low-numbered cubes scattered across the map and merge matching numbers to grow bigger. Power-ups appear along the way, and picking them up gives your snake extra advantages.

Steer with your mouse, the left and right arrow keys, or the A and D keys. Hold left-click or press the spacebar to boost. Aim to collect cubes that are lower than or equal to your current number, since those are the ones that help you grow.
balls-ricochet: Balls: Ricochet! is an arcade shooter that honors the spirit of classic retro games. Anyone who loves vintage titles will feel right at home, since the game brings back that old-school nostalgia. Its authentic gameplay, accurate ball physics, and clean visual style make it a pleasure to look at and to play. The core idea was built in the early 1980s, and it still holds up well today.

Each shot comes down to choosing the right angle. You aim the ball, and it bounces off walls and blocks, so a single well-placed launch can clear several blocks at once. The compelling loop keeps you chasing a higher score for a long time, and you can also compare results with friends to see who comes out on top.
idle-gravity-breakout: Idle Gravity Breakout lets you unleash your destructive side. Tapping is how you crush orbs that seem to ignore gravity, and each crush rewards you with wealth. You can spend that wealth to build up your collection of balls.

The idle style means the action keeps going even when you are not tapping. You shape your combat power step by step, deciding which enhancements matter most at each point. The steady climb in strength and destruction is the core of the experience, and it suits anyone who enjoys puzzles or strategy.
dd-bubble-up: DD Bubble Up is an online puzzle game built around matching colors and testing how well you plan your moves. Your job is to pop balls of the same color, which earns points and carries you through the levels. Aim your shot and fire, working to clear the playing field in as few shots as possible.

Along the way, you will come across boosters that help you move forward. Bombs, rockets, rainbows, and lightning all belong to this group, and bombs and rockets also appear among the game's power-ups. The game is free and runs on any device, so you can play it wherever you happen to be.
mega-ramp-stunt-moto-fun-and-run-3d-game: Mega Ramp Stunt Moto is a driving title that many people consider one of the more engaging games of the year. Its gameplay is hard to put down, and the visuals aim for a lifelike three-dimensional look. You ride a motorbike along a platform suspended high in the air, pulling off tricks as you go, while various barriers stand in your path.
Along the way you can grab speed-up items that give your bike an extra burst of acceleration, helping you get ahead of other players. Everything is handled with a tap or click.
doges-battle-royale: Doges Battle Royale is a survival shooter in the Arcade category where you step into the shoes of the famous Doge. The battlefield is packed with guns, other weapons, and wild rivals you have to face. Every enemy you defeat leaves items behind that you can pick up.

Winning takes planning your moves and aiming with care, since precise shots are what keep you in the fight longer than your opponents. It is a tense Battle Royale challenge built around outlasting everyone else. Controls are simple: mouse click or tap to play.
toy-smash: Set in a toy fairground, Toy Smash is a colorful physics game about knocking things down. A stack of tin cans, wooden crates, glass blocks, stone cubes and dynamite sticks sits on a purple carnival platform, and your cannon holds only a limited number of balls. Each level brings a new tower, from can castles and domino lines to crate cakes, glass gates and mixed piles that collapse only when you hit the right support.
Tap or click the tower to fire at that spot, and aim for the lowest, most
outer-planet: Outer Planet puts you in charge of defending your world from alien invaders that keep coming at it. You steer through each fight and rely on precise shooting to hold your ground. Along the way, you plan your moves to free planets from the enemy, and new kinds of challenges appear as you advance. The whole intergalactic adventure runs in your web browser, and every shot you take can make a difference in the outer space battles. Your goal is simple: save your planet from doom.
block-breaker-game: Block Breaker Game is an arcade title where you work through brick-breaking challenges using single-handed controls. Each stage calls for careful planning, and a range of blasters gives you different ways to approach it. The levels are tough enough to test your skills, so you will need to think ahead and time your moves well.

The game has a retro feel that fans of classic arcade titles should recognize. Your results can place you on competitive leaderboards, giving you a reason to sharpen your tactics and aim for the top spots. Patience and precision go a long way here.
pull-up-bar-tricks: Pull-up Bar Tricks is a 3D gymnastics and street workout sim where a ragdoll stickman hangs from a bar. You swing it using arm and leg motion, release your grip, flip through the air, and try to snatch the bar again. Because limb positions shape speed and spin, every move depends on good timing. You can attempt giant swings, regrabs, and hops from bar to bar, or head to the ground to rehearse flips and landings before linking moves into longer sequences.

Slow the action down when a tricky move needs careful study. Points of experience and coins reward your tricks, which unlock new playgrounds and character skins. Finished attempts can be saved as replays, reviewed in slow motion, and your combinations can be shared. Controls can be remapped to match your style. Keyboard, mouse, and touch layouts are all supported, and R restarts an attempt while Esc pauses.
grandfather-road-chase-realistic-shooter: Grandfather Road Chase Realistic Shooter is a first person shooter where you try to escape a fast pursuit that never lets up. You carry a wide set of weapons and must pick the right one for each situation, since the enemies come in many different types. The game spans more than 50 levels, and in each one you can aim your fire at parts of the vehicles chasing you. Tough bosses appear along the way.

As you progress, you can unlock upgrades that strengthen your arsenal. Every stage asks you to think about where to shoot and which tool to use, so careful planning matters as much as quick reactions.
stickman-rush: In StickMan Rush, you sprint and leap through a platform survival game. Your job is to guide the vexx guy through a series of levels while he paints every platform in bright color. Watch out for spikes and other lethal hazards, because contact with them can end your run. Your goal is to stay alive in this tough world, dodging every trap along the way.
Controls are simple: use the arrow keys on a keyboard, or tap the screen if you are playing on a touch device. Keep moving, keep jumping, and do whatever it takes to get through this demanding world.
nutty-rush-kart: Nutty Rush Kart is a bright, cheerful arcade racer featuring the creatures from Nutty Rush. You choose from twelve drivers and assemble your vehicle from different bodies, wheels, side panels, nut cannons and gliding wings. The game offers forty circuits spread over eight worlds, and each world ends with a cup made of five races.

On the track, you can grab nuts and launch them at rivals, while drifting through corners builds up a boost. Speed pads also give you a push. Press W or Up to accelerate, A, D or the side arrows to steer, and S or Down to brake and reverse. Hold Space or Shift to drift, then let go for a boost. E fires forward, Q fires backward, P or Esc pauses, and R returns you to the track. On touch devices, an on-screen wheel takes over the steering.
bounce-ball-hook: Steer your ball through the twisting stages of Bounce Ball Hook, where accuracy and good timing help you get past awkward hazards. Bounce and hook your way around the course to pick up stars, which add to your score, and do your best to keep the ball from dropping. The game offers a satisfying test of skill, and each move you make can help you move forward.

Every stage asks you to think before you act, so take your time and plan your path. Watch how the ball reacts to each bounce and hook, then adjust your approach as the obstacles grow tougher. Success comes from patience and careful play, and the rewards feel well earned as you progress.
mantis-clicker: Mantis Clicker is a clicker game where every tap multiplies the rare mantis coins you collect. As your stash grows, you can spend coins on upgrades that boost your earnings and on skins that give your mantis a new look. The aim is to build your coins and gain influence across the mantis universe.
Each upgrade you buy raises your gains, so steady tapping and careful spending both matter. The game rewards persistence, letting you keep clicking and watch your coin total climb one tap at a time.
train-master: Train Master is a puzzle game where careful planning matters most. Your aim is to collect passengers without causing any crashes. You begin with a simple train and steer it along winding routes, gathering coins that you can spend on upgrades. It is free to play on both phones and computers.

Controls are easy to pick up: press and hold to speed up, then let go to stop. Along the way you will need to handle obstacles and keep to tight timetables while picking up riders, dropping them off, and earning rewards. Routes pass through busy cities and quiet countryside alike. Spend your rewards on faster speed or a bigger carriage capacity. Just be sure to avoid hitting any cars or people.
ski-king-2022: Ski King 2022 sends you down snowy slopes, and its controls are simple to pick up. As you glide, collect coins and use them to upgrade your skills. Dodge the obstacles in your path to keep your run going.

An impending avalanche is closing in behind you, so you need to escape it before the snow catches up. See whether you can meet every challenge and earn the title of Ski King. The festive atmosphere gives each run a cheerful, seasonal feel.
hide-and-luig: In this point-and-click hide-and-seek game, your one task is to find Luig, an elusive character who keeps squeezing into the strangest objects you can picture. Wander through playful scenes and click on everything you see until you uncover his newest hideout. The whole experience has a silly, lighthearted tone with plenty of small surprises along the way.

Controls are simple, since a mouse click or a tap is all you need. Each scene rewards careful looking, so check unusual corners and odd objects closely. It is a puzzle-style game that depends more on curiosity than speed, which makes it a good fit for anyone who enjoys searching for hidden things.
pull-the-pin-rescue: Pull the Pin Rescue is a puzzle game about saving someone who is trapped. Your job is to pull the pins in the correct order so the young man can get free. Pull them in the wrong order, though, and he becomes dangerous, so every move matters. The game puts its focus on strategy, and planning each step is the key to saving him.
Controls are simple: tap and slide to move. Think carefully about each pin before you act, because your choices decide whether the rescue succeeds.
ninja-adventure-game: Ninja Adventure puts your agility to the test as you set off on a journey through a series of tricky routes. The paths are packed with unexpected twists, so you will need quick hands and sharp instincts to get through. Along the way you can grab coins, which helps you sharpen your reflexes as you go.

Timing plays a big role here, since many obstacles can only be cleared when you act at exactly the right moment. Keep an eye out for hidden rewards tucked away in the stages, and work your way up through levels that grow tougher the further you advance.
mahjong-solitaire-zodiac: Sharpen your focus with this mahjong take on solitaire. Your job is to spot pairs of identical tiles and clear them away one match at a time. A tile can be picked only when no tile sits on top of it and either its left or right side is open. Tap two matching open tiles to remove them, and keep going until the board is empty.

The game mixes thinking and calm in a classic format you can enjoy wherever you are. Its tiles are attractively drawn, the controls are easy to pick up, and the puzzles are satisfying whether you're new to mahjong or have played for years. Take a break whenever you need to unwind.
stunt-rider: Stunt Rider lets you ride a motorcycle through a series of levels filled with daring tricks. Your job is to race through each course while pulling off stunts that are sure to impress. Balance and accuracy matter here, and the controls are simple to pick up, so you can focus on timing your jumps and landings.
As you go, you can upgrade your bike to make the ride feel even wilder. Every level presents its own challenge, which keeps the pressure on and gives your reflexes a real workout.
banana-quest: Banana Quest sends you into a jungle where you guide a courageous monkey on a quest for bananas. Your goal is to gather as many as you can while steering clear of spikes, leaping over barriers, and staying away from foes. The game runs without end, so the action keeps coming, and every banana you pick up pushes your score higher. Bright visuals and cheerful music fill the scene, and the controls respond smoothly.

Controls are kept simple. On a desktop, press the left mouse button to make the monkey jump, or tap the screen on mobile. The game suits players of all ages and is simple to learn, yet hard to master.
archer-trial-by-fate: In this top-down action game, you play an archer fighting through dozens of rooms full of monsters and bosses while challenging fate itself. Each run gives you a new mix of abilities, including ricochet, split arrows, meteors, orbs, ice and fire arrows, ghostly companions, and many more. Enemies and bosses each behave differently, with their own attacks and weaknesses.

Between runs, unlock new heroes, upgrade your gear in the Forge, and spend coins on permanent stat boosts. Room and wave order is randomized, so no two attempts match. Your goal is to clear every stage and defeat the final boss. Move with the virtual joystick or WASD and arrow keys. Shooting is automatic, so stand still to let your hero aim at the nearest enemy and fire, and keep moving to dodge.
fnf-music-clash: Timing decides everything in this fast racing game. Just as you settle into a smooth drive, rough rivals and merciless bosses test how far your skills can stretch. You change gears in step with the beat, trigger boosts right on the rhythm, and tear through story-based races, though a bad move can send you spinning out. Each stage asks you to outdrive twisted opponents and prove you deserve a place on the road.

The soundtrack is packed with tunes that keep your adrenaline up while you refine every shift. Sharp visuals, distinct tracks, and strong rivals support quick gameplay where precision, music, and speed meet. Controls are simple: a single mouse tap gets you going.
beach-bowling-3d: Beach Bowling 3D blends a relaxed seaside mood, rendered in three dimensions, with the classic sport of bowling. You can take on skilled opponents or challenge others in multiplayer duels. The game is simple to pick up on your first try, yet it takes practice to truly master. Each round gives you a reason to keep playing, since you can always aim to beat your previous best scores. It works on any device, so you can enjoy a game wherever you happen to be.
collect-million-coins: Collect Million Coins is a calm, solo 3D collecting simulator built around incremental upgrades. You enter a vault overflowing with gold, then improve your bag and tools to gather more. A powerful magnet pulls streams of coins toward you, and a minecart lets you load up and haul what you have collected.

Movement uses WASD, and the mouse controls your view, or you can hold the right button if pointer lock isn't available. Hold E or the left mouse button to collect coins, and press E at the receiver, upgrade table or minecart to interact with them. Keys 1, 2 and 3 select tools, P opens the Prime collection, and Esc or Tab pauses the game. Empty each vault and deposit every coin to reach the next one, and work toward earning all ten Prime ranks.
buggy-simulator-sandbox-3d: Buggy Simulator Sandbox 3D is a physics-based game where you drive a buggy across different maps and watch how the car and its wheels respond. You can pick from several vehicles and swap between them whenever you like, taking control of whichever one you want. The map includes a city and a bridge, so you can cruise around, leap over hills, or drive straight off the edge of the bridge. A separate test zone lets you smash pyramids and study how the suspension performs.

Use WASD to drive and steer, hold SPACE for the handbrake, and press Shift for nitro. C switches the camera view, R resets your car, and N jumps to the next vehicle. Tab opens the menu, and everything else is handled through the on-screen interface, which is also what mobile players should use. There is no fixed objective here, so the idea is simply to ride however you enjoy.
a-mole-in-a-hole: Help an absent-minded mole find his way back underground before time runs out. The tunnels twist in every direction, so you will need a good memory and a sharp sense of direction to plot a route. Watch out for hazards and distractions that can pull you away from the goal.

The game's retro pixel graphics have an old-school feel, and the challenges grow harder the further you dig. Your reward is dinner waiting at the end of the tunnels. Each choice you make can change how the journey turns out, so think carefully before you dig.
bus-master-road-journey: Take the wheel of a powerful bus and drive through busy city streets, long highways, and tricky roads in Busora: Highway Driver 3D. Your job is to pick up passengers, weave through traffic, and bring them to their destinations safely. Every trip puts your driving skills to the test in this 3D bus simulator.

Controls are straightforward. Press W to accelerate and move the bus forward, and press S to brake or reverse. Use A to steer left and D to steer right. The Space bar and H key are also part of the controls. The whole experience is built around the feel of handling a large vehicle on busy routes.
zombie-vacation-2: Stranded on a tropical island overrun with hungry undead, you take on the role of a special forces soldier fighting to stay alive. Your job is to shoot down every zombie that comes your way, and as you progress you can unlock a large selection of guns to help you endure. The visuals look sharp and add to the 3D action.

Controls are simple. Use W, A, S and D to move around, and press the left mouse button to fire. Hold the right button to aim, scroll the mouse wheel to switch between weapons, and tap R to reload. Space makes your character jump, while T triggers bullet time.
maths-puzzle: Maths Puzzle is a logic game that tests your number skills and problem-solving. Its varied puzzles range in difficulty, making it a good pick for anyone who wants to sharpen their mental agility in an educational way. Each one is an equation with missing parts, and you must work out the numbers, symbols, or operations that make both sides equal.
fastlaners: In FastLaners, you pick a speedy car and a strong weapon, then head out onto a busy street full of roadblocks that you need to smash through. Your route brings you face to face with a vicious, merciless wanted criminal who won't let you pass easily. Speed matters most here, so you must keep moving quickly while staying alive.

Along the way, gather cash and spend it on faster vehicles and better guns to upgrade your ride. Sharpen your driving by dodging hazards or blasting them apart, and work your way up to defeating the boss. Play with your mouse or your touchscreen, and aim to earn the title of street legend.
baby-race-galaxy-2: In Baby Race Galaxy 2, a funny little baby takes the wheel in this 3D racing game. You race your car and upgrade it until it reaches its maximum speed. You can also buy accessories to join you along the way on this long race.

Explore different galaxies on your journey and work toward becoming the best baby racer in the universe. It is a playful, lighthearted game meant purely for fun. Control your racer with WASD or the arrow keys, and use the spacebar as well.
penalty-shooter: Penalty Shooter recreates the tense feel of a football penalty, where one kick can change the outcome of a match. You switch roles, so you will sometimes take the shot and other times stand in goal. As the taker, your aim and timing must beat the keeper and send the ball into the back of the net. As the goalkeeper, you need to read what your opponent intends, make key saves, and become a hero for your team.

Anyone can learn the basics quickly, but getting really good takes practice. To shoot, drag your finger or mouse to draw the path the ball will follow, then release to kick. Bending your line with curves and angles is the way to outsm
princess-nail-art: Princess Nail Art is a calm puzzle game that mixes creativity with relaxation. You shape elegant nail designs for both hands and feet, using intuitive drag-and-drop tools to build each look step by step. The game gives you room to try out ideas at your own pace, so experimenting feels natural rather than rushed.

Its stress-free atmosphere makes it easy to unwind while you pamper yourself and let your artistic side take over. There are no time limits and no scores to worry about, so the focus stays on the enjoyment of creating. It is a gentle, uncomplicated experience with nothing to win or lose.
basketball-io: Basketball.io is a 3D multiplayer sports game where you bounce the ball, launch shots, and put points on the board. Your goal is to grab the ball and come out on top against the rest of the world. It belongs to the .io family of games and mixes basketball with a bit of action.

Moving your player works with the arrow keys or WASD, and you can aim by dragging the mouse. Use those same controls to dribble and release your shots at the hoop. Every match pits you against other people online, so quick reactions and smart aim are what count.
fantasticlandia: FantasticLandia is a 2D adventure for one player, set in a land packed with marvels. Your character leaps across colorful scenery and works through playful puzzles along the way. Every corner of the map is open for you to wander and discover.
Controls rely on the W, A, S, and D keys plus the spacebar. The game can keep you busy for many hours as you roam and explore its world. Take your time looking around each area.
two-punk-racing-2: This is the second chapter in the Two Punk Racing series, and it keeps the street racing feel. You take on rivals, pick up rewards along the way, and spend them on new cars or upgrades for the one you already drive. The game has three modes. In one, you race against rivals. In another, two players compete head to head. In the third, you gather rewards across a vast, free map.

Visit the garage to buy new vehicles, customize them, and get back to racing. Player 1 steers with the arrow keys, uses nitro with N, and looks back with B. Player 2 drives with W, A, S, and D, uses nitro with T, and looks back with C. Press R at any time to restart the level.
epic-racing-descent-on-cars: Expect wild, crash-filled racing in this game, where every event turns into a rough scrap of twisted steel. Your task is to slip past rivals and outdrive them across a range of different tracks. The physics behave in a lifelike way and the graphics look sharp, so each collision unfolds as a spectacle worth watching closely.
Your goal is to be the first car to reach the finish line and claim the win. Stay focused, read every turn, and keep pushing forward through the chaos until you cross it.
super-world-adventure: Super World Adventure is a platform adventure game in which a small hero sets out to save a princess in a fantasy land. Players move through a series of levels, gathering coins, grabbing power-ups, and beating enemies on the way to each castle. Along the route you will need to get past various hazards, and by the end you have a chance to prove yourself as a true hero.

The game runs on both desktop computers and mobile devices, so you can pick it up on whichever screen is closest. Its mix of jumping, collecting, and fighting makes it a fitting choice for anyone who enjoys classic side-scrolling action with a storybook feel.
sell-lemons-idle: Begin with just one lemon and gradually build it into a large lemonade business. You grow and harvest lemons, open additional farms, and buy upgrades that make each farm work better. Production speeds up over time, and automation keeps your lemons coming in. Along the way, you can discover new ways to develop your farms, pile up huge heaps of lemons across the world, and use multipliers to push output higher. Rewards and bonuses are waiting to be collected, and some secret upgrades can be unlocked too.
On a computer, use W, A, S and D to move, Space to jump, and the mouse to look around. On a phone, touch the left side of the screen to move and the right side to control the camera.
mr-bouncemaster: In Mr BounceMaster, your goal is to launch a penguin as far as it can go. You can speed it along, bounce it high, and steer around obstacles in every location. Along the way, you can upgrade the penguin to improve it. Hitting your friends helps the penguin fly higher on its way to reaching love.

To get there, you take control of a polar bear carrying a baseball bat. The bat is not his only tool, since he picks up extra shock equipment as he progresses. Gather coins and diamonds to unlock new upgrades and weapons. You can play with a mouse or by touch.
dessert-maker: Dessert Maker is a playful game about building sweet treats from the ground up. You can prepare creamy ice cream, bright popsicles, light and fluffy waffles, cool bingsu, and rolled ice cream. Blend different flavors, try out a range of toppings, and shape the result into a creation you are proud of. Your imagination does most of the work here.

Combine ingredients such as syrup and icing on a cake to make new combinations, then stock your fridge with a variety of desserts. Decorating works much like it does in other cake decorating titles, so you can add ornamental toppings to each dish. Every creation is a chance to show off your personal style.
anime-avatar-maker-anime-doll: Dress up anime-style characters just the way you like. You can choose a skin tone, a hairstyle, a hair color, and eye expressions, then combine them with stylish dresses from a large collection of decorative items. The game also offers many hairstyles and different themes to explore.

The graphics are attractive, the sound is high quality, and the anime background scenes are neatly arranged, which gives the photo feature a fresh feel. You can pick between Doll maker and PK modes. Create unique looks for a variety of styling challenges, and compete with other players at the same time. When you are happy with a look, take a photo and save your creation to your phone.
emoji-guess-master: Emoji Guess Master is a puzzle game where your creativity and quick thinking get a workout. Each round gives you a word, and your job is to pick two emojis that match it. The game asks you to draw on both your general knowledge and your gut feeling. It offers several difficulty levels, bright graphics, and gameplay that keeps you engaged. Along the way you can sharpen your mental skills, and it suits both short breaks and longer sittings.
To play on a phone, tap the screen to move through the menus and choose emojis. On a computer, click with the left mouse button to press buttons and select the emojis you want.
mud-trails-4x4-jeep-game: Mud Trails 4x4 Jeep puts you behind the wheel of powerful four-wheel-drive jeeps on muddy tracks, bumpy ground, and demanding off-road routes. Your job is to sharpen your driving and keep the vehicle under control when the paths get difficult. It works as a jeep simulator, so you can see how the machine responds to uneven surfaces and muddy roads. Fans of jeep driving, off-road racing, 4x4 vehicle simulators, or extreme driving challenges should find plenty to enjoy here.

The controls are simple. Press W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move back, A or the Left Arrow to move left, and D or the Right Arrow to move right. Any button on screen can be clicked with the mouse.
hunters-and-props: Hunters and Props puts a fresh spin on the classic game of hide and seek. You can take the form of everyday objects to avoid being spotted, or you can go after decoys that are hard to pin down. The settings are messy and crowded, which makes every search a challenge.
Strategy matters here, and you can team up with friends or go it alone. No two rounds tend to play out the same way, so each match keeps you guessing and tests how clever you are.
card-solitaire-word-game: Card Solitaire: Word Game is a solitaire-style puzzle built around wordplay. The pairings are clever, some levels are tricky to work out, and the topic sorting changes from one board to the next. You need to think carefully and plan a few steps ahead, because your moves are limited and every card has to find its correct home before you run out.

Some cards show pictures and others show words, so your job is to spot the link between them and make the match. Topics range from fruits and animals to everyday objects and abstract ideas. Each level tests your vocabulary, logic, and strategy in its own way. Controls are simple taps, and the relaxed pace suits fans of word solitaire, word games, and logic puzzles.
noob-hero-adventure: Steer a likable hero across dangerous territory in Noob Hero Adventure, where each move teaches you something new. Sharpen your abilities, cross a variety of landscapes, beat tough enemies, and dig up concealed riches along the way. The game follows a path from beginner to champion inside an approachable 3D action-adventure world.

The title is built around growth, so your character gets better as you go and you can take on greater challenges as you progress. It is designed to be easy to pick up, which makes it a comfortable choice for anyone who enjoys exploring and fighting their way through new places.
dragon-fly: You hatched as a dragon pup, but your wings are still far too small to carry you through the air. Your first adventure starts anyway, across realms covered in rolling, curvy hills. Glide down their slopes and tap at the right moments to gather speed, then launch yourself into the sky. Mouse controls handle every touch. Speed matters, because your worried mother has set off to stop your journey and drag you home to the nest.
giant-wanted-monster: Giant creatures have taken over the city, and you are an elite sniper called in to fight back. Grab your rifle and take out these wild monsters to keep humanity alive. Every shot counts, because the city's future depends on it. Your weapon is powerful, so you aim from far away and strike each monster at its weak spot.

The game is played with the mouse: click or tap to fire and take your shots. It's an arcade title tagged with monster, running, sniper and survival themes, so expect a steady pace where precise aim matters most.
world-flags-color-puzzle: World Flags: Color Puzzle mixes a flag-painting challenge with a journey around the planet. Your goal is to paint each flag correctly, using the country's name as your guide. Every correct result puts your geography knowledge to the test, so the game works as both a puzzle and a learning tool.

Once you have painted a flag, take to the sky with the airplane button. Fly across the world map to explore uncharted territories and discover new countries. As you travel, you unlock more flag challenges, so each trip brings fresh flags to color.
urban-sniper-multiplayer-2: Urban Sniper Multiplayer 2 drops you into city street fighting where you face other players in multiplayer matches. You pick your spots from high ground and choose from several strong sniper rifles. The streets and buildings shift around you, so you need to stay one step ahead of rivals. Your goal is to climb the leaderboard by proving your accuracy and clever tactics.

The game is built around competitive shooting in a busy urban setting. Every shot counts, and quick thinking helps you outplay the people you're up against. Whether you prefer patient ambushes or bold repositioning, the match rewards careful planning. Rise through the rankings and show what your aim can do.
rotate-to-escape: Rotate to Escape is a puzzle adventure spanning 60 dungeon levels. Your goal is to find the key and use it to break free. Hazards lurk throughout, including deadly traps, falling crates, and razor-sharp thorns that stand in your path.

The twist is that you can rotate the entire dungeon to shift gravity, so a wall can become a walkway and a pitfall can turn into a path. You will need to think fast, plan your moves, and outsmart the dungeon's tricks. Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all it takes to play.
candy-clicker-2: Step into a candy-coated world in Candy Clicker 2, a game built around gathering sweets without end. The approach is simple: every click adds to your growing stash of candy. Playful music runs in the background and adds to the cheerful mood as you play, and the gameplay stays satisfyingly straightforward from start to finish.
Everything about this clicking adventure stays light-hearted, and its simple charm makes it hard to put down. Your goal is to reach the top and earn the title of candy master.
high-pizza: In High Pizza, your job is to carry piping-hot pizzas to customers. Along the way you need to get past hurdles and steer clear of spoiled ingredients, all while serving large feasts with skill. Speed and accuracy both matter here, so every move counts.

The game feels like a fast arcade challenge built around quick action. Quick reactions and carefully planned movement are key to doing well. Aim for high scores and try to climb the competitive leaderboard. Expect a lively, rapid-paced run that calls for sharp reflexes and smart positioning.
squid-gun-fest: Squid Gun Fest brings back the Gun Fest series with a new Squid Game theme. You duplicate your weapons by solving math problems, then use that firepower to destroy the Squid Game employees. Now and then the Squid Game baby appears as the boss, and you will need as many weapons as you can gather to take him down. When you reach the final line, stop and destroy the truck trying to escape from the island.

Points you earn at the end of each level add up, and collecting enough of them lets you unlock six different weapons. The game works with a mouse or a touch pad, so you can aim and fire on whichever device you use.
army-base: You take command of a military base and turn plain privates into capable soldiers. Guide your recruits through the different training areas: the shooting range sharpens their accuracy, the sports area builds strength and endurance, and the medical center teaches medical skills and helps them recover. Each recruit improves gradually, and your whole squad grows stronger over time.

Once your soldiers are trained, you can send them into battle to put their abilities to the test, though some may be wounded and need time in the infirmary. New recruits keep arriving, so you will need to upgrade the base, add buildings, and open new training zones to keep up. To begin, lead recruits to the training stations, and simply approach a recruit to pick them up.
break-a-lucky-block: Smash open lucky blocks in this Roblox-style simulator to discover rare rewards. Move fast, because guards are chasing you and will catch you if you hang around too long. Every block you break brings you one step closer to new prizes.

Brainrots appear throughout the game, so grab them whenever you spot one. Carry your finds back to your plot, where everything you gather ends up. Your goal is to build a full collection of brainrots.
car-carrier-truck-highway-master: Step behind the wheel of a heavy transport truck in this 3D adventure, where precision, patience, and solid driving skills lead to success. Your job is to load valuable cars and haul them along demanding roads, completing delivery missions that move each vehicle from one destination to another. Every run gives you a chance to sharpen your handling.

The controls are straightforward. Press W to accelerate forward, and use S to brake or reverse. Press A to steer left and D to steer right. Whether you enjoy truck simulators or realistic driving, this game offers a relaxed but engaging ride for anyone who likes handling big vehicles.
ford-f-100-eluminator-slide: Ford F-100 Eluminator Slide is a sliding puzzle built around a picture of the Ford F-100 Eluminator. Your job is to rearrange the scrambled tiles until the car image comes back together. The game includes three different pictures, so you can switch up the scene whenever you like.

Difficulty depends on the grid size. You can choose from three modes: a 3x3 board, a 4x4 board, or a 5x5 board, with more pieces as the grid gets bigger. The game is built with HTML5 and is played entirely with a mouse, which you use to slide the pieces into place.
nail-salon: Nail Salon is a creative nail beauty art game where the aim is to turn clients' nails into eye-catching works of beauty. You greet each customer in a lively salon and use your artistic skills to give them full makeovers. Mix and match a wide range of designs and colors to help every set of nails stand out.

Each job follows a simple routine. First, you paint the nails while following a stencil that guides your design. Next, you file them into a neat, well-defined shape. To finish, you pick an adhesive jewel and place it as the final decorative touch. As you advance, new options unlock, ranging from detailed stencils to marble designs and more.
aquapark-shark: Aquapark Shark is a casual clicker game where you guide a small character through a water park toward the finish line. Your aim is to reach the end with the best score you can manage. The game mixes water slides, pool racing and adventure-style runs, with plenty of splashy rides to try in the park.

On a computer, press and hold the left mouse button to accelerate, then release it to brake. On phones and tablets, touch the screen to accelerate and brake. Tagged as adventure, casual and running, it is built around summer water fun.
arrows-cube: Clear a three-dimensional cube by sending its arrows out one at a time. Each arrow flies only in the direction its head points, and only when its path is open. Tap a blocked arrow and it bumps into a neighbour and stays put. Rotate the cube freely, since some arrows hide on the back. Moves are limited, so think ahead and work out the right order.

The game has many levels, from a gentle warm-up to tough brainteasers, and new mechanics such as double-headed arrows, branching arrows, turn tiles, stop tiles and reversers appear step by step. If you get stuck, use a hint, undo a move, or restart the level. Finished levels bring coins and stars that light up constellations in a starry sky, each giving lasting bonuses. With no timer, soft sounds and lively animations, it's a calm way to train your brain.
swamp-attack-online: Monsters are crashing into your swamp, and it's up to you to hold the line. Pick up a weapon and guard your home against invaders, including zombie-like creatures, crocodiles, aliens, and plenty of others. Plan ahead, decide how you'll respond, then fire your weapons to take down each foe. Your goal is to get through the assault and keep your home safe. These monsters show no mercy, yet each one presents its own fun challenge to overcome.

Controls are simple: aim and shoot with the mouse, pick weapons with keys 1, 2 and 3, and use Q, W, E and R to reach more options. Press the special attack when you need extra power, and tap or touch the screen if you're playing on a touch device.
extreme-police-chase: Extreme Police Chase is a fast police car driving game where every second matters. You weave through crowded highways, go after cars trying to get away, and dodge the traffic around you. Each pursuit takes place across action-filled levels, and you need to keep your target in view while pushing your speed as far as it will go.

Build up your police garage by upgrading your cars so they perform better, then take on harder chases. You can choose from three modes: Race Mode, where you chase targets through traffic in intense races; League Mode, where you climb the ranks; and Elite Mode, built for top drivers facing high-speed pursuits. Use the arrow keys or WASD to steer, accelerate, and brake, explore the maps, avoid obstacles, and unlock new vehicles. Each level brings faster targets, heavier traffic, and tougher chases.
boat-attack: Boat Attack puts you alone behind the wheel of a motorboat in a single-player racing challenge. You compete against rivals in a boat racing championship, steering a speed boat around tight, narrow bends and aiming to beat every opponent. The setting is striking, with clear emerald water surrounding a tall limestone island crowned with rain forest, and the visuals and sound add to the mood.

You can choose one of two boat types and paint your boat in any color you like. Use WASD or the arrow keys to drive, press R to reload your boat, and hit P to pause the game. Esc takes you back to the menu whenever you need it.
2048-classic-puzzle-challenge: In this classic take on 2048, your aim is to combine numbered tiles until you reach the 2048 tile. You push tiles across the grid and join matching ones together, so every move needs careful thought. The controls are simple to pick up, which makes the game easy to enjoy at any age, whenever and wherever you like.

Friends can also get in on the fun, since the goal is to get ahead of them through well-planned moves. Every slide counts, and foresight is the key to success. See how well you can handle the board and put your strategy to a proper test.
fireball-vs-ice-cream: You play as a small ice cream that must keep moving to dodge a stream of fireballs. Survival is the goal: the longer you avoid the flames, the higher your score climbs. The controls are intuitive, so you can focus on weaving through the burning playing field. As the game goes on, the challenges ramp up, and every trip through the blazing arena tests your reflexes.

Success depends on staying watchful and being patient rather than rushing. Careful movement helps you outlast the surrounding heat. The game carries the feel of classic arcade titles while keeping things fresh. Each run gives you another chance to see how long your frozen treat can hold out.
goo-turf: Goo Turf throws you into a messy, colorful 3D action arena, where you control a small slime with an oversized blaster. In single-player matches, you form a four-versus-four squad with bot teammates. Your team wins by painting more of the arena than the rival side before the clock runs out. Swim through your team's goo to speed up and refill your ink. Progress through 70 creative stages, and win battles to open new ones. You can also dress your slime in new outfits and weapons.

On desktop, WASD moves your slime, the mouse aims, and the left mouse button fires. Hold Shift to dive into your team's goo, press Space to jump, and Esc to pause. On mobile, use the on-screen joystick and action buttons
alien-shooter: Alien Shooter is an arcade game where you build up your weapons to hold off waves of relentless alien invaders. You work through a series of missions, and each one calls for some planning so you can decide how to put your firepower to use. Your task is to protect humanity from being wiped out.

The action keeps you hooked from the first moment to the last. Every upgrade adds to your arsenal, giving you more power against the enemy forces. If you enjoy blasting through alien hordes while thinking a few moves ahead, this airplane shooter has plenty to offer.
pacific-ocean-adventure: Dive into the deep waters of the Pacific Ocean in this single-player, 2D pixel shooter. Your fishing trip takes you into the depths, where sharks are a constant danger and you must fight them. Along the way, you hunt other fish to earn gold.

Movement is handled with the W, A, S and D keys or the arrow keys, and the Space bar launches your attack. If you open the game on a mobile device, touch controls appear on the screen so you can play without a keyboard.
candy-cutter-saga: Candy Cutter Saga is a physics puzzler where accuracy matters most. You slice through ropes at the right moments to steer a piece of candy past tricky obstacles. Along the way, you can collect every star in the level before dropping the candy into the open mouth of the hungry target.

The levels are challenging, and the realistic physics and fun mechanics keep each attempt interesting. The game tests your timing and problem-solving skills, so take a moment to plan your path before you act. Think ahead and use your brain to decide where each cut should go.
vector-strike: Take the cockpit of a fighter ship and make your way through ten sectors drawn in glowing wireframe, where ten towering bosses await. Enemy fire comes from every direction, so weaving through it is essential. Along the way, pick up upgrades to strengthen your arsenal with rear-facing guns, missiles, shields, and split shots. When a boss exposes its weak points, destroy them to reach its core, then finish the fight.

The action stays quick, with short stages keeping things moving. Autofire can be switched off if you prefer manual shooting, which uses Space. Move with WASD, the arrow keys, or by dragging. Press E or C to upgrade, X to unleash a nuke, and Shift to phase. Use P or Esc to pause.
speed-car-race-madness: Speed Car Race Madness puts you in an underground street racing scene made specifically for phones. You tear across the asphalt of Blackridge city, trigger your nitro, and tune your cars. Fans of extreme driving will find plenty of thrills here, including routes that climb into the mountains. The game features a wide range of 3D cars, and its casual driving sessions can get your heart pumping fast.
The controls are simple. Press the Right Arrow to drive forward and the Left Arrow to go back. Use X to perform a front flip and Z to perform a back flip.
place-it-right: In this calm puzzler, you tidy up scenes by moving everyday items to the spots where they belong. You sort, arrange, and line up picture frames, tools, kitchen items, books, keys, buttons, pencils, and many other things until each scene looks neat. Each level asks you to study the layout, spot the hidden pattern, and place every object where it fits. Some puzzles depend on color, size, shape, symmetry, or the category an object belongs to.
Controls are simple. On desktop, hold the left mouse button and drag an object, release the mouse to drop it into place, and left-click to select or interact with items. On mobile, tap and drag an
gram-simulator: Gram Simulator lets you chase the dream of becoming an influencer. Snapping photos, sharing them, and getting noticed are all part of the routine. You engage with your fans, grow your following, and climb the social ladder one step at a time. Along the way, you feel the thrill of fame while carefully putting together the perfect post.

The goal is to leave a lasting mark and become a standout digital icon. Listed under Arcade and tagged Simulation, this game focuses on shaping your online image. Step into the glow of the spotlight and see how far your audience can take you.
mr-bouncemasters-2: This game asks you to hurl a penguin as far as you possibly can. Once it is airborne, keep it zooming along at speed, bounce it upward whenever you can, and slip past the obstacles that appear across every location. Its mix of shooting and jumping gives it a funny, lighthearted feel from the first launch.

Upgrade your penguin so it performs better and can travel farther. Your results count toward the leaderboard, so you can aim to become the best of the bunch. Controls are simple: use your mouse, or touch the screen on a touch device, to play.
sausage-man-shooting-adventure: Sausage Man Shooting Adventure is a side-scrolling shooter that puts you in charge of a wild, high-energy sausage fighter. You push forward through rolling waves of foes, firing at them as the screen scrolls sideways. Along the way you leap across platforms and steer clear of traps.
Airdrops appear during your run, and grabbing one boosts the damage your shots deal. The game is controlled entirely with a mouse click or a tap.
bug-war: You control a single plastic toy soldier while bugs spill across the flower bed. Your job is to hold your ground through 18 story stages that take you through the backyard, the garage, the kitchen, and more. As you progress, you climb through 15 ranks and earn new weapons and paint jobs to customize your soldier. If you prefer competition, a 4v4 toy-soldier deathmatch is on offer.
A two-player mode lets you and a friend share one screen and
stealthy-heist: Stealthy Heist puts you in the role of a skilled thief who plans jobs and carries them out without anyone noticing. Your route takes you past security guards, you switch off alarms, and you open safes while gathering valuable loot. Every job works like a puzzle, so you need to think fast, time your moves carefully, and hope for a little luck along the way. Between missions, you can improve your gadgets and learn new abilities, which helps you tackle tougher assignments set in richly detailed locations.

The controls feel smooth and simple, and the storyline keeps each job connected to the next. The challenge is to excel at your trade by taking items while staying undetected. You can play using a mouse or a touch screen.
moscow-metro-simulator: You take the controls of a Moscow metro train and carry passengers along the Kalininskaya line, which runs through eight stations from Tretyakovskaya to Novokosino. Four train models are included: Nomernoy, Oka, the E-type wagon and Moscow. Real recordings of a Moscow metro announcer play during your journey.

Driver mode lets you run the train, while Training teaches you how to handle it. Set your speed with the left controller at X1 to X4, or slow down with T1 to T3. Bottom-right buttons start the announcer, open the doors when you are stopped within 3 meters of the rail, switch the headlights and sound a beep when held. The camera button sits in the top left. After stopping, use the bottom-left button to get off and explore the stations, then get back on the train.
tom-and-angela-insta-fashion: Tom and Angela want to rise to fame on Instagram, and you get to help them get there. Shop for outfits, hairstyles, and accessories that suit each character's mood. Dress them up for different occasions, snap photos worth sharing, and watch the likes roll in. Build the perfect look for every post and enjoy the process.

The game runs smoothly on phones, tablets, and computers. On a desktop, use the mouse to click items, tools, and buttons. On a touchscreen, simply tap to pick and apply your choices. It is filed under Girls and carries tags such as Dress Up, Fashion, Make Up, Hair, and Girls.
watermelon-run: Players haul watermelon bricks across the course, search for a shortcut over the water, and build a bridge to pull ahead of their rivals. Props and weapons are mixed into the action, adding variety to each run. The game is designed for many people to play together, so it works best with a crowd.

Solo players are not left out, since those without friends can still match their own style against others. Overall, the gameplay feels lighthearted and cheerful. Finishing more tasks unlocks colorful watermelon outfits, and players can let their imagination run wild while they keep collecting ski. Every character has its own look, so choosing the one that suits you is part of the fun.
baby-hazel-fun-time: Step into the cheerful everyday life of Baby Hazel, where your job is to keep her happy by looking after whatever she needs. You begin by getting her out of bed, then move on to playing games and taking part in other activities with her. Simple clicks and drags are all it takes to guide her through the day. Keep an eye out for hints that show you how to keep her in a good mood from morning until night.
amaze-escape: In this game, you slip past watchful guards while working your way through winding mazes. Each challenge is harder than the last, so you need to think carefully as you go. The setting is a tightly guarded prison, and the mood stays tense from start to finish.

Every choice you make brings you a step nearer to freedom, but a single misstep can lead to serious consequences. Success depends on building a well-thought-out escape plan. The goal is a flawless getaway, and that takes sharp thinking from the very first move.
real-car-parking-game: Step behind the wheel in this 2024 street car driving game, which sits in the racing category. Street parking brings a mix of parking and driving challenges, and you take the driver's seat to test your skills in this street car park game.

Car racing and vehicle driving blend together here, offering an entertaining experience for fans of car driving games, car simulators, and vehicle simulators. Everything is handled with the mouse, so simply click any button to move through the game.
fly-car-stunt-5: Fly Car Stunt 5 comes with a fresh set of upgrades. Its futuristic Space City setting and six original flying cars give the game a new feel, and its updated physics offer much better control of your vehicle in the air. Across ten levels, you race against the clock and unlock new flying cars along the way. Use your nitro wisely and soar over the obstacles in your path.

Player one drives with the arrow keys, uses nitro with N, and looks back with B. Player two moves with W, A, S and D, uses nitro with T, and looks back with C. Press R to restart a level. The two-player option lets you and a friend go head to head to see who is the better driver of these futuristic flying cars.
obby-ragdoll-boxing: Obby: Ragdoll Boxing is an action game built around floppy, physics-driven fighters. You take charge of a ragdoll boxer who must tackle challenges in the arena, during training sessions, and in spontaneous brawls. Its animations are silly, its behavior is hard to predict, and collisions make every bout feel like a comedy show.

Design your own fighter, visit different places, and aim to be the top boxer among the Obby crew. You can throw punches and slip away with careful timing, or simply sit back and watch your fighters tumble across the ring. The controls are easy to pick up, yet there is strategy and quick reactions to master along the way.
aidan-in-danger: Aidan in Danger is a platform game that follows Aidan, a young elf with red hair who fights with a slingshot. He has to keep Drakor, the last dragon left on Earth, safe from an interdimensional villain who wants to rule everything. Along the way you face dangerous monsters, travel through time, and work through tough stages.

Expect absorbing gameplay, a gripping storyline, and eye-catching graphics. Your goal is to help Aidan save Drakor and bring peace back to the land. The left and right arrow keys move Aidan, while W or the up arrow jumps. C or K rolls, X or J shoots, and Space dashes. Press P or Tab to pause.
butterfly-dash: Steer a butterfly through richly drawn worlds in Butterfly Dash. The paths wind through complicated scenery crowded with hazards and foes, and you gather nectar along the way while your reflexes get sharper. Controls are easy to pick up, and the bright graphics pair well with puzzles that test your timing and patience.

Each stage asks you to plan your moves carefully rather than rush ahead. The game suits anyone who enjoys a gentle but demanding adventure with a lot of charm. Set off on the journey whenever you feel like a calm, colorful challenge.
hard-puzzle-color-lines: Hard Puzzle: Color Lines is a thinking game built around linking matching colored pieces with paths that stretch across the board. Every move calls for forethought. As you progress, extra colors appear, open space disappears, and mistakes become easier to make. Even so, the stages are brief and the rules stay clear, making it a calm yet mentally demanding pastime, with the toughest challenges saved for the later stages.

On each level, you pair up identical colors by drawing lines between them, keeping the board neat so no color gets walled off. Tap one colored piece, then trace a route to its match. Lines may not cross, and leftover gaps are usually not allowed. If a route goes wrong, undo or redo your steps, or restart the level. Finish the level by joining every color pair.
candy-pop-mania: Candy Pop Mania is a colorful match 3 game with hundreds of levels to work through. Your task is to pop, blast, and match sweets across the board. Swipe tiles horizontally or vertically to line up three or more matching items, and clear the board while completing each level's objective.

Matching four or more pieces creates special candies with unique abilities, including striped candies, wrapped candies, and color bombs. Use power-ups to clear the trickier parts of the board. Newer levels bring fresh goals and obstacles, so the challenge keeps changing.
Each day you can spin the bonus wheel for free boosters, coins, and special items. Completing levels also earns you rewards.
parkour-obby-jump-to-victory: Parkour Obby Jump to Victory puts you in a run of obstacle courses, where you leap across gaps and move along narrow routes with careful timing. Each step must land precisely. Dodge the traps in your way and decide your next move quickly, because the clock keeps ticking and every run tests your precision.
Master each course you tackle and you will climb toward legendary status. Keep your footing steady and your decisions sharp, and see how far your parkour skills can take you.
punch-the-wall: Punch The Wall is a hypercasual adventure that gives you a safe outlet for pent-up feelings. Rather than taking a bad mood out on the people around you, you aim it at the game instead. Walls rise up along your path, and each one must be broken before you can keep going. Run forward, smash through every barrier, and let the tension drain away with each hit.

Press the space bar to throw a punch and shatter whatever stands in front of you. It is a way to release frustration and stress while showing off your strength. Run, punch, and break through wall after wall.
stick-war-tower-mighty-defense: Stick War: Tower Mighty Defense sends you on a rescue mission with a brave blue stickman as your hero. Your path leads through enemy towers, and you will need to take them down while facing strong monsters along the way. Pick up fresh weapons as you go to raise your strength and keep up with what lies ahead. Every level ramps up the difficulty, so you will have to think ahead and react fast to succeed.
kick-the-santa-christmas-buddy: Kick The Santa Christmas Buddy is a light, hypercasual holiday game packed with silly chaos. Your Christmas Buddy helps you blow off steam, and the whole experience is built around big laughs. Smashing and weapons are central to the fun, so expect messy, over-the-top action throughout.

Everything runs on one simple input. A mouse click or a tap is all you need to play, so it's easy to pick up whenever you have a spare moment. The mix of Christmas theming and goofy humor keeps things cheerful from start to finish.
idle-supermarket-tycoon: Step into the role of a retail tycoon in Idle Supermarket Tycoon, a free online simulation you can play on a phone or computer. You begin with a small shopping mall and grow it into a busy retail empire. Open new shops, upgrade their interiors, and give the mall's outside a fresh look. Your aim is to keep customers happy, raise your reputation, and push your profits higher.

Everything is controlled with the left mouse button. Spend your earnings on expanding the mall, and hand out reputation points to visitors. Pick priority customers for each shop so you earn more from serving them. Buying delivery vehicles adds extra income every time a trip is finished. Keep an eye on the corridors, since trash cans and vending machines can become clogged. Stuck on what to do? The missions offer rewards that help you grow your supermarket kingdom.
save-nemo: In this underwater puzzle adventure, you help a brave little fish escape dangerous traps, outwit a hungry shark, and rescue the Fish Princess. Solve a range of brain-teasing mini-games, from choosing the right actions to pulling pins in the correct order and connecting pipes.

On desktop, use the left mouse button. On a phone or tablet, tap and drag the screen. Choice puzzles let you click or tap one of the available options. In pin puzzles, click or tap the right pin, or hold and drag it, and think about the order before releasing water or opening a path. Pipe puzzles require tapping pieces to turn them into one continuous route. Each solved puzzle moves the story forward, and you can explore the underwater tale and decorate your island with charming items along the way.
obby-arena-1-frag: Obby Arena: +1 Frag is a quick first-person shooter with chunky, block-style characters and bright, colorful arenas. You can take part in deathmatch rounds, team battles, or plant-and-defuse matches where a bomb is on the line. String together eliminations to build up killstreaks, using jumps and slides to keep moving.

Unlock new guns, arrange your loadout, and personalize how your character looks. Move with WASD and look around with the mouse. Left click fires, while right click or E aims down sights. Space jumps, Shift while moving slides, and C crouches. Press R to reload, use keys 1 through 4 or the mouse wheel to swap weapons, and tap Q to return to the previous one. Hold F to plant or defuse the bomb, press Tab for the scoreboard, and P to pause.
moonshine-runners-samogonki: Moonshine Runners Samogonki is a offbeat kart racer set on an alien planet. You pick from a roster of distinctive drivers and fire off magic spells to gain the upper hand. Rogue robots get in your way, so you'll need to dodge and outwit them as you go. The tracks change in ways you can't always predict, and you'll gather vital energy along the route. Winning is how you take your world back, and the whole experience is full of quirky experiments and personality.

It's kart racing with a bit of a twist, built around chaotic, playful action. Every race asks you to stay sharp, adapt to surprises, and make the most of your spells and your driver's strengths. Expect a wild, adventurous ride that rewards bold moves and a willingness to try something unusual.
yarn-untangled: Yarn Untangled puts you in charge of a playful kitty that works through colorful balls of tangled yarn. Your job is to pick apart each knot by studying how the strands are wound. The controls are simple, but the puzzles reward careful, strategic thinking.

Each stage brings more demanding knots than the one before, and the charming animations keep the mood light as you go. This hyper-casual adventure is designed to be both amusing and relaxing, giving your problem-solving skills a steady workout while you unwind.
princess-glitter-coloring-for-kids: Made for children of every age, this game will appeal most to girls who enjoy dressing up and decorating princesses. It is simple to pick up and genuinely entertaining, and it gives young players room to explore their imaginative side while also sharpening hand-eye coordination. Controls are straightforward: just tap or click.
No internet connection is needed, so the game is handy when travelling as well. It can keep kids busy for hours at a stretch, whether they are at home or on the road.
katana-zero-borrowed-seconds: Rei is the lead in this 2D sword-action game set in a neon-lit city. Borrowed time comes from stolen technology, but every use costs Rei some memory. You move through carefully crafted rooms, cutting down enemies, reflecting bullets, and dashing past danger, while slowing the action lets you plan your next move. Detailed environments and an original electronic soundtrack add to the moody atmosphere of the story.

Controls are easy to pick up. A and D or the arrow keys move, Space or W jumps, and J or a left click slashes. K or a right click dashes, and holding L or Q slows time. Press R to retry quickly from checkpoints, Esc to pause, and M to mute. Your progress is saved along the way, and mobile players get Left, Right, Time, Dash, Jump, and Slash buttons on screen.
click-and-colors-dinosaurs: Step back in time with this coloring game full of dinosaurs and ancient scenes. Players fill in pictures by clicking on the outlined areas, and each click paints that section with the color you have chosen. You can pick shades from a bright palette, so every drawing can look different.

The game is simple to pick up, with one-click coloring and a interface made for kids. It encourages creativity and helps build hand-eye coordination, while offering an easy and educational way to enjoy art and dinosaurs. Keep going until the whole picture is colored in. All you need to play is a mouse click or a tap.
school-escape-obby: School Escape Obby is a Roblox-style online game with sharp graphics and a variety of settings. Each zone brings its own challenges, from school hallways to eerie dungeons. You can dress your character in hundreds of stylish skins, then compete with friends in multiplayer mode. Your mission is to escape the school while playing for time.

Every obstacle tests your agility and wit, so you will need to leap, dodge, and solve puzzles to get out. The fast platforming and creative level design suit players of every skill level. Regular updates, eye-catching visuals, and competitive leaderboards keep obstacle course fans busy. Millions of players worldwide already test their skills here. On PC, Shift shows the cursor, WASD moves, Space jumps, Tab pauses, F pushes enemies, and E or a mouse click interacts with objects. Phones use on-screen controls.
crazy-three-puzzle: Crazy Three Puzzle is a 3D matching game where you line up three matching tiles to clear them. It also asks you to sort and organize items, so you are matching and tidying at the same time. You can play it offline whenever you like, and it offers hundreds of bright levels to work through.

The difficulty ranges from easy, relaxed stages to tougher ones that require more thought. If you want a calm break or a bit of a mental workout, you should find a level that suits you. The controls use the left mouse button: tap and hold it to play.
volley-beans: Volley Beans turns volleyball into a silly contest between wobbly bean characters. Its physics-based gameplay keeps every fast match funny and unpredictable, and each round lasts about two minutes, so it fits neatly into a short break. Play alone against the AI or challenge friends online, and unlock new characters and customizations as you go.

Choose Career Mode to climb the volleyball championships, Online Multiplayer to face players worldwide, Local Play for pass-and-play with friends, or Tournament Mode for special events. Bright, eye-catching graphics, lively sound effects and music, and regular content updates round out the package. Left-click to jump, double-click to smash the ball, and press SPACE to start.
shape-transform-race: Shape Transform Race is a reaction-based racing game with both single-player and two-player modes. You can compete against computer bots or challenge a friend. Choosing the right vehicle for each section of the track is the key to staying in front. Coins earned from races can be spent to unlock new vehicles and characters.

Each track has its own difficulty level and plenty of surprises. Your character changes shape to suit the terrain, becoming a boat on water, a car on the road, or an airplane in the air. Transform at the right moment to keep your speed up and leave opponents behind. Switch vehicles with the mouse or touch controls, or use the A, S, D and J, K, L keys as shortcuts in two-player mode. The first racer to reach the finish line wins.
blocks-adventure-jungle-saga: Set in jungle lands where wild vines creep across the screen, this block puzzle invites you to drag and drop pieces in a bright, flowing rhythm. Each well-placed piece gives a satisfying click, and your points stack up quickly when you keep the pace going.

Drag each shape from the current set onto empty cells of the grid. Filling an entire row or column clears it and earns points. Once every shape in the set is placed, a new set unlocks. The game ends when none of the remaining shapes can fit on the board. To change a piece's orientation, drop it into the pocket and it rotates. Unlike classic falling block games, this format rewards careful placement and planning ahead.
hooked-idle: Hooked Idle is a bright, idle-style fishing title where every fish you land helps you grow. Coins build up as you play, and you can spend them to raise your income and improve your fisherman. Along the way, you can unlock talents, add new species to your fish collection, and complete tasks and achievements for rewards.

To catch a fish, simply move your mouse over it and watch your coin total climb. Once you have earned enough prestige points, press and hold the prestige button to start a fresh run that keeps lasting bonuses. Keep upgrading and see how far you can progress.
madness-combat-fangame: Madness Combat Fangame drops you into a chaotic shooter where planning and quick reactions both matter. You fight off a steady stream of hostile enemies using a collection of one-of-a-kind guns, and you need to think ahead about how to handle each different type of foe you meet. All the while, you have to keep running from Tricky the Clown, who never seems to stop coming after you.

Getting through this game means balancing careful choices with fast movement. Each encounter asks you to pick the right weapon and approach, so the fights stay fresh. Pushing through the mayhem is a real challenge, and the game leaves you finding out how far your nerve and tactics can carry you through the madness.
cake-shop-cafe-pastries-and-waffles-cook: In this cooking game, you play the creative mind behind every dessert in your own café. Your job is to bake and assemble pastries and waffles, then serve them to eager customers. Keeping the business going means managing your supplies, improving your equipment, and opening new locations as you grow. It is a puzzle game with a strategy side, so you will need to plan ahead and think creatively.
Anyone who enjoys sweet treats and clever planning can jump into this sugary adventure. Each decision, from the recipes you prepare to where your next sh
fastlane-revenge-online: In this free 2D racing shooter, your goal is to win back the top spot. Start from behind and climb through the field by overtaking the other racers, then face the flashy bosses leading the most feared gangs. Blend driving with shooting as you work your way forward.

angry-battle-birds-mania: Angry Battle Bird Mania is a bird-slinging game where careful aiming and planning matter most. You pick your toughest birds, load them into the catapult, and fire them at enemy structures to knock everything down. Scores climb higher the fewer launches it takes to clear the board, so every shot counts.

Physics-based action makes each launch feel lively, and the birds come with special powers you can use at the right moment. Levels grow more challenging as you go, so you will need to think ahead. To play, click and aim, then use the slingshot to send your bird flying. It is built to keep you busy for a long stretch.
slalom-hero: Slalom Hero sends you down snowy hillsides, where you weave skillfully between the gates. Grab boosts along the way to get ahead of your rivals. The coins you gather help enhance your hero's abilities, and your aim is to reach that elusive gold medal.
The controls are easy to pick up, and the charming visuals give the game a warm, friendly feel. Players of all ages can enjoy competing to set the fastest time.
hit-masters-rush: Hit Masters Rush is a free clicker-style action game that mixes running, jumping and shooting. Your little hero keeps running and jumping, and your job is to take out the bandits hiding in buildings along with their weapons. Enemies also wait on the rooftops, so you will need to jump, slide and shoot to deal with them. The game is based on the earlier Hit Master game.

Each attempt is a chance to beat your previous score, and as your skills improve you can unlock new avatars. Controls are simple: press W to jump, tap the spacebar to slow down time, and left-click to shoot. On touch screens, tap the on-screen buttons to jump and shoot.
farming-tractor-game: Farming Tractor Game is a simulator built around driving tractors. You roam rural landscapes and take on jobs that test your farming skills. Your machines are strong, and you put them to work in the fields, hauling produce and other farm goods from one place to another. The game also follows the routine of a farmer who works hard every day.

Controls are simple. Press W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move back, A or the Left Arrow to move left, and D or the Right Arrow to move right. Buttons on screen are selected with a mouse click.
