watermelon-merging: Watermelon Merging is a puzzle game where you combine assorted fruit into one giant watermelon. Everything is controlled with taps, so each quick touch moves you forward. The overall feel is calm and soothing, and the game is built to be played whenever you have a spare moment.

Every tap brings a merge closer, and the screen fills with bright, colorful fruit as you go. The pace stays gentle from start to finish, so you can settle into a relaxed rhythm. Whether you have a few minutes or a longer session, the game fits easily into your day.
shortcut-race-3d: Shortcut Race 3D! pits you against opponents on the track while you collect as many boards as you can. Each shortcut you build with those boards helps you run faster. However, the more boards you stack, the slower you run, so you have to manage your load carefully. Striking the right balance is what lets you outsmart your rivals.

This 3D arcade game is made for one player and mixes a racing challenge with collecting. Controls work by touch: touch the screen and swipe to move. Keep an eye on how many boards you carry, because too many will hold back your run. Get the balance right and you can leave the competition behind.
obby-pogo-parkour: Obby Pogo Parkour is a parkour game where you control a pogo stick that keeps you bouncing through each course. Every stage brings tough challenges, and you can improve your bouncy ride as you move forward. Clearing obstacles takes quick timing, and you are racing against players from around the globe.

Sharp reflexes matter a lot here, since every leap has to defy gravity in just the right way. Work through the levels with patience and push for a spot near the top of the worldwide leaderboards. Anyone who keeps practicing their hops may find themselves climbing those rankings.
summon-tribe: Summon Tribe mixes merging with tower defense. You join matching units to make tougher ones, which helps you hold back incoming enemies. The game is relaxed and works well for killing time, and it can also run in idle mode while you do other things.

To win, combine facilities, traps, and turrets into the strongest setup you can manage. Space is tight, so every placement matters, and you need to plan ahead to beat your foes. Pick skills that strengthen your defenses, and experiment until you find a combination that lets you last.
air-fighter-3d: Settle into the cockpit of your preferred fighter jet, get ready for takeoff, and climb into the sky, where intense air battles await. You can fly alone as a lone wolf or lead a group of agile acrobatic planes to gain control of the air above the battlefield. Pull off dizzying aerobatic maneuvers, line up your targets, and pull the trigger to bring them down. The game includes offline missions and player-versus-player battles featuring modern warplanes.
Controls are simple: press and hold the left mouse button, then drag left or right to shift your position.
princess-hair-spa-salon: In this salon game, you can reshape your character in countless ways. Each makeover unfolds over three relaxed steps: washing, styling, and adding accessories. Along the way, you have plenty of room for imagination and flair, and every visit ends with your character looking glowing and refreshed, leaving any skin-care worries from a doctor's office far behind.

Think of it as a pampering trip where the fun comes from your own choices. Start by cleansing, move on to styling, then finish with accessories until your character leaves the salon looking new. Every step is a chance to experiment, so no two makeovers need to look alike.
my-parking-lot: My Parking Lot is a puzzle game where your job is to untangle a jammed lot full of cars. You move each vehicle by dragging it, and you need to plan a route that lets every car reach an exit without bumping into another one. As you progress, the layouts grow more tangled and demand sharper thinking.

Each stage gives you a new arrangement to work through, so you get steady practice at spotting the right order of moves. It is a good pick if you enjoy a brain-teasing challenge that builds your problem-solving skills one level at a time.
cat-from-hell-cat-simulator: You play as a troublemaking cat roaming through Granny's house. Your job is to knock things over and make a mess, whether that means breaking plates, throwing balls, or smashing a fish tank. Granny is never far away, so you need to escape before she catches you.

The game lets you explore, play pranks, and cause chaos. Every corner hides something you can destroy, and new challenges keep appearing as you go. Controls are simple: click with your mouse or tap the screen.
football-legends: Step onto the pitch with a team of your choice and jump into quick football duels. Every shot depends on your aim, so line up each kick carefully. Upgrade your squad as you go, and work toward lifting the Legends Cup. Each match runs until two goals go in or the timer runs out, whichever comes first.

Drag your finger to set your aim, then let go to launch a player who kicks the ball. Power-ups can help you during a match, and precise aiming will make a real difference. Work your way through the tournaments and fight for the top spots.
stick-doors-and-island: Picture yourself washed up on a lonely island or shut inside a room with the door sealed tight. The game gives you several ways to get free, yet only some of them actually work. A few routes are clever, a few carry real danger, and a few will simply end in defeat. Your task is to locate every route that leads to a successful exit, whether you are working through puzzles in a room or trying to stay alive on the island.
Expect to rely on sharp reasoning and creative thinking as you search for the single genuine path to freedom.
bucket-crusher-asmr: Bucket Crusher ASMR is a calm, relaxing game about tearing down pixel walls and structures. You steer a crusher arm through each level, and every piece you smash moves your progress forward until the level is complete.

Guide the bucket arm carefully so that every brick and every pixel gets ground to dust. As you go, you can upgrade the arm's length, its size, and its power, so your machine can reach farther. Controls are simple: just mouse click or tap to play.
streets-of-rage-neon-district: Step into this side-scrolling brawler, which spans eight chapters of glowing neon districts. Choose Rhea or Vale and take to the streets. Strike with fists and feet, launch attacks while airborne, and sidestep enemy wind-ups. Grab opponents to throw them, and snatch up weapons along the way. Explore several scenes, face the boss of each district, and rely on checkpoints to keep your progress.

Fighters are drawn with rich detail, and the city backdrops and an original electronic score help set the scene. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, punch with J or a left click, and kick with K or a right click. Use E to grab, throw, or pick up items. Shift or L dodges, Space jumps, and P or Esc pauses. Play with keyboard, mouse, or touch, and on mobile, use the on-screen controls.
makeup-fruits: Imagine giving a watermelon a makeover, or adding eyelashes and a swipe of lipstick to a juicy melon. In this game, your job is to help fruit shine with beauty. Start by clicking the fruit you want to transform, then pick from a range of brands, powder colors, eyelashes, lipsticks, and stickers. Using your mouse, drag headbands, eye colors, and many other components onto your chosen fruit until the look is complete.
When your creation is ready, take a selfie of it to share with friends. Along the way you earn gems, which you can spend on new items to unlock more options and keep the playing going.
green-man-smash: Green Man Smash is an addictive action game with adventure and monster elements. Your mission is to stop villains from taking over the world, and that means battling through a city crowded with rotten zombies. You play as a towering green hulk who is built for smashing.
Getting around is simple. Use WASD or the arrow keys to move, and press Space to jump. For combat, press Z or 1 to kick, X or 2 to punch, and C or 3 to unleash a power attack.
night-city-racing: Night City Racing takes you into a car driving simulator that blends realism with a touch of fantasy. Ten super-sport cars, among the fastest in the game, are ready for the ride. You can adjust each car's engine as well as its appearance, so every build can look and perform differently. Play alone in single-player mode or share the track with a friend in two-player mode.
Single-player controls use W, A, S, D or the arrow
connect-hero: Connect Hero puts you behind a cannon, firing bullets to nudge superhero symbol gems back into their proper spots. Every level presents its own puzzle, so you need to aim carefully, work out how much force to use, and make clever use of the surrounding terrain. A single poorly judged shot can knock the gems off their path, so precision matters. The gameplay is simple yet challenging, making it a light and absorbing pastime.
Controls rely solely on the mouse, so aiming and firing require no extra keys. Blending casual puzzling with shooting and a superhero theme, the game delivers a light and engaging experience.
darkside-stunt-car-driving-3d: Set during the night, this 3D stunt driving game puts you behind the wheel of supercars that are already waiting for you. The course stretches across extreme tracks high in the sky, and you need to stay on the track, since falling off is the main danger. Each run starts from a container stand, and from there you must keep your car under control while surviving tricky stunts.

Money gathered after finishing new levels can be used to buy additional supercars. Arrow keys drive the car, F activates nitro, and the spacebar works as the handbrake. Press C to change the camera view. The game can be played on phones and on the web, and it is made for one player in the racing category.
drive-pro-3d: Drive Pro 3D is a straightforward driving game that rewards good timing and smooth dodging. You hold down the button to speed up and let go to stop right away. Your job is to slip through traffic, get around obstacles, and squeeze between hazards that are moving until you cross the finish line. Each level you clear pays out coins, and you can use them in the car shop to pick up new vehicles with their own styles and feel.
The whole game runs on a single control: click or tap to play. It is quick to learn, but hitting the right moment every time takes practice. Keep your reactions sharp and your lines clean.
flappyball: Steer a bouncing ball through a winding course of obstacles in FlappyBall. Every tap makes the ball flap upward, and the gaps you need to pass through keep getting narrower as you go. Your goal is to rack up a higher score, all while enjoying the old-school visuals and a catchy soundtrack that keeps you hooked.

This is a never-ending arcade game that rewards quick reactions and good timing. Learning the rhythm of your taps is the key to lasting longer than you did before. Think you have what it takes to beat your friends' best scores?
people-playground-ragdoll-arena: This physics playground is a place where creativity and destruction blend together. You pick up objects, throw them at helpless ragdolls, and watch the dramatic reactions that follow. There is no shortage of setups to try, whether you drop a vehicle from above or launch rocks at the figures below. Working out your own tactics is a big part of the fun, since the aim is to create as much mayhem as possible.
This version doubles the number of dolls, so there are twice as many targets for your experiments. It is a chaotic, playful take on physics-based fun that rewards inventive thinking.
idle-zombie-wave: Idle Zombie Wave is a 3D shooting game set in a world that is falling apart under a zombie invasion. You take charge of a group of survivors and make the calls as their leader. The undead keep coming without pause, and your job is to hold off wave after wave to protect your base. The game plays as a tower defense battle, so placement and strategy matter as much as firing.

Everything is controlled with taps or clicks. Tag-wise, expect a mix of apocalyptic themes, gunplay, and zombie combat wrapped in a strategic setup. Keep your team alive, respond quickly to each new surge, and see how long your home can stand against the horde.
jump-in-rhythm-to-the-hit-cat-disco: Hop along to a mix of cat meows and pop rhythms in this arcade game. You can play to a wide selection of popular tunes, including worldwide hits, and to remixed tracks that add a fun meow. The visuals are bright and colorful, the design is cute and kawaii, and you can choose from a variety of cats to take on the adventure.

Your goal is to reach the end of each level by jumping across the tiles without falling off. Time every leap to the beat of the music, and watch out for missing tiles. Controls are simple: on a phone, slide your finger left and right across the screen; on a computer, hold the left mouse button and move the mouse. Complete as many levels as you can to unlock all the songs, and earn coins to unlock new cats and new tracks.
6x6-offroad-jeep: You drive a powerful six-wheeled off-road jeep along demanding mountain tracks. Your route takes you up steep, rocky slopes and across bumpy ground until you reach the finish line. Hill-climb stages call for careful speed control on risky inclines, and all six wheels need to keep moving over rough surfaces.

Press W or the Up Arrow to accelerate and S or the Down Arrow to brake or reverse. Use A and D, or the Left and Right Arrows, to steer. Tap C to switch camera views and pick the smartest line past each obstacle. Use the on-screen controls where they appear, and get better with each attempt.
knight-360: Knight 360 puts you in the role of a brave warrior facing off against creepy monsters. Your main move is a strategic spin attack, and knowing when to use it matters as much as the swing itself. The world is built in 3D, and you must find your way through its intricate layout while fending off skeletons and ghosts. Every fight calls for skillful combat.

As you advance, each stage tests both your wits and your bravery, since the enemies change their tactics. The challenge grows steadily, so survival depends on staying sharp and clever. If you enjoy combat-focused browser games with a spooky mood, this one will keep you on your toes.
pixel-destroyer: This physics-based arcade puzzler challenges you to destroy colorful shapes made of pixel blocks by launching bouncing balls at them. Each level features its own unique shape, and clearing it takes both wits and precision. You have only a limited number of shots, so every launch matters.

To aim, touch the screen and drag, then release to fire a burst of balls. The balls follow the laws of physics, bouncing off walls and obstacles, which lets you reach even the most hard-to-access blocks. Use the walls to ricochet shots into protected areas. Destroy every block on the screen to complete the level.
water-sort-master-color-puzzle: Step into a bright setting full of colored liquids and puzzles that will make you think. Your task is to pour and group colors across hundreds of levels built to test your logic and planning. Each move matters as you untangle mixed liquids, open up fresh challenges as you progress, and build your problem-solving skills along the way. The game is simple to pick up yet takes real practice to master, offering a calm but hard-to-put-down experience that suits players of every age.

To play, tap a bottle to select it, then tap a second bottle to pour. Liquid can only go onto a matching color or into an empty bottle. Keep going until every bottle holds just one color, and think ahead so you can solve each puzzle.
tiny-tomb: Tiny Tomb is a 3D voxel adventure set inside a tomb. You wander through mysterious chambers and dig up buried treasure as you go. Planning each move matters, since you need to find your way around traps and finish the quests you pick up.

Enemies lurk nearby, so you have to stay alert and slip past them. Your unique abilities help you reveal hidden mysteries that would otherwise stay out of sight. Collect coins along the way and use them to unlock the tomb's puzzle-filled passageways.
sniper-mission-war: Step into a genuine 3D browser adventure as an elite soldier in the sniper forces. Your job is to carry out demanding tasks and help win the conflict. Follow the directions at every stage and stay hidden, because being spotted could cost you the chance to finish the job. You also play as a deadly assassin in this free gun game, where intense offline missions give you the chance to test your shooting skills.
Use WASD to move and left click to shoot. Right click aims, the spacebar jumps, and Ctrl makes you run. Press F to interact and Esc to open the menu.
push-to-go: Push To Go is a 2D puzzle platformer made with Unity, designed for players who enjoy logic games, button-driven challenges, and clean, minimal brain teasers. Each stage tests your timing, forward planning, and problem-solving. Movement relies on pressing: you choose the correct buttons to get past obstacles. The controls are simple, but the level layouts are carefully built to keep you thinking.

As you play, you gather stars that open up new stages, so progress feels rewarding. The levels steadily become harder, which suits anyone who loves puzzles. The game runs smoothly across all browsers. To play, just click with your mouse or tap the screen.
subway-princess-run: Subway Princess Run asks you to react fast and time your moves carefully. You race along colorful railway tracks, leaping over hurdles and weaving around obstacles as you go. Its parkour challenges give you room to sharpen your technique, and the pace stays quick from start to finish, keeping the action intense and full of energy.

Expect plenty of fun and thrills as you progress. Each stretch of track brings something new to handle, so you need to stay alert and keep your rhythm steady. If you enjoy fast runner games with a lively arcade feel, this one offers a brisk, high-energy run.
mix-monsters-fun-merge: Mix Monsters: Fun Merge is a puzzle game where you blend quirky characters into one-of-a-kind creatures. It runs on several platforms and suits players of every age. It works well for short play sessions and for sharpening your problem-solving skills.

Start by crossing two different monsters, which produces an egg. Eggs come in three types: Common, Rare, and Legendary. You then need to crack the egg open, and once it breaks, a unique monster hatches. Keep combining monsters to discover which creatures you can hatch next.
army-guns-collector: Army Guns Collector is an arcade-style war game set in a chaotic battlefield, where you need to move quickly. You have only 15 seconds per round to gather a variety of firearms, so precise grabs and smart timing matter. Quick reflexes help, but planning your moves helps you get ahead.

As you advance, the challenges grow more complex and each new level asks more of you. The controls are intuitive, so you can focus on the action instead of memorizing instructions. Every run pushes you to sharpen your skills and race against the countdown.
pop-it-duel: If Pop It 3D has stopped feeling like a real challenge, this game is a good next step. Pop It Duel gives Pop It a fresh twist with a one-on-one multiplayer mode full of action. You face a rival in a best-of-three match, and whoever pops their Pop It first wins the round.

Win two rounds and you can snatch your opponent's Pop It and add it to your collection. Be careful, though, because your rival will also try to steal yours. Show off your speed and skill as you pop each one. The full set of controls is covered in the instructions section.
stickman-vs-monster-school: Stickman vs Monster School is an action platformer where you guide a stickman through a school overrun with monsters. You arm yourself with a range of different weapons and plan your approach as the enemies grow steadily tougher. Along the way you will face fearsome bosses, and the game spans 60 levels to work through.

Success depends on switching between weapons quickly and moving nimbly across each stage. Staying alive in this monster-filled world means keeping both your reflexes and your tactics sharp from start to finish.
pudding-monsters: Pudding Monsters is a puzzle adventure starring cute pudding creatures. Your task is to slide these wobbly characters together so they combine into new forms. Each kind of pudding has its own quirky traits, so you can try out different types to see which combinations work best. By merging them carefully, you can get them to settle onto the star tiles.

The game offers unusual mechanics and a warm, charming style that keeps the mood light. Its puzzles are built to make you think, giving you a fun and mentally engaging challenge from start to finish. It's a dessert that skips the calories entirely.
super-drive: Super Drive offers striking visuals and a wide selection of high-performance cars. Your route runs through a large city where the streets are packed with pedestrians, so keep your eyes open. Push the pedal as hard as you like, aim for top speed, and work in a range of stunts whenever the road allows.
Controls are simple: use W, A, S and D to drive, hit Space to brake, and press C to switch between camera views. It's a single-player 3D driving race built around speed and style.
vehicle-driving-master-game: Vehicle Driving Master 3D is an adventure where precision counts for more than speed. Rather than rushing toward a finish line, you drive a range of vehicles and park each one carefully in its marked space. The lineup stretches from quick sports cars to large, heavy trucks, and every machine handles differently and brings its own set of challenges. You can also customize your city rides to suit your own style.

Players who enjoy parking and driving tests will find plenty to do here. Slide into the driver's seat, test your skills on city streets, and work your way toward becoming a true master of the wheel. To click any button, just use your mouse.
color-sort-party: Sort colored liquids into the right tubes in this water-pouring puzzler. You pick one tube and move its liquid into another tube that holds a matching shade. Each level is more challenging than the last, so you'll need to think strategically. If you get stuck, helpers like Level Skip, One Step Back, and Extra Tube can help you stay ahead.
Play across four tropical backgrounds, and personalize your tubes with any of up to 18 different styles. Be careful with each pour, and keep moving forward as the puzzles grow harder.
battle-hamsters: Battle Hamsters puts you in charge of a squad of fighting hamsters. Your task is to bring down the enemy squad. Both sides shoot in turns, so every round becomes a back-and-forth battle. As you progress, you unlock new levels, more hamsters, and different locations to fight in.

The controls are easy to pick up. On a computer, you click with your mouse to take a shot. On mobile devices, you hold your finger on the screen to fire. Since it works on both desktop and mobile, you can play on whichever device you prefer.
stick-boy-bazooka-ragdoll: Stick Boy: Bazooka Ragdoll blends careful planning with wild mayhem. You fire a variety of powerful bazookas at enemies and their bases, and the ammo you choose can decide how well Stick Boy performs. Each level is complete once you have destroyed every enemy in it. You can also buy new weapons that fire unique bullets, giving you more ways to handle a tough stage.

Aiming is simple. Hold your finger on the screen, or hold the left mouse button, then release to fire. Be careful, though. Your Stick can be destroyed by incoming bullets or level hazards, and you will also fail if you destroy any hostages. Bright explosive effects and impressive physics turn every level into its own puzzle. The game is free to play online on both phones and computers.
1-speed-keyboard-escape-halloween-update: This arcade title, in its Halloween update, asks you to race forward by tapping your keyboard. Each key you hit gives you a little more speed, so typing quickly is the main way to get ahead. As you climb through the stages, the obstacles grow tougher. Your goal is to last as long as you can while pushing toward the top speed and the final stage.

On a computer, you accelerate by pressing keys, move with WASD, and look around with the mouse. On mobile, a joystick handles movement, and tapping the on-screen controls lets you interact with things. The game blends running, obstacle courses, and typing into one quick challenge.
stickman-duel-battle: Stickman Duel Battle is a two-player fighting game built on the Stick War: Infinity Duel idea. Weapons drop from the sky at regular intervals, so you need to snatch a gun, line up your aim, and take out the opposing stickman. Speed matters, since grabbing a weapon first also lets you disarm your rival. Some tracks move, so you have to keep your balance and avoid falling off. Your only goal is to collect weapons and defeat the enemy.

Playing with a friend is the main draw, and the 2-player option works well even at school. The game also has a bright, refreshed look. Player 1 moves with the arrow keys and shoots with the L key. Player 2
sky-flight: Take to the air as a bird gliding over beautiful scenery in Sky Flight. Your job is to fly through rings along the way while steering around obstacles that try to block your path. Everything is controlled with the mouse, so the movement feels smooth and natural from the moment you take off.

Flying here offers both excitement and calm, with quiet moments mixed in among the rush. Stay focused, because one bump into something can send your bird tumbling back down to the ground. Keeping aloft is the whole challenge.
drive-chained-car-3d: Drive Chained Car 3D is a real-time vehicle racing simulator built around a fresh rapid beam drive and a distinctive ramp. Your job is to keep your speed under control while navigating an off-road bus and a Prado Jeep in a furious road race and crash simulator. You must avoid colliding with other vehicles along the way.

Each car is linked by chains to rival cars, so you must steer the group toward a target before time runs out. Reaching it takes careful driving and parking skills, along with a steady hand, since you need to hold your speed before hitting traffic. A set of chains is fixed to your chassis. The challenge unfolds as a freight coach and a wild chain-breaker race weave through the city's streets. Use WASD to drive.
robby-1-to-speed-per-second: Robby +1 To Speed Per Second is an obby where your speed climbs by itself every second, with no cap on how fast you can go. Your goal is to become the quickest runner around and clear each test at lightning pace. The map is split into four locations, and every one brings its own set of hurdles. Along the way you can unlock pets and try to gather them all. A store lets you buy outfit pieces to customize your character.

On a computer, move with W, A, S, and D, look around with the mouse, and press Space to jump. Tab or Escape toggles your cursor on and off. On a phone, use the on-screen interface to move and drag anywhere on the screen to change your view.
the-zombie-house: Your job in The Zombie House is to guard your home against a never-ending stream of undead. Every zombie you defeat drops coins and ability pickups. You can spend those coins on upgrades for yourself and for the house, helping both hold out against the next wave. Each level brings tougher zombies, so you will need to keep improving to last.

On a PC, move with the W, A, S and D keys and click a zombie to fire in its direction. On mobile, steer with the left joystick, then aim and shoot with the right one. Your survival time shows how well you have held your ground against the horde.
pencil-jam: Pencil Jam is a colorful sorting puzzle. You tap the hexa shapes and watch them combine until a full picture is filled in. Each solved board reveals a lively image, so the game feels like painting as much as puzzling. The main task is to sort three pencil-shaped pieces of the same color, and every successful match brings the picture closer to completion.

There is no clock and no pressure, so you can take each board at whatever pace feels comfortable. Beyond simple matching, you are building artwork as you go, which keeps the experience calm and creative. The mix of puzzle and art makes every image come to life as you play.
dogfight: Take the controls of a battle plane in this air combat title, where you face off in fierce skies. Loop, roll, and turn through fast-moving dogfights, and enjoy the feel of real aerial clashes while proving how skilled a pilot you are.

Desktop players fly with W to speed up and S to slow down, A and D for left and right turns, and Q and E for sharp turns. Press J to fire, K for your sub-weapon, Space to pull up, Shift to roll, and R to reload. On phones and tablets, drag the on-screen joystick in any direction, tap the fire button to shoot, and use the pitch and roll buttons to pull up or spin your plane.
basketball-beans: Basketball Beans lets you step onto the court and play like a true hoops star. You can pull off smooth passes, swipe the ball away from opponents, and drain long three-point shots. Tournaments give you a chance to compete, and winning them unlocks special basketballs and sharp uniforms to show off. The controls are easy to pick up, and there is a tactical side to each game, so every match stays fun and engaging.
grand-zombie-swarm: In this single-player 3D shooter, you play as a special forces soldier moving through an open world filled with zombies. Your job is to take on huge hordes using several different types of weapons, and to stay alive as you work through each level.

Controls are straightforward. Use W, A, S and D to move, and press the left mouse button to shoot. Hold the right button to aim, and scroll the mouse wheel to switch weapons. Press R to reload, tap Space to jump, and press P whenever you want to pause the game.
streets-of-rage: Trouble is brewing across the city, and sinister powers are on the move. Streets Of Rage is an arcade-style street brawler that drops you right into the middle of it. To get your battle started, you can choose from moves and boosts such as Fire Whirlwind Kick, ATK SPD Up, and Fire Blast, among others.

Work your way through waves of foes, chaining together strong combos as you advance. Punches, kicks, and special moves are all at your disposal, so you can keep your enemies in check and push toward becoming a true warrior. Controls are simple: just click or tap with your mouse to play.
football-panda: Football Panda challenges you to score goals in a game built around the appeal of pandas. Its arcade action moves at a brisk pace, so fast reactions and well-timed moves are your strongest assets. As you progress through shifting stages, each one presents its own distinct hurdles to overcome.

Everything is presented in colorful, cute graphics themed around pandas, giving the whole experience a warm and playful feel. Fans of fast arcade games will find it an easy pick for a quick, energetic session.
sniper-shooter-save-the-fish: Sniper Shooter-Save The Fish blends the familiar bubble-popping formula with physics-driven puzzling. The action centers on a hexagon that spins, so each level asks you to keep up with shifting angles, movement, and gravity. The visuals carry an ocean theme, and the light story follows a crab who sets out to free a clownfish.

To play, you aim and fire bubbles at the six-sided structure. When a shot lands, the hexagon may begin to turn, which changes where bubbles travel and how they behave moment to moment. Good timing, careful angles, and the structure's motion are all need
k-pop-stars-inspired-look: Step into the shoes of a stylist who works against the clock in K-Pop Stars Inspired Look. Your job is to design fashionable outfits and makeup for devoted fans, and every look needs to be ready before they head out to the club party. The game is bright and colorful, and its fashion challenges keep you busy while bringing the signature style of famous K-pop acts to life.

Each client arrives with their own vision, so you'll need to pick pieces and beauty touches that match the trend. Keep an eye on the timer as you work, because the party won't wait for anyone. Along the way you'll capture the feel of iconic K-pop fashion, one outfit at a time.
power-puncher: Power Puncher is an arcade game that tests how hard you can hit. You play as a boxer who must stand up to a steady flood of wooden boxes and smash each one to pieces. The boxes come in many sizes and shapes, so you need to watch them closely and strike at the right moment.

Hitting the center of a box delivers your strongest blow, so aim with care. Dodge the sharp edges, because they can injure you. Landing several punches in a row raises your score and unlocks special power-ups. The controls are simple: click to punch.
model-wedding-girl-games: Get ready for a wedding day full of fun as you dress up four different brides in "Model Wedding - Girl Games." Choose from more than 200 high-end pieces, ranging from eye-catching gowns to stylish accessories. Let your imagination run wild while you build the ideal bridal style, with nothing holding you back and nothing to pay along the way.

This girls' dress-up title invites you to explore fashion and mix together outfits until each bride looks just right. Every item is available to try, so you can keep experimenting until you are happy with the final result.
port-bike-stunt: The newest entry in the Bike Stunt series takes place on the Port map, a large harbor setting built for showing off your stunt skills. Your route runs across a road made from shipping containers, and it is harder than it looks. Several traps line the way, and some containers sit at a slant. Each level gives you five lives, and every time you clear one, a new motorcycle becomes available. When you reach long tunnel ramps, hit NITRO to get over them.

Choose the 2 PLAYER option to face a friend and prove who is the better bike master. Player 1 steers with the arrow keys, uses N for nitro, and presses C to change the camera. Player 2 uses W, A, S, and D to move, T for nitro, and Q for camera. Press R to restart a level.
block-puzzle-jewel: Block Puzzle Jewel is a jewel-themed game about fitting colorful blocks onto a grid. Your goal is to place each piece so that full lines form. There is no time limit, so you can take as long as you need to plan each move. The game tests your sense of space as you work out where every shape belongs.

Thinking ahead matters here, because a careless placement can leave gaps that are hard to fill later. Watching the board closely helps you notice which areas need attention before the grid runs out of room. Keep an eye on the open cells, plan a few moves in advance, and reward your own patience with steady progress.
modern-fps-strike-zombie-gun-war-ops: Modern FPS Strike: Zombie Gun War Ops is a first-person shooter where you fight off zombies. Step into the FPS Strike Modern Arena to sharpen your aim, take on tactical missions, and defeat your enemies in modern warfare. Your aim is to grow into an elite commando.

Missions move quickly, and each firefight tests how well you react. The battles play out in a realistic warzone, where you can pick up advanced guns and a range of weapons for FPS combat. Action keeps coming from start to finish. To play, just click the mouse or tap the screen.
kinder-garden: In Kinder Garden, you take on the role of a kindergarten teacher looking after a group of little ones. Your daily tasks include swapping out diapers, preparing meals and feeding the children, and tucking them in for their naps. Your care helps build a cozy, loving space where young kids can grow and develop well.

Getting around is simple: steer with the joystick. Walk over to the diapers to grab fresh ones, then head to a baby to change them. When it is time to eat, pick up a bottle and bring it to a child. To put someone to bed, carry the baby over to the crib. This clicker, idle and management simulation is built for players who enjoy gentle, caring routines.
crazy-obstacle-blitz-going-ball-3d: Crazy Obstacle Blitz, also known as Going Ball 3D, is a 3D ball game with simple one-click controls. You steer the ball left and right with the keyboard, weaving past obstacles so it keeps rolling forward. Touch an obstacle and the ball is lost, so timing matters. Driving over the acceleration belt gives you a speed boost.

The game offers stunning 3D worlds and effects, crazy speed, and several color skins to choose from. There is no time limit, so you can race at your own pace, and it doubles as a way to ease pressure. Challenges test your extreme speed and quick response while training your motor skills and reflexes. It is a fast reaction-speed game for anyone who enjoys a rush of adrenaline.
unscrew-odyssey: Unscrew Odyssey is a three-dimensional puzzle game about taking screws out of their places. Tap a colorful screw to send it into a free box of the same color. Turn the toy-like models by dragging across them, which can reveal screws that were hidden from view. Some parts stay stuck until you free them, and the levels grow more clever as you go.

Boosters are there for the trickier boards. Keep enough free box slots open, and remove every screw to clear a level. Build a win streak and climb the leaderboard to see how you compare. The game is easy to learn, yet it takes practice to master. On desktop, use the mouse; on mob
draw-path-to-home: Sketch a route and guide your heroes safely to their front door in this relaxed brain teaser. You can gather a group of characters, including Nubik, Huggy Wuggy, Rainbow Friends, Cat Juan, and several others. Click a hero to begin drawing its path, then carry it home while avoiding obstacles and foes. Your goal is to plan the quickest and safest course to the destination.

The game offers puzzles at several difficulty levels, along with plenty of bonuses and gifts to find. Its characters are lively and interesting, and the background music creates a pleasant atmosphere. Unusual enemies add challenge as you experiment with creative lines. Along the way, you develop your logic and exercise your brain.
winter-tale-secrets-and-mergings: Step into a winter fairy tale, where a magical merge puzzle sends you on a quest alongside brave heroes. Your aim is to bring the spirit of Christmas back to a snowy forest and revive its lost enchantment. Each item you combine on the board uncovers more of the forest's ancient secrets and moves the story forward.

Along the way, finish tasks and collect rewards to restore rare artifacts from the fairy tale. Merge identical items to unlock new combinations, and spend resources to help build a better New Year. Colorful visuals and smooth animations give the game a picture-book charm. Daily events and quests offer valuable prizes, and the intuitive controls suit both touchscreens and mouse.
parking-skills: Parking Skills puts you above a car as it moves through a lively city district crowded with obstacles. Each challenge asks you to bring your vehicle into a designated parking spot without bumping into anything along the way. Sharpening your maneuvering skills helps you clear every level and earn the title of master of the streets.
You steer the car with your mouse or by touching the screen. Take on each new challenge, practice your driving, and keep refining your technique until you have worked through all of the levels.
yarn-to-art-arrow-puzzle: Yarn to Art blends arrow puzzles with colorful yarn artwork. Your job is to pull loose the yarn arrows that have an open route ahead, then guide each thread onto a spool of the same shade. Threads that don't match go to a shared spool, which only holds so much. As you finish colored spools, the picture gets stitched together and more of the board opens up. You clear the level once no yarn remains. The game offers 156 puzzles across layered mazes, and you can play with a mouse or by touch.

Along the way you collect finished artwork, unlock outfits, and earn yarn to decorate six cozy rooms by holding the build button. Optional boosters can add storage, clear the reserve, or remove a layer piece, and rewarded videos are available too.
moto-extreme-halloween-land: Step into a Halloween-themed 3D side-scroller where your motorbike rides through dark, mysterious courses. Each track is full of tough obstacles and risky stretches that you must clear while keeping your bike steady. The world is built with a spooky mood, so every stretch of road feels a little eerie.

Your aim is to reach the end of every track by putting your riding skills to the test. Press W or the Up Arrow to move forward and S or the Down Arrow to move backward. Tap A and D, or the Left and Right Arrow keys, to balance the motorcycle as you go.
reindeer-escape: Reindeer Escape puts you in the hooves of a defiant reindeer determined to break free. Your path crosses icy, snow-covered terrain where you must weave past hazards and get around foes. Quick reactions will help you slip past danger, but you will also need to plan ahead to outwit the enemies you meet along the way.

The game is built around a charming pixel art style that brings its wintry setting to life. Along the way you will battle and survive as you work toward the goal of earning your freedom. It is a shooter at heart, so combat is a key part of the challenge.
muscle-clicker-2: Muscle Clicker 2 lets you build a virtual body one tap at a time. Your goal is to reach muscle mastery through simulated strength training, including bench presses and squats. As you train, you earn upgrades to strengthen your character, and you can compete fiercely against others.

Success depends on finding the right balance of power. You work with diverse equipment and choose your strategic upgrades carefully. Adrenaline-pumping challenges test how well you plan and push your progress forward.
bouncing-eggs: This Easter-themed arcade game asks you to catch tumbling eggs in a basket by bouncing them off the cloth the bunnies hold. Each of the game's ten levels has its own target you need to reach before you can move on to the next one.
Control is simple: press the arrow keys to move the bunnies left and right. It is a one-player title built around physics, so every bounce depends on where the cloth sits when an egg arrives,
ultimate-bike-stunt-racing: Ride a wide selection of bikes through tricky stunt courses packed with challenging tracks and fast bike races. Each run lets you show off your tricks and sharpen your balance as you learn the moves that make a stunt rider. Most stages feel simple at first, yet beating the top time on a track can take serious practice. Whether you enjoy the raw speed of a motorcycle or the nimble handling of a stunt bike, this racing title has something for you.

Click or tap the mouse to start playing. Press the Right Arrow to drive forward and the Left Arrow to brake. Use the Up Arrow for a front flip, the Down Arrow for a back flip, and the Space Bar to jump.
warm-paws-merge-and-cat: You inherit a rundown cat shelter with 30 days before it faces closure. Photograph its residents in the merge studio, where you collect poses and fill orders to earn coins for repairs. Ten rooms need restoring, each with its own story and fresh spots for cats.

Between shoots, feed the cats twice a day, bathe newcomers, clean the litter boxes, and sit with the shy ones. Every cat has a temperament worth learning before you choose its family, or it may come back. Adoption interviews help you match each cat to a suitable home, and letters and photos arrive from cats in their new lives. Mini-games include bathing, feeding, puzzles, spot the difference, and night rounds, and progress saves automatically. Tap and drag to play. Finish the day's repairs, feed the cats, and clean up, and the night round begins. Have the shelter in order and the cats placed before the day-30 inspection.
fruits-slice-challenge: Fruits Slice Challenge is a 3D hypercasual game that asks you to chop like a chef and move as quickly as a ninja. Built with HTML5, it runs in the browser on mobile devices and suits kids as well as anyone who wants a relaxing, hard-to-put-down experience. Its food and fruit theme makes every slice feel satisfying.

The controls are easy to learn: tap and hold to chop, then release to stop. Your aim is to reach the finish line while avoiding the various boards, which will damage your knife. Slice with care, and you can work your way toward chopping like a true master.
wild-west-mafia-redemption-gun: Step into the lawless Wild West in this first-person shooter. Tense gunfights with outlaws call for quiet tactics and careful planning, and your goal is to be the last gunslinger standing. Trick rival gangs, pick the gear you want to carry, and complete missions across scenic landscapes.

The game blends stealth with straight-up shootouts, so every showdown asks you to think before you fire. Each mission gives you a fresh chance to outwit the gangs and prove you can hold your ground. If you enjoy shooters with a rugged Western feel, this one is built for you.
sandwich-runner: Sandwich Runner is a hypercasual game where you race along paths lined with food to satisfy a hungry diner. Steer carefully to grab tasty snacks, and keep clear of spoiled surprises that could slow you down. Along the way, you can pick up fiery power-ups, while the playful animations add plenty of personality to each moment.
As you keep going, the challenges ramp up, so precise moves become essential to keep the diner happy. Every run is a burst of bright, messy kitchen chaos.
obby-parkour-sleeping-brainrots: Obby Parkour: Sleeping Brainrots is an arcade game built around parkour jumping. You sprint across the course while weaving past the sleepers, and a massive Brainrot keeps creeping closer behind you, so you must stay ahead of it. Each tough level rewards quick thinking, fast movement, and nimble footwork, and your aim is to keep Brainrot out of harm along the way.

On a computer, use W, A, S, and D to move and the space bar to jump. Move the mouse to rotate the camera, and press E to take or put down a Brainrot. On a phone, a joystick on the left side and on-screen buttons handle movement, while pinching and dragging on the right side of the screen turns the camera.
sand-truck: Sand Truck is a puzzle game about controlling how sand flows. Your task is to guide colorful sands through a network of pipes so that each color reaches the truck it belongs to. The game includes 30 levels, and the layouts grow more complicated as you progress.

Each level asks you to study the pipelines and decide how to sort the sand. Tricky setups put your strategic thinking to the test, and working out a solution feels good once everything lines up. If you enjoy puzzles that reward careful thought, this one gives you a bright, colorful way to practice it.
halloween-hand-care: In this hypercasual health game, you run a creepy little clinic where six good-natured monsters come in for hand treatment. Pick up tools with your mouse or finger and drag them over the matching trouble spot, holding steady to treat it. Puffy fingers need attention, itchy red bumps can be calmed, scratches get covered
world-soccer-game-championship: Step into the boots of a professional footballer in this 3D adventure set around the 2025 World Cup. Build your own career and climb the worldwide leaderboard, aiming to become one of the best players in history. Unlock defenders, curl a perfect shot into the net, and celebrate when your side wins.

Your trophies track your progress through the career, and you can earn great prizes as your team works toward being the best side in the world. Hundreds of matches bring varied challenges that your squad must conquer. The arrow keys move your player, K performs a fast run, N passes, M makes a high hit, and the Space Bar handles long shots, with throws also part of the controls.
war-of-islands-mine-and-craft: War of Islands: Mine and Craft asks you to march your army to victory. You gather resources by mining, then trade them for gold that you can spend on growing your military camp. Build barracks, improve your facilities, and bring in tough fighters to strengthen your side. Once your troops are ready, give the orders and send them against opponents in large clashes. The game is a quick, casual hypercasual title, so it is easy to pick up and play in short bursts.

Every choice you make shapes how your camp develops, so plan where each building goes and when to upgrade. The aim is to build a force strong enough to dominate the islands and see whether you can come out on top.
head-soccer-2023: Head Soccer 2023 is a sports game built around quick, fast matches where good timing and clever positioning matter. Your main tools are jumping and kicking, and getting better at both is the key to winning. You can play single one-on-one matches or join bigger tournaments. Whether you prefer going it alone or challenging a friend, the goal is to read your opponent, outwit them, and work your way toward the championship.
retro-basketball: Retro Basketball is a sports game where you take shots at the hoop and try to rack up a big score. You aim by clicking and dragging, which keeps the controls simple to pick up. The pixel-art visuals give it an old-school feel, and the action moves quickly, so every throw counts. Your accuracy is what matters most here. Nail each shot and you can work your way up the leaderboard.
minimissions: MiniMissions gives you a set of 80 tough skill challenges to work through. Finishing one challenge immediately brings up another, so the run keeps going as long as you keep succeeding. Every task depends on precise timing: you move forward by clicking at exactly the right moment. A single slip ends the attempt, so concentration matters. A few missions also have a clock running, which means you need to react fast.

All you need is your mouse, since every action is a simple click. Keep your focus sharp and watch the timing closely as each new mission appears. Whether you are a quick-reflexes type or prefer careful play, this collection tests how well you can hit the right beat. Your goal is to clear the entire set, one well-timed click at a time.
idle-gold-miner: Idle Gold Miner takes you deep underground in search of gold. You grow a mining operation piece by piece, decide how to spend your resources, and set up automation so earnings keep coming in, even when you are away from the game. Along the way you will run into obstacles, earn extra bonuses, and move through a steady stream of upgrades.

Whether you like tuning your setup for maximum efficiency or simply want a calm session watching the gold pile up, the game fits either style. It is a good pick for anyone who enjoys slowly building something over time and feels the pull of the next discovery.
find-the-vampire: Step into the role of a hunter in this casual 3D game set in a city overrun by vampires. Your mission is to spot the bloodsuckers living among the citizens, eliminate them, and lift the threat hanging over the streets. The creatures disguise themselves as regular folk, animals, or even everyday objects. Special exterminator kits and detectors help you uncover the enemies lurking nearby.
As you progress, you can open new districts and
connect-associations: A cluster of words in Connect Associations hides several meaningful links. Your task is to spot four entries that share a theme and combine them, one step at a time, into a single group. Each correct match brings a category to light. Later levels add fresh word sets and ice obstacles, and frozen words stay locked until you thaw them.

The pace stays relaxed, giving you room to weigh every move. Tap one word and then another, or drag one onto the other, and keep adding related words until four are joined. Each correct merge chips away at the ice, while a wrong pair costs one attempt. Stuck? Shuffle the words or use a hint to keep things moving. Finish levels to earn coins and watch your overall progress grow.
elements-craft-ultimate: Start with only Water, Fire, Earth, and Wind, then blend them into an entire universe. Drop items onto one another to uncover hundreds of distinct recipes in this puzzle game built around alchemy. For instance, mixing Water and Fire gives you Steam. Your collection grows as you go, moving from weather and nature all the way to technology, societies, and magic.

There is no fixed ending, since discovery goes on endlessly. Still, you can show your skill in a few ways: find every element in the catalog, finish daily tasks, regular quests, and global achievements to collect Coins, or race a timer in Time Mode to craft a chosen target element as quickly as you can.
world-war-zombie: World War Zombie is a shooting game where the undead have taken over, and you and your weapons are the best hope for the human race. Accurate aim is essential, since every shot counts. Clever players can also find helpful items that let them take down zombies while saving ammunition. Thinking ahead is what will make you the top zombie hunter.
To play, just click or tap the screen to get going. Aim carefully, pick up the useful extras when you can, and make each bullet count as the horde closes in.
panda-fight: Panda Fight is an animal-themed game built around drag-and-drop controls for staging battles between pandas. You travel through small pixel-art worlds, gathering stars as you go, with the main goal of rescuing the Panda Princess. Each fight rewards careful planning, so thinking ahead matters as much as acting quickly.

Players who like to explore every corner can aim for full completion, reaching 100% in the game. The mix of pixel landscapes, tactical clashes, and star collecting keeps the adventure lively from start to finish. It suits anyone who enjoys animal-themed battles with a strategic edge.
trash-baron: In Trash Baron, waste is treated as a valuable resource rather than something to throw away. You begin with a modest landfill and gradually build it into a modern, high-tech operation. Your job is to gather heaps of plastic, glass, metal, and rubber, then sort each material correctly. Once sorted, you set up production lines that turn items back into useful products, such as making fresh bottles out of old plastic ones.
Selling your goods brings in money, and better quality products earn bigger profits. Use your earnings to purchase
car-crash-tricks-simulator-crazy-stunts: Get behind the wheel of this arcade driving game and send fast cars into chaos. Your job is to smash through barriers and ramps, launch off jumps, and pull off loops and flips. Realistic physics shape every collision, so vehicles can crash, crush, crumble, and explode in many different ways. The game blends stunts and destruction into one driving experience, and you can test your skills to see how big a crash you can create.

The environments and vehicles are detailed, and the crash effects are explosive. Press W or the Up Arrow to accelerate and S or the Down Arrow to brake. Use A and D, or the Left and Right Arrows, to steer. Hold Space for the handbrake, and press Esc to pause or open the options.
call-of-ops-3-zombies: Call of Ops 3 Zombies is a 3D shooter for one player, built around zombie combat. Each round, you must shoot a set number of zombies to get through it, and surviving a round rewards you with new weapons. The game uses realistic physics and spreads its action across three detailed maps.

Your keyboard and mouse handle every action. Use W, A, S and D to move, and left-click to fire. Hold the right mouse button to aim, and scroll the mouse wheel to switch weapons. Press R to reload, Space to jump, and T to activate bullet time.
escape-waves-for-lucky-blocks: Escape Waves for Lucky Blocks is a running survival game in the obby style. Sprint across the map to grab Lucky Blocks as quickly as you can. Dangerous waves arrive regularly, one after another, so you need to dodge them by hiding, running, and surviving.

Over time, you gradually build your base with Brainrots, and each one you unlock can be placed in your setup. Upgrade your area to make room for even more Brainrots. The aim is to keep going and stay alive for as long as possible.
tanks-2d-war-and-heroes: Tanks 2D War and Heroes puts you in charge of a tank and sends you to wipe out enemy units across rough, demanding ground. The battles are played from a top-down view, where planning each move matters as much as firing. You will need to get comfortable with the controls, then build up your arsenal with upgrades so you can slip past opponents and hit them with explosive force.

The game is also described as a side-scrolling adventure, so the action moves across the map as you push forward. Victory depends on quick reactions combined with clever tactics. If you keep the upper hand and control the battlefield, your strategy and sharp timing should carry you to a win.
creative-puzzle: Creative Puzzle mixes coloring with brainwork. Players work through a collection of 32 bright scenes, filling in artwork while also fitting pieces together to complete each puzzle. The game balances artistic expression with a bit of mental challenge, so every picture asks you to think as well as draw.

It is a good fit for younger players, since it gives them room to build both imagination and reasoning skills. As you color and assemble each image, the puzzles steadily become more demanding, growing in difficulty as you progress. It is an easygoing way to combine creative play with logical thinking.
gorilla-multiplayer: Step into the shoes of a gorilla in this online multiplayer title, where you can team up with or face off against people from all over the world. The fast-paced environments reward agility, careful planning, and working together. You climb, swing, and leap across demanding terrain, whether you are competing with friends or working alongside them. Customize your avatar, try various game modes, and join a busy community of fellow players.
Getting around is simple. On PC, use the arrow keys to move your gorilla, and steer the camera and aim with the mouse. On mobile, use the on-screen joystick to move and tap the jump button to jump.
temple-runner: You play as an adventurous explorer sprinting through ruined temples. While you run, you collect gold, and that gold helps you earn cool outfits for your character. Obstacles block the way throughout the run, so you need to stay alert and steer around them as you race onward.

Useful power-ups appear along the route and can give you a helpful hand when you need it. Movement uses the arrow keys to guide your explorer wherever you need to go. Enjoy each dash through the temples and watch your outfit collection grow.
merge-number-up: This brain-teasing number game asks you to think ahead and notice patterns. Your job is to tap clusters of matching numbers so they fuse into a single tile with a bigger value. Larger clusters bring a bigger score, and as the figures climb, the grid calls for more careful planning so you can keep your chain of merges alive.

To play, tap two or more linked tiles that share the same number. Those tiles combine into one new tile with a higher value. Fresh tiles drop in from above to fill any empty spots. Keep combining to push toward larger numbers and try to beat your previous best score.
final-freeway-2r: Final Freeway 2R takes you back to the feel of classic arcade driving games. Your job is to balance speed with precise steering while you slip between cars on the road. A tough rival is on the course, so you will need to beat them to the end. Along the way you can pick different routes, and each choice can change how your run goes.

The pace stays quick from start to finish, and every turn asks you to stay sharp. Your goal is simple: get across the finish line first. If you enjoy fast racing with a retro touch, this one has plenty to offer.
rope-bowing-puzzle: Rope Bowing Puzzle asks you to steer a bowling ball through winding mazes. Each route calls for careful planning, since you need to map out your path ahead of time while watching for surprise obstacles that can throw you off course. The game blends deliberate, thoughtful strategy with lively challenges, so you will need a steady mind and quick hands to get through it.

As you move forward, the levels grow steadily more complicated, testing how well you think and react. Its compelling loop keeps you coming back to try one more stage. If you enjoy bowling games with a puzzle twist, this one offers plenty to chew on.
roll-away-3d: Roll Away 3D borrows the rolling mechanics of ZenRoll, keeping things simple while still drawing you in. You guide a ball with the keyboard, and small, subtle inputs are enough to steer it where you want. As you move through carefully designed levels, you will meet an assortment of obstacles and challenges placed to test your skill and patience. The spacebar makes your ball jump.

The difficulty rises gently, so the experience stays relaxed rather than stressful. Each stage invites you to explore and discover something new around every turn. Use the arrow keys to move left, right, up, and down, and press the spacebar to jump.
truck-simulator-arcade-championship: Climb behind the wheel of massive, powerful trucks in this arcade racer, which rewards both quick reflexes and careful handling. Pick from different truck types and enter demanding races held on assorted courses and ground surfaces. Each event asks you to balance speed with precision, whether you are pushing hard against rivals or finding your line through tricky terrain.

Expect a fast pace, shifting surroundings, and fierce rivalries that keep the tension high. Strategy matters as much as raw power, so plan your moves carefully. Steer and move your truck with the WASD keys or the arrow keys.
draw-path-to-finish: Guide a young heroine across a course packed with dangerous obstacles. The line you sketch becomes the route her moving platform follows, and then you watch to see whether she makes it to the finish. Along the way you will face saws, fire, lava, cannons, explosive barrels, and other traps.

Draw your path by pressing or touching the screen and holding while you drag from the starting point toward the finish. Release to send the platform along the route you created, then guide it around saws, fire, lava, projectiles, and other obstacles. Collect coins to unlock new looks for her. Each level combines its hazards in a different way, so success takes precision, careful planning, and a little courage.
box-playground-punch-it: Step into a three-dimensional boxing arena where every blow lands with real force. Your fighter has stretchy arms that reach out to land hits, so you'll need to plan your moves carefully to get through each stage. A single tap throws a strike, and because the bodies respond with ragdoll physics, every connection sends figures flopping around in funny ways.

As you move forward, you can improve your abilities and take on challenges with friends who want to test their skills against you. Some upgrades unlock superpowers that add an extra twist to your fights, keeping the action going without a break. It's a mix of strategy and goofy physics, so if you enjoy punching your way through silly, unpredictable matches, this one has plenty to offer.
mr-racer-stunt-mania: MR RACER: Stunt Mania is a 3D arcade racer made for mobile devices, suited to both casual drivers and competitive players. Steer with a single touch, speed up, and perform stunts off ramps while dodging flying boxes, barriers, and pitfalls. Five intelligent AI cars share every track, and collisions with them are part of the challenge.

Work through many levels across themes such as Toy House, Metaverse, Port, Candy-Land, and Desert. Finishing levels and placing high in races earns in-game currency, which buys new cars and upgrades to handling, acceleration, and top speed. The main menu links to Settings, the Garage, and the Shop, while on-screen details track your speed, rank, and progress. After each race, a results screen shows rankings and lets you collect rewards.
flowers-garden-merge: In this relaxing puzzle game, you go head to head with other players as you uncover fresh, lovely blooms. Whenever two matching flowers touch, they fuse into a sweet-smelling bloom that pleases you and the bees buzzing nearby. Every flower you place also adds to your score. Your aim is to link up as many blossoms as you can and rise to the top as the best nectar supplier for the bees.

Controls are easy: grab a flower and drag it to the spot where you want to let go. Once released, it drops, and if it lands on another flower, the pair is replaced by a new cluster. Larger flowers are worth more points. When the game ends, you can check where you r
tennis-open-2024: Tennis Open 2024 is a sports game that puts you on the court with realistic physics and tactical play that echo real tournaments. Every serve and return carries weight, so you will feel the pressure as you climb through the rankings. Success depends on good timing, accurate placement, and clever plans against opponents that adjust to how you play. The whole experience is built to pull you in deeply and keep you focused on the match.
hugie-wugie-coloring: Hugie Wugie is a big blue monster from Poppy Playtime, and it also appears in FNF. In this game you meet that blue creature, the one that hunts people, shown alongside our artwork. We have gathered a collection of Hugie Wugie coloring pages made for boys and girls of all ages.

This arcade coloring game is built with HTML5 and runs on mobile devices as well as computers. You can control it with your mouse or by tapping the screen. It is a fun pick for anyone who enjoys coloring.
delta-force-airborne: Delta Force Airborne is a shooter that drops you into the middle of a fierce military conflict. Its visuals and sound are designed to pull you in, so every firefight feels close and real. You will need to plan your moves carefully, because the game rewards players who think ahead rather than rush in.

Teamwork sits at the core of the experience. You work alongside your team across a range of different maps, communicating with teammates and getting past obstacles along the way. Clever tactics are the key to winning, and the decisions you make throughout a match directly determine how it ends.
hexasort: HexaSort is a sorting puzzle built around colorful hex tiles. Your goal is to sort them by color, arranging each tile so that pieces of the same shade end up next to each other. When that happens, the stack disappears.

To play, place tiles on the game board and try to group matching colors side by side. Once neighboring tiles line up, the columns merge and vanish. If you get stuck, you can use the hints for a nudge. It is a mobile-friendly title that leans on logic and matching.
anti-terrorist-shooting-game: You play as an elite commando in a modern war against terrorists. Each mission takes you across realistic terrains, where AI enemies are waiting. Finishing missions is the goal, and auto-shoot paired with swipe-to-aim keeps the action fluid. High-definition visuals and immersive sound fill out the experience.

The game offers six modes. Campaign follows a story of taking down terrorists, while Survival throws endless enemy waves at you. Offline PVP lets you practice against AI opponents, and Zombie Mode tests you against undead attacks. Tank Mode puts you in command of tanks to destroy terrorist bases, and Defuse Mode challenges you to disarm bombs with careful strategy. Weapons and explosives can be upgraded along the way. To start, click or tap. Use W, A, S, and D to move left and right, left tap to shoot, right click to aim, and R to reload.
twining-color-switch-game: Twining Color Switch Game is a ball-themed title that tests how quickly you can think and react. Your job is to spin a color wheel so it lines up with candies as they drop down the screen. Every correct match raises the intensity, and the pace keeps climbing, so you need to work out which color is coming next before it arrives.
Because the challenge never ends, the game is built around staying alert and keeping your focus sharp for as long as you can. It is a steady test of both reflexes and concentration.
scp-173-foundation-escape: You play as SCP-173, working to escape the Foundation's hold on you. This stealth challenge follows one strict rule: you can move only while nobody is watching. Slip into darkness, avoid guards on patrol, and wait for the right moment to dash down unlit hallways. One mistake means capture. Plan each route carefully, use shadows and cover to your advantage, and upgrade your stealth abilities to outmaneuver security forces. One glance freezes you in place, while a wrong move starts
star-wing: Humanity's final chance rests with a single starship that you pilot through deep space. Your task is to defend Earth from waves of alien invaders, and in the process help keep the wider Universe safe from its wicked foes. Expect the enemy numbers to keep climbing while you fly through dangerous surroundings.

As you advance, you unlock the chance to strengthen your craft and let loose its full destructive power. Pick up items along the way to upgrade your current guns or swap them for different weapons. This retro-style space shooter keeps the focus firmly on blasting your way forward.
colored-water-and-pin: Step into a bright, colorful setting where your reasoning and sense of timing get a workout. Your job is to guide colored liquids through tricky puzzles by pulling pins in the right order. The animations are eye-catching, and the challenges grow harder as you move along. Every stage gives your brain a different kind of exercise, mixing easy-to-grasp rules with plenty of depth so the fun keeps going.
grill-match-sort-food: Grill Match: Sort Food is a sorting puzzle played on a hot barbecue grill. You arrange steaks, burgers, shrimp, fresh vegetables, and many other grilled dishes, and each time you match three identical items, they clear from the grill. Your goal is to empty the whole grill, which takes both logic and reflexes.

Every level introduces new ingredients and trickier combinations, so the challenge keeps growing. The game is easy to pick up but takes practice to master. Its juicy BBQ visuals and relaxed mood make it a calm experience, and tapping a food item moves it between grill slots. The collection includes hundreds of puzzle levels, making it a good fit for fans of cozy sorting and puzzle games.
bowling-hero-multiplayer: Bowling Hero Multiplayer puts you in the role of a bowling champion in a match against other players. You can compete with friends or challenge people from around the world. Your aim is to master strikes using one of six varied heroes.

Precise swipes control your throws, so every release counts. Plan each shot carefully, because your goal is to knock down every pin and claim victory before your rivals do. Strategic shots matter here, since each choice you make can decide who wins.
two-bike-stunts: Two Bike Stunts lets you ride in 3D on motorcycles, with eight bikes to choose from across two large maps. Three of those bikes start out locked in the garage, so gather the coins scattered around each map to open them. Two of the maps have ramps where you can pull off dozens of stunts. Any bikes you have unlocked can also be given new skins for a more personal look.

Twisting roads can throw you off balance, so nitro is important for keeping your bike on the road. Player one steers with the arrow keys, uses N for nitro, and switches the camera with C. Player two moves with W, A, S, and D, uses T for nitro, and switches the camera with Q. Press R to restart the level whenever you want another try.
figure-skating-on-ice: Step onto the rink in this free online arcade game about figure skating. It is aimed at girls and is easy to pick up, with dressed-up skaters, partners called cavaliers, and spinning pirouettes to enjoy. Nothing needs to be learned beforehand, and the calm, meditative pace is meant to help ease stress.

To play, press the left mouse button or tap the phone screen, then slide the cursor up or down the scale until it stops on the color you want. The skater shifts into different poses according to where the cursor sits on that scale. It is a simple, relaxing way to feel like a top performer on the ice.
biozombie-outbreak: Step into this 3D single-player shooter set on crowded city streets, where swarms of blood-hungry zombies are closing in. Your job is to gun down every zombie that comes your way, switching between different types of weapons as the situation demands. The whole fight is a race against the clock, so you must survive until time runs out.

Controls are simple to pick up. Move with W, A, S and D, and jump with the space bar. Hold the left mouse button to shoot and the right button to aim. Scroll the mouse wheel to change weapons, press R to reload, and press G to throw a grenade. Press P at any time to pause the action.
rolling-donut: In Rolling Donut, you steer a quirky hero through nonstop waves of clattering false teeth. Sharp dodges and well-timed hops help you squash your foes and build up your points. The game is an arcade title, so expect fast, tense moments where every move matters.
Your reflexes and precision get a real workout here. Each wave asks you to react a little quicker, and the mix of fun and nerve-wracking action keeps you focused from start to finish.
line-control: Line Control asks you to think about paths, strongholds, and fast choices. You sketch lines from your own points toward empty spots and rival outposts, dispatch troops along them, and slowly win ground across the battlefield. Each stage presents a different puzzle. At times you should grab open points before anyone else does, and at other times you need to hold the places that matter most. A single well-planned route occasionally turns the entire contest around. Every base you add to your side makes you stronger than the last.

The controls are simple enough to pick up in seconds, while the difficulty climbs as you advance, so every stage stays demanding and absorbing. Your objective is to seize every enemy point. Watch the numbers printed on each location, since they reveal its attack and defense strength. Hold back some squads rather than committing everything at once, reinforce the positions that count, claim unowned points early, and pick the routes that bring you to victory sooner.
moto-maniac-3: Moto Maniac 3 is a tilt-based bike game that puts your trial riding skills to a serious test. The course winds through a forest, so you will need to climb over trees and rocks along the way. Your main aim is to clear every obstacle as quickly as you can, but a second goal matters just as much. A bear finds your loud engine noise irritating and is chasing you, so you must move fast to avoid getting caught.
The controls are easy to learn. Press Up or W to drive forward and Down or S to drive backward. Use Left or A and Right or D to tilt the bike left or right, and press P to pause.
hit-em-up: Hit Em Up mixes puzzle thinking with arcade shooting. You play a soldier fighting off a zombie outbreak, and your job is to clear each level of undead by firing explosive shots with care. Precise aiming matters, and so does saving your ammunition, since every shot counts. You can also shape the surroundings to your advantage as you work through the stages. The game is built around chasing a high score.

Each level asks you to think a step ahead before you pull the trigger. Plan your shots, make the most of the environment, and keep your supply of shots in mind. It is a challenge that rewards patience and sharp aim, and it is designed to keep you coming back for another run.
idle-zoo: Idle Zoo puts you in charge of forgotten zoos that need a fresh start. Invest your money wisely, expand a range of habitats, and balance strategy with management as you build an animal empire. Your zoo keeps thriving even when you are away from the screen.

Clicker gameplay keeps things moving while you work to attract visitors and boost your earnings. Watching your collection grow into a lively home for animals is the reward, and every choice you make as the leader helps your zoo flourish.
a-and-b-kids: A & B Kids mixes studying and fun. Young players tap letters in alphabetical order, which helps them learn the ABCs while also sharpening their reflexes. The game offers satisfying rewards and bright, colorful graphics that keep things lively.

Its challenges grow gradually harder, which builds skills and helps improve hand-eye coordination. The overall aim is to spark an early interest in learning. It is a cheerful pick for kids who enjoy letters and quick reactions.
the-flowers-merge-and-sell-bouquets: Set in a calm summer garden, this puzzle has you joining blooms together to collect coins. The whole game takes place inside a play area shaped like a doorway. A flower waits at the top and slides along with your finger or cursor. Let go, and it drops down. When two matching flowers touch, they fuse into a new kind of flower.

Watch the top of the screen, because a letter icon there signals a fresh bouquet order from a customer. Sell bouquets to customers for coins, and use your pruning shears to clear away flowers you no longer want. The more coins you earn compared with other players, the higher you climb on the leaderboard.
nullify-merge-math: Nullify is a stripped-back, calming puzzle game where your aim is to wipe the screen clean by combining numbers and math signs. Working through 56 unique, hand-built levels and endless generated ones gives you a chance to sharpen your logic and math skills.

Controls are simple: click and drag each symbol to move it, then merge pieces together until the board is empty. The game offers four infinite modes alongside its levels, and 13 math symbols are available to work with.
deep-space-horror-outpost: Your space cruiser has run out of energy, so you limp into a nearby Deep Space Outpost hoping to refuel. To continue your journey, you must gather eight Energy Cells. The job is harder than it sounds. Humans have abandoned the station, and the only things still there are non-human and bloodthirsty.

Move with W, A, S, and D, and look around with the mouse. Left click fires, and right click aims. Scroll the mouse wheel to change weapons, press G for grenades, R to reload, and F to pick up items. Hold Left Shift to run, press Left Ctrl to crouch, X to go prone, V to melee, and Space to jump.
roadster-dash-halloween-night: Roadster Dash: Halloween Night is a spooky 3D arcade racer where your car can take to the air. Rush along a haunted highway, leap past traffic, and soar, flip or roll sideways to build stunt combos. Collect glowing pumpkins and power-ups under the full moon while ghosts and bats haunt four zones.
Chase a high score solo or challenge a friend in split-screen 2 Player mode. Both drivers share the same
slap-battle-arena-online: Slap Battle: Arena Online is a multiplayer game built around open-hand strikes. Your goal is to gather as many slaps as possible, and you earn them by knocking out other players.
