As you go, the levels become more demanding and vary in layout, so there is always a new arrangement to figure out. The game suits puzzle fans of any age who enjoy working through a problem. It is a good match for anyone who likes a bit of brain-teasing logic.
adventure-time-bullet-jake: Fans of Adventure Time will recognize the cartoon that inspired this arcade shooter. Jake and his best friend take part in a round of Bullet Man, and a cannon launches Jake into the sky so you can find out how far he can fly. Your task is to line up each shot and fire.

Once Jake is airborne, use your ammunition to give him a boost. Gather the coins you come across and spend them on upgrades such as extra life, more bullets, a rocket backpack, or stronger cannon force. Each attempt is a chance to beat your previous distance. Aim and shoot with the mouse, or tap the on-screen buttons on a phone or tablet.
leg-soccer: Leg Soccer is a sports game built around shifting physics, so no two matches play out the same way. Players need to roll with the changes and stay flexible if they want to outscore their rivals. Even as the chaos builds, the core aim stays simple: get the ball into the net.

It takes the familiar feel of classic soccer and bends it into something far less predictable. Each match rewards quick adjustment and calm focus, since the physics never stay the same for long. Keep adapting, outplay your opponents, and work toward earning a legendary reputation on the pitch.
big-donuts-mania: Big Donuts Mania is a puzzle game built around matching colorful donuts while the clock runs down. Each move is a swap between neighboring treats, and smart swaps lead to satisfying sweet combos. Bright, eye-catching visuals keep the sugary theme lively from start to finish.

Your scores place you on a leaderboard, giving every round a reason to beat your last result. Planning a few steps ahead pays off, since the timer keeps ticking. Its sugary challenges are simple to pick up yet tough to put down, drawing in anyone who wants to prove their puzzle skills.
erase-one-part: Erase One Part is an arcade puzzle game where you clear each challenge by wiping away different items. Each stage asks you to follow its instructions and erase the right things to move forward. The game feels calm and relaxing, yet it is easy to keep coming back for another round. It includes 51 unique levels, so there is plenty to work through.

It also works well as an educational pick for kids, since it encourages careful thinking as you solve each puzzle. Whether you are a young player or someone who simply enjoys casual puzzles, this 2D title offers a gentle challenge. Just erase as the instructions say and see how far you can go.
turbo-drive-mode-blitz: Turbo Drive: Mode Blitz is a racing simulation that blends high speed, eye-catching car styling, and a variety of driving challenges. You take the wheel of a supercar you can customize to your liking and race through an open city. One of your jobs is to accept a mission that involves driving a student to school, and finishing the task earns you a reward. Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need.
drive-ahead-sports: Drive Ahead Sports offers a pixelated take on sports showdowns, with you behind the wheel of vehicles on a soccer pitch. The matches are packed with driving fun, and the thrill of racing across the field is part of the appeal. Each game mixes driving with football, so you steer your ride while working toward the ball.

Your job is to kick the ball, push forward toward the opposing team's goal, and aim for victory. Battle-style play adds a competitive edge to every match. To play, simply click the mouse or tap the screen.
infinite-heroes: Infinite Heroes is a card game where every card you play could decide whether you win or lose. You face tough enemies and dangerous ground as you work through a shifting world. Each step requires careful planning, so you need to pick your moves with care.

Your journey follows winding routes where you must move with accuracy, and every clash with an opponent tests your judgment. Along the way you can discover hidden treasures. Through a mix of clever thinking and bravery, you shape the story of your own hero.
tower-necromancer-s: Tower Necromancer's puts you in the role of a necromancer who lives in a tower that the nearby kingdom considers dangerous. Enemies keep marching in, aiming to bring the tower down, so you have to hold them off through wave after wave. Dark magic is your main tool: you can raise skeletons and zombies to fight for you, improve your tower, and add new sections to it. Each enemy type behaves differently, so you will need to plan ahead and find the right response to each one.

Controls depend on your device. On a phone or tablet, touch an enemy with your finger to grab it, then fling it away. On a computer, click with the mouse to pick up an enemy and launch it into the air.
police-car-chaser: Take the wheel of a police car and race through busy city roads in this browser game. Your job is to chase down criminals across a set of missions that test your driving. Dodge obstacles, steer carefully, and keep your targets in sight until every chase is complete.

Controls are simple. Use the arrow keys or WASD to drive and steer, with Up or W to accelerate and Down or S to brake or reverse. Left or A turns left, and Right or D turns right. The Spacebar works as a handbrake where it is supported. The handling feels smooth and easy to pick up, while the challenging roads and obstacles keep each chase demanding.
ghost-sniper: Ghost Sniper casts you as an expert marksman who relies on quiet movement and careful aim. Across more than 30 levels, you slip through each area and take out your targets without being spotted, so every shot has to count. Use your surroundings to your advantage, plan each move in advance, and stay hidden in the shadows as you work through each mission.

This shooter adventure is built around tension. Each stage asks you to think before you pull the trigger, and the pressure grows as you close in on your targets. If you enjoy sniping games where patience matters as much as aim, this one has a lot to offer.
draw-an-obby: Draw an Obby is an obstacle course for players who want a real test of their obby skills. It has 30 levels packed with tough obstacles, so you need to stay alert from start to finish. Its main twist lets you sketch your own shapes to get past the hazards. The game should especially appeal to people who already enjoy Roblox Obby games.

On a computer, move with the WASD keys, press the Space Bar to jump, and hold the right mouse button to adjust the camera view. On a phone, use the game interface to move to any location, and adjust the camera view to look around.
one-line-drawling: One Line Drawing gathers several different games built around tracing drawings with a single continuous line. If you want to unwind, you can pick the calm, easy-going version and let your stress slip away while you enjoy a peaceful stretch of play. If you prefer a mental workout, the puzzle-style levels will put your thinking to the test.

Every mode uses the same basic idea: draw each picture without lifting your pen. The simpler gameplay is meant to help you relax and have a pleasant break, while the harder challenges ask you to plan each stroke carefully. Whatever mood you are in, there is a way to enjoy the game.
halloween-makeup-me: This makeover game lets you transform a girl for Halloween. Many festival-inspired themes are waiting, from beautiful monsters and lovely witches to bloody vampires. Let your personal sense of style guide every choice as you build her look.

When your design is finished, you can take photos of your creation. Share your happy results with friends, or send your pictures to the site to enter the weekly contest called "Best Makeup Designs of the Week." The game is played with a mouse or by tapping the screen.
yummy-churros-ice-cream: Whip up churros ice cream in this bright, hands-on cooking game. You choose the flavors, then build your recipe by adding toppings until it looks and tastes just right. As you move along, you can earn achievements for your progress. Each step of the process feels like a bit of kitchen magic, and the colorful visuals and fun challenges keep things lively from start to finish.

Treat yourself to a sweet session whenever you feel like a snack. Every new combination gives you a reason to experiment, so there is plenty to try. It is a cheerful pick for anyone who enjoys making desserts on screen.
block-blast-jewel-puzzle: Block Blast: Jewel Puzzle is a block-fitting game where you drag pieces onto a grid and clear lines as you go. It offers three ways to play. Classic Mode lets you clear blocks without any pressure, Timer Mode challenges you to think quickly before time runs out, and Level Mode presents stages that call for careful logic and accuracy. The visuals are bright and the movements feel smooth, and a global leaderboard lets you see how your scores compare with players around the world.

The rules are simple enough for anyone to pick up, yet there is room for planning ahead. On a computer, use your mouse or touchpad to drag blocks into the grid. On a phone or tablet, tap a block and slide it into place with your finger. Fans of Tetris, Block Blast, and other brain-training puzzles should find plenty to enjoy here.
slenderman-lost-at-school: This online horror game places you in a dim, unsettling school where Slenderman wanders the halls. You explore the empty building, work through puzzles, and gather items so you can break free from his grip. The game mixes sneaking, careful planning, and fear to pull you into its tense world.

The atmosphere relies on dread, and immersive sound effects keep the suspense building. Stealth is central: you must avoid being caught by Slenderman by moving carefully and staying out of his sight. Puzzles play a major role too, since solving them opens up new areas of the school.
mowmentum: Mowmentum is a calm idle game about cutting grass. You steer your tool through a garden that has grown wild, trimming grass and plants while collecting money. That money goes toward upgrades, and over time you unlock better hand tools, automatic mowers, fresh areas to work on, seeds, beetles, and other things that help you reshape the yard and build up your collection.

To play, move your mouse to guide the tool you have equipped around the garden. Press Tab or click the Shop button to open the shop, then use the mouse to buy upgrades and pick out tools. When you are done browsing, click the X button to close it.
tiny-sports-empire-idle: Build a small team into a large sports club in this clicker-style manager. You can compete in basketball, hockey, soccer, rugby, volleyball, and baseball. Cash keeps arriving even while you are away, and you spend it on training plans, win chance boosts, new sports, recruits, and gear. Team power rises with each choice, while matches play out automatically.

Idle income, offline rewards, special events, skills, and season progress all push your franchise forward. On desktop, use the left mouse button to press buttons, switch tabs, and open settings. Click the Sports button to view or change sports and check league progress. On mobile, tap buttons and event cards, then tap and scroll through panels.
mavy-the-fish-mom: Mavy is a caring fish mom who looks after her little ones by preparing meals for them. The game is an idle farming title. You begin with simple tools, and once you have saved enough money, which you gather from the fish, you can upgrade them. Buying fish eggs lets you collect more valuable coins.
To raise a new child, buy an egg, equip it, and place it in the nest. Then wait while your little one hatches.
mfps-military-combat: MFPS: Military Combat is an action game built around gunfights in a 3D, first-person view. Chaos fills every round, so you have to survive while you hunt down rival players. Your goal is to eliminate them and rise as the champion of the battlefield. Its army setting and multiplayer PvP battles give it a competitive feel.

Getting started is simple. Move with the WASD keys, and use a left mouse click to attack. A right mouse click opens up special actions. Keep those three controls in mind, and you'll be ready to face the battlefield.
unno-game: Unno Game puts its own spin on the familiar card game you may already know. Your aim is to outwit your opponents by playing special cards that change how each round unfolds. The game is easy to pick up, and its bright, colorful visuals keep the screen lively. You can enjoy it alone or invite others for a multiplayer match.

Winning takes planning ahead and choosing your moves with care, since the right play at the right time can shift the match in your favor. Don't forget to call out "Uno!" before your rivals do. Keep an eye on your hand and on what your competitors are doing, and you'll be ready for your next move.
subway-surfers-zurich: Subway Surfers World Tour: Zurich 2020 is the 121st update of Subway Surfers and the 115th entry in the World Tour series. This version brings back Hugo, who is offered as a Season Hunt reward, and adds a new Pirate Outfit that costs 30 Keys. Clockwork also returns as a Season Hunt prize.

Your goal is to keep your runner going for as long as possible while jumping over barriers and dodging obstacles. On a computer, the arrow keys control your runner, and the spacebar activates your skateboard.
rapid-apex-rush: Rapid Apex Rush lets you take the wheel of a fast formula-style race car. Your job is to handle sharp bends with care, time your turns accurately, and use strong speed boosts to keep your position in the field. On high-speed tracks you will need quick reactions to avoid other cars and obstacles, all while working out the quickest line through each corner.
Steering is done with the arrow keys, and any further instructions can be found inside the game itself. Tags for this title include Best Games, Cars, Multiplayer, and Race.
sports-minibattles: Sports MiniBattles brings together a set of sport-themed mini games in one place. You can face the computer or a friend using split controls. Four different sports are on offer, and each match is an intense contest where you aim to outscore your rival. The first player to score five times takes the win, so stay focused and make every point count.

The 2D graphics look appealing, and the physics make the action entertaining. Player one moves with A and D, jumps with W, and smashes with the space bar. Player two uses the left and right arrows to move, the up arrow to jump, and either the 0 key or Enter to smash. If physics-based play appeals to you, 12 MiniBattles is a similar game.
epic-mine: This adventure title asks you to plan your resources carefully and react quickly at the same time. Your goal is to tunnel down toward the planet's core and rescue your bearded companions who have landed in trouble. As you descend, you move through dark passages, look for concealed secrets, and improve your abilities. Treasures you find can be smelted and then sold.

Pack your dynamite before you set off, because the deeper you dig, the more explosive surprises wait in the depths. Keep an eye on your supplies and your timing, since both matter when danger appears. Each trip underground brings new things to discover and a chance to grow stronger.
draw-flag-asmr-painting-games: Draw Flag: ASMR Painting Games lets you sketch your country's flag on rough paper, filling it with bright colors and lively animations. You work out the right hues, then drop the tiles into their exact spots. A flag guessing contest tests how well you know the colors of Asian and European flags, and you need that knowledge to win the quiz competition. Along the way, you learn more about the colors used on flags from countries around the world.

The game has two modes. In Guess the Country, a flag image appears on screen and you must name the country it belongs to. In Make the Flag, you draw designs and paint them with accurate colors, and the mode suits learners of every age. To play, tap a color to select it, tap a flag section to paint it, and tap another color to switch. Complete all sections correctly to finish the level.
brick-out-candy: Brick Out Candy is a colorful arcade game where you bounce a ball into candy bricks to smash them apart. Precise shots are the key to success, and you can collect power-ups along the way to give you a boost. Aim high to reach the upper bricks while keeping the ball in play, and rack up points as you go.

As you advance, the levels grow trickier, so you will need sharp timing and careful aim to clear them. The whole experience is themed around sugary treats, giving the classic brick-breaking idea a bright and playful look. It is a fun pick for anyone who enjoys arcade challenges with a sweet twist.
harvest-rush-tractor-farm: Steer a boxy tractor across a field of tall grass and watch each patch break apart into cubes. The cubes load onto your trailer, and you park on the glowing market pad to sell them for coins. You can steer with WASD, the arrow keys, or by dragging anywhere on the screen. Purple thornberry bushes need blade level 3 before they can be cut.
Spend your coins on upgrades for your blade, trailer, engine
hit-master: Hit Master is an arcade shooter built around accuracy, where each bullet has to count. You plan your shot angles and bounce rounds off surfaces to take down waves of outlaws in a messy Wild West setting. Your ammo is limited, so taking time to aim carefully is what keeps you alive and helps you rack up a higher score.
The game includes several different modes, each offering its own type of challenge, so the action changes as you go. Expect plenty of explosive moments along the way.
top-shootout: Saddle up for a trip to the Old West in Top Shootout. Your job is to test your quick reactions by hunting down outlaws while keeping the local townspeople safe from harm. Collect useful supplies along the way, and keep your aim steady, because the pressure ramps up as the action builds.
Your aim is to post the highest score you can in this cowboy shootout adventure. Stay focused as the action heats up, since every shot you take counts toward that goal.
art-master-puzzle: Art Master Puzzle combines two pastimes, puzzles and coloring books, into a single game. You rebuild a picture from its parts, beginning with a plain black-and-white image. Colorful pieces wait along the bottom of the screen. Your job is to find where each one belongs and tap it into the matching spot. As each piece settles in, the picture gradually fills with bright color.

The game offers a range of unique pictures to color and collect. Free hints are available whenever you get stuck on a tricky spot. Once a picture is finished, it animates and comes to life so you can admire your work. The graphics are bright and colorful throughout, which keeps every puzzle cheerful and easy on the eyes.
square-hero-bird: In Square Hero Bird, you guide a bird hero who builds an egg tower to get past the barriers in its way. Smooth handling is essential, and so are good timing and picking the right level. Hit the grass three times with clean landings to fire a shot that clears every obstacle in your path.

You can steer everything with a mouse or by touch. The game sits in the hypercasual category and is tagged arcade, bird, casual, and jump. Keep your tower steady and your timing sharp to get through each stage.
run-rich-3d: Run Rich 3D is a 3D arcade game where you race to the end of the track. Along the way, you try to gather as many money bills as you can. The more cash you collect, the better your outfit looks. Be careful, though. If you pick up too many bottles, trash cans or bills, you become poorer and risk losing everything.
The game is simple and intuitive, with controls that are easy to remember. To move, just drag. Its clear setup lets you keep your attention on the track and on the money you are collecting.
counter-craft-zombies: Counter Craft Zombies is an adventure game that blends shooting tactics with survival play. You gather an arsenal of weapons and fire HD bullets while outmaneuvering the undead across worlds built from pixels. Staying mobile is key, and you need to plan each move to stay ahead of the attackers.

The enemies are blocky Minecraft zombies that keep coming in an unending stream, so every shot has to count. Deciding when to fire and when to reposition can determine how long you last against the horde. The game challenges you to see whether you can endure the zombie apocalypse, testing your focus and quick thinking from start to finish.
agent-j: You play as an elite agent in Agent J, a shooting game where battles call for both quick moves and clever thinking. Your agility and cunning help you outwit tough enemies. Before each fight, choose your arsenal carefully, since the right weapons can change how things go. Move through perilous surroundings and work to uphold justice in a dangerous world.
Every encounter brings suspense, and each one tests how well you plan ahead. If you enjoy shooters that reward careful strategy, this title puts your tactical skills to the test.
real-driving-simulator: Real Driving Simulator puts you in the driver's seat of a lifelike driving experience built around racing and the rush of the road. Start by unlocking a range of different vehicles, then take each one out through city streets and race circuits. The game aims to make you feel what it is like to actually sit behind the wheel.

Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need to get moving. Whether you enjoy simulation titles or fast-paced racing, this one gives you a realistic take on both, with the Car, running, and Simulation tags describing its focus.
egg-escape-tycoon: In this colorful, blocky tycoon, your goal is to slip into well-guarded biomes, lift eggs from the animal guards, and dash back to your base before they catch you. Once eggs are planted at home, they hatch into pets in a range of sizes and rarities, and those pets generate coins every second. You can spend those coins in shops, build your speed on the treadmill, unlock trails, or rebirth for stronger multipliers.
Up to four people can share the same world, though timing matters since the biomes l
highway-racers: Highway Racers puts you behind the wheel for a driving challenge where you weave through busy traffic on your way to the finish line. Your goal is to reach the end of each track, and along the way you can pick up cash and powerups that help you get there.

Steering your car is easy: use the WASD keys or the arrow keys to control it. Keep an eye on the traffic ahead, grab the cash you pass, and collect powerups whenever you can. Each run is about finishing the track while staying in the race.
escape-school-duel: A quick, humorous, and nerve-wracking escape game where a school refuses to let its students go. Chase your personal best time alone, or bring a friend and turn every hallway into a sprint toward freedom. One moment you are ducking past traps, and the next you are sneaking by the principal in a lengthy corridor or getting around a teacher lurking near a classroom. Each section brings its own hazard, so memorizing the building's layout is a big part of winning.

Player 1 moves with W, A, S, and D, jumps with Space, and runs with Left Shift. Tap Space twice to double jump. Player 2 moves with the arrow keys, jumps with L, and runs with K. Tap L twice to double jump.
slow-time-ninja: In Slow Time Ninja, you play a stealthy warrior who relies on timing and accuracy. Swipe to throw your weapon at enemies. While you still hold it, time crawls forward, giving you room to study the battlefield and plan your next move. Once the weapon leaves your hand, time returns to its normal pace, so every throw needs careful thought.

Your goal is to defeat all the enemies on the battlefield. Keep watching your surroundings, because some foes are faster, stronger, or craftier than they first appear. Use the environment and the time-slowing mechanic to outwit them. Stay hidden, stay patient, and strike with calm, precise control.
obby-the-legendary-dragon: Obby The Legendary Dragon is a pet catching simulator made with Pokemon fans in mind. You can journey through several Roblox worlds and level up heroes, all in one place. Collect health and upgrade your hero so you can explore the worlds the game offers.

Pets come in several ways. You can catch them during battles, hatch them from cases and eggs, or buy and trade them to build a team of strong helpers and friends. Money is earned as you play, and it helps you upgrade your Obby character, which also advances through ranks and titles.
On PC, use the AWSD keys to run, Space to jump, Tab to show or hide the cursor, and the mouse to turn. On smartphones, move with the joystick to run, and the up arrow is used to jump.
foxytruck: Foxy sets off on a tractor run to help friends stuck in harsh weather. At the poles he clears ice so penguins can get free. In the deserts he gathers cacti to bring water to thirsty foxes, and in the forests he smashes rocks to collect carrots for hungry rabbits. Each area has its own job and its own bright scenery.

To play, pick the right attachment for the job, drive your tractor, and finish every one of Foxy's tasks. On a keyboard, use the arrow keys to move, Ctrl to brake, and Shift to swap attachments. On a phone or tablet, swipe to drive, tap once to stop, and double-tap to switch attachments.
tap-gallery: Tap Gallery asks you to put your thinking skills to work as you clear a path to reveal pictures hidden beneath a grid of blocks. Each puzzle has its own layout, so no two brain teasers feel the same. Working through the logic keeps your mind sharp and can ease tension while you play.

To progress, press the blocks that carry arrows so they slide out of the way. Think ahead about each move so you can clear the board in as few steps as possible, and your problem-solving will sharpen with practice. When you get stuck, boosters can remove several blocks at once. Finish harder and harder puzzles to unlock new levels and become a true master of the tapping challenge.
violent-shooter: Violent Shooter is a relaxed 3D shooting game with a casual feel. You can choose between a sniper rifle, a Gatling gun, and a rocket launcher, and you can also call on your piggy buddies to help you take out enemies. Your aim is to defeat foes, collect treasure chests, and take on new levels as you go.

Controls are simple, since a mouse click or a tap is all you need to play. It is a single-player game, so you face every challenge on your own. The Fire tag hints that flames and blasts are part of the action, so expect plenty of gunfire as you work through each stage.
baby-taylor-babysitter-daycare: Taylor's aunt has an urgent meeting at work today, so Taylor and her mom are stepping in to look after her baby cousin, who is not yet one year old. Caring for a baby takes more effort than it might seem, and you can pitch in. Feed him, play with him, and keep up with whatever else the day brings.

Watch for a dirty diaper, because it needs cleaning right away. If you wait, the baby will become upset from the discomfort. The game also includes cooking, cleaning, and dress-up activities, and it teaches you what it takes to be a good babysitter. Everything is controlled with a mouse click or a tap.
arrow-rescue: Trapped animals have ended up stuck in dangerous mazes, and it is up to you to free them through careful thinking. Tap the arrows and pull them in the right sequence so that obstacles disappear, hidden paths open, and each creature finds its way to safety. Every stage brings fresh challenges that test your logic and planning.
The game feels calm and easy on the eyes, with colorful visuals and hundreds of carefully designed levels. Avoid blocking the only escape route, and
hotfoot-baseball: Hotfoot Baseball is a sports game you control with simple one-tap inputs. Its pace is fast, so your timing and strategy decide whether you come out on top. Begin by selecting the nation you want to represent. Then aim for precise swings at the ball and dash between the bases as you chase the championship.

Each decision you make brings you a little closer to victory, and the game is designed to deliver a true-to-life sense of excitement along the way. Stay focused from the first moment to the last, because one well-timed move can change the outcome.
redboy-and-bluegirl: RedBoy and BlueGirl is a two-player arcade game that mixes team play with the fire-and-ice style many fans remember. Its story unfolds in a dark forest maze, where players may feel a sense of nostalgia for adventures from their childhood. You guide the red boy, Fire Boy, and his partner, the blue water girl, through a puzzle adventure that they must tackle together.

Movement is handled entirely with the arrow keys. The game runs in the browser as a 2D title built with HTML5 and WebGL, and it is tagged as funny and suitable for kids. Because both characters must work together to progress, you and a friend will need to coordinate your moves.
demon-killer: Demons keep coming in this shooting game, and you are the one standing between them and the rest of the world. Quick reactions are just as important as accurate aim, and each wave of attackers is more intense than the last. You must survive these onslaughts while deciding which weapons to strengthen along the way.

Your arsenal offers a wide range of weapons, so switching between them keeps every battle fresh. Plan your upgrades carefully, because a smart choice can be the difference between falling and holding on. The stakes are high from start to finish, since you are humanity's final hope and the goal is to save the world from the hellish invasion.
donutosaur-2: Donutosaur 2 sends your dinosaur through strange, playful worlds packed with fans, portals, and delicious flotation gear. The game offers 25 creative stages, and each one asks you to hunt down hard-to-reach stars. Expect puzzles that test both your thinking and your patience. Every stage can be revisited whenever you like, and the whole adventure is free and works unblocked.
Collecting the stars is the main goal, and each level pushes you to think carefully before moving on. This dinosaur title suits anyone looking for a mix of brain
duelers: Your mission in this adventure is to rescue a princess held by wicked captors. You begin with a dependable sword and must find your way past dangerous hazards while battling the enemies who block your path. Planning and skill matter just as much as quick swings, so think carefully about which foes you choose to challenge.

Each victory can earn you upgrades that make the journey easier, and every clash gives you a chance to fight for honor. Travel across the entire kingdom as you work toward the princess's freedom, knowing that each decision shapes how far you get.
cats-block-puzzle: In this puzzle game, you place cats by dragging them onto a board and try to get every one to fit perfectly. Each board has its own shape, and the challenge grows as you move through the levels, so your brain has to approach problems in fresh ways. The game features a range of cats, including chubby ones and grumpy ones, and you should aim to fit them all without making any of them upset.

Solving puzzles raises your level and unlocks new cats to collect as you progress. You can also dress your cats in cute costumes to personalize them. Along the way you build thinking skills and spatial reasoning through shape-based challenges that become tougher over time.
guess-monster-voice: Guess Monster Voice is a quiz-style game built around sound. You hear the voice of a mythical creature and try to work out which legendary being made that chilling noise. It works on both mobile and desktop, and you can play it for free.

Listen closely to the monster's characteristic sounds, then pick the matching creature from the options provided. If you choose the wrong answer, you lose and have to start over. When a challenge feels too difficult, you can use the hint, which helps you get past it more easily.
juice-tycoon: Juice Tycoon mixes arcade action with idle play, and it feels both soothing and hard to put down. Your goal is to grow a juice business from scratch. Gather fruit, press it into tasty drinks, and sell them to customers who want something cool to sip. The money you earn can go back into the business to unlock new kinds of fruit, speed up your machines,
ring-fall-puzzle: Turn the rings to find your way out in Ring Fall Puzzle, a game that blends strategy with precision. You work through twisting mazes using controls that are easy to pick up, steering round shapes toward their goal. Careful planning and steady hands both count here.

Every stage checks how quick your reactions are and how well you solve problems, and the layouts become harder as you advance. The game is designed to stay entertaining without end, and it suits players of every age.
flappy-alien: Steer a playful alien through a space-themed obstacle course in Flappy Alien. Tapping is all you need to control it, and the tap-based controls feel natural right away. Your job is to avoid asteroids while the game gets faster, so your reflexes have to keep sharpening. Each flap keeps your alien aloft as the hazards in deep space change unpredictably.

The game has a retro feel that brings back memories of classic arcade play, and it asks for good timing and steady precision. If you enjoy a challenge built around rhythm, this one delivers that test in a cosmic setting.
dino-simulator-city-attack: The year is 2024, and dinosaurs have been extinct for ages, yet they roam alongside people in a busy city. Peace isn't really the rule. This lifelike dinosaur game lets you pick from several species of these huge creatures, then walk, sprint, wreck, crush, leap, cause chaos, or try almost anything you like in a free-roaming 3D world. You can also choose your favorite dinosaur before you start.
Advance through multiple levels as they unl
goblin-clan: Goblin Clan drops you into a fanciful land where speed of thought and careful planning will carry you forward. As you wander through its playful landscape, you must slip past those who want to capture you while gathering loot along the way. Each challenge you face earns experience, and building that experience unlocks rewards. A powerful sorceress is also in the mix, and you must outwit her. Expect a fast-paced arcade journey that is hard to put down.
paint-pop-3d: Paint Pop 3D is a shooting game you can control with a single tap, and it is easy to pick up for long play sessions. Each tap splashes paint, and holding your finger down keeps the fun going. Your goal is to coat every slice on the ring, and you need to dodge the obstacles along the way, since touching one ends the run.
The game offers more than 1000 levels, along with many challenging missions to work through. You can also choose from a variety of characters and themes, and the visuals are attractive throughout.
mad-city-matrix: In Mad City Matrix, you battle agents across a large open-world city in this 3D shooter. Your goal is to defeat every agent that comes after you, using powerful punches along with plenty of weapons. Each level has a time limit, so you must survive until the clock runs out.

Movement uses the WASD keys, and the left mouse button fires your weapon. Hold the right button to aim and scroll the mouse wheel to switch weapons. Press R to reload, Space to jump, and T to activate bullet time. It is a one-player game that mixes action, fighting, and shooting.
purrrification: This 2D pixel platformer, filed under puzzles, looks harmless at first. You hop between platforms, collect things along the way, and push forward through seven levels that grow harder. Then something starts to feel off. Layouts shift, sounds warp, and the screen seems to react to you. It is meant to be more than a simple game.

Hidden easter eggs are waiting to be discovered, and intentional glitches can change how the game plays. The distortion builds over time, altering the environments, sounds, and interface as you go. Metanarrative elements and unexpected behaviors keep you guessing, and even the menu can deceive you. To begin, click or tap.
superstar-kitty-fashion-award: Step into a colorful world of cat fashion, where you take on the role of a makeover artist. In Superstar Kitty Fashion Award, your job is to turn feline clients into glamorous stars using your sense of style. You pick from a range of treatments and tools across fun mini-games, helping each charming cat look and feel great from the outside in.

The game is all about creative styling and playful variety. Each mini-game gives you a different set of tools to work with, so you can keep experimenting until your clients shine. It's a light, cheerful title for anyone who enjoys dressing up animals and watching them transform.
miner-builder: In this simulation game, you play a builder aiming to construct the highest tower on the planet. You climb into heavy machinery and handle the controls. A bulldozer lets you gather blocks from the ground, while a crane is where you stack cubes into a house and collect coins for your work. To step into either machine, walk up to it and wait for its gauge to fill. Press the button to climb back out.

Movement works with the on-screen joystick, WASD keys, or arrow keys. Head to the upgrade menu and press the button to improve your machines and your character. Upgrades also open new kinds of cubes to build with. Once you have saved enough coins, you can buy a conveyor belt or hire an assistant.
crazy-knife: Crazy Knife casts you as a cook whose best tool is a blade that slices at lightning speed. You chop as frantically as you can, but obstacles along the way can drain your score and wear down your knife's sharpness. Your challenge is to balance raw speed with careful precision.
The action is fast-paced from start to finish, so quick reflexes matter as much as steady focus. Play well and you can climb the culinary ranks, showing how far your inner chef can go.
heroes-of-the-dungeons-match-3-rpg: Gather heroes of legend, push back the monsters, and help restore a kingdom that has fallen in this match-3 adventure. A mysterious gate has released evil creatures across the land, cutting the realm off from the outside world. You are the Master of Hunters, the last hope for the people. Line up gems to unleash strong attacks, build chain reactions, and time your hero skills for the perfect moment.

Matching three or more tiles hits enemies and charges your team's skills. Swap neighboring tiles to create combos and special blocks that deal heavy damage. When a hero is ready, use their ability to strike an enemy's weak point and turn the battle around. Win fights to collect loot and materials, then spend them upgrading castle shops for better income and stronger heroes in later
combat-zombie-warfare: Combat Zombie Warfare is a realistic shooting game where you face off against zombies, enemy soldiers, and real players from all over the world. Choose the weapon and the map you prefer, then push through every level of the campaign. In this virtual battle, shooting is all you need to do.
Use WASD to move, and rely on the mouse to aim, look around, sh
pager-war: Pager War is a casual strategy game about armies clashing on the battlefield. You use energy to summon soldiers, and those soldiers hold back the enemy attacks coming your way. Deciding when to summon and how to spend your energy keeps each round engaging from start to finish.

The game includes a level mode and an endless challenge mode. Everything is controlled with a simple mouse click or tap. The title sits in the Fighting category and is tagged with .io Games, Army, Stickman, and War.
cat-box-merge: Cat Box Merge is a laid-back puzzle game about boxes, cats, and merging. Tap to open boxes and meet adorable felines, then combine two identical cats to get a rarer pet. Cats you place on beds lend a hand and slowly deliver fresh boxes, helping you keep moving forward. Each cozy world has its own mood, look, and cast of characters, and as you advance you will find new cats, nice rewards, boosts, and a steady sense of growth.

It suits anyone who enjoys relaxing clicker games, merge mechanics, collecting, and a sweet atmosphere. Set your own pace, build up your collection, and gather more fluffy companions. Coins buy new boxes, and you can also collect bo
make-the-glass-happy: Guide flowing water along paths you sketch, then pour it into a waiting glass. Each level calls for logic and a bit of creativity, and your lines must bring the glass to a happy state. The game mixes drawing with physics, so every stroke you make changes how the liquid moves.
On a computer, press the left mouse button to draw a shape. On a phone or tablet, draw by tapping the screen. The game supports mobile devices as well as computers.
super-watermelon: Super Watermelon is a puzzle game where you combine smaller fruits to build up to one big watermelon. Every drop needs careful thought, since the play area is cramped and leaves little room for error. The physics are quirky, so fruits do not always move the way you expect. Along the way, surprise elements can shake up your plans, and you can unlock clever moves to help you out.

The game has a bright, colorful look and keeps the fun going from start to finish. Your goal is to become a skilled fruit alchemist by planning each merge so you can reach that juicy final reward. It suits anyone who enjoys thinking a few steps ahead while watching fruit transform on screen.
bus-crash-stunts-2: Bus Crash Stunts 2 puts you behind the wheel in a bus driving simulator built around wrecks and tricks. The demolition arena is your playground, where you can smash into obstacles and pull off daring jumps. The game aims for a realistic atmosphere and offers racing, long leaps, and heavy collisions. Parts of your bus can break off, and the
bullet-army-run: You take on the role of a commander in Bullet Army Run, where your job is to lead a group of bullets across parkour platforms. It sits in the puzzle category and works as a light, relaxing game that still asks you to plan ahead and react quickly. As you go, pick up extra bullets so your squad keeps growing.

Watch out for hazards such as cutters, hammers, and similar obstacles that can get in your army's way. Steering the team safely past each one is the main challenge. Controls are simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to play.
wall-kickers: In Wall Kickers, you break through the barriers that crowd everyday places like offices, classrooms, and busy streets, giving you a way out of their dull routine. Every crash leaves you feeling lively and tougher than before. You control your furious Hulk-style buddy as he charges ahead and knocks down each wall standing in his way.

Clear more than 50 levels to earn the title of Smash God. Speed is handled with the mouse, so move it to pick up pace and keep the destruction going. The game is listed in the Action category and tagged with 3D Games, kiz10, running, and Superhero.
hidden-paint-3d: Hidden Paint 3D is a hidden object game built in 3D, where color brings everything to life. One click on an item changes it into vivid shades almost instantly. The gameplay is simple and calming, so players of any age can enjoy using it to express their creativity.

Your task is to locate every item on the list, then tap each one to color it. Once you have finished a scene, you can move on to a new location with a different environment. Drawing and color sit at the heart of the experience, making it a relaxed choice for anyone who likes creating something colorful.
narcos-crime-master: You play as a budding mob leader in a bright city made of low-poly shapes. You drive through its streets, go up against rival gangs, and tackle missions that combine car chases, sidewalk brawls, and shady deals with real danger. Each job you finish helps build your reputation as you climb the ranks of the city's criminal underworld.
Steering and movement use the W, A, S, and D keys or the arrow keys. On phones and tablets, touch controls handle the same actions.
run-fish-run: Run Fish Run takes you through a never-ending sea full of bright, colorful scenery. You steer a rebellious fish hero through the water, and every stretch of the ocean feels lively and full of motion.

Your job is to weave past hazards with quick reactions and to time your jumps to a steady rhythm. Grab power-ups along the way to keep your fish safe. As the journey continues, the challenges grow tougher, putting your agility and strategic timing to the test.
pixel-paint-sort: Pixel Paint Sort mixes pixel coloring with tile sorting. You shuffle colorful tiles and fit each one onto the peg that matches its color. As you go, the pixel image gradually appears, so each move reveals a little more of the picture until a jumbled board becomes a complete scene.

To play, tap a tile to select its connected group of the same color, then move those tiles onto open matching pegs. The tray lets you set tiles aside for a moment while you plan your next moves. Complete every color to reveal the full pixel picture. The level is finished once every tile sits on its matching peg.
truck-factory-for-kids: Truck Factory For Kids is a bright, colorful learning game made for little ones in kindergarten. It costs nothing to play, and it welcomes boys and girls alike. Anyone who loves cars, trucks, or building-style games will feel right at home here.

The game is built around educational truck games with themes like adventure, cleaning, collecting, and design. You play by tapping or clicking. We hope children enjoy learning about trucks as much as they enjoy playing.
sword-master-slice-your-enemies: Sword Master: Slice Your Enemies! is a free 3D action game where you clear your path by cutting down foes and smashing obstacles. You can wield knives, sabers, blades, and other melee weapons, including lightsabers inspired by Star Wars. Your goal is to become a skilled blade fighter, working through numerous levels that each bring their own challenges. As you advance, you unlock new weapons to try.

Each strike shifts into slow motion, so you can savor every slice. On a PC, hold the left mouse button to attack, then move the mouse in the direction you want to cut. On mobile devices, swipe across the screen to slice enemies. Fans of Swing Blade or Slash the Enemies to Pieces! should find plenty to enjoy here.
jungle-bricks-breaker: Jungle Bricks Breaker takes you deep into a leafy jungle, where quick reactions and careful aim matter most. Your job is to knock out colorful bricks across a series of levels by learning how the ball rebounds off each surface. Moving your paddle with purpose is a big part of the challenge, and the game keeps things fresh with varied challenges that keep you on your toes.
ninja-clash-heroes: Ninja Clash Heroes puts you in command of a team of skilled fighters. You can choose a sneaky ninja Scout, a heavily armored samurai, a wise Buddhist monk, or a sniper Geisha who strikes from a distance. The battles take place in a lovely oriental garden, though the scenery is easy to overlook because enemies are working to steal the Fortune Cat you have sworn to guard.

Unlock your class's special powers and collect stars to open crates filled with weapons and boosters. You can also upgrade your hero and earn medals along the way. Controls: WASD moves, SPACE jumps, G throws a grenade, C crouches, right mouse button aims, and TAB opens the score table.
escape-from-the-portal: Escape from the Portal sends you through dim, underground tunnels where traps lie in wait and creatures lurk in the dark. You will need to fight off monsters while uncovering clues about what happened in this place long ago. Your goal is to gather magical artifacts and use them to open the portal and break free from the underworld.

The game has a bleak, unsettling mood, with a strange otherworld full of hidden secrets and dangers. Move with WASD, and use items or interact with E or the left mouse button. Press H for a hint, C to open the shop, and TAB to check your inventory. Keys 1 through 4 let you pick magic for quick actions.
torture-the-trollface: Torture the Trollface is an action game where you get to punish a trollface dummy. You can take your time with it or finish the job fast, whichever you like. Coins are scattered around to collect, and they help you unlock every weapon in the game. Your arsenal includes knives, machine guns, a shotgun, spikes, bombs, traps, and more, all ready to use on the troll.

The whole game runs with a mouse or on a touchscreen, so you can start right away on either device. It's a cartoonish, over-the-top title that fits well with the Action, Cartoon, and Crazy tags it carries.
bushman-bamboo: Bushman Bamboo takes you on a tribal adventure where precision and timing are key to getting ahead. Your job is to stretch bamboo sticks across perilous gaps so you can keep moving safely. The controls feel intuitive from the start, and the visuals are genuinely striking to take in.

Whether you have a spare few minutes or want a longer run, the game is built for both. Each new level tests your abilities, and the challenge rises steadily as you move forward, with the excitement growing along the way.
cavern-run-endless-runner-game: Cavern Run is an endless runner played in a side-scrolling view, where you race through underground tunnels that never seem to end. Your job is to dodge the hazards blocking your route, react quickly with fast moves, and gather power-ups that help you stay alive in the murky deep.

Success depends on both quick reflexes and smart planning, because the challenges keep changing as you go. Each attempt tests how long you can hold out in the shadowy caves, so be ready for a tense, fast-paced journey through the dark.
mr-orange-flappy-jump: Mr. Orange is the star of this arcade game, and your job is to guide him through a colorful world. Tapping makes him fly, so each tap lifts him a little while you weave around the obstacles in his path. Dodging them relies on precise timing, and that careful rhythm is what gives the game its satisfying challenge.

Every jump and flap brings its own small thrill when the timing lands just right. The game is built to keep you coming back for another attempt. Finding the rhythm is the key to rising higher and staying in the air for longer.
carrom-club: Carrom Club brings the board game carrom to your web browser. You flick a striker to knock coins into the pockets, and you need to sink the queen as well to outplay your opponent. Before each game you place a wager, and as you win you build up a growing stash of coins. You can start with casual games and work your way up to tables where the stakes are much higher.

The physics feel smooth, and each shot responds well to your touch. Matches are short, so you can jump into a quick round whenever you have a moment. You can play on a desktop or on a phone. On desktop, drag the striker left or right along the rail with your mouse, then pull back to aim and release to shoot. Mobile uses the same method, just with touch.
idle-island-build-and-survive: You are stranded on an uninhabited island and must stay alive by gathering materials, making tools, and building a shelter of your own. Careful planning and quick choices help you turn every obstacle into a chance to advance. Over time, the empty, lifeless terrain grows into a lively settlement full of activity.

As the game goes on, you adapt and get better at handling your surroundings. The title mixes several styles of play into one experience, so the survival side and the building side work together. Your decisions shape how far you can go and how well you master the environment around you.
animal-racing-2: Animal Racing 2 is a wild race that blends arcade adventure with running, shape-shifting, and puzzles that test your thinking. You run across platforms alongside your rivals, and the goal is to get ahead by outsmarting them. The racing sections follow a simulator style, so each challenge feels like a real test of skill.

The key move is switching into a different animal at just the right moment. A shark can carry you across the sea, an eagle can soar over a gap, and an orangutan can climb a flight of steps. Everything is controlled with a mouse click or a tap, so the game works with either input.
tile-matcher-triple-fun: Tile Matcher Triple Fun is a calm puzzle game built around matching sets of three, drawing its inspiration from Mahjong Solitaire. Your job is to spot three identical fruit tiles, such as peaches, blueberries, or bananas, and clear them from a bright, stacked board. Each new level grows harder, so planning your moves ahead becomes part of the fun. The scene is a peaceful seaside setting with a surfer and palm islands.

Help is available whenever you get stuck. A lightbulb button offers a hint, while a shuffle button mixes up the tiles on the board. On a computer, you select and match tiles with the mouse, clicking the lightbulb or shuffle button as needed. On a phone or tablet, simply tap the tiles, the lightbulb, or the shuffle button to play in the same way.
retro-speed: Retro Speed sends you racing through a world with a charmingly old-school feel. Each coin you collect makes your car go faster, so the run grows more intense the longer you last. The controls are simple to pick up, and they let you slip through traffic and pass rival drivers whenever an opening appears.

Your aim is to climb the rankings by staying focused behind the wheel. As the speed ramps up, you will need steady nerves and quick reflexes to keep your car on track. Every moment tests how well you can handle the rising pace.
shooting-zombie-fps-xtreme-good-vs-bad-b: Shooting Zombie FPS Xtreme: Good vs Bad Boys is a free-to-play first-person shooter. You battle a crowd of AI opponents, including soldiers and realistic zombies. The game offers five modes, such as Gun Game, Survival, Team Deathmatch and Deathmatch, along with several more. You can team up with friends online or play alone through 40 offline levels.
Controls are simple. Use W, A, S and D to move, and use the mouse to aim, look around, shoot and change your gun. Press Space to jump, hold Shift to run, and press Tab to open the menu.
sword-play-ninja-slice-runner: Sword Play! Ninja Slice Runner is an HTML5 game you play in your browser, offering a lively arcade challenge. You take on the role of a skilled swordsman who slices through many enemies. It suits fans of ninjas as well as anyone who enjoys action titles. Sharpen your blade, because every cut matters.

The game blends slicing and action, and each swing reflects careful technique and the skill of a kunai master. Expect scenic landscapes and mysterious foes as you move through a good number of demanding levels, including samurai missions and waves of ninja assassins. The adventure is a ninja journey, and you can enjoy it without any internet connection, so it works as an offline experience.
fruit-merge-juice-jumble: In this puzzle game, you release fruit into a container and join two identical pieces to make a bigger fruit. You position it by clicking and dragging, then release so it falls and joins any matching fruit below. Your goal is to score as high as possible by merging. The round ends once the container is full.
A helpful strategy is to group
roller-for-brainrots: Roller for Brainrots is an arcade game built around rollerskating. As you skate, you collect different kinds of Brainrots, so gathering them is what you do while moving through the game. The title carries both the Obby and Arcade tags, which fits its mix of movement and collecting.

On a computer, you move with the W, A, S, and D keys and use the cursor to get around the map. To pick up a Brainrot, press the right mouse button. If you are playing on a phone, an on-screen joystick handles movement across the map instead.
baby-hazel-birthday-party: Celebrate Baby Hazel's third birthday in this cheerful game, where surprises and magic shows await. Using point-and-click controls, you help keep Hazel's happiness climbing by granting her playful, whimsical wishes. Each request you complete lifts her mood a little higher as the party unfolds.

The adventure blends interactive play with a surprise twist, so the fun keeps developing as you go. It is a joyful experience that aims to leave players grinning from start to finish. Anyone who enjoys light, happy games aimed at girls will likely feel right at home here.
bunny-boy-online: Get ready for intense, fast-paced matches against players from around the world in this online multiplayer game. Each battlefield is different, so you can plan your approach before every round. You will also find a range of powerful weapons and several distinct game modes to try.

Team up with friends for coordinated play, or go it alone and rely on your own quick reflexes. Dodging enemy attacks and outthinking your opponents is the key to staying in the fight. Every win moves you higher on the leaderboards, letting you prove your standing against the competition.
tralala-test: Tralala Test is a trivia game where internet culture gets thrown into a blender of madness. You answer 20 tricky questions that test how well you know memes. Each round asks you to pick from odd characters and over-the-top answer choices. The whole thing is a silly ride through the strange corners of AI brainrot, made for anyone who enjoys pure nonsense.

Expect plenty of laughs as you move from one bizarre question to the next. Your job is to show off your meme knowledge by choosing carefully, even when every option seems ridiculous. If you enjoy absurd humor and don't mind a little chaos, this game offers a playful way to spend your time.
dinosaur-shifting-run: Dinosaur Shifting Run starts with a human adventurer dashing across a blazing desert. Later, the runner changes into a powerful dinosaur that smashes through obstacles in a green jungle. This game sets itself apart from other runner games, because every level brings its own kind of challenge, so the play stays fresh.

Your job is to switch the character into whatever form suits the surroundings. Picking the correct form is the key to coming out on top. As you advance to higher levels, the gameplay grows harder to handle.
red-and-blue-stickman-rope: Step into an adventure starring two stickman brothers, one blue and one red. Together they must collect a key and make their way to a door. This 2D game is built for two players, so you can team up with a friend and guide both brothers at once. Once the pair reaches the door, they move on to the next level, though a number of challenges stand in their path along the way.

Controls are simple. Use WASD for one brother and the arrow keys for the other, and a double jump is available when you need an extra leap. On mobile, touch controls let you play without a keyboard. Whichever way you play, the aim stays the same: get both brothers through each stage to the door.
keyboard-rush: Keyboard Rush takes you into a bright, three-dimensional world built on a massive keyboard. Your goal is to sprint across its oversized keys and reach the glowing gift waiting at the end. The cartoon visuals are full of color, and the action keeps moving, so you need to respond fast to whatever comes next.

Steer your character along the keys, dodge obstacles, and leap over gaps before you tumble off the path. Every key you step on gives you one point, and collecting points raises your level and boosts your running speed. The higher you climb, the quicker you move, so careful timing of each jump matters. Cross the finish line to clear the level and open the next challenge.
car-crash-test-abandoned-city: Smash up cars in this browser game set in an abandoned city. Vehicles break apart realistically: a hard impact can knock off doors, the hood, or wheels. Explore a large open world packed with ramps, presses, and other tools for wrecking. Other cars speed along the roads, and you can race them into messy crashes.

Build your own car by picking body and detail colors, then adjusting wheel size and alignment. Visit the crash test sites, leap off jumps, and do whatever you like. Steer with WASD, brake with Space, boost with Shift, switch views with C, and swap cars with N. Press R to put a car back in service, K to repair it, B to slow time, and Tab to open the pause menu. On mobile, use the buttons on the screen.
math-battle: Math Battle pits your dinosaur against an opponent in fierce duels. Your strength comes from math: each problem you solve charges up your creature so it can win the fight. Since wrong replies won't help you, take a moment to weigh every answer before you choose one. Get the sums right and your beast stays strong throughout the match.

The game is built as a strategic adventure, and the challenges grow harder as you move forward. It blends dinosaur combat with number practice, so you build your math skills while you battle. Think carefully at each step, and your dinosaur will keep its power from the first clash to the final victory.
frontline-commando-shooting-gun-games: Frontline Commando Shooting drops you into a first-person shooter filled with fierce firefights, action-packed missions, and tense survival situations. You can pick from a large range of realistic modern guns alongside futuristic prototype weapons. The lineup covers pistols, assault rifles, submachine guns, sniper rifles, shotguns, and heavy machine guns, and each one handles differently and hits hard.
Movement runs on the keyboard. W or the Up arrow moves you forward, S or the Down arrow moves you back, A or the Left arrow shifts you left, and D or the Right arrow shifts you right. Press
kaiten-sushi: Kaiten Sushi is a quick arcade title where accuracy and pace matter most. You play a sushi chef who cuts and chops many kinds of seafood as it rolls past on a busy conveyor belt. Working under time pressure, you learn the craft of preparing each dish one step at a time.

Keep your eyes open, because demanding diners are waiting, and each one expects their order made just right. Your job is to keep up the tempo and stay focused so no order slips by. Sharpen your reflexes and see how well you can handle the rush of the belt.
bubble-shooter-pet-match-3: Bubble Fight IO brings the bubble shooter style into online multiplayer, so you can jump in whenever and wherever you like. A cluster of bubbles sits in the middle of the arena, and you and your rival take turns firing at them. Every bubble you clear adds to the damage dealt to your opponent.

Each turn is a head-to-head exchange, and knocking down more bubbles means hitting your opponent harder. Since the stack stays at the center, the whole arena stays focused on your shots and theirs. Aim well, keep up the pressure, and aim to be the best player in the arena.
world-flags-quiz: World Flags Quiz is a quick, fun, and educational mobile game where you match countries with their correct flags. It keeps things simple and clear, offering just one game mode that is easy to pick up and hard to put down. Each question tests your geography knowledge one country at a time.

Every round shows the name of a country, such as France, Brazil, Japan, or Nigeria. You then choose the matching flag from four options. Only one choice is right, while the other three are picked to challenge your attention to detail and your flag recognition skills. Use your mouse to select an answer.
war-machine: Take charge of a powerful trebuchet, a siege engine built for smashing things. Your job is to spot the weak spots in enemy walls and fortresses and hit them where it hurts. You can fire several kinds of projectiles to bring down the foes, and your aim is to drive the invading armies out of your homeland.

Aiming and firing work with the left mouse button on a computer or a touchpad, and with the screen on a phone or tablet. Tips shown during play will walk you through the basics, so you can pick up the mechanics quickly.
mike-and-mia-1st-day-school: Mike and Mia can hardly wait for their very first school day. Your job is to tidy up their bedroom and pack a tasty snack box for them. Next, pick from a range of adorable outfits to dress them up. The game ends with a day at school full of cheerful, affectionate games and activities. Everything works on any screen size. On a computer, click items, tools, and buttons to interact; on a phone or tablet, tap the screen to choose and apply your selections.
mahjong-street-cafe: Mahjong Street Cafe mixes classic tile matching with the feel of match-3 puzzles. The action takes place in a cozy cafe on a busy street. Your job is to pair up tiles that are free to move, clearing the whole board one match at a time. Think ahead about which tiles to remove first, and you can set off chain reactions that boost your score. The game looks lovely and keeps your mind busy as you work through each layout.
snake-arena: Snake Arena is a online game where you guide your snake through colorful arenas, get ahead of other players, and pick up power-ups along the way. Each point you collect helps your snake grow, so planning your moves carefully pays off. The game mixes a retro feel with fresh ideas, and you can customize how your snake looks.

On a phone, use the virtual joystick to steer and tap the boost button for a burst of speed. On a computer, the snake turns toward wherever your mouse cursor points, and a left click gives you a speed boost.
zombie-apocalypse-bunker-survival-z: Zombie Apocalypse Bunker Survival Z is a free-to-play online shooter that runs right in your browser. You face many enemy AI opponents, such as soldiers and realistic zombies. The game includes five modes, among them gun game, survival, team deathmatch (TDM), and deathmatch (DM), along with much more. Every gun can be styled with camo and fitted with attachments.
You can also play multiplayer with friends. Move with W, A, S, and D, and use
doll-queen-designer: Doll Queen Designer is a 3D dress-up runner where you steer a doll down a route, weaving around obstacles while gathering stylish outfits along the way. The fun lies in putting together your own looks, so you can let your creative side take charge and play the stylist.
Here, careful timing matters more than rushing, and the pace stays calm and easygoing as you move along a fashion runway. Build outfits that will earn high marks when you reach the finish line.
castel-wars: Castel Wars is a pixel-art tower battle with a defensive twist, built for two players. Each side can lay small bricks to create a route for escaping or to trap the rival. A catapult sits inside your tower, and firing it deals more damage to the other side. A mysterious hero drifts overhead on balloons, supplying new weapons and bullets and now and then dropping bonuses. If you get stuck, press the action button to throw your sword and take out your opponent.
Blue player moves with W, A, S and D and uses E. Red player uses the arrow keys and P.
satisdom: Satisdom is a casual puzzle game built for stress relief, and people all over the world enjoy it. Players of every age find it appealing, and it works well whether you are with family, friends, or children. It is a mobile game that leans toward matching and strategy.

Your tasks involve dragging, tapping, sorting, matching, or assembling pieces. The controls feel smooth, so getting started takes very little effort. Nothing pushes you to hurry, since the game is meant for slowing down and easing tension. Playful little touches appear throughout, and the fun comes from the doing itself, not only from reaching the end.
squid-sniper-game: Taking cues from the much-talked-about Squid Game, this shooter asks you to spot the players taking part in Red Light, Green Light and take them out with a sniper. Hitting a player who is standing still lowers your score and causes the mission to fail, so you need to aim carefully. Players who are moving are marked with arrows to help you pick the right targets.
Your sniper moves with the mouse, and pressing L locks or unlocks the mouse. Right-click to zoom in, left-click to fire, and use the mouse wheel to zoom in and out.
formula-go: You slide into the cockpit of a fast Formula 1 machine and race against smart AI rivals. The tracks are built to resemble well-known real-world circuits, and the controls respond quickly, so every move you make matters. The competition stays strong from start to finish.

Your driving skill matters most here. Fine-tune your car to suit your style, take sharp bends with care, and push your limits in pursuit of a top spot on the podium. To play, just use a mouse click or a tap.
squid-maze-challenge: Fans of the show will recognize the mood in this 3D adventure, which draws on the candy and pin challenge and the green light, red light game. You run through mysterious mazes with one goal: find the Exit Key and reach the finish door. Some glass is easy to break, while other panes are very strong, so pick your steps and paths with care or you will be eliminated.
Movement uses W, A, S, and D, the mouse lets you look around, and the space bar makes you jump. On mobile, a virtual joystick handles movement, and touch keys handle jumping and running.
mixed-world: Mixed World puts you in charge of cute blue monsters who must think ahead to get past sneaky red enemies. Across 30 levels, you rely on the special talents each creature brings, working through puzzles that test your planning. Your aim is to reach the highest score you can.

The game is built around physics, so objects react realistically as you work through each challenge. It runs smoothly on any device, so you can pick it up wherever you are. Whether you are chasing the top spot or simply enjoying the puzzles, there is plenty to keep you busy.
clicker-knights-vs-dragons: In this pixel-art idle clicker RPG, you assemble a team of small heroes and keep tapping to land Hero Tap DMG, while your party auto-attacks skeletons and dragons on its own. Stages move through different fantasy biomes, and the desert Stage 4-1 shown in the game reaches 8.81 Total DPS. Upgrading Striker DPS brings exponential growth against tougher foes, and you can hire heroes, level them up, and cast spells as you go.

Progress continues even when you step away, thanks to offline rewards. Boss raids add bigger fights along the way, and the stages keep going through a wide medieval fantasy world. On desktop, press the left mouse button anywhere on screen to deal damage. On mobile, tap anywhere on the screen. Use the on-screen buttons and menus to hire heroes, level up, and activate abilities.
pop-it-plus: This browser game turns the stress-relief toy POP it into a computer version. First, click the pop it to collect points and clear level one. After that, things get trickier. Different balls appear inside the pop it, and each one must be picked up by clicking the matching large ball along the bottom of the field. Choose wrongly and you may lose points, or the sunken bumps return to their original state.

A soccer ball goes to the large soccer ball, a volleyball to the large volleyball, and so on. The game blends three styles into one: anti-stress play, clicking, and mahjong. Its original gameplay helps build reaction speed and eyesight, and not everyone gets through level ten. Control is handled entirely with the mouse.
red-stickman-vs-craftmans: In this action game, you step into the shoes of the Red Stickman and take on monsters in one-on-one duels. Each fight is up close, with your hero trading blows across a world built from pixels. Every victory brings you a little nearer to escape, so keep pushing forward through every encounter.
The creatures you face are blocky beasties, and the game builds toward a final showdown. Your task is to conquer these monsters and see whether you can survive the fight to the end.
air-wars: Air Wars drops you into aerial combat over the skies of the Second World War. Your job is to fly with care, using precise handling to dodge and outmanoeuvre enemy aircraft. Your guns fire on their own, so you can concentrate on steering. Picking up fuel and ammunition is necessary to keep your plane in the air, and everything rests on your reflexes and sharp judgement.

Expect a fast, tense dogfight where every turn counts. Staying alive means watching your supplies as closely as the enemy planes around you. It is a shooter for players who enjoy quick decisions and flying under pressure.
draw-bridge-puzzle-brain-game: Draw Bridge Puzzle is a brain game that asks you to think carefully and sharpen your problem-solving skills. Your job is to build bridges and roads so a stranded car can get past obstacles and reach its destination. It is a bridge-building adventure at heart, and every line you draw helps bring the car to safety.

To play, touch the screen to start drawing. Hold your finger down and drag across the screen to form the shapes you need. When you finish, lift your finger and the car will set off along the path you made.
summer-fashion-makeover: During the pandemic, Lily let her appearance slip, and today she looks rather frightening. Summer has arrived and life is slowly getting better, so she is longing for another trip to the beach. Your job is to give her a full makeover until she looks lovely and tidy once again.

The game is responsive, so it adapts to all devices, whether you are at a desk or on the go. On a computer, the mouse handles all the controls and makes play easy. On mobile, simply tap the screen to start and enjoy the gameplay.
dino-hide-n-shoot: Dino Hide N Shoot is a shooting title with a prehistoric twist. You control a courageous gunman who must keep running to dodge dinosaur attacks. Keep an eye out for bullets lying around, because collecting them builds up your firepower. Crates scattered across the field can shield you, so duck behind one and wait for the right moment before firing back at the dinosaurs.
The design is simple to pick up, yet it demands quick timing and careful positioning to survive. Everything is controlled with mouse clicks or taps.
arrow-fever: Arrow Fever puts you in control of an archer who uses a bow and arrow to take down foes. This action title can be played on iOS and Android devices as well as desktop computers, and it is currently very popular. No account is needed, and it costs nothing to start playing.

Your character can level up as you go, and the gameplay is demanding. Rewards go to players who show good skill and plan their moves carefully. To move your hero left or right, use your mouse or your finger. Dodge obstacles along the way and grab upgrades whenever you can.
fun-fishing: In this fishing title, you reel in a wide range of fish and carry your haul back to sell for cash. Fish run from everyday types to rare catches that take more effort to land. Your rods can be upgraded as you progress, and you can travel to different locations to see what is biting. Boats open up new waters to explore. The fishing itself is kept simple, and the relaxed mood makes it hard to put down
lady-pool: Lady Pool is a comical dress-up game that mixes everyday fashion with comic book style. You can take inspiration from well-loved anti-hero costumes and remix them with daring color pairings, surprising patterns, and playful add-ons. Want something silly? Build a fun pajama look for a party, or go bigger with a dramatic outfit for a bold runway show. The wardrobe includes quirky hats that help your character stand out, along with sleek superhero jumpsuits. Let your imagination run wild and shape your heroine into a true style icon.
Controls are simple: use a computer mouse click on a desktop, or tap the screen on a touch device.
my-ice-cream-shop: Run a busy ice cream truck in this puzzle strategy game, serving customers who want frozen treats made to their liking. Timing matters, so you need to plan ahead and keep things moving when the crowds arrive. Each challenge asks you to think carefully about what to make and when to make it.

Designing your own one-of-a-kind sweets helps draw people in and gives your shop more charm. Keeping customers happy brings in generous rewards as you progress. The whole experience is a lighthearted adventure that will appeal to anyone who loves ice cream.
christmas-brain-teasers: Christmas Brain Teasers is a holiday-themed puzzle game that brings seasonal cheer to the challenge of thinking things through. Some of its tasks ask you to notice patterns, while others present riddles to crack. Every puzzle you finish feels worthwhile, so there is a real sense of accomplishment as you go.

The game works as a festive journey meant to keep your mind sharp and lift your holiday mood at the same time. You can enjoy it alone or gather the whole family around the screen for shared fun. Either way, it offers a cozy way to spend the holidays.
tumble-boat: Tumble Boat is a puzzle game where you try to land a boat safely on the ground. The boat begins perched on top of a stack of blocks. You pull the blocks out one by one while keeping the tower from tipping. If the boat falls, the game ends right away, so each move matters. Every level presents a new challenge that tests your thinking and timing.
On a computer, press the mouse button, drag across a block, and let go to remove it. On a phone, tap a block and drag it away to clear it.
contra-jungle-breach: Mara leads a rescue run through this 2D shooter, where you keep moving and firing at the same time. The mission covers ten areas, starting at jungle outposts and moving on to frozen facilities before a final push into an alien lair. You can leap over incoming shots and use a quick dash to escape tight spots. Along the way, you can find weapon upgrades, activate relays, and face enemies that grow tougher as you advance.

Choose the difficulty that suits you, and return to checkpoints when things go wrong. A punchy original arcade soundtrack runs throughout. You can play with keyboard and mouse or with touch controls on mobile. Move and aim with WASD or the arrow keys, jump with Space or K, fire with J or X, reload with F, and dash with Shift or L. Use the mouse to aim and shoot, press P or Esc to pause, R to retry, and M to mute.
geo-metric-run: Geo-Metric Run puts you inside shifting worlds built from shapes and angles, where fast reactions matter more than anything else. You dash forward, time your jumps carefully, and change direction quickly to get past the patterns ahead. Throughout the run, the layouts grow more intricate and the challenges keep escalating.

Your main goal is to survive for as long as you can. You need to stay alert at every moment, since a single mistake can end your attempt. It is a test of agility and quick thinking that rewards sharp focus and steady nerves.
sticker-book-puzzle-color-by-number: Sticker Book Puzzle: Color By Number is a free online game that blends coloring with puzzle solving. Its color-by-number format draws on the relaxing appeal of grown-up coloring books, while you match numbered stickers to work through each intricate design. You can play on a phone or a computer, and every finished picture grows one sticker at a time.

Expect plenty of lovely, detailed and cute stickers that build up the full image. Each sticker carries a number, so you pair it with the matching spot to complete the whole book.
