stunt-extreme: Stunt Extreme puts you on a dirt bike in a side-scrolling motocross game. Your job is to master a range of tricks while working your way across demanding courses. Racing against rivals is at the heart of the action, so you need to stay ahead of the pack and show what your stunt skills can do.

Each race calls for careful timing and quick reactions, since both precision and speed matter. The tracks can be tough to conquer, so practice pays off. Competing is the main goal, and every run gives you another chance to sharpen your riding.
funny-pet-haircut: Bring your untidy animals, an alpaca and a cat, to the salon. First, wash and dry them, then give them a fresh style by switching up their colors and adding patterns. You can also dress them in outfits and transform them into fashionable little beauties.
The game adapts to any device. On a computer, click items, tools, and buttons to interact with them. On a phone or tablet, tap the screen to pick and apply your choices.
super-basketball: Super Basketball is an arcade sports game centered on rowdy hoops clashes and showy slam dunks. You snatch the ball, shove past rivals, and try to outscore the other side before the match ends. Rounds are brief, the arenas are bright and varied, and key finishes unfold in dramatic slow motion, so it's easy to dive in.

Winning earns coins that unlock new players, basketballs, and courts, and each step brings tougher opponents. Aim for the highlighted basket, dodge or barge past defenders, and reach the rim to pull off a dunk. Mouse players hold the left button and drag toward the direction they want, then release to stop turning. On touch screens, press and drag anywhere on the play area, then lift your finger. Tap or click the buttons to pick modes and upgrades.
blade-and-bedlam: Blade & Bedlam is a top-down, physics-driven medieval melee fighter. Swing your weapon to strike enemies, and use it to block incoming projectiles. Your goal is to last as long as possible by dodging attacks, defeating foes quickly, and buying items from the shop between rounds.

flag-puzzle-jam-collect-flags: Flag Puzzle Jam combines puzzle solving with collecting flags, making it a relaxing free online game that also introduces national symbols from around the world. It runs smoothly on any device, and its bright, colorful look keeps each quest feeling fresh.

Each flag is assembled from loose banner pieces. A single tap sends a piece gliding into its correct spot automatically, and the visual effects add a calm, soothing feel. Plan your taps carefully, though, because if every open slot fills with the wrong pieces, the level is lost. Match the pieces thoughtfully and clear the board one flag at a time.
monster-heroes-of-myths: Monster Heroes Of Myths is a fast-paced adventure in which you call up soldiers to fight wicked foes. It will appeal most to young players who enjoy a good quest. Your job is to build your own army and travel across a mysterious map.
Everything is controlled with the mouse: click or tap to play. There is no need for complicated inputs, so you can jump straight into the action and focus on your troops.
shape-defense: Shape Defense asks you to protect your treasure from endless waves of geometric attackers. Each shape you face behaves differently, so you need to think ahead and react fast to hold your ground. Coins you gather during play can be spent on stronger upgrades that help you survive longer. The pace keeps climbing, and the action gets busier and wilder as you go. Every round throws in something unexpected, so stay alert and keep your guard up.
glowit-two-players: Glowit: Two Players lets you and a friend go head to head. Take turns and compete across 12 mini-games. Each round brings a new game picked at random, so you never know what comes next. The challenges vary from one to the next, but every round explains how to play before you begin.

The whole experience takes place on a glowing neon stage. Turn-based play means you and your opponent alternate moves, so each turn matters. You can take it with you wherever you go. To make a move, hold the left mouse button and drag. Each round is a chance to see who has the edge over their friend.
drakkar-strike: Drakkar Strike is an action game set on the open sea, where you sail a Viking drakkar and fire spears in the manner of a sling. Your aim matters most: you pull back, then let go to send each spear toward rival raiders. The goal is to defeat the enemy vikings before they can sink your vessel.

Controls are easy to learn. Drag to aim, then release to launch. Each hit on an enemy viking sinks their ship, and you win by clearing every foe from the water. The title also carries strategy, shooting, pirate, and boat tags, so it mixes several styles of play.
locked-in-grandma-s-basement-2-revenge-h: This sequel to a well-loved point-and-click horror game picks up after you slipped free once before. Grandma has tracked you down, and this time she has locked you in a place that is even darker and more warped. You cannot roam freely. Instead, you view each scene from a fixed, first-person angle. Clicking on objects lets you examine them, gather useful items, and use those items in the right spots to solve puzzles and move the story forward.

Expect eerie rooms, cryptic puzzles, cursed objects, and grotesque clues. You will need logic and courage to find tools, open hidden paths, and carry out a disturbing ritual that may lead to your escape. Nothing is placed without reason, and every detail hints at a larger story, all while Grandma is always watching. Fans of horror, escape rooms, and point-and-click adventures should feel right at home.
lumina-robot: Lumina Robot blends platforming with puzzle solving in a game set across dark, mysterious stages. Your robot carries a light on its head, and you use that glow to see your way through the gloom. Gather card keys to open doors and move on. The challenges grow harder as you advance, asking you to think carefully and react quickly on your way to the trophy.

Watch out for the torches, since touching one sends you back to the start of the level. Move with W, A, S, and D or the arrow keys, and press Space to jump. Each stage tests your logic and reflexes, so plan carefully and time your moves.
dino-funny-digging: Dino Funny Digging is a simulation game about archaeology, where you hunt for fossils buried in the ground. Your discoveries include tyrannosaurs, triceratops, stegosaurs, and other ancient creatures. You can explore a range of different places as you go, and the skeleton collection is presented as realistic.

Play is split into two main tasks. First, you use tools to remove dinosaur bones from the soil with care. Then you piece the finds together to build complete dinosaur skeletons. The game is listed under Kids and carries dinosaur, funny, and simulation tags.
squad-assembler-red-vs-blue: Build your own fighting group in Squad Assembler - Red vs Blue, a puzzle game with a strategy focus. You plan your lineup, outfit each member with equipment, and manage the funds needed to keep your team going. Battles take place in isometric skirmishes where the goal is to outwit rival squads.

Combining pieces of gear lets you create stronger items, so your fighters grow sharper as you progress. Lead your troops through challenging arenas by making careful, well-timed decisions. Every battle rewards planning, so precise tactics are the key to victory.
merge-plane-tycoon: In this tycoon title, you build an airline by combining aircraft. You start with modest little planes, and whenever two identical ones meet, they join to form a more capable machine. Each step up unlocks quicker, more advanced jets, and every upgrade raises your earnings while your airline expands.

To play, grab one plane and drag it over another of the same type, using a mouse or your finger on touch screens. Once they match, the pair becomes a stronger plane with greater value and performance. Keep combining, discover new models, and widen your runway to bring in more cash. Your fleet keeps growing automatically, even when you are away from the game. Simple controls, satisfying merges, and colorful visuals suit relaxed, idle play.
owl-block: Owl Block is a platform adventure where you guide your way through a series of tricky paths. Obstacles stand in your way, so you need quick reflexes and a plan for how each block should move. The game offers more than 100 levels, and each one brings new challenges to work through.

Expect to sharpen your timing as you go, since every stage calls for precise moves. Each level tests your agility and keeps you on edge. If you enjoy games that push your reflexes and reward careful strategy, this one gives you plenty to work on.
lost-bus: In the aftermath of the last nuclear war on Earth, humans have mutated into zombies, and some have grown to unnatural sizes that are frightening to imagine. Almost everyone you meet is against you. Your only support comes from Sasha, your devoted girlfriend, and your modernized school bus.

Help comes in different forms. Sometimes the military can step in, sometimes the bus modifications make the difference, and sometimes luck decides the outcome. This shooting survival game includes defense and monster elements, and you must fight through a hellish situation to stay alive. All controls are listed in the control section of the start menu, which is adapted for both desktop and mobile devices.
super-ball-blast: Super Ball Blast is an arcade game in which you shoot every ball you can spot on the screen. Along the way, you can upgrade your cannon, and the real challenge is seeing how long you can survive.
This casual action title is controlled with a mouse or touch input, so you can aim and fire on whichever device you have at hand. Its tags are Action and Casual, and it sits in the Arcade category.
suger-rush: A candy-themed quest opens with a monster from Chocoland and a hungry rabbit. The bunny is eager to munch on sweets, but it has to win the challenge before any treat reaches its mouth. Your job is to snip candy ropes at just the right moment so the sweet drops to the rabbit. Watch the route closely as you cut, because a candy that tumbles off the wrong way ends the round.
Fans of physics-based games and qu
stickman-clicker: In this clicker, you help a stick figure work its way toward becoming a billionaire. Tapping the character brings in cash, which you can invest in upgrades. As your money grows, you can also unlock fashionable accessories and dress your stick figure in them.

Along the way, you can customize your figure and reach milestones by earning a range of achievements. Each goal you complete marks another step in building your idle empire, which grows quickly as you expand it. Every tap counts toward your fortune, so keep clicking to speed up your progress.
my-sweetstreet-shop: Step behind the counter of your own candy and pastry store, where your days revolve around the sweet treats on offer. Your job is to look after the customers who come in, hand over their orders, and gather the cash they leave. As your earnings grow, you can unlock fresh products, improve your character, bring in helpers, and widen the premises until your sweet business thrives.

Getting around is simple. On PC, use WASD or the arrow keys, or use the floating joystick on mobile. Pick up sweets, carry them to customers and counters, and collect the money you earn. Spend it on upgrades, new stations, and expanding the shop. The more customers you keep serving, the more your SweetStreet Shop grows.
constructor-bricks: Constructor Bricks is a building puzzle where creativity takes the lead. Across many levels, you will meet models that range from basic shapes to intricate architectural designs. Every build comes with step-by-step guidance, so you can follow along and put together one-of-a-kind structures without much trouble. Along the way, the game helps sharpen your sense of space, your focus, and your patience, while you pick up ideas about various design methods and building styles.

Extra challenges are available for those who want more, and you can compete with friends or show off what you have built. A community of players is also part of the experience. To assemble a set, click the bl
falling-blocks-2048-2d: Falling Blocks 2048 - 2D mixes the falling-piece style of Tetris with the number-merging idea from 2048. You steer blocks as they drop so that matching numbers combine, with the goal of creating a 2048 tile. Because each placement changes the board, you need to think a few moves ahead to take control of the grid.

Whether you have a spare minute or want to settle in for a long stretch, this puzzle game suits either style of play. It asks for both strategic planning and quick decisions, making it a fun choice for anyone who enjoys brain-teasing challenges.
hook-master-mafia-city: Hook Master: Mafia City is a relaxed puzzle title that mixes brainwork with escape and collecting. You move through a dangerous city where clever thinking helps you crack each challenge. A grappling hook lets you swing around the streets, and you can dodge and strike with the nimble moves of a secret agent to get away from enemies who are hunting you.
Controls are simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to play.
monster-live: Monster Live places you in a crumbling world where the battles play out in real time, with undead foes pressing in nonstop. You can face the danger alone or join friends and other players from around the globe. Each level lets you choose and sharpen your abilities, so think carefully about which upgrades suit your style.

Success depends on quick responses and working with allies when you play as a group, since the undead arrive in large numbers, hungry for human brains. As the stages grow tougher, your character grows stronger too, and keeping up with the mounting pressure is the core test.
triangle-run: Triangle Run is an arcade game in the skill category. The whole world keeps rotating, so you need to watch where your triangle is headed at all times. A tap sends it in a new direction, and timing those taps well is what keeps it moving through the course. Each stage brings its own hazards, and you have to learn them before you can get past.

Success depends on careful aim and a calm approach. Fast reactions help, but so does waiting for the right moment instead of rushing. The game keeps throwing new turns and obstacles at you, so it stays engaging from one attempt to the next. It suits players who enjoy games that reward focus and steady nerves.
deep-worm: Deep Worm puts you in control of a hungry worm that lives beneath the ground. To stay alive, you need to plan your moves carefully as you tunnel through the soil. Your job is to surface and eat whatever is above ground, all while avoiding people who are carrying weapons and trying to stop you. Timing is everything: you must know when to pop out for a meal and when to dive back down to safety.

The threats grow stronger the longer you last, so every successful feeding run becomes a bit more tense. Keep your wits sharp, choose your moments wisely, and see how long your worm can keep feasting without being caught.
yoga-master-flex-running: Yoga can do a lot for your quality of life, and this arcade game gives the idea a playful twist. Yoga Master is a 3D running game with different levels that will test even the sharpest reaction times. As you run, you move your character and adjust its pose to dodge incoming obstacles, collecting money along the way. Be careful, because some of those stacks of cash are traps.
To begin a level, tap or swipe. Swipe to move the character, and adjust the pose to dodge the furniture in your path. Your aim is to avoid getting hit by anything until the level ends.
kitten-connections: Kitten Connections is a sweet puzzle game in which you help little cats find their matching friends. You draw paths across the board to link identical kittens, and each puzzle asks you to think a bit before you move. As you clear levels, you earn new fluffy companions, colorful backgrounds, and small surprises. The game is simple to pick up but takes skill to master, so it suits both cat fans and puzzle lovers. Relax with its cheerful soundtrack and bright graphics while your kitten collection keeps growing. Can you pair every kitten and build a kitten paradise? You can play with a mouse or on a touch screen.
miss-robins-dream-home: Create lovely homes in sunny, colorful settings while working through hundreds of cheerful match 3 puzzles in this light home makeover game. You take on the role of Miss Robins, a bright young designer who chooses décor and furniture to refresh charming houses.

Sharpen your sense of style by picking the decorations and furniture for each home. Swap and line up candy pieces to make power-ups, and enjoy a large collection of match-3 levels. The gameplay is relaxed and easy to pick up. Everything is controlled with the mouse, so just click any button to move through the game.
pro-obunga-vs-creepender: Pro Obunga vs CreepEnder is an escape game where a relentless monster is always on your heels. Your main tools are strategic jumps and nimble moves as you make your way through dangerous levels. Along the way, you can collect coins to upgrade your character's abilities.

The game also supports cooperative play, so you can team up with another player to get through the levels. Your goal stays the same: reach the portal before Obunga catches you. Each level is full of hazards, so keep moving and stay one step ahead.
angela-real-dentist-doctor-surgery-game: Smiles brighten our days, and healthy teeth help make them shine. Pets need good dental care too, and like people, they sometimes need a special doctor, a dentist, to look after their teeth. This entertaining game for kids puts the player in the role of a real dentist working at an animal hospital, which is a vet clinic.

The young vet's patients arrive with aching teeth after eating too many sweets. In a real dental office, you use tools such as tongs, scalpels, Burmashin and many others to clean plaque off furry friends' teeth, straighten them, perform operations, remove cavities and fill them. You play by tapping or clicking, and the animals will be very grateful for your help.
sorty-bolty: Arranging things neatly and matching colors are at the heart of this game. Your job is to move bright nuts onto bolts of the matching shade. Watching each bolt fill with a single color is pleasing to the eye, and the task also keeps your mind busy. The rules are easy to pick up, but the challenge grows as you go, so you will need to plan several moves ahead.

To play, tap a bolt to select a nut, then tap another bolt that either matches its color or is empty to collect the nuts there. If you get stuck, two hints can help. Cancel move undoes your most recent step, while Extra bolt opens more room for nuts.
power-crusher: Power Crusher is a clicker game about smashing things to pieces. Each hit you land produces a dazzling display on screen. As you play, you can raise your crusher's strength and speed, so every tap packs more force and looks more impressive. Progress rewards careful planning, and your main aim is to turn minerals into fragments and watch them shatter.

Expect a steady stream of striking effects as your machine improves. Upgrades add up over time, so it pays to think ahead before spending. The further you advance, the larger your crusher's capabilities become, letting you see just how far it can go.
noob-city-the-gangster: Step into the shoes of a street criminal in this action game, which has a blocky, Minecraft-like look. Explore its open world, where rival crooks are ready to take you down the moment you appear. Work through the levels, and each one brings tougher opponents to face.

Mouse controls where you look, while W, A, S and D handle driving. Press Space to pull the handbrake and F to get out of a vehicle. Expect plenty of fighting, shooting and running as you make your way through this action title.
stickboys-hook: Guide Stickboys across the screen by swinging and leaping toward the finish. He needs your help to get there, so lend him a hand as you move through each stage. Launch ramps can send him airborne, and firing webs gives him something to latch onto so he can keep heading for the goal. Every level must be cleared before you can move on, and you should keep an eye on the drop, because a fall from the sky ends your run. The game offers 20 tough levels, and you control it by clicking or tapping to throw your rope. Touch controls are supported, so you can play on a phone as well.
gas-station-stick-simulator: You begin with a modest fuel stop beside a busy highway, and every decision rests on you. Fill up passing vehicles, service them, and collect coins along the way. Gradually your station grows into a larger business with a shop, a restroom, a café, and a hot dog delivery service. More customers bring more profit and more upgrades to unlock.

Oversee daily operations, improve your stations, and hire staff to keep everything running smoothly. Your business keeps earning even while the game is closed. It is more than a simple simulator. It is a chance to manage your own small empire. Cook hot dogs, welcome guests to your café, and work toward becoming the boss of every gas station.
zombie-shooter-3d: In 2037, a deadly virus outbreak spread from a secret lab run by a group of doom haters. Most survivors were infected, and the world became a dead zone full of walking corpses. You play as an SAS zombie shooter and a doom hater, searching through the pandemic to hunt down the undead and rescue the last SAS member.

Aim for clean headshots and keep your finger on the trigger, since you hold it down and never let go. Online multiplayer PvP doom battle mode lets you face other players too. The Ares Virus has plunged the planet into anarchy, with weak dying light, so when the dead start rising, grab your guns and keep firing for an adrenaline-fueled run of endless shooting.
funny-kitty-care: Funny Kitty Care invites you to help a stray kitten recover and grow strong again. You will clean up your furry friend, tend to its injuries, and then have fun picking outfits so it looks its very best. The controls are simple to pick up, and the game leans on your imagination, so you can shape your kitty into whatever adorable look you like.

It is a cozy dress-up experience from start to finish, with plenty of room for creative choices along the way. Watching a scruffy little stray turn into a charming, well-groomed companion is the main joy here. The game is listed under Girls and tagged Dress Up.
mergemaster-dragonets: In this puzzle title centered on dragonets, you blend ideas from the 2048 and Merge styles. Your task is to join matching dragonets that sit inside bubbles, making as many connections as you can while keeping the field from overfilling. Each successful connection earns points. The value of those points grows as your level rises over time.

Controls are simple. Choose the spot where the next bubble should fall. Along the bottom of the board, you will find bonuses that help you fill or clear the board faster. Keep merging, watch the field, and see how high your score can climb.
long-drive-to-horizons-sim: Long Drive to Horizons Sim is a survival adventure set in a vast desert. This open-world simulator mixes sandbox freedom with fast racing and shooting. You steer one vehicle over dune after dune that seem to stretch on forever, with the harsh terrain offering little mercy.

Build your own off-roader by gathering parts and materials, then combining different bodies, engines, and wheels. Repairs go deep here, since every bolt and wiring circuit matters. Keep your machine running by refueling, replacing worn components, and unlocking performance boosts, and your mechanical skill grows with each fix. Search abandoned camps, wrecked caravans, and rundown garages for weapon parts, ammo, and crafting supplies. For racing, you tackle desert courses spanning dozens of kilometers, balancing fuel, speed, and durability to get ahead of rivals.
woods-of-nevia-forest-survival: Woods of Nevia: Forest Survival is a one-tap action adventure set in the wild. You fight off wolves with your axe, chop wood, and construct a shelter. Roam the forest to collect resources and uncover hidden chests. Gaining levels lets you pick upgrades, and you must endure dangers that grow over time while keeping hunger and health in check.
The left mouse button moves your character and lets you interact with the game's interface. The right mouse button rotates the camera, and you can walk with either the WASD keys or the arrow keys.
wedding-beauty-makeup-salon-indian-desig: Step into the colorful setting of an Indian wedding in Wedding Beauty Makeup Salon. Your job is to get a bride and groom ready for their big day by working on their makeup and styling. Pick up the finer techniques, then try out different color palettes and looks as you see fit. There is plenty of room to be creative, and you can mix things up until you land on a style you love.
The game is made for anyone who enjoys dressing up characters and playing with makeup. Every look you create is meant to feel memorable, so take your time and experiment freely.
joyful-ball: In Joyful Ball, you break glass bottles by balancing tricky blocks together with the ball. Everything runs on physics, so you must control the block balance carefully to bring the ball smoothly to its target. The ball has a funny face, which adds charm as it works through each bottle. Be careful, though: if the ball falls, the game is over.
tic-tac-toe-html5: This browser version of the classic game lets you pick from three board sizes: a 3x3 grid, a 5x5 grid, or a demanding 7x7 layout. Your goal stays the same on every board, which is to line up your marks in an unbroken row before your opponent does.

You can sharpen your approach by facing a friend or pitting your skills against the computer. Each match is brief and built around clever positioning, so you can jump into a series of quick duels whenever you like. The game keeps things simple to pick up, yet the larger boards provide a real test of planning.
basketball-school: Basketball School is an arcade-style basketball game where your job is to sink shots. It offers three modes to choose from. In Arcade mode you start with 10 balls, and every basket you make keeps the round going, though each one is tougher than the last. Time Attack gives you unlimited balls, but the clock is ticking, so you need to score as many baskets as you can before time runs out. Distance mode asks you to take your shots farther from the hoop each time you score.
To play, press and hold the left mouse button and drag to aim, then let go to shoot.
stairs-trivia: Stairs Trivia is an online quiz game where you climb higher by answering questions correctly. Your aim is to reach the top and be the final player still standing against others. It runs on several platforms and offers a 3D look, with challenges that keep you thinking.
Movement is handled with your mouse, so guide your character with care. Stop when you reach a pile and collect it to construct stairs beneath you. Keep building your way up until you reach the top.
nothing-2-lose: Nothing 2 Lose is a blocky survival shooter built around teamwork. Fight alongside survivor bots or join friends online, and hold out together against waves of zombies and bosses across many maps. Maps range from Easy to Hard, with supply drops, vehicles, and objectives along the way.

Earn cash and EXP to rank up and unlock dozens of guns, plus attachments, armor, and items, then spend your cash between rounds on better weapons. WASD moves, the mouse aims, left click shoots, and right click aims down sights. R reloads or refills at an ammo station, Q kicks, F opens supply boxes, and X switches on the flashlight. Scroll toggles between first and third person. On phones, on-screen sticks and buttons handle everything.
flag-painting-game: Paint your way through a collection of national flags in this calm coloring experience. You fill each design with color and let your imagination guide the choices. The painting controls feel smooth and simple to pick up, and the palette is full of bright shades. Fans of flag games, color games, or art games should find plenty to enjoy, and the game offers both fun and learning. It also suits children and anyone who enjoys coloring books.
Each level is built to help you unwind, concentrate, and discover more about different countries as you go. To press any button, use your mouse to click on it.
key-and-shield-2: Set out on a bold trek across Gorlik Island in Key & Shield 2. Your mission is to clear tough stages, free friends trapped in cages, and lift a curse that has settled over the land. The game pairs clever gameplay with a polished look, making it a modern arcade adventure that runs well on any device.

Each level brings its own puzzle, so every move counts. Along the way, you work toward restoring the island by setting your companions free and breaking the curse. It sits in the Monster category, so fans of that theme will feel at home, and the island's fate rests on whether you can prove yourself as its savior.
car-real-simulator: Car Real Simulator puts you behind the wheel of cars that handle like the real thing. You move through open-world areas that change as you go, and the vehicle physics are built to feel true to life. Whether you are cruising through town or sliding around in drift challenges, each drive has a natural, grounded feel.

Beyond the road, you can browse a large garage full of vehicles, practice tight parking tasks, and head out across a variety of terrain. It is a racing game for anyone who enjoys a thrilling, car-focused adventure with realistic control.
word-search-and-quiz: Word Search & Quiz is a brain training game that blends classic word puzzles with trivia across five modes. In the classic mode, you swipe or drag with a mouse to connect letters and find hidden words in a grid, with themed puzzles that change from chapter to chapter. Picture puzzles ask you to study an image and locate related words, while riddle mode hides the answer to a text clue among the letters.

Word From Image has you spell the object shown using scrambled letters, and Quiz Mode offers trivia from easy warm-ups to tougher teasers. Each chapter has its own theme and background, and you can track completion, replay questions to reach 100%, unlock ranks, and enjoy endless practice. Cloud saves keep your progress across devices, and hints can reveal letters or remove wrong answers. The game suits all ages and receives regular updates.
moms-diary-cooking-games: Moms Diary: Culinary World combines two cooking titles, Moms Diary and Moms Kitchen Crush, into a 2024 time management experience set in a kitchen city. You work to meet challenging targets while racing the clock, and the adventure stretches across the globe from one location to the next.

Your job is to tap to prepare each recipe, then serve the dishes to customers so you can finish the levels. Whether you are a seasoned chef or simply a fan of cooking games, this title was designed with you in mind.
the-rooms-escape-challenge: The Rooms-Escape Challenge drops you into a set of connected rooms where you must look closely and work out puzzles to find concealed keys and hidden mechanisms. Each space offers a different look and feel, so you move from one setting to the next as you go. Handling objects around you and tackling tricky challenges are central to the experience.
This is an escape adventure built around sharp thinking. Pay attention to small details, because any one of them might help you get out. Expect your reasoning to get a real workout as you go.
knock-and-run-100-doors-escape: You play as a quick, bold stickman dashing through a hotel hallway in this arcade runner. Along the way, you ring, knock, and slam doors, pulling pranks on the people inside. Your main goal is to avoid getting caught. Each resident reacts differently, so you never know who will jump in fright or who will come storming out angry. Danger can appear around any corner.

The game blends fast running, mischief, and quick dodging, with a bright, minimalist look that keeps your focus on the chase. Fun challenges test your agility and speed. Controls are simple: steer with touch, the mouse cursor, or WASD, and remember that your character never stops running. Reach the end of the level to win.
army-block-squad: Army Block Squad puts you in charge of your own battalion as you fight to survive a large-scale war. You build your army from the ground up, then move your forces strategically to seize the day. The game blends action and strategy, so quick reactions and careful planning both matter.

You control everything with a mouse or touch input. Listed in the Boys category, this new title suits players who enjoy thinking ahead about their next move. Plan each step carefully, because every choice shapes how well your battalion holds up in the fight.
city-tuk-tuk-rickshaw-game-auto-games: Climb behind the wheel of an auto rickshaw and take on pick-up and drop-off jobs across a wide, open city. You can choose from 10 different rickshaws, each with lifelike controls and detailed interiors. The game mixes city rides with tuk tuk challenges, all set in a carefully designed urban map.

Gameplay runs smoothly and is shown in detailed 3D graphics, so the streets feel like a real place to explore. Press W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move back, A or the Left Arrow to move left, and D or the Right Arrow to move right. Use your mouse to click any on-screen button.
onet-animals: Onet Animals is a puzzle game built around matching tiles that show similar animals. Each pair you complete moves you closer to finishing the level, so every board offers a new set of matches to solve. The challenge is engaging, and the adorable visuals make the whole experience pleasant to look at.

Tagged under Brain, Logic, Animals, and Matching, this title is meant for players of every age. Its mix of animal pictures and logical thinking gives it a light, friendly feel that makes it enjoyable for all kinds of players.
balls-vs-lasers: Balls Vs Lasers is an arcade challenge that pushes your skill and reaction speed to their limit. You control two balls at once and must dodge the lasers heading your way. Movement feels flexible, but the operation is demanding, so every move counts. Keep both balls moving and steer clear of each oncoming laser attack. You also need to match balls of the same color with the laser that corresponds to them.
Input is handled with a mouse click or a tap. The game sits in the hypercasual category and is tagged with ball and music. It is built around quick reactions and careful, challenging control.
stellar-guardian: Stellar Guardian puts you in charge of a spacecraft defending the cosmos. You blast through waves of enemy ships, then take on massive bosses that test your nerve. You can also upgrade your ship with powerful abilities to help you survive the fight.

The game has sleek controls that keep the action easy to handle, along with bright, detailed visuals that bring each battle to life. Its intense modes reward careful planning and strategy rather than wild shooting. Every run is a fight to save the universe from danger.
esther-the-penguin-return-to-antartica: Guide Esther the Penguin across a frozen landscape on her way home to Antarctica. Along the route you will work through puzzles and steer around icy hazards. The animation is charming to watch, and the challenges grow harder as you progress, so this is a game that can hold your attention for a long time. Taking your time and thinking things through will serve you well.

Your journey is built around solving problems rather than racing the clock. Each stage asks you to figure out a path forward while keeping Esther clear of the frost. Patience and sharp thinking are the qualities that will carry you furthest in this gentle, story-driven puzzle game.
fruit-chopper: Slice fruit as it appears or gets tossed into the air. Your job is to time each throw and swipe so that one cut catches several pieces at once, which earns extra points. Keep your movements quick and precise, because a single miss hurts your progress. Taps and swipes both have a role, so choose whichever fits the moment.

Every level you finish rewards you with one cocktail. Gather four of them and you unlock a spin on the fortune wheel. Rarer cocktails bring better prizes. Reaching level 100 is the long-term challenge for players who stick with it.
red-and-green-3: Red and Green 3 is a two-player adventure game that follows the friendship between the red man and the green man. It spans ten chapters, and your goal is to collect candies to earn points. Stay alert, because lasers are waiting along the way and can get in your path.

Player one moves with WASD and uses R, while player two uses the arrow keys and O. Touch controls are also available for mobile, so you can play together on a phone or tablet. Coordinate with your partner as you work through each chapter.
drivers-washing-clean: Drivers Washing Clean is a fast-paced arcade game for mobile in which you steer your ride to a car wash. Your goal is to help drivers keep their vehicles clean. Cars pull in with many different kinds of grime, and you must wash, polish, and detail each one before the next batch of vehicles arrives.
As you advance, you can improve your equipment, hire assistants, and unlock fresh cleaning tools. Staying on top of the steady flow of
sustainable-3: You play as a security guard at a museum that faces threats from eco-terrorists. Your rounds take you through the galleries, where you search for evidence that reveals who is behind the plots. Once you know the culprits, you must act fast and firmly to stop their sabotage.

Along the way you confront suspects and sit through tense interrogations, where outwitting your opponents is key. Your job is to keep the valuable artworks safe and the museum calm before a disaster can unfold.
money-maker: This merge game puts you in charge of a banknote machine that keeps producing cash. Drop money into it, set power-up chips in the spots that work best, and watch each bounce add to your income. Drag pins onto the board to boost your profits, and combine two pins by dropping one onto the other to create a higher-tier pin.

As cash builds up, you can buy upgrades and open new chip slots, which multiply your profits and keep the money flowing. Upgrading the Money Machine raises the base value of every banknote and increases your earnings overall. The goal is to grow your money machine as far as you can take it.
siren-head-3-game: This is a 3D horror shooter where you and a companion fight a creature with a siren head, using an ax and whatever else you can find. The creature mostly lurks in villages and woodlands, and it targets travelers, hikers, and even young children. It may lure victims into the forest by copying the sound of someone in distress.

Walk with W, A, S, and D, and use the mouse to look around. Left click fires, right click aims, and the mouse wheel switches weapons. G throws grenades, R reloads, and F interacts with things. Hold Left Shift to run, Left Ctrl to crouch, and X to go prone. Press C to change the camera view. The Space bar is also part of the control set.
bananacat-clicker: BananaCAT Clicker is a playful world built around tapping your screen. Each tap sets off funny cat behavior and sends you searching for hidden banana treasure. The colorful graphics make every session easy to enjoy, and the game keeps you hooked from the first click.

As you gather bananas, you can improve your characters through thoughtful upgrade choices. Each new cat you unlock joins your collection, and you'll face a range of fun challenges along the way. Expect plenty of entertainment for anyone who likes simple tapping games with a sense of progress.
unboxing-brainrots: In this game, you open mysterious cases to uncover rare Italian animals, each with its own distinctive design. Upgrade your weapons so you are ready for any challenge. You can also collect and breed pets, mixing them to discover new creatures and surprising combinations.

Build your own base and mine resources to help it grow. Every case may hold something unexpected, and each new find could make a real difference. Expect bright visuals, fast-paced action, and plenty of silly humor as you work toward a team of goofy animals.
drift-tycoon: Drift Tycoon is a relaxed idle game centered on cars, racing, and growing a personal vehicle collection. You acquire new cars, boost their stats, and collect coins while they circle the track. A bigger garage produces more coins over time. Finishing laps, earning money, completing tasks, and unlocking achievements all help you improve your results. Prestige is another layer: it lets you convert progress into prestige points, which unlock stronger perks. Amusing cars are there to collect, and you can climb the leaderboard.

Shop for vehicles from the car panel, and each one earns income while it drives around the track. Spend coins on fresh cars or on level upgrades, which raise your earnings and speed up garage growth. Finishing tasks rewards you with extra coins. The achievements panel tracks your goals and how far you have come. Once your progress is large enough, you can prestige. This wipes your current run but grants prestige points and opens new perks that boost income, lower upgrade costs, and offer other handy bonuses. You can also see how your results stack up against other players on the leaderboard.
mummy-land: Steer a mummy through winding levels built inside pyramids. Each chamber is packed with sneaky traps and puzzles that take some thinking to solve. Along the way, gather treasures and pick up power-ups that help your mummy last longer.

As you move deeper, the challenges keep getting harder, so you will need a sharp mind and quick, nimble reflexes. Your task is to conquer the ancient labyrinth. Whether your mummy makes it out alive is up to you.
cookie-maker-for-kids: Step into Cookie Maker for Kids, a cheerful game where little bakers take on the role of pastry chefs. You roll out dough, cut it into shapes, and bake your cookies. Then you can let your imagination run wild by adding bright, colorful decorations to finish them off.

The controls are easy to pick up, so anyone can start baking right away. The whole experience feels happy and relaxed, making it a sweet way to spend time with fun and creative play. It is a great pick for young cooks who dream of working in a kitchen one day.
road-race-3d: Road Race 3D is a racing game that takes you along a challenging track. It brings together 3D racing and parkour, so every run asks you to drive and move through the course with skill. The layout pushes you to stay alert from start to finish.

Controls are easy to pick up: mouse click or tap to play. Flexible operation and quick reactions are the keys to winning each game. To draw a vehicle, one appears at random for you, so every match can feel a little different.
red-and-blue-stickman-spy-puzzles-2: Red And Blue Stickman Spy Puzzles 2 is an action puzzle game built around archery. You take on the role of a blue stickman on a special adventure. Each level sends red monsters your way, and you must slip past them with well-timed agility while working to defeat them.
Every shot is an archery shot, so planning matters. You can keep adjusting your aim angle and distance until you hit the red monster you're targeting. The game is played with a mouse click or a tap.
o-m-i-n-o: In O.M.I.N.O, you guide a bold human through a pixelated universe that aliens have invaded. Your job is to weave past hostile spaceships while collecting valuable coins. Everything moves quickly, so you need sharp timing and a clear head to keep your character safe.

The controls rely on taps alone, which makes the game easy to pick up but difficult to fully master. Each run grows tougher as the challenge ramps up, pushing you to plan ahead and react in a split second. If you enjoy games built around quick reflexes and staying alive through simple inputs, this one has plenty to offer.
panda-lu-treehouse: Animal lovers, step into Panda Lu Treehouse, a casual simulator that will warm your heart. You look after Panda Lu, a panda who needs a cozy and colorful place to call home. Your first job is to build a tree house for him. Keep him happy by offering a range of entertainments up in the tree house.
As the tree house grows, you can add new rooms and areas for Panda Lu to explore. As you progress, new fun activities let you spend time with him. The game is played with a mouse click or a tap.
demolition-derby-racing: Demolition Derby Racing drops you into a noisy, messy world where cars crunch and twist into one another. The heart of the game is fast vehicle combat, and your chances of survival depend on the upgrades you choose and the clever moves you make against tough opponents. Careful planning matters just as much as speed.

Before each battle, you can customize your vehicle to suit your style. Then you head into treacherous arenas, where every turn could change the outcome. The game is built for multiplayer, so you face off against other drivers in a showdown of destruction, aiming to come out on top.
snake-simple-retro-game: Snake Simple Retro Game is an arcade title where you steer a snake that grows longer each time it reaches its next meal. The controls are easy to pick up, but the endless challenges mean you have to think carefully about every move. As you eat, you must dodge your own body, so each turn matters.

Your munching unlocks captivating themes to explore. The whole game uses a 2D style with a retro feel, bringing back the look of classic arcade titles. It is a straightforward choice for anyone who enjoys nostalgic, timeless gameplay.
decode-the-movie-quote: Decode the Movie Quote is a quiz where you work out famous film lines by guessing one letter at a time. Each puzzle brings up memorable lines from well-loved films, and the varied challenges mean there is plenty to keep you busy for hours. You can play alone or go head to head with friends to see who knows movies best.

The on-screen keyboard uses colour to guide you. A dark key means all instances of that letter have already been used up. A yellow key tells you the letter appears somewhere in the phrase, and clicking it within the phrase will highlight its possible positions. A red key means the letter does not appear at all. If you get stuck, you can use a hint.
slap-king: Slap King is a 3D action game where you challenge opponents to earn the title of best slapper. The harder you throw, the better your chances of knocking your foe out of the ring, so concentrate on landing the single best slap. Designed to entertain people during the days spent indoors amid a coronavirus outbreak, it aims to be a change from the titles you have already tried.
Controls are straightforward: a left mouse click is all you need. Your goal is to rise to the top and be remembered as the best slapper in the universe.
lumen-descent: In Lumen Descent, you explore a long-abandoned tower in a precision platformer built around careful, exact movement. You carry a glowing light through twelve perilous floors, tackling difficult jumps and dashing past hazards along the way. Activate checkpoints as you go, and keep descending into the unknown.

The obstacles on each floor are handcrafted, and the tower hides secrets for players who look closely. The atmosphere is moody, and the challenge rewards precise timing and skill. Move with A and D or the Left and Right keys, jump with Space, dash with Shift, and drop down with S. Press R to retry and P to pause or resume. On mobile, use the on-screen touch controls.
3d-darts: 3D Darts is a sports game built around precision and skill. You can challenge friends or work through hundreds of levels, each one rewarding accurate throws. Timing is central, since releasing your dart at the right moment helps you score big. The game also lets you outwit your opponents.

It is easy to start but hard to master, so newcomers can jump in while seasoned players keep sharpening their technique. Every round tests your focus, and landing a well-timed throw feels rewarding. It is a fitting way to prove your dart prowess.
draw-the-path-puzzle: In this drawing puzzle, your job is to sketch a route that guides a ball into a basket. The controls rely on intuitive line drawing, so anyone can pick them up quickly. Along the way, you will need to steer past a variety of obstacles, planning each stroke carefully so the ball lands exactly where it should.

The game presents a series of different challenges, each one adding fresh tests for your problem-solving skills. It is optimized to work on all kinds of devices. Creative thinkers should find plenty to keep them busy as they work to get every route just right.
panda-hair-do: Step into this hair salon game, where you tend to a girl who loves pandas. You start by washing her hair, then move on to styling it, and finish by adding accessories to complete the look. With countless makeover combinations to explore, every session feels like a fresh journey that you chart yourself.

Along the way you pick up plenty of inspiration and lots of fashion fun. The looks you create could spark ideas for your own personal style in the future. Each visit to the salon brings something new, so no two experiences look quite alike.
idle-crafting-empire-tycoon: Idle Crafting Empire Tycoon is a free online economic simulator that blends empire building, resource crafting, and clicker play, and it's a relaxed way to pass the time. You rule an island and set out to explore every corner of it, sending expeditions to find new resources and turning them into valuable goods. You can hire managers and traders to handle daily tasks and bring in extra profit. The game runs on both phones and computers.

Upgrading your factories takes resources, and you need to keep production balanced so finished goods keep coming. Completing production orders earns you valuable rewards. A short introductory training explains how goods are produced and how new regions of the island are opened. Your goal is to build your island into an empire so impressive that everyone in this world will hear about it.
car-transform-mania-merger-tycoon: Car Transform Mania Merger Tycoon is a game about joining cars together to build your own vehicle business. By carefully pairing up cars, you unlock new models, increase your income, and adjust your track so profits keep arriving even when you are not actively playing. Success depends as much on careful planning as on waiting for results.

The blend of strategy and patience keeps things moving, and there is always another improvement to chase. Each merge pushes your automotive empire further, bringing a steady stream of mechanical innovation and solid financial rewards. It suits players who enjoy strategy where small decisions add up over time.
stunt-boxes: Stunt Boxes is an arcade game where you pilot a craft through a series of stages. In every level, your goal is to gather all the stars while flying through hoops and avoiding crashes. Your fuel is limited, so you'll need to pick up fuel barrels along the way to keep flying.
As you progress, the difficulty rises, so you may need to replay levels and refine your strategy before you can finish them. Playing requires only a mouse click or a tap.
baby-dino-planet: Baby Dino Planet is a cute adventure game set in a bright land full of little dinosaurs. You wander through ancient landscapes, lend a hand to young dinos facing playful trials, and search out secret treasures as you go. Its collecting and arcade-style elements keep things lively for one player.
Your job is to steer a ba
bricks-buster: Bricks Buster is an arcade title where you line up your shots and smash through rows of blocks. Drag your finger across the screen to set your angle, then let go to launch the balls. Every brick displays how many hits it can take, so you can judge which ones to target first. Bouncing your shots off the walls lets you reach more bricks and chain combos together.

A level ends once every brick has been cleared or once the bricks drop to the bottom, so you need to act before they get there. When a stage gets stubborn, power-ups can help you move through it faster. Planning each move carefully is the key to this classic, puzzle-style game, which offers endless brick-breaking action. Aim wisely and push for a high score.
block-ice-puzzle: Block Ice Puzzle is a sliding puzzle played on a frosty six-by-six grid. Your goal is to push and steer the blocks across the board so that the blue ice block can finally slip free. Each arrangement asks you to think a few steps ahead before you move anything.

The game offers a never-ending supply of levels, so there is always another puzzle waiting once you finish one. Its controls feel smooth and responsive, which keeps your attention on working out each layout. It suits anyone who enjoys testing their logic and patience, and it is likely to keep you coming back for more.
jelly-block-puzzle: Jelly Block Puzzle is a colorful game about merging jellies that share the same color. Each level asks you to connect a set number of color combinations before you can move on, and the levels never run out, so you can keep playing as long as you want. Two power-ups help along the way: one destroys a jelly you select, and the other swaps jellies.

The game mixes logic with color matching, so it gives your brain a workout while keeping the mood light. It is fun to see how far you can get in this jelly-themed adventure, and it suits anyone who enjoys puzzles that test their thinking.
fireline-merge-defense: In FireLine: Merge Defense, you unlock a wide selection of guns and store them in your arsenal. Combining weapons upgrades your cannon, and choosing the right tactical position is key to holding back waves of cube-shaped enemies that keep growing more powerful. Along the way, deadly bosses test every defense you have built.
This single-player clicker sits in the arcade category and runs online through HTML5. Everything is controlled with the mouse, so you point, click, and defend your position from start to finish.
fresh-drop-triple-match: Fresh Drop: Triple Match is a bright, 3D puzzle game built around grouping products. Your job is to gather identical items into sets of three and empty the board completely before the clock hits zero. Each level brings in new hurdles, helpful boosters, and pleasing visual effects, yet every round stays short and simple to pick up.

To play, click or tap any product that is free to reach and it moves into the tray at the bottom. When three matching products sit in the tray, they disappear. Watch the tray carefully, since filling every slot ends the attempt. If a stage starts to feel tough, call on a booster to help you through. Mouse users only need the left button, while touchscreen players simply tap. Your progress is stored automatically, so you can switch between a computer and a phone without losing your place.
draw-to-help: Draw to Help is a puzzle title in which each scene carries a short tale. You might be asked to sketch something for a famished pup or a kitten stuck out in a downpour. Your job is to spot the piece that is absent from the picture, then sketch that missing piece with your finger, after which the characters respond to your answer.

The artwork has a charming cast, humorous setups, and illustrations made by hand. Each challenge calls for some clever thinking, and a tip becomes available whenever you get stuck. Artistic talent is not needed. To play, click or tap, then drag to draw.
basketball-allstars: Basketball AllStars is a two-player basketball game in the Sports category. You pick your team and work your way through a demanding tournament. Your player can pull off big dunks and three-pointers, and you can block or slap an opponent to knock them out and win the ball. Keep an eye on the supershot bar at the top of the screen. Once it fills, you can unleash a special dunk from anywhere on the court, and it always lands.

The arrow keys move your player, make them jump, and let them block when you press down. X pumps, Z shoots, and the game also includes controls for stealing and using the supershot. Your aim is to become the strongest player on the field.
handless-millionaire: In Handless Millionaire, you have to be willing to gamble everything. Fast reflexes and a calm head will serve you well as you try to pull banknotes out from under a guillotine blade. The blade picks up speed every round, so each grab feels tighter than the last.
Your greed pushes you to reach for more, but caution is what keeps your hands attached. Finding the right balance between the two makes every high-stakes round a tense test that keeps you on edge.
boxing-hero-2077: Boxing Hero 2077 puts you in the shoes of a rookie boxer in a high-tech future version of the sport. You train your fighter, sharpen your punches, and unlock new abilities as you go. Your opponents become steadily stronger, and your aim is to earn the title of cyber boxing champion.

The game features a wide range of enemies and locations, plus an ability system, an attack upgrade system, and quests to complete. Its gameplay is simple to pick up, so you can jump into the ring without a long learning curve. Controls use WASD or the mouse. A full run is expected to take about 60 to 80 minutes.
car-wash-diy: Car Wash DIY is a simulation game about looking after cars. You can wash them, tidy them up, and fix them, all through calm, easy tasks. Dirt can be scrubbed away, scratches can be repaired, fuel can be added to the tank, and a glossy finish can be applied as a final touch. The game is built around simple mechanics and controls, so players of any experience can pick it up quickly.

To work on a car, use your finger to scrub or tap the grimy spots. Tools such as the sprayer, sponge, sander, and polish are used by dragging or tapping. Scratches are fixed by tapping or dragging the repair tool. A cleaning job is only complete once every dirty spot has been covered. Whether you want a quick break or a longer, unhurried session, the game offers a relaxing way to unwind and be creative.
hidden-basketball: Hidden Basketball is a browser game that puts you on the court in a bright, detailed basketball simulator. You can sharpen your shooting in a training mode, take on rivals in casual matches, and work your way through tournaments. Every action is yours to direct, with plenty of tactical choices to make along the way.

The game looks sharp, with vivid graphics that make each shot and move easy to follow. Your aim is to reach the top of the competition through steady practice and smart decisions. Whether you want a quick warm-up or a longer run through the bracket, the game gives you room to focus on your timing and control.
do-not-feed-the-monkeys: This arcade simulation puts you in the role of a watcher, following strangers through hidden cameras. As you observe them, you gradually uncover their secrets and the dilemmas they face. The appeal lies in discovering all of this while fighting the urge to step in and interfere.

The game makes a clear point: staying unseen and simply observing matters most, but meddling could tip the balance of this privacy dilemma. Every decision sits on a fine line between curiosity and interference. Whether your restraint holds or your curiosity wins out is the central challenge.
zombies-ate-my-castle: Zombies Ate My Castle puts you in charge of an undead force defending your fortress in a tower defense setting. You position your zombie allies where they are needed, call in zombie carriers that bring fallen foes back to life, and cast strong spells when a battle turns against you. Coins earned from each win can be spent on upgrades that sharpen your abilities and strengthen your horde.

Your mission is to rescue the zombie princess. Recruit new zombies, gather resources from the enemies you defeat, and hold your castle against every wave of attackers that comes your way. Control everything with a mouse or a touchscreen: select units, then press the buttons to act.
happy-supermarket-3d-simulator: Run your own grocery store in this 3D management tycoon. You start with a modest shop and grow it into a busy supermarket by stocking shelves, greeting shoppers, and ringing up their purchases at the register. Each day your sales bring in cash, which you can spend on upgrades and new space so the store keeps expanding.

Move through the aisles with the W, A, S, and D keys, and use the mouse to look around and pick up or interact with items. Keeping products neatly arranged, serving customers quickly, and running the checkout smoothly are the keys to a store that thrives. The game asks whether you can transform a small corner shop into a thriving supermarket.
zombie-tycoon: The world has collapsed, but survivors still need to eat. You play a dusty cowboy with a torch, running the last food outpost in the zombie wasteland. Venture into the monster fields to hunt cute yet deadly mutant tomatoes and cucumbers, then haul their produce home. Load it into the canning machine, stock your food stand, and serve hungry survivors at the cash desk.

Coins from sales unlock new buildings, upgrade machines, and hire cashiers, delivery workers, and hunters who keep working while you rest. Quests and leveling up bring large rewards, and costume boxes provide outfits with income and speed bonuses. As your outpost grows, you can expand into more dangerous stages. Use WASD or arrow keys on PC, or drag the joystick on mobile. Walking onto a zone handles pickups, drop-offs, payments, and coll
hopeless-island-survival-hero: This action title pits you against monstrous creatures while you make your way across a perilous island. You fight back with blades and firearms, so your combat skills matter. When danger appears, trust your gut, and keep a close eye on your supplies, since using them wisely is essential.

Every choice you make can shift the outcome, so think before you act. Your goal is to get past each threat and find a way off the island, where the constant danger never lets up. Filed under fighting, the game tests your instincts, planning, and ability to survive.
realistic-lion-hunting-animal-2024: Step into the role of a lion in this immersive simulator, set in a vast and lifelike forest. Your goal is to hunt a variety of animals so you can survive, and overcoming tough stages lets you move on to new ones. Thick wilderness surrounds you, so you will need to track your prey carefully as you explore.

Movement uses the WASD keys, and holding Left Shift turns your walk into a run. Right-clicking stops a run, while left-clicking performs an attack. Anyone who enjoys hunting, tracking, and a realistic look at life as a predator should find it appealing.
freekick-hero: Freekick Hero is a 3D arcade soccer game about curling free kicks around walls of defenders and past goalkeepers. You can follow a Career that unfolds one season at a time, or go after the highest score in the Free Kick Challenge. Each shot asks you to line up your aim, choose where to strike the ball, and adapt to changing distances, angles, and wind.
Chain together scoring streaks, improve your power and curve, and unlock special balls. These include homing shots, wind-resistant balls, and explosive Meteor strikes.
super-friday-squid-challenge: The couple is back for another round of trouble. After losing all their money gambling, they end up joining a deadly contest inspired by the Squid Games. Your job is to clear songs across several weeks, hitting every arrow on time, so they can take home the high prize and win back what they lost. Many contestants won't make it, so keep dancing and don't hesitate.
The challenge has 12 levels, and finishing them all makes you the winner of 38 million USD. On a computer, use the arrow keys to play. On mobile, touch the areas of the game to play.
delivery-now: Delivery Now is an open world game built around endless deliveries. You race against the clock to get charming cargo to its destination. The action is fast-paced, blending driving with racing, while the graphics and sound work together to draw you into the experience.

Along the way, you weave through busy city highway traffic and pass other racers. You can pick your own route toward each goal, so no single path is required. Controls are simple: click or tap to play. It is a single-player title.
red-stickman-vs-monster-school-2: Red Stickman vs Monster School 2 drops you into a blocky, pixel-styled realm where you fight across 60 stages. Plan each move with the weapons in your collection as you face a crowd of hostile creatures and demanding bosses, including the notorious Herobrine. The ground you cross can be treacherous, so every step needs care.
Keep an eye out for lucky blocks scattered along the way,
stickman-epic: You play as a brave stickman setting out on a long adventure. Three distinct fighters are available, each offering its own style of play. As you progress, you can upgrade their armor to help them hold their ground.

The journey spans 15 levels, and along the way cunning bosses will test your plans. Careful strategy matters, and each hero can call on special abilities to turn a fight in your favor. The colorful, pixelated world adds charm to every clash, and the mix of battles and rewards keeps the fun going.
spider-robot-transformation: Spider Robot Transformation is a shooting game built around a robotic battle. Police spider robots are ready to fight, and the title centers on transforming robots, space robot warriors, and mech warrior skills. It is also tagged as action and adventure, so combat and robot-themed exploration sit side by side.

You control the spider with the WASD keys or the arrow keys. Using these controls, you move your robot across the battlefield and take on each fight from the spider's point of view. Fans of robot transformation games will recognize the familiar mix of mech combat and shooting here.
starpoly: Starpoly is a PC trading board game that you can play against the computer or with family and friends. It has its own unique features, including a lottery and draws tied to property appreciation. You can choose to accept or decline a loan, and the starbridge is part of the game too.

Managing your properties happens through site management, where you settle amounts and upgrade, downgrade, or sell them. You can also carry out these actions by clicking the matching sites or slots directly on the board. Everything is controlled with the mouse, and the game is meant to be a relaxed, enjoyable experience.
glauron-dragon-tales: You play as Glauron, a furious dragon hungry for revenge. Controls are simple, since two clicks are all it takes to unleash your attacks. Your targets include archers who keep firing at you, arrows you can burn out of the sky, and villages you can set alight.

The game is quick to pick up but takes practice to truly master. Soaring through the air as a conqueror, you'll need sharp reactions and plenty of rage to keep going. It falls under the dinosaur category and carries the dinosaur tag.
cut-grass-for-brainrots: Cut Grass for Brainrots puts you in charge of a lawn full of tall, dense grass, with Brainrots hidden underneath. Swing your weapon to mow through the patches, clear each field, and open up new zones to explore. As your damage grows, you can tackle thicker grass more comfortably. Gathering Brainrots boosts your income so you can move ahead faster. When you rebirth, you receive stronger boosts and a wider attack range.

On mobile, drag the left joystick to move, use the right side of the screen to turn the camera, and tap the on-screen button to jump. On PC, move with WASD or the arrow keys, aim the camera with the mouse, press Space to jump, press 1 to eject your fishing rod, and press 2 to open your inventory.
survival-wave-zombie-multiplayer: Survival Wave Zombie Multiplayer is a free shooter where you face a crowd of computer-controlled foes, including soldiers and lifelike zombies. The game offers five modes, among them gun game, survival, team deathmatch and deathmatch, along with more options to try. You can team up with friends for multiplayer matches, and every weapon can be customized with camo patterns and attachments.
Controls are simple. Use W, A, S and D to move, and the mouse to aim, look around and shoot. Press SPACE to jump, SHIFT to run and TAB to open the menu, and change weapons as you go.
connect-pipe-color-puzzle-game: Connect Pipe! is a colorful puzzle title that suits players of every age. Your job is to join pipes that share a color, making sure no two routes cross. The palette is bright and cheerful, and the levels grow harder as you move forward, so you can measure your skill as you go.

Puzzles come with a time limit, so you need both speed and accuracy to finish before the clock runs out. A fresh puzzle is also waiting every day to keep your mind sharp. On touch devices, drag your finger to connect pipes smoothly. On a computer, use a left-click to link pipes with ease.
polybounce-tycoon: PolyBounce Tycoon mixes idle play with arcade ball bounce physics. You can spawn balls yourself or let an auto spawner do the work, and each bounce pays out virtual cash, shown with popup text and sound effects. The arenas range from circles and squares to triangles, hexagons, and more, and each level changes the shape you play in. Tapping anywhere gives the balls a brief speed boost at no cost.

Three buttons at the bottom handle your growth. Add Ball spawns an extra ball, Incremental Payout raises what each wall bounce earns, and Passive Income boosts your earnings every second, even when you're idle. You can also speed up the auto spawner, upgrade balls with new sprites and levels, and browse the shop for new ball skins. Reaching the next level unlocks new arena shapes and multiplies your profits, but it resets your upgrades. All cash in the game is virtual and has no real-world value.
dark-world: Dark World is a platformer where bravery is needed to move forward through dangerous terrain and plenty of excitement. You get through 30 stages, using both a sword and a bow to deal with clever enemies. Along the way you wander through puzzling routes and search out hidden loot. Careful planning and a brave heart are what will keep you alive.
falcon-dogfight: Take to the sky in cutting-edge fighter jets and join intense air battles. The controls are kept simple, so close-range dogfights and long-distance BVR fights are easy to pick up. Lock onto targets with your radar and use automatic manoeuvres to outmatch enemies far away. The game captures the rush of modern aerial warfare without a heavy learning curve.
cricket-hero: In Cricket Hero, your goal is to become a star by getting really good at batting. Send balls flying into the stands while steering around pesky obstacles like eggs and bombs. Quick reflexes are essential, and every strong hit helps you win over the crowd.

The game is built around a lively cricket atmosphere that pulls you into the action. You can practice your timing, sharpen your reactions, and enjoy the buzz of the match from start to finish. It is a sports title for anyone who enjoys cricket or fast-thinking challenges.
ninja-escape-2: Ninja Escape 2 is a demanding platformer that lets you tap into ninja powers with fresh, intuitive touch controls. Sprint, leap, slide, and soar through the air to steer clear of every spike, because hitting one means you will explode in a burst of blood.
Follow the master through the stages, and once you have completed every level, an endless mode unlocks so you can chase the top scores. The controls work with a mouse click or a touch.
nut-sort-build-the-city: In this color-sorting puzzle, you work through a jumble of nuts and bolts until every bolt holds only one color. Each finished stage moves your city forward, since the nuts you collect can be spent on new houses and parks. You can construct 14 different cities, and thousands of levels offer a range of difficulty. After every five regular levels, a special bonus stage appears.

Controls are simple: tap the bolt you want to take a nut from, then tap the bolt that should receive it. Only the topmost nut can move, and it may land on a matching color or an empty bolt. If you get stuck, you can view a solution for the level or add an extra bolt to the field. The game is relaxing and also gives your brain a workout.
baseball-for-clowns: Henk, a famous baseball star, is back on the field to face a crew of troublemaking jokers. The game takes you through wacky, fast-moving stages where every swing counts. Your goal is to use your batting and baseball know-how to outwit the jesters and knock them out of the picture, so Henk can win back the fame he once had.
It is a silly, lighthearted journey from start to finish. Help Henk work his way back to the top, one swing at a time.
paperly-paper-plane-adventure: Paperly: Paper Plane Adventure is a single-player 3D adventure where you guide a paper plane on a journey. Along the way you learn different flight mechanics and work toward reaching your destination. Each attempt teaches you something, so earlier mistakes become lessons that help you fly better next time. The game is built on physics, so how the plane behaves in the air shapes every move you make.

On PC, you steer with the WASD keys and use Shift to boost. On mobile, you play with a joystick and buttons. Either way, the goal is to handle your plane with care and improve from one flight to the next.
pixel-jam-bus-puzzle: Pixel Jam Bus Puzzle is a colorful sorting game where tiny passengers gather to form playful pixel pictures. You steer vehicles into a set of limited parking spaces and match each one's color to the passengers waiting nearby. Tap a vehicle to collect passengers of its shade. Once it fills up, it leaves and frees a space. Your goal is to clear the picture without filling every space.

The puzzle offers 1,000 levels that grow harder over time, with easier stages appearing now and then. Clear and Shuffle helpers are there when you need them, and pickup speed upgrades can be applied through on-screen buttons. Think ahead about vehicle capacity and the colors coming up next. Play with mouse or touch controls, in portrait or landscape. Progress is saved in your current browser.
rollance-going-balls: Rollance Going Balls is a casual platform game in the hypercasual genre. You steer a colorful ball and roll it across a set of carefully built platforms. Every jump and roll blends luck with skill, so each attempt feels like its own little performance. Stay alert for moving hammers that can get in your way.

To start, just click the mouse or tap the screen. The game is listed under arcade, with ball, jump, and skill as its main tags. Moving from one platform to the next is the core of the challenge, so keep your eyes on the path ahead.
weapon-run-battle: Weapon Run Battle is a hypercasual game where you dash, leap, and blast your way through its levels. Collect cash as you go and spend it to upgrade your arsenal. Picking the right weapon matters when you face tough enemies, so think about your choices carefully. The game mixes parkour-style movement with shooting, which means you keep moving while you fire. It is tagged as casual.

Each run gives you room to experiment and refine your tactics. Your goal is to reach complete triumph over the enemies in your way. Expect an adventure powered by money, where every bit of cash you gather helps you grow stronger.
gun-bounce-idle: Gun Bounce Idle is a clicker about chain reactions. You drop guns into an arena and watch their bullets ricochet off the edges, firing in every direction and collecting cash with each hit. Once a weapon is bought and placed on the field, it bounces and attacks on its own, earning coins as it deals damage. Use the left mouse button to move through the in-game menus.

Spend your coins on talents that raise power, attack speed, critical hit chance, and income. Unlock new guns with their own behaviors and special modifiers to turn plain shots into something much messier. Gaining levels grants experience, unlocks upgrades, and opens up tougher targets, while achievements give you extra goals to work toward. When progress starts to slow, Prestige resets your run in return for permanent bonuses that make each new run stronger and quicker.
zombie-invasion: Zombie Invasion drops you into a 3D world after the end of civilization. You pick either Rick or Kate and fight off endless waves of undead. Your job is to avoid harm, keep survivors safe, and grab power-ups along the way. The action moves quickly, so you need quick reactions and a steady aim to handle the tougher zombie enemies.

The game is built around fast, nonstop combat that rewards sharp instincts. Every encounter tests how well you can dodge and shoot at the same time. If you enjoy action games with a heavy dose of tension, this one offers plenty of it.
lovely-virtual-cat-at-restaurant: This cooking title follows a cat who runs a restaurant that has become very well liked. A crowd of animals stops by to sample the menu, and it's up to you to keep the place running. Your everyday duties include taking food orders and preparing the dishes. Along the way you'll spot some unusual surprises, such as a lobster that grows larger when you feed it.

You can also swap the table decorations to suit a certain mood. Touching the animals makes them produce cute sounds, and the game holds plenty of other entertaining bits to discover. Controls are simple: use your mouse or tap the screen.
super-tank-hero: Super Tank Hero is an action shooter where you take the controls of a tank and fire your way through battlefields. Each fight usually pits you against seven enemies, and you also have to dodge or work around obstacles along the way. Before a battle begins, gather soldiers to bring onto your side, since they will join your team and lend a hand in the fighting.

Playing is simple: just click the mouse or tap the screen. Keep an eye on the enemies, steer your tank into position, and let your soldiers support you as you push through each clash on the battlefield.
fun-summer-holiday: Join Ashleigh and her pals for spontaneous trips in this dress-up game for girls. Spin the wheel to find out where you will head next, then choose outfits that suit each stop. Snap pictures as the holiday unfolds, saving the moments you enjoy most.
When you want to look back, the photo gallery lets you revisit every trip you took. Once you have seen it all, you can jet off once more for another summer getaway full of style and play.
hotel-manager-simulator: You start with a modest hotel that has just opened its doors. Your job is to welcome visitors, check each one into a free room, and provide them with meals, drinks, and a place to stay. Happy guests reward you with likes, which you collect as you work. Over time, your goal is to grow the business until you own the biggest hotel in the world.

When a rush of guests becomes too much, boosters can help you keep up with what they want. Once someone leaves, tidy up their room so it's ready for the next arrival. This mobile management simulation lets you run the whole place as a tycoon.
