hole-and-fill-collect-master: Step into the shoes of a magical hole in this adventure. Your job is to swallow up all sorts of food lying around the scene, including cakes, slices of meat, and donuts. Each bite fills you up and makes you more powerful, and the bigger the item you gulp down, the faster you upgrade. Your aim is to gather as much food in the scene as you can.

Controls are simple: just click with your mouse or tap your screen to play. As you collect more and more food, your hole keeps growing and getting stronger. Hole And Fill Collect Master suits anyone who enjoys a playful adventure with a hungry twist.
chicken-farm: Chicken Farm is a clicker and tycoon game where you start with a few birds and grow your own poultry business. Buy chickens and set them up around your farm. They lay eggs on their own, so you collect those eggs and trade them for cash. Spend that cash on more chickens and new land to keep your farm expanding.

Combining two identical chickens gives you a rarer, more profitable breed, so there is always something new to discover. You can also upgrade your coop and unlock fresh features as you move forward. Your hens keep laying even when you close the game, so your earnings keep building while you are away. Move around with WASD and use the mouse to change your view.
water-me-please: In this puzzle game, your job is to route water to parched plants by moving and fitting pieces into place. It spans more than 600 stages, so there is plenty to work through. You can unwind at a calm pace in Relax Mode, or take on harder tests in Challenge Mode.

The cast of charming characters adds personality, and the controls are simple to pick up. Because it is easy to start and suitable for everyone, it works for a quick break or a longer session whenever and wherever you like.
fashion-sewing-clothes: You step into the role of a famous costume designer, and princesses are among the biggest fans of your outfits. Two stylish visitors, Elisa and Alice, arrive at your studio, and both are considered the most fashionable girls around. They will customize the costumes you make, so you need to listen closely to what they ask for. Your task is to craft the most beautiful outfits you can to match their wishes.
Everything in the game is controlled with a mouse click or a tap.
ricopop: RICOPOP is a glowing ricochet puzzle with an arcade feel. You line up a volley, let the balls bank off the walls, and try to break every crystal in as few shots as possible. Chain reactions help clear the board, and you can charge the Pulse while chasing three stars through 50 levels split into 10 chapters. Six ball styles are waiting to be unlocked, and the game offers 14 languages.

Controls are simple. Drag with your mouse or finger to aim, then release to fire. Balls return to you on their own. Angled bounces off the walls let you reach crystals from unexpected directions. Press Escape or the pause button to take a break, and use the speed button to hurry a volley along.
switch-colors: Switch Colors is a ball game in which you guide a ball that changes color through hoops that keep rotating. To get past each one, you need to match the ball's shade to the hoop, which takes careful aim and good timing. Quick reactions help, and so does remembering which colors came before, since the challenges keep shifting.

Every run lets you try for a higher score, so you will want to refine your timing and stay alert from start to finish. It plays as a puzzle adventure that tests both focus and memory. Anyone who enjoys testing their reflexes against changing obstacles should find plenty here to hold their attention.
super-shark-world: Dive into an underwater adventure where you steer a shark through a submarine packed with hazards. The gold you collect by the end of the game can be spent on new shark characters, giving you a reason to come back and try them out.

You can explore the submarine across fifteen levels or switch to endless mode. Along the way, three boss characters stand in your path, and defeating all of them lets you take over the submarine. Move with W, A, S, D or the arrow keys, press K to shoot, and press L to dash.
pool-float-party: Blondie and Marie are planning a pool party with a twist: they want refreshing cocktails in their small but private pool. First, the pair needs a mojito made from soda, lemon, lime and mint leaves, so you will mix it together while Blondie handles the drinks and Marie tidies the space beside the water. Then it is time to decorate the area in a style that suits the celebration.

Once everything is in order, the girls get their own makeovers. Pick outfits and accessories for each of them from a range of swimsuits and pareos. Blondie is drawn to pink tones, whereas Marie favors red and black paired with a polka dot print. Finish the looks with an inflatable raft in an unusual shape. The finished scene can be saved as a PNG image. Play with a mouse click or a simple tap on a touchscreen.
princess-kawaii-swimwear: Princess Kawaii Swimwear takes you to the seaside, where fashion is the focus. You express your imagination by dressing princesses in swimsuits in bright, soft pastel shades. The goal is to put together a fun beach-ready outfit for each character.

The controls are simple to pick up, so you can start styling right away. Combine different pieces, switch them up, and add accessories until every princess looks her best. It is a cheerful dress-up game full of color. Each princess can shine in a style that feels like your own.
halloween-mania: A castle has been taken over by frightened monsters and assorted garden creatures in this Match 3 casual puzzler. Its traditional design offers 60 demanding levels, and each one comes with its own goal to reach. To remove monsters, line up at least three of the same color so they vanish from the field. Lining up four or more creates powerful tiles that blast nearby sections of the board.

Your challenge is to clear every level with three stars while earning as many points as you can. Since each stage asks for something different, you will need to plan your matches carefully. Every combination you pull off helps push your score higher as you work through the creatures in the castle.
basketball-arcade: In Basketball Arcade, you grab a ball and aim to score as many points as you can. Free throws come from a variety of angles and distances, so each shot brings a new challenge. Before you start, choose a team you like and see how far you can climb toward being the top player. The clock is ticking, so you will need to act fast, and you have 20 balls to work with.

Judging the right angle and power is the tricky part. Pick up the ball from the table, then press and hold the left mouse button to build up shooting force. The strength appears on the indicator on the right. Release to shoot, and watch the timer as you go. Move with W, A, S and D, jump with Space, and aim with the mouse.
mini-games-puzzle-collection: Mini Games: Puzzle Collection gathers three of the most popular puzzle games into one package. Each one offers a different kind of brainteaser, so you get a varied mix of challenges to work through.

In one challenge, your supply of wooden planks is limited, so you must build a bridge that lets a doge cross the river and reach the bones on the far side. Another round asks you to draw lines that carry donuts to the doge. Play with mouse clicks or taps.
gun-and-guys: Gun and Guys puts two players head to head in fast shootouts. Your job is to move quickly, take clean shots, and choose from a range of weapons and upgrades along the way. Staying safe means jumping and dodging while you line up your aim across colorful arenas.

Every match rewards careful thinking as much as quick reactions. You need to plan each move so you can get ahead of your rival and outplay them. The player who is faster and more precise usually comes out on top.
squishy-clicker: Squishy Clicker is a relaxed idle game about soft, squashy toys. A 3D squishy sits in the middle of the screen. Press into it and it dents, then slowly puffs back up. Swipe beside it and it spins. Every squeeze earns coins, and the squishies you buy keep earning on their own, even while you are away. You can collect mochi, strawberry, kitty, cloud, panda and more.

Watch for the golden squishy, which brings coin rain and frenzies. Tap quickly to fill a bar and trigger a mega squeeze, and claim a daily gift when it is ready. Achievements unlock new tap effects and backgrounds. When progress slows, rebirth for softness stars, each adding 10% income permanently and making new rounds faster. Climb the leaderboard ranked by total squeezes. Use a mouse on desktop or touch on mobile.
rabbit-samurai: As a brave rabbit warrior, you set out on an adventure across the land. The main skill is swinging, and you must pick the right angle for each swing to move forward. Along the way, you can rescue mice and gather treasures.

The landscapes you cross are beautiful to look at, and you get around them with grappling hooks and ropes. Your goal is to outwit the clever wolves who stand in your way. Each swing brings you closer to the end of the quest.
yummy-waffle-ice-cream: Yummy Waffle Ice Cream is a cooking game for anyone who enjoys waffles and ice cream. Your job is to bake a waffle and then top it with scoops of ice cream, your choice of fruit, and a variety of syrups. Think of yourself as a waffle chef and let your creativity guide each dessert you build.

The game is designed to work across phones, tablets, and computers. On a desktop, you use your mouse to click on ingredients, tools, and buttons. On a touchscreen, you simply tap to pick items and apply them to your waffle. Either way, the controls stay simple so you can focus on decorating.
street-food-cooking-game: Welcome to a lively world of food trucks, where your cooking abilities get a real workout. Your job is to prepare street snacks that look as good as they taste, from hot dogs to plates of nachos. Add a range of creative toppings to make each order stand out.
Chef-level challenges push your skills even further, so you will need to stay sharp. Your virtual kitchen stays busy as you work to keep every customer satisfied and the whole operation moving.
impossible-car-stunt-mega-ramp-3d: Take the wheel of a car on lofty sky roads, where winding tracks are built around giant ramps and seemingly impossible jumps. Your job is to pull off daring stunts while handling zigzag routes that demand careful driving at great heights. The jumps follow convincing physics, so every launch feels believable as you soar through the air.

Race against rival drivers on endless 3D courses, drifting through corners and performing wild mid-air flips along the way. Speed through like a daredevil as you chase victory in this 2019 racing simulator. All controls are handled with the keyboard, so buckle up and get ready to take off.
cat-pet-doctor-dentist: Imagine yourself working as a veterinarian, rescuing poor kittens whenever they need help. The game gives you treatment tools for cats that are designed to look very true to life. An X-ray machine lets you check a cat's bones, and a magnifying glass helps you look closely for skin problems.
Everything is controlled with a simple mouse click or tap. It suits anyone curious about animal care or the hands-on work a vet does each day, and it offers a relaxed way to explore that role.
coin-hunt: Coin Hunt lets you drive through shifting scenery while gathering treasure coins tucked away along the way. You can pick from a range of cars and tweak them to suit your style. Each track is packed with hidden routes and jumps, and you can grab power-ups that give your car a speed boost.

The game looks sharp and presents plenty of tactical puzzles to solve as you drive. Every run is a fast, thrilling trip, and your goal is to rise up the worldwide leaderboards by outperforming other players.
basketball-park: Basketball Park is a 3D sports game for one player, where you take shots at the hoop with a stack of ten balls. To launch a ball, drag back and let go. Sinking a basket without the ball brushing the rim earns you bonus balls to keep playing.

Reaching higher scores unlocks creatures that can give you a hand. The leaderboard shows how your results compare with the best players. Now and then, unusual creatures appear at certain score milestones to assist you, which keeps every round a little surprising.
room-makeover-design-and-aesthetic: Step into a relaxed interior design game where each level gives you an empty room and boxes full of furniture and decor. Unpack everything and drag each piece onto the highlighted spot where it belongs, turning bare space into a cozy, stylish retreat. Every item has one correct place, and the level ends once all of them are positioned. Rooms grow more complex as you progress, adding more items and more elaborate styles.

Choose from soft pastels, modern elegance, bohemian chic, or trendy aesthetics to shape each space. Every room challenges your taste and creativity, yet there are no timers and no pressure, so the experience stays calm and meditative. Mix colors, experiment with arrangements, and enjoy the satisfying results. Watching the color palette and overall style helps you find the right spot faster. It suits anyone who loves organizing or simply wants a feel-good way to unwind.
falling-dummy: Push the ragdoll dummy off the roof of the tallest tower on a construction site, then watch its bones break on the way down. As the little man falls, you control his body and steer it toward the ground, concrete structures, construction cranes, and other building objects. Each hit breaks more of his limbs, and your aim is to break as many as possible.

This anti-stress game is made for relaxing after a long day. It offers easygoing gameplay, bright stylized 3D graphics, and interesting levels. You can also choose from a range of skins to change how the dummy looks as it tumbles.
wizard-santa-jump: Wizard Santa Jump sends you on a holiday trip as a wizard version of Santa Claus. Each level is full of hazards, so you need to time your moves with care. Your job is to leap over deadly obstacles, use your momentum to carry you forward, and finish every stage before time runs out.

The game mixes danger with festive cheer, so tense moments sit alongside cheerful ones. It asks for patience as well as skill, which makes this winter-themed journey a real test. It is filed under Arcade.
cup-quest: Cup Quest , Hero's Journey gives the classic ball-and-cup game a new spin by turning it into an adventure. You play as a brave cat determined to save the day. Puzzles and physics challenges fill every stage, and the cat must get past spinning platforms, explosives, and other tricky obstacles. The game offers more than 200 levels, ranging from simple to seriously tricky.

Every level tests your aim and timing. You guide the balls dropping from the cup, bounce them off the environment, and land them neatly in the target cup. Power alone is not enough, since strategy, finesse, and a little creative thinking matter too. Along the way you can unlock new feline heroes and grow stronger, while swarms of enemies and traps try to slow you down. Use your mouse to guide the balls and to click buttons and powerups.
physics-box-2: Physics Box 2 is a puzzle game where you guide a cube to the finish line. The cube carries momentum, so each push and bounce affects where it ends up, and you need to plan your moves. Along the way you will meet lasers, moving platforms, and spikes to avoid.

Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need, so it works on both computers and phones. The game suits players who enjoy physics-based jumping and platform challenges that reward timing and skill. Its straightforward tasks make it approachable for younger players as well.
bouncing-ball: Bouncing Ball drops you into a colorful world where good timing and careful aim matter most. You tap to guide your ball through winding obstacle courses, and you need to keep a steady pace while staying accurate to win each stage. As you move on, every level pushes harder, so your quick reactions and split-second choices get tested again and again. It's a fast arcade adventure that many players find hard to put down.

The controls are simple: tapping is all it takes to move through each course. Because the speed and precision both count, you'll learn to judge when to hurry and when to slow down. Bouncing Ball is a quick-moving game for anyone who enjoys ball games with a strong focus on rhythm and reflexes.
dunkin-beanz: Dunkin Beanz is a basketball game built around dunking. The latest update brings a fresh version of the game, and each match moves at a brisk pace.

You can face players from around the world in multiplayer matches. Climb the leaderboards, earn achievements, and prove you have mastered the game. Upgrading and unboxing are part of the path to winning. Move with WASD, the arrow keys, or by dragging with the left mouse button, then release the buttons to throw or pass.
who-will-win-create-a-battle: You design your own showdowns in this battle game, using a large collection of more than 300 objects. Pick from a range of characters, vehicles, and weapons, then combine them to craft fights of your own making. Each choice you make shapes the clash you create.

The goal is to build battles that keep you hooked until the final moment. Strategy plays a big part, so think carefully about how your setup will play out. Once everything is in place, you can see who ends up as the winner of the clash.
battleships-pirates: Battleships Pirates is a turn-based take on the classic guessing game. Each side has a grid and quietly marks a set of ships on it. You decide where every vessel goes, aiming for spots that are hardest for the enemy to hit, or you can let the game place them on random squares instead. Players take turns firing at the opponent's grid, and the first side to sink every enemy ship wins.

Since each move depends on working out where the hidden ships might be, the game is a good way to practise logical thinking. It adapts to any screen size, so it runs smoothly on desktop computers and mobile devices alike. Mouse users click to select and confirm their choices, while touch screen players tap to do the same.
yummy-cupcake: In this puzzle game, you step into the role of a head pastry chef. You start by baking cupcakes, then decorate them however you like. The toppings never run out, so you can keep experimenting, and you can choose from a bright range of cups to hold each treat.

Once your cupcakes are finished, you serve them to customers who are waiting for a taste. Pleasing them raises their happiness, so every order is a chance to show off your skills. The game gives your creativity plenty of room, and its colorful, tempting look makes for an engaging experience from start to finish.
double-boy-jump: Double Boy Jump is an arcade game where you guide two heroes joined by a rope across tricky platforms. Press and hold to jump, then let go at just the right moment to land safely. You can also switch between the two partners. Keep both of them out of danger as you cross gaps, pick up coins, and work toward a higher score.

The game includes themed modes called Snow Dash, Face to Face, Cloud Ride, Monster Escape, and Escort Quest. You can unlock character skins as you play. The controls are simple, and the rope-linked teamwork means every jump is a new test of timing. Use a mouse on desktop or touch controls on mobile, click or tap START to begin, and choose your mode with the on-screen buttons.
red-light-green-light-io: Red Light Green Light.io turns the well-known Squid Game challenge into a multiplayer .io game. You work to complete the game at the same time as players from all over the world. When the killer baby calls out red light, you must stop, and when it calls green light, you must move. Speed matters, but so does care, since you need to finish before everyone else.

You can play with a mouse or touchpad, or steer with the W, A, S, and D keys or the arrow keys. The game page contains no links. Whether you are new to the idea or already know the original, you will need good timing and quick reactions to succeed.
my-golf: Start each shot in My Golf, a charming pixel-art game where accuracy is everything. You play across a variety of landscapes, collecting stars that open up new courses and alternative golf balls. The retro look adds to the fun. Every hole asks you to think through your approach, and the controls are simple and easy to pick up.

The game rewards careful planning, so take your time lining up each swing and work out the best route to the cup. Whether you are chasing stars or simply enjoying the scenery, each hole offers its own challenge to solve.
cube-island-3d: Take on the role of the brave Steve, who must begin from nothing on a mysterious island where no one lives. Your job is to shape this stretch of wild nature into a thriving home for living things. Along the way you will survive hardships, complete tasks, earn achievements, construct buildings, gather materials, and craft new items. You can also discover other islands to explore.

Your creativity and strategic choices will decide how well you do, as you move from simply staying alive to building real prosperity. The game is in 3D and can be played on mobile devices or with a mouse. Swipe across the screen or press the left mouse button to control your moves.
draw-and-escape: Draw And Escape gathers together a set of puzzles that blend parking challenges with drawing challenges. One of them is Draw Bridge, where you sketch a line across a defined area to guide the yellow car to the finish line. The route you draw is the only help the car gets, so plan your line carefully before you begin.

Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need. The game sits in the Puzzles category and is tagged with car, drawing, and parking, which gives a clear idea of what to expect. It suits anyone who enjoys solving small problems with a drawn solution.
noob-s-great-escape: Noob's Great Escape is a platformer that sends you on a daring getaway through 100 carefully crafted stages. Your job is to steer Noob toward freedom, and along the way you will need both quick reactions and a clear head. Each stage throws up a puzzle or a surprise that forces you to rethink your approach.

Expect plenty of tricky obstacles and unexpected turns that catch you off guard. Every level rewards careful thinking as much as quick hands, so take your time to study the layout before you leap. If you can outwit each challenge, you will lead Noob all the way to victory.
farm-nubik-vs-zombies: In this farm-based game, you help Nubik find a way out of a place he needs to leave. Your route runs through improving his base, strengthening Nubik himself, and upgrading his weapons. Hired mercenaries can support you along the way. Collecting resources lets you open new zones, though bigger zones bring more zombies. Strategy matters throughout.

Your main objective is to locate the portal that leads out, and reaching it also destroys the zombie helpers. The pace is relaxing and meditative, so you can take your time. A leaderboard ranks players by kills, giving you a chance to climb toward the top. Keep building your base and working toward that exit.
asmr-tower-1-jump: In this 3D tower climber, every step you take adds one point of jump power, so each leap carries you a little higher. Work through unusual ASMR obstacles, and crush or break the crunchy objects you meet to earn bonus rewards. Spend what you collect on powerful upgrades, and unlock satisfying ASMR effects along the way.

Move with the WASD keys and turn the camera with your mouse. Keep training your jump, climb higher up the tower, and unlock new levels and challenges as you advance. Reach the finish line to claim victory. The game blends platforming, running and idle clicking into one experience.
fall-beans-game: Sprint toward the end of the course while jostling with a big crowd of rivals in a battle-royale style of contest. Your challenge is to time each move so you clear the obstacles in your path, then pick the speediest route to reach victory. Every choice you make shapes how fast you cross the line.
You play by clicking with a mouse or tapping the screen. The focus stays on timing your movements and choosing your route, so dash through the course and see whether your path can beat everyone else.
gt-ghost-racing: GT Ghost Racing puts you behind the wheel of old-school and high-tech cars as you chase down legendary ghostly rivals. The courses wind through many kinds of scenery and across different seasons, so you need to learn each bend and every type of road surface. Races are tense and close, and you pick up stars along the way to climb toward the championship.
Expect shifting tracks that keep you alert from start to finish. Your goal is to master the twists, collect the stars, and prove you can outdrive the spectral competition.
constella-single-line-puzzle: Constella invites you to slow down as you link stars together and bring constellations into view. Each puzzle asks you to draw one continuous path across the night sky, and every solved board reveals a new shape. The setting is quiet and peaceful, and the hidden figures include a desert cactus, a crisp apple, a celestial turtle, and a starry crab.

The game is tranquil and soothing, and it gently stretches your mind as you go. To play, hold the left mouse button and drag to trace lines between stars. A left click on the on-screen controls lets you undo a move, ask for a hint, or skip a level. Move the mouse to look around and navigate the board.
ancient-aztec-coloring: Ancient Aztec Coloring is a free online coloring game aimed at kids. Your job is to fill in eight separate pictures, and the quicker you finish them, the higher your final score will be. A palette of 23 shades is available for you to pick from. When you are happy with a picture, you can save a copy of it. Control it with your mouse or by tapping the screen.
Each session gives you a chance to experiment with colors and see how your artwork turns out. Whether you are on a desktop or a phone, the game is simple to pick up and enjoy.
sword-hunter: Sword Hunter is a 2D role-playing beat-em-up with an arcade feel. You take charge of a sword-wielding heroine whose job is to defeat the foes that keep coming at her. Her mission is to restore order by wiping out these enemies one after another.
Controls are simple: click or tap with your mouse or finger to play. The game focuses on fast, straightforward combat, so you can jump right in and start swinging your blade at whatever approaches.
haystack-works: Somewhere inside an enormous pile of hay sits a lost needle, and digging it out is your goal. Begin by gathering hay with your own hands: hold the left mouse button on the pile, carry your load to the sale dock on the left, and press E to sell. The money from sales pays for conveyors, bale presses, and machines that turn straw into more profit. Unlock improvements through research and complete orders as they come in.

Move with WASD. T opens the research tree, I opens the tools, and B opens the build catalog. R rotates a piece, PageUp and PageDown adjust build height, and Q cancels, though conveyors need two clicks to place. F loads hay into a machine. Tab opens the menu and pauses the game, and Esc works as a backup. Let your production run on its own, then track down all six concealed needles to win.
gt-flying-car-racing: Take the wheel of fast GT cars that can change into flying machines in this arcade racer. You weave through demanding tracks, pull off aerial stunts, and move between road driving and flight whenever you choose. Dodging obstacles and beating rival racers are both part of the challenge, and you need skill on the ground as well as in the sky to climb to the top spot.

Everything is controlled with the mouse alone. It is a single-player casual game, so you can jump in for a quick run or take your time working through the courses. Your goal is to master both land and air racing and become the champion.
mechaspider-cyber-strike: Step into a city at war in the future, where you pilot an advanced mechanical spider built as a deadly weapon. You can scale the sides of towering skyscrapers, launch energy webs, and fire heavy artillery. Your aim is to tear through waves of rogue machines and take full control of the battlefield.

Agile movement and powerful tech abilities are the keys to success. Press V to lock or unlock your mouse, and use keys 1 through 4 to switch weapons while in robot form. Click to shoot, and left-click to aim.
merge-grabber-race-to-2048: Merge Grabber: Race to 2048 blends quick decision-making with fast-paced movement. You sprint along lanes that keep changing shape, combining characters as you go to build toward the 2048 tile. Zombies are waiting along the way, so you need to stay one step ahead of them. This arcade game rewards players who can think on their feet and move without hesitation.

Expect a challenge that tests both your reflexes and your cunning. Those who make smart choices quickly and aren't afraid to take risks are the ones who come out on top. It suits anyone who likes quick thinking under pressure.
cube-drop-puzzle-match-color: Cube Drop Puzzle: Match Color is a brain game that mixes placing blocks with pairing colors, all set around a fun water park theme. You steer falling cubes so the cheerful bears can enjoy their splash time. The puzzles keep getting cleverer as you go, so you need to plan where each cube will land before you let it drop. The bright water scenery keeps the mood lively from start to finish.

Every bear has a matching hole, and your aim is to guide each one into its own hole so it can jump into the aqua lake. As the levels grow more complex, strategic thinking becomes essential for getting past the tougher challenges.
train-artillery-adventure: You take charge of a powerful artillery train and defend it against endless waves of undead foes. Merging weapons is central to the approach, so you need to plan which pieces work best together. As you gather resources, you can customize your train and boost its firepower, and a wide selection of guns gives you different ways to handle each threat.

Every stage calls for quick reactions and smart tactics, so both your reflexes and your strategy get tested. Each shot has to land precisely, since accuracy is what clears the hordes. Across the intense levels, your train becomes a tougher machine as you wipe out enemy after enemy.
world-cricket-champ: Lead your country's cricket team in World Cricket Champ, a sports game that rewards both smart planning and fast reactions. You face rivals from around the world, come up with clever tactics, and get through quick-moving matches on your way to international cricket success. The controls are easy to pick up, and the challenges keep things engaging from start to finish.

Every decision you make shapes how your team performs, so you'll need to balance strategy with split-second timing. The game blends careful management with action on the field, giving you plenty to think about as you aim for victory on the global stage.
coloring-book-for-kids-game: Little artists can spend time with this coloring title, which works as both a free book of pictures to color and a painting app. Its toolset is bright and imaginative, giving children of every age room to make their own artwork on a mobile device.

Several play styles are included so the whole household can join in. Players can try paint by numbers, color by numbers, or open doodling, or pick from free coloring books of all types. Whether the artist is a toddler or a preschooler, there is something here to draw. Play with a mouse or by tapping.
ash-hidden-objects: Your job in this game is to help the silly Ash and Pikachu track down hidden objects. Pick a level to start, and you will need to locate every item on the list. The names of what you are searching for appear on the left side of the screen, so keep an eye on them. Stay focused, because the clock keeps ticking and the game ends if time runs out.
Click with your mouse or tap the screen to find the objects. Aim for the highest score you can and try to earn three stars on each level.
team-men: In this co-op runner, you race down roads while picking up companions who share your color. Each matching recruit makes your group bigger, and your target is the finish at the end of every road. Along the way, try to assemble the mightiest crew you can and rack up as many points as possible.

Steering works like this. On a computer, move the mouse left or right to shift your character. On a phone, use touch controls to move it left or right. Points you gather can be spent to strengthen your army, and the game
wedding-artist2: Wedding Artist is an HTML5 browser game that runs in Safari and Chrome. It also works on phones and tablets, including iPhone, iPad, Samsung and Android devices, and Windows Phone. Jennifer and her fiancé are getting married in a month, and her list of wedding preparations is packed with tasks. Your job is to help her get ready for the wedding she has always pictured.
There are three girls to choose from, and you pick one to design. The game is controlled with a mouse or by clicking. Out of 9764 players, 95.68% say they enjoy this mobile game.
block-match-3d: Block Match 3D is a calm but mentally engaging puzzle in which a giant cube of blocks is taken apart piece by piece. Each block shows a cute icon, such as donuts, animals, emoji, or music symbols. Pair blocks with the category goals shown at the top, dig deeper into the structure, and clear everything before the timer runs out. It is easy to pick up but takes planning, because the storage bar at the bottom fills fast.

Only blocks with an open face can be tapped, so buried ones must wait. A block that matches a goal chip flies straight to it, while other blocks go into storage, and an overflowing bar ends the level. Finishing a goal brings in the next category, and stored blocks of that type fly over automatically. Dozens of levels, colorful icon collections, and boosters such as Hint, Shuffle, Magic Wand, and Undo keep the matching going
i-want-ice-cream: Set in the heart of Antarctica, this puzzle platformer follows a little penguin on a quest for ice cream. You steer your bird across a slippery, frozen landscape, avoiding obstacles and searching for ice cream treats hidden in tricky spots. The cartoon-style graphics are bright and playful, and a catchy soundtrack keeps things lively as you go.

Controls are simple: use the arrow keys to move the penguin and guide it to the ice cream. The game is designed to keep players entertained for hours, and it suits people of all ages. Whether you enjoy puzzles or jumping across platforms, there is plenty to explore in this chilly world.
bridge-bounce-jump-challenge: Bridge Bounce: Jump Challenge is a quick arcade runner in which timing your leaps is everything. You hop along a tall bridge, pass through gates, avoid obstacles, and clear gaps that drop down toward the water. Gather coins as you go, maintain your speed, and push for the longest run you can manage before you slip off. It is simple to pick up but hard to perfect, since a single error ends the attempt.
Jumping is the only action you need. Click or tap the screen, press the spacebar, or use the W key or the Up Arrow. Time each jump so you clear barriers, gates, and gaps.
lamborghiniparking3: Guide your luxury Lamborghini into the marked parking spot, which calls for precise handling. You can play alone, with two players, or with three, and each mode asks you to park smoothly in the designated space without touching anything else.

The game runs on phones, but multiplayer is only available on a computer. Player one steers with W, S, A and D and brakes with the space bar. Player two uses the arrow keys and brakes with keypad 1. Player three moves with I, K, J and L. Take your time and enjoy the full experience.
kids-good-habits: Kids Good Habits is an educational title with attractive visuals and animations. Its interactive design is packed with detail, so each scene has plenty of small things to notice. The game is split into four parts. In the first, you help a panda brush its teeth, and in the second, you help the panda take a bath. A third part has you feeding a puppy, while the last asks you to judge whether the behavior of a lamb and giraffes is correct.
Through these short games, the title helps you build good habits for everyday life. Controls are simple: click with a mouse or tap the screen to play.
mouth-shift-3d: In Mouth Shift 3D, you customize a greedy mouth and head off into colorful worlds built in 3D. Along the way, you gobble up many kinds of food while steering around obstacles in your path. The controls are simple, and you guide your mouth with easy sliding movements.

The challenge keeps changing, so every run brings something new to handle. This arcade adventure offers tasty rewards and a steady stream of gastronomic fun. Your aim is to find out how much you can devour.
fishing-baron-real-fishing: Fishing Baron - Real Fishing blends calm moments with a bit of thrill as you head out on the water. Each cast could bring up a rare fish, and the scenery shifts across beautiful spots to visit. Refine your casting technique, improve your equipment as you go, and tackle a range of waters home to many different kinds of fish.

You can explore new areas, catch what you find, and build your skills as an angler, with the aim of earning money and fame along the way. The pace stays relaxed, yet each new catch keeps things lively.
cat-chaos-simulator: Step into a three-dimensional world where you play a cat looking for trouble. The game takes you through different locations, including homes and outdoor spaces like parks, and every one is full of things to tip over and people to pester. Your job is to cause as much disorder as you can while exploring.

Inside the Room Naughty mode, you leap onto tables, sweep cups off surfaces, wreck computers, and more. Keep tearing up furniture to watch your mess value climb, and see how far you can push it. Control is simple: click with your mouse or tap on a touchscreen to play.
combat-strike-zombie-survival-multiplaye: Combat Strike is a free pixel-style shooter where you battle enemy soldiers and realistic-looking zombies, both controlled by AI. You can pick from five game settings, including survival, team deathmatch, and deathmatch, each offering its own way to fight. Guns stay locked until you reach the right rank, and you spend XP to buy new characters.

You can team up with close friends in multiplayer or play alone in offline mode, which has 40 levels. The controls are simple. Use WASD to move and the mouse to aim, look around, shoot, and change guns. Press SPACE to jump, SHIFT to run, and TAB to open the menu.
raccoon-retail: You play as a raccoon working to clean up a busy store that is packed with shoppers. Those shoppers love making a mess, so your job is to keep the floors and shelves spotless. You move through the space, dodging spills while picking up the rubbish scattered across the aisles.

As the store grows with more aisles to cover, you can upgrade your cleaning gear to keep pace. The goal is to out-clean the messiest critters in the shop. Throughout the game, expect a playful, silly experience full of wacky moments.
juicyjong: JuicyJong puts a colorful spin on the classic tile game Mahjong. Every move asks for careful thought, and the puzzles are built to keep your mind busy from start to finish. You slide tiles across the board in whichever direction you choose, lining up three or more matching symbols in a row to collect them. When a stage gets tricky, special bonu
the-matrix-merge: Matrix Merge is a puzzle game with a playful twist. Your job is to join and pair up familiar faces so they grow into giant characters, and each merge pushes your score higher. You combine faces with a simple swipe, so the controls are quick to pick up, though mastering the game takes real practice.

The game offers hundreds of distinct levels, and each one brings its own challenges and goals, so there is always something new to figure out. Along the way you can use special power-ups: the Personality Blender, the Bomb, and Double Points. It is played with a mouse or by touch.
laser-nodes: Laser Nodes is a puzzle game about lining up beams of light. Your job is to guide every laser through the nodes, and the level is only beaten once all of them pass through. Expect a tough brain teaser that demands careful thought.

To move a laser, drag its shooter until the beam points where it needs to go. Mirrors can send beams in new directions, and in later stages lasers bounce off them through endless reflections, opening up a huge range of possible paths. It is a demanding challenge for anyone who enjoys physics-based puzzles.
zombie-parade-defense: In this tower defense shooter, you can play alone or with a friend in two-player mode. Your job is to guard a building from zombies that arrive in waves. Every new wave brings tougher undead, so you will need to grab power-ups and upgrade your guns to keep up. Whether you are solo or teaming up, the aim stays the same: stop the zombies from reaching the building. Survive a total of 10 waves and you win.

Player 1 moves with W, A, S and D, switches guns with Q, and enters or leaves the base with F. Player 2 uses the arrow keys to move, P to switch guns, and L to go in or out of the base. Use the mouse to activate weapons and power-ups.
angry-checkers: Angry Checkers takes the familiar board game and turns it up a notch. Your goal is to knock enemy pieces off the board. The game offers three ways to play. In Multiplayer, you face a random opponent over the internet. Single Player lets you test your skills against the computer. Hot Seat is built for two people sharing one device, so you can challenge a friend right beside you.
It is controlled with the mouse or touch screen. Whether you prefer quick matches online, a solo challenge, or a face-to-face showdown, there is a mode for you.
hot-rods-arena-stars: Pilot a heavily armed Hot Rod against dozens of merciless rivals in this arena game. There are no set rules, so your speed, firepower, and quick reactions decide the winner. Gather stars along the way to unlock stronger upgrades that let you switch weapons, toughen your armor, and push your top speed higher. Each arena brings its own test, and players willing to accept danger have the best shot at winning.

Controls: on desktop, use W, A, S, and D to drive. On mobile, steer with the left stick in any direction. The objective is simple: collect more stars than your rivals. Fire precise shots at enemies, trap them, and deny them any chance to fire back. A single mistake will turn your car into scrap metal.
block-puzzle-king: Block Puzzle King is a timeless elimination game built around clearing the board. Its cute, charming visuals help prevent eye strain. Levels come in a range of difficulties, which keeps things interesting as you progress, and the gameplay still feels fresh throughout. You will also find plenty of props to use with careful planning.

To play, drag the blocks along the bottom into the empty spaces on the grid. Any time you fill a full horizontal or vertical row, that line disappears. Your goal on each stage is to remove every block from the board, and once that is done, you move on to the next level.
galaxy-bricks: Galaxy Bricks is an arcade brick-breaker with a neon glow. Your main tool is the paddle, which you position to shatter the luminous blocks across each stage. Power-ups can be triggered at smart moments, giving you a strategic edge when a level gets tough.

Each stage raises the stakes, with tougher challenges arriving as you progress. The patterns of blocks keep shifting, so you have to remain agile and outwit them. The whole adventure unfolds across a cosmic setting that rewards quick thinking.
erase-the-extra-element: Sharp eyes are all you need in this puzzle game, where each scene includes something that does not belong. Your job is to wipe away the mistakes hidden in every picture, and as you clear them, the truth behind each puzzle slowly comes into view.

Controls are simple. On a computer, press the left mouse button to erase, and on mobile devices, tap the screen to rub away the extra details. It suits players who enjoy brain teasers, logic challenges, and hunting for hidden objects.
asmr-beauty-superstar: Welcome to a quiet clinic where skilled care meets creative styling. Your task is to transform a celebrity by pampering her skin and feet with soothing treatments, then giving her a fresh look to match. Every step feels calm and unhurried, so you can enjoy the process.

Browse a wide selection of hairstyles and makeup options to put together a one-of-a-kind look. This relaxing game blends wellness with fashion, so it suits anyone who enjoys pampering and dressing up characters in a peaceful setting.
drift-king-racing-multiplayer: Drift King Racing Multiplayer is a quick drift racer where accuracy, flair, and speed decide who wins. You go head to head with real people from all over the world in live matches. Take tight bends while sliding and leaving smoke behind you, and show off how well you can drift. Your cars can be improved and styled too, starting from rough street machines and moving up to professionally tuned rides. Races take place on glowing, neon-lit circuits set in a range of cities.
Earn points for clean drifts, invite your friends for a challenge, and work your way up the leaderboard to be crowned the Drift King. Use the arrow keys to move.
doodle-rpg-survivor: Draw your way through waves of classroom doodles in this survivor RPG, set across the pages of a notebook. Your spells fire automatically, so your main job is to weave between enemies and pick the upgrades that appear as you go. The game has 16 stages, from elementary school all the way up to university, and 64 bosses, each one of a kind. Spell combinations can get surprisingly wild.

Gear is plentiful. You can loot pieces, upgrade them, and stack their effects. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, press B to open your backpack, and use Space to confirm choices or reroll offers. Escape pauses the action. Menus work with point-and-click, and you can right-click or drag items in the backpack to equip them.
criatures-defense: Criatures Defense puts you in charge of a fortress that must hold off large waves of different enemy units. The attackers come in big groups, and if you fail to stop them, they will destroy your base. Your main gun fires at targets when you aim it, while an extra system takes care of shooting on its own. Weapons can be switched on from the panel along the bottom of the screen for focused attacks. Clear each level to move forward and spend what you earn on upgrades.
You can play with a mouse or on a touchscreen. This is a shooting title with action and fighting elements, and it is listed under the Action, Fight, and Shooting tags.
gt-formula-championship: GT Formula Championship is a fast racing game built around Formula cars, some of the most powerful and technically advanced machines you can drive here. You take the wheel and go head to head with skilled rivals on world-class circuits. Fierce competition keeps the pressure on, the physics feel true to life, and the visuals are stunning to look at.

The game is designed to feel like real professional Formula racing. Care went into nearly everything, from how the car's aerodynamics work to the texture of the track surface. It is a single-player experience, and drifting plays a part in the driving. To move your car, use the arrow keys.
maze-maker: In Maze Maker, you design your own labyrinth by linking blocks together, then sit back and follow a ball as it rolls along the route you created. Every interaction brings in cash, which you can invest in additional balls, fresh maze pieces, and upgrades that boost your earnings. As your setup grows, your income grows too, and new options open up along the way. The game keeps running while you watch, so the mood stays calm and unhurried.

Key features include expanding your maze layout, unlocking new balls and elements, and improving how much you make. Controls are simple: tap the screen on a phone, or click the left mouse button on a computer, to press buttons, open menus, and interact with items in the game.
nitro-speed-car-racing: Nitro Speed Car Racing offers a fresh spin on the racing genre. Watch the pointer moving around a dial, then click or tap to stop it at exactly the right moment. A well-timed stop earns you Nitro, a boost that helps your car rush toward the finish line.

The game is a real test of quick reactions, and it gives your brain a workout. Coins you collect along the way can be spent to upgrade your engine and your Nitro. Each round aims to get your dopamine flowing while pushing your reflexes to their limit. Controls are simple, since a mouse click or a tap is all you need.
golf-invaders: Golf Invaders mixes arcade shooting with golf. Punks, bums, and other troublemakers have taken over a golf course, and you must clear them out using carefully aimed golf shots until every invader is gone.

To fire, drag to set your aim, then let go to launch the ball. Each level gives you only a limited number of balls, so spend them wisely. Unlock power shots, which are explosive balls that cause heavy damage and can clear several invaders in one hit. Wind pushes the ball off its path, so every shot becomes trickier. Different enemies also appear, each behaving in its own way.
baby-taylor-bubble-tea-maker: Bubble tea has become the go-to drink for many young women, and it's common to spot someone sipping one almost anywhere you go. Taylor and her friend Jessica are fans too, but there isn't a shop like that in their neighborhood. This time, Taylor's mom decides to give it a try at home. Your job is to guide her through preparing and making the drink, step by step.
Everything is controlled with mouse clicks or taps, so it's easy to pick up and enjoy. Take your time, follow along, and have a good time with it.
idle-desert-life: In Idle Desert Life, your goal is to stay alive and eventually thrive in a barren wasteland. Start by putting together rafts, then rescue people who have been stranded out there. You also guide your team as it explores unfamiliar lands.

Expect to meet many different cultures while you slowly rebuild civilization. Careful handling of resources is central to progress, and the story-driven journeys keep things engaging. The game ends with a shipbuilding challenge for players who hope to earn a reputation as a legend of the desert.
super-war: Super War casts you as the commander of a base that must stand firm against incoming enemies. Your task is to construct your own stronghold and choose from a variety of defensive fortifications to place around it. With these structures in place, you aim to push back every assault the enemy launches. It is a 3D, HTML5 arcade title with a casual feel, and its defense and war tags make its theme clear.

Controls are simple. You play with a mouse click or a tap, so the game can be enjoyed on a computer or a touch device. Watch how the enemies approach, decide where each fortification should go, and work to keep them from breaking through your defenses.
pill-soccer: Pill Soccer puts you on the pitch for some seriously tough matches. You can take on dozens of real players, or grab a friend and switch to the 2 Player mode to see who really rules the field.

Player 1 uses the arrow keys: Up to jump, Left and Right to move, and either P or Down to kick. Pressing K activates the Super Bonus. Player 2 uses the keyboard instead, with W to jump, A and D to move left and right, and S to kick.
street-legends: Take the handlebars of a fearless cyclist speeding through a busy city in Street Legends: Urban Bike Rider. Your aim is to slip between cars, steer around traffic, and clear tough obstacles while chasing the highest score you can reach. This single-player hypercasual adventure moves at a fast pace from start to finish.

The controls respond quickly, so you will need sharp reflexes to avoid collisions. To steer right, tap the right side of the screen or press the right arrow key. To steer left, tap the left side or press the left arrow key. Practice your timing, and see how far your urban riding skills can carry you through the streets.
guard-the-baby: In this hypercasual title, you play a courageous little boy who must keep his footing while handling a stream of tasty fruit and nonstop wild animals. Quick thinking and sound choices matter throughout, and balance sits at the heart of it all.
Munch on fruit, push back the creatures that come after you, and try to set a new high score as the pace picks up. It is a quick, casual experience built around fast reactions and smart moves.
block-puzzle-tropical-story: In this tropical block puzzle, you link pieces together and work through clever challenges. Each completed level earns stars and opens fresh spots, from dense jungles to calm shorelines. Those stars also carry you forward into later chapters of the island journey.

Boosters are available when a stage gets tough, and the rules are designed so that newcomers and seasoned fans can both enjoy the game. Attractive visuals, a soothing soundtrack, and a resort-style mood make it a relaxed place to spend time. To move a block, hold down the left mouse button and drag it into position.
apocalypse-rush: In this survival action title, your job is to protect your trailer from nonstop swarms of foes. You can pick up a range of weapons and gather coins to improve your gear. The aim is to hold out for as long as you can, and the longer you stay alive, the tougher things get.

The game also supports two players. Player 1 moves with the arrow keys, fires with K, and launches a special attack with L. Player 2 uses W, A, S, and D to move, C to shoot, and V for a special attack. Keep the trailer standing through the endless apocalypse and unleash powerful blows whenever you can.
kaido: Kaido is an adventure game where you guide a friendly robot across dangerous ground. You need to move carefully to dodge whirling blades and foes that wear odd hats, all while working toward a goal of gathering orange ice cream bars. Good timing matters, and so does the double jump, which helps you reach tricky spots.

The game is split into eight levels, and each one is more challenging than the last. Getting through them takes steady control and quick reactions. Keep your eyes on the path ahead and on every hazard along the way, and you will get a feel for what each stage asks of you.
escape-police-for-brainrots: Escape Police for Brainrots is a running game where you sprint away from pursuing officers and try to stay one step ahead. As you go, you pick up Brainrots and steadily boost your speed. Dash across the map, dodge the obstacles in your path, and make sure the police never catch you.

The further you travel, the more progress you earn, and the stronger the Brainrots you collect become. Along the way you can open up new options, grow your Brainrot base, and push for the longest run you can manage.
obby-easy-grow: Obby Easy Grow! brings a Roblox-style obstacle course to your browser. Work through varied courses and keep going for a while, using checkpoints so a fall doesn't send you back to the very start. The standout feature is changing your character's size to get past obstacles on the way to the finish. Each level offers a fresh challenge, and finishing faster than other players is part of the goal.

Customize a hero from a large selection of characters, with options for appearance, outfits, and accessories. Bright graphics, detailed levels, and smooth animation keep things visually appealing. Resize your character with the on-screen slider or the mouse wheel, hold the right button to rotate the camera, press Shift to show the cursor, use WASD to move, Space to jump, Tab to pause, and F to push enemies. Phone players
squid-glass-bridge: This browser game recreates the glass bridge challenge from Squid Game. Before you cross, pick a difficulty level from the main menu. Your task is to work out which panes will hold you and jump from one to the next. Some panes are fake, and stepping on one shatters the glass and sends your character falling to their death. Stay alert, study the path ahead, and guide your runner carefully until you reach the far side.

Movement uses W, A, S, and D or the arrow keys, and Space makes your character jump. Move the mouse to look around and scan the surroundings for safe footing. Every choice matters, because one wrong step on a fake pane ends the run.
formula-car-racing-games-real: Formula Car Racing Games Real puts you behind the wheel of extremely fast machines. You tackle demanding tracks while rival drivers fight hard for every position. Precise, careful driving is the key to staying ahead, whether you race with others online or play offline.

Each lap rewards both speed and smart planning, since knowing when to push and when to hold back matters just as much as how fast you go. The game brings high-stakes racing right to your home. Speed, strategy, and plenty of thrills are waiting on every lap, so keep your focus from start to finish.
melon-maker-fruit-game: Melon Maker is a merge puzzle where you join matching fruits so they grow into larger ones, working your way up until you make a melon. As the box fills, you can test your skill against players around the world, all trying to build the biggest melon possible.
Keep an eye on the box, because if any fruit spills out, you lose. Controls are simple: tap the screen to drop the next fruit in. The game is also built for mobile and multiplayer play.
paper-craft-wars: Paper Craft Wars is a quick-moving blend of real-time strategy and role-playing. You pick a race and lead it to victory by carrying out clever tactics, seizing enemy bases, and protecting your realm. The whole game uses a paper-cut look that sets it apart visually. Magical abilities are available, and there are achievements you can earn along the way.

Think of it as a strategy adventure where planning matters as much as quick reactions. Its creative paper-style world gives every battle a distinct feel. Under the Puzzles category and tagged for Strategy, it suits anyone who enjoys commanding armies and growing their kingdom step by step.
fall-germ: Fall Germ is an arcade game where you dodge germs as they drop down the screen and clear them out before they spread. It is hard to put down, and it puts both your reflexes and your planning to the test. Each level is bright and lively, and you will need to learn the patterns the germs follow. Power-ups can help you stop an outbreak when things get crowded.
Race up the leaderboard by reacting fast and making clever moves. Keep your focus sharp, study the falling patterns, and use your power-ups wisely so the germs never take over.
freddys-return-village-escape: This 3D title puts you in a tense encounter with Freddy, though the escape mode lets you learn the layout first. You start in a mysterious, long-forgotten city on New Year's Eve, where heavy snow makes getting away harder. Your goal is to get out while staying alive as long as you can, which means exploring the whole map.

The second mode has Freddy and his snowman minions chasing and attacking you relentlessly. You can choose to bring weapons along to help destroy them. Move with W, A, S and D, look around with the mouse, hold Left Shift to run, press C to crouch, and use Space to jump. Press F to interact or hide, T to unhide, and G to drop an item.
456-impostor: Pilot 456 is stranded in space and has to survive. The only way to do that is to wipe out the men in red suits. You jump onto each one and crush them, then keep going until you reach the final level.

Every 10 levels, the action shifts to an endless run, and you must still defeat the red-suited men that appear. Movement uses WASD on a keyboard, and mobile devices use touch controls. It is a single-player 2D arcade game.
bounce-dunk-basketball: Bounce Dunk - Basketball is an arcade game for anyone who enjoys hoops. The challenge lies in timing the bounce of the ball so you can land clean shots and rack up a high score. Each attempt asks you to judge how hard and at what angle to send the ball so it drops straight through the hoop.

Playing is simple: a mouse click or a tap on the screen sets both the angle and strength of your throw, so the ball bounces neatly into the basket. Along the way you can also destroy enemies and collect coins, all while chasing a better score.
fast-and-wild-in-sky: Fast and Wild in Sky takes you high above the clouds, where one slip can plunge you straight down into them. As you speed along the course, you'll weave past obstacles that never follow a pattern, which puts your reflexes and skill to the test. Unlock new vehicles and upgrade the ones you already own. Each race is high-stakes, so you'll need to think fast and stay precise to come out ahead.

You can play it online for free on any device. On a PC, control your vehicle with the W, A, S and D keys. On a phone, press the matching buttons on the screen to control the machine. It sits in the racing and driving category, so fans of both will know what to expect.
fridge-perfect-sorting: Fridge: Perfect Sorting is built for people who love things tidy. Your job is to load a fridge with groceries and fit every item onto the shelves so none of them are left sitting in the basket. Work through the varied products and stack them neatly so there is space for all of them.

To play, pick the food you want to store and then slide it into the open room inside the fridge. The round is complete once the fridge is filled to 100 percent. Use the mouse on a computer, or swipe to select food and tap to place it on a phone.
don-t-touch-the-red: Put your reflexes to the test in this Hyper Casual title, where the trick is to tap only the green tiles and avoid the red ones. The whole game is built around quick reactions and careful timing, and staying alert is what keeps you going.
Several game modes are available, and the challenge grows harder as you progress. Because the difficulty increases, you will need to react faster
digit-shooter-1: Digit Shooter 1 is an arcade runner with a vertical layout, where you race forward and blast your way through. The playfield is filled with three-dimensional green digits. You fire green numbers at other green numbers and at walls carrying numbers, and each hit you land or pick up raises your own number so it grows larger.

Red walls are hazards that waste your bullets and time, so steer clear of them. Once you reach the finish line, aim to concentrate your fire on a single line, and doing so earns you more rewards. To play, click or tap with your mouse or finger.
paws-and-paths: Paws & Paths is an arcade puzzle game where you link cats, bears, and rabbits to meet the goals shown above the board. It includes 50 colorful levels, and each one asks you to plan ahead so you finish before your moves run out. Along the way, you will break through ice and work around metal blocks, which stay in place.

To play, press and drag with your mouse, or swipe with your finger, across neighboring animals of the same kind. Release to collect the chain, and new animals will drop in to fill the gaps. Once that feature is introduced, chains of four or more launch extra paws. Clear animals next to numbered ice to break it. If you want to rethink a move, use Undo, and Hint is there when you need help.
bounce-ball-timer: Bounce Ball Timer is a 2D arcade title that is both entertaining and demanding. Your goal is to pick up the three stars in each level while keeping your ball clear of the obstacles in its path. Collect every star and avoid the hazards, and you'll advance to the next level.

You can play with touch or with the keyboard, so you can choose whichever suits you. The game is listed under .io games and 2D titles, which makes it a good fit if you enjoy that style of play. Stay alert, keep your ball bouncing, and aim to clear each level.
stick-duel-the-war: The Stick Duel series returns with its newest chapter, The War, which brings fresh physics, new weapons, and new levels. You can take on the CPU or challenge a friend, and the goal is to win the match by taking five rounds.

Each weapon comes with its own advantages and drawbacks, so your choice affects how you fight. The game includes 20 distinct maps, and you need to stay clear of fire pools and traps. Player 1 moves with the arrow keys, double jumps by pressing up twice, and attacks with L. Player 2 moves with W, A, S, and D, double jumps by pressing W twice, and attacks with F.
medieval-battle-2p: Travel back to the medieval era and take part in battles across historic battlefields. This 3D game focuses on strong soldiers, fierce fights, and the tactics that decide who wins. You place your forces and watch how each clash unfolds.

You can play alone or team up with a friend in two player mode. The mouse handles nearly everything: left-click to interact with the battlefield, press X to remove a soldier, and hold CTRL to place soldiers properly. Right-click lets you rotate the camera, while W, A, S and D move it around the field.
shadow-samurai-ninja: In this action game, you play as a shadow samurai ninja on a long journey. You move swiftly across magical landscapes, slip past clever traps, and face tough opponents head on. Quick reflexes help, but so does strategy, since battles call for careful planning as much as fast moves.

Along the way, you can unlock stronger upgrades that help you go further. The road ahead is full of demanding challenges, but the rewards you earn make every hard-won step feel worthwhile. Action fans who enjoy testing their timing and tactics will find plenty to keep them busy.
cool-tuning-paint-the-car: Cool Tuning: Paint the Car is aimed at anyone who enjoys tweaking vehicles and getting creative. It has a similar feel to Car Mechanic Simulator and Need for Speed, yet its focus is on designing cars and then reselling them. Players buy vehicles, customize their look with spray painting, and apply films and stickers. Finished cars can be sent to auction to sell.

To begin, buy your first car and start adding color. Your toolkit includes a brush, a spray can, stickers, and film. Once you finish tuning, the car heads to auction and you collect the money it earns. Use that cash to buy more cars and keep growing. The store also offers new colors, films, and stickers for extra variety.
skibronx-runner: Skibronx Runner is an endless runner where you make your way through the streets while facing a variety of challenges. It offers two modes. In level mode, your objective is to reach the grocery store without losing, while in endless mode you try to get as far as possible before you lose.

Press the Up Arrow to jump, then press it again in the air for a double jump. Keep holding Up after the double jump to fly. The Down Arrow makes you slide, and the E key lets you shoot a water gun or perform a bump.
home-decor-clicker: Home Decor Clicker is a calm clicker where you tap your house to bring in money. Each tap moves you a little further along, and the gold you collect can be spent on new decorations and home upgrades. As your earnings rise, you bring in more with every tap, and the game keeps moving forward at a steady pace.

You can furnish and style your house however you like, so each home ends up reflecting your own choices. Over time, a plain house turns into a full living space. Controls are simple and easy to pick up, which makes this a good fit for anyone who enjoys idle and clicker titles and wants a relaxing way to enjoy steady growth.
vampire-survival: Step into a mythical vampire world in this multiplayer game, where every battle carries serious stakes. You sharpen your vampiric skills while dodging hunters who want you gone, and you can take to the air to slip past danger when you need to. Collecting gold lets you strengthen your powers, which helps you last longer than the other players.
The mood stays dark from start to finish, so expect a grim adventure where thoughtful choices count. Stay alert, decide when to fight and when to flee, and work to outlast your rivals.
ninja-obby-speed-run: Each level tests your speed, agility, and planning across hundreds of distinct obstacle courses. The game mixes competitive racing with ninja-style combat, and you can personalize your ninja in many ways. At checkpoints, glass doors block your path, but your ninja power lets you smash through them. Bonuses such as a speed boost, giant mode, and flight change how each run plays out.

While flying, gather the golden rings in the sky to earn coins, then spend them in the shop on more items. Player 1 moves with WASD and jumps with SPACE, while Player 2 moves with the arrow keys and jumps with L. Tap the jump button twice for a double jump, and hold the forward key to sprint.
pop-the-balloons-bounce: Pop the Balloons Bounce asks you to think ahead before every shot. You aim a spiky thorn ball by judging both the angle and the power of your launch, then use it to burst balloons. The levels are tough but fair, and accurate aim and well-timed moves are essential. Setting off chain reactions is a central part of the challenge, and you refine your bouncing tactics as you progress.

Careful planning pays off more than rushed attempts. Watching how the thorn ball rebounds helps you set up your next move. The game centers on popping balloons through precision, timing, and clever strategy.
warriors-vs-evil-spirits: You play as a single fighter facing waves of undead zombies in this arcade title. Pushing forward means dealing with large groups that keep coming, so choosing the right weapon for each situation matters. Your movement counts too, since positioning yourself carefully can help you stay alive through every clash.

Each skirmish lets you collect rewards that you can put toward stronger weapons and gear. The goal is to hold off the evil spirits that want to take over the planet, becoming more powerful as the fighting gets tougher.
color-roll-3d: Color Roll 3D is a puzzle game built around color and attention to detail. Your job is to recreate a sample picture exactly, right down to the smallest detail. Each level hands you a set of brightly colored rolls, and you unroll and arrange them until the picture is complete. It takes sharp eyes and careful movement.
The trick is that the colors need
battle-area: Battle Area is a first-person shooter set in 3D. Enemies have taken over a mineral mine on Mars, and you play as an elite soldier whose job is to wipe out every hostile and win the mine back. Every fight is seen through your own eyes, so the action stays close and direct.

On desktop, the arrow keys or W, A, S and D move your character, while the mouse turns it, aims and fires. On mobile, an on-screen joystick handles movement and a fire button shoots. To aim and turn, tap and drag on the right side of the screen. The game is built with HTML5 and supports mobile play as well.
airport-security-3d: In Airport Security 3D, you work a shift at an airport checkpoint inside a simulation built from cartoon-style 3D models. Your duty is to arrest wrongdoers who carry fake IDs or weapons while letting ordinary civilians pass. At the counter, you compare each passenger's name with the ID card they present. Next, at the security checkpoint, you search their baggage and spot anyone hiding a weapon. Once you have caught a criminal, you can question them.
Play is simple, with a mouse click or a tap doing everything you need. The game sits in the hypercasual category and is tagged with airplane and simulation.
fashion-foot-shop: In Fashion Foot Shop, you run your own small foot salon and serve a steady stream of visitors. Each one arrives with a different foot concern, whether that means overgrown nails, grimy nails, or cuts and other wounds. Your job starts with fixing these problems, since you work as a manicurist first.

Once the basics are handled, you step into the role of nail artist and create designs for each person. Pick styles that suit each customer's traits, so every client leaves with nails that fit them. You can play with a mouse or by tapping.
it-clicker: IT Clicker is a cheerful simulation where each press of the mouse moves you forward. Buying ClickBoost upgrades raises your output and quickens your path through a world that keeps changing and growing more productive. Planning matters here, because clicking becomes a steady, rhythmic drive toward growth. The mechanics are engaging, and the upgrades give a satisfying sense of reward as you go.

Every click counts toward your progress, so the game rewards steady, focused play. Choose your upgrades with care to speed up your efficiency and keep your momentum going. It is a relaxing title for anyone who enjoys watching small actions add up to bigger results over time.
pop-it-master: Pop It Master is a free simulation where you gather the full set of 150 Pop It and Simple Dimple toys. It is a simple, straightforward way to ease stress after school or once work is over. Each toy is calm and easy to enjoy, and the collection includes many different shapes and colors to discover.

To move forward, press every bump on the current toy to open the next one. Once you have collected all 150 toys, a Secret Mode becomes available. You can also see how you stack up against other players, since the game tracks how many bumps you have pressed.
car-stunt-race-trial: Car Stunt Race Trial is a stunt driving game built around rally cars. If you enjoy daring tricks and long rally-style races, this 2021 offline title offers endless racing across tracks that feel impossible. The game has also received a new update.

The game runs on a simulation engine with lively environments and physics-based modern cars and airplanes. Your goal is to keep control and stability while performing stunts. Drive with W, A, S and D, and use the pause button whenever you want to stop the action.
mafia-billiard-tricks: Step into a showdown with the mafia, where billiards is the battleground. Each game pits your skills against craftier opponents than the last, building toward a tense final match against the mob boss. Every shot rewards precision, and every choice rewards careful planning.

Your goal is to earn the respect of these notorious figures. Success depends on sharp aim and smart strategy, and you must prove your mettle at every step. Presented with a stylish look, this sports challenge puts a dangerous twist on billiards for anyone who enjoys a tough table.
wash-master: Grab a pressure washer and restore a dirty neighborhood one surface at a time. This calm 3D cleaner uses a first-person view, so you line up each shot and blast away grime until the bright colors underneath show through. You can scrub houses and many other spots, and each level is complete once every dirty surface is clean.

On a computer, move with WASD or the arrow keys, aim with the mouse, and hold the left button to spray. Press B to open the shop. On a phone or tablet, use the left side of the screen to move, drag to aim, and hold the spray button to clean. Collect coins, buy upgrades, and unlock new tools to work faster. It is easy to pick up and very satisfying.
alphabet-writing-for-kids: Alphabet Writing for Kids turns learning letters into a game that feels like a little journey. Children follow along as they trace each letter, and interactive guidance helps them get the shape right. Each letter is said out loud so kids hear how it sounds, and cheerful music adds to the fun. Bright animations and rewarding stickers keep the experience lively from start to finish.

Designed for young learners, the game makes getting to know the alphabet feel enjoyable and absorbing. Every session invites kids to practice writing while they explore the letters at their own pace. It is a pleasant way for little ones to build familiarity with the full alphabet.
bubble-stars-boxes-sirius-and-najia: Bubble Stars boxes: Sirius & Najia is an action game with 104 characters and 1,037 skins to discover. Open boxes to collect star drops, unlock new fighters, and grow your own roster. You can upgrade your characters by tapping on them, and swap backgrounds through the item shop.
Players can jump into many game modes, win battles, and earn trophies for each victory. Events come with challenges to complete, and you can level up the season pass to claim rewards along the way.
balls-bricks-breaker: Balls Bricks Breaker is a ball game about firing your balls at bricks and smashing through them. The levels keep changing, so every bounce tests both your reflexes and your thinking. Hidden power-ups are scattered through the stages. They can turn the tide of a round and help you shatter obstacles more efficiently.

Each level brings its own challenges and strategic elements, so you need to plan where you aim and when you act. Because the ideas keep shifting from one stage to the next, the game feels like a fresh brick-busting adventure throughout. It suits anyone who enjoys ball games and wants a mix of quick reactions and careful planning.
zombie-royale-io: Zombie Royale Io is an arcade survival game with a collecting twist, built in the style of .io titles. Your job is to guide a group of 3D cartoon survivors, picking up more people along the way while blasting away as many zombies as possible. The longer you last, the tougher the undead become, and stronger ones gradually show up to hunt down whoever is still left standing, choosing their targets at random.

To keep your team alive, you can call in extra soldiers and bombs during the action. When a round ends, spend the gold coins you earned to upgrade your survivors before the next one begins. Controls are simple: just click with your mouse or tap the screen.
dye-it-right-color-picker: Dye It Right: Color Picker is a laid-back brain teaser that sends you on a journey full of color. Its challenges are made for young players, but anyone who still enjoys a playful puzzle will likely find plenty to like. It offers a relaxed way to test your sense of color while you work through its tasks.

Controls are simple: you only need to click with a mouse or tap the screen. That makes it easy to pick up and play on a computer or a touch device. The game keeps the pace light and welcoming from start to finish.
bricks-breaker: Bricks Breaker is a relaxing puzzle game where you fire balls at rows of bricks. To complete a level, every brick has to be cleared. Each brick has a score that drops with every hit, and it disappears once that score hits zero. Choosing the right angle is the key, since a well-aimed shot can take out many bricks at once. Be quick, because bricks that reach the bottom of the screen end your run.
The game offers more than 3000 levels to work through. You aim by clicking in the direction you want your balls to travel, or you can use the slider to set the angle instead.
railroad-magnate: You build and run your own railroad, starting from scratch and laying out every track and station yourself.
