The world is drawn in charming pixel art, and its scenes give each run a tense, suspenseful mood. Every attempt pushes you to react quickly and stay one step ahead of the creature behind you. Collect what you can, unlock someone new, and see how far Noob can get before the chase finally catches up.
squid-sugar-cooking: Squid Sugar Cooking is a well-liked kitchen game inspired by the TV show Squid Game. Its Squid Sugar Challenge has the same tense, gripping feel as the series, and it invites you to discover how this candy is made. Step by step, you uncover the secret behind this sweet treat. Just a few ingredients are needed, and by following the steps you can produce a Squid Sugar that matches the one shown in the game. Along the way, you can also unlock a range of attractive shapes.
The real-world version is not something to attempt alone, so keep the sugar-making inside the game, where the fun is all on scre
party-games-mini-shooter-battle: Party Games: Mini Shooter Battle is a battle-royale shooter drawn in a playful 2D cartoon style. Across four different modes, you blast rival players to rack up points, which convert into coins and gems. Spend those rewards in the Shop on new roles and weapons. Your character locks onto the nearest enemy by itself, so your main job is to fire and sidestep incoming shots. Score more eliminations while dying less often, and you'll collect bigger coin and gem payouts. Click or tap to play.
parkour-runner-3d: Parkour Runner 3D is a quick action game about running hard and staying nimble. You sprint, leap, slide, and flip your way through obstacle courses, racing over rooftops and hopping from one platform to the next while avoiding traps. Your reflexes get tested constantly, and the smooth handling, lively surroundings, and demanding stages keep every attempt tense.

Timing is the key to going far. Grab boosts along the way, unlock new characters, and work toward becoming a top parkour runner. Use WASD or the arrow keys to move, jump, and slide. Tap Space once for a head booster, or tap it twice to activate the hover board.
blue-and-red-impostor: Two impostors, one red and one blue, must work their way through an episode before the water rises around them. Each level has to be cleared before the flood arrives, so the pair needs to move quickly to survive. The game is built for two players and is made up of 15 parts, each one a fresh test of speed.
Controls use the WASD keys and the arrow keys. On mobile devices, touch controls take their place. Filed under adventure and arcade, this 2D title keeps the pressure on from start to finish.
slap-kings-fun-and-run-3d-game: Slap Kings is a 3D reflection game that suits a relaxed mood, so it works well when you want a break. Your aim is to strike other people and beat them before they manage to beat you. It is filed under Action and carries tags including Casual, 3D Games, Boy, and Girl.

When winning feels hard, you can upgrade your abilities and make another attempt. Controls are tap or click, so you can start right away. The game is meant to give you a good time and a chance to relax.
kitten-s-way-home-word-associations: Kitten's Way Home: Word Associations is a word-guessing duel that suits an evening with someone close by. Two people can share one screen, or you can face the artificial intelligence instead. The rules are easy to pick up, yet every round carries plenty of tension. Your task is to name words linked to the given theme.
The game doubles as brain training and an educational pastime, and it gives your vocabulary a workout too. In Player vs. Player mode you alternate turns with
basketball-master-kids: Basketball Master Kids brings street-style hoops to your screen, set on an open-air court. Your job is to aim and take your shots while planning a route past obstacles and defenders who try to get in your way. Each throw tests how accurate you can be, so steady aim matters as much as quick th
jumpero: Jumpero is an arcade game built around jumping, and it plays with the idea that gravity is more of a loose guideline. Your job is to leap over tall walls, and success depends on how well you judge timing and momentum. Each jump has to be timed carefully.
When a jump is timed well, the game lets you bend the rules of physics and climb to heights with no fixed cei
monster-trucks-kids-racing: Monster Trucks Kids Racing is a racing adventure made with young players in mind. Large on-screen buttons let you jump, sound the horn, and switch between music tracks, so you can enjoy a wide range of sounds. As you drive your oversized trucks along the course, you flatten the cars in your path and pick up stars along the way.
Each level ends with a burst of fireworks and a round of balloon popping. Controls are simple: just tap or click. The game is built to keep younger players entertained from start to finish.
stickman-escape-plane-and-ship: You play as Stick, a stickman whose goal is to find every successful way out of a plane and a ship. The path is full of difficulties, including enemies, monsters, and choices about which items to use and which actions to take. The game playfully challenges you to prove you are a rich man, though only players who have money can make purchases here. Its follow-up, a continuation about escaping the ship, is paid.
Controls are simple. On a computer, you use your mouse. On a mobile device, you can use a stylus or your finger instead. Work through the different options until you have uncovered all the
100-doors-escape-mysteries: In this room-escape brain teaser, your goal is to unlock 100 mysterious doors, one after another. Each door guards a complex puzzle that calls for careful thinking. To move from one room to the next, you rely on your intelligence and wisdom and work out how to get past every challenge.

Logic is the main tool you will use here. Study each room closely to find the key that lets you escape, then carry on to the next door. Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all it takes to play.
blue-chameleon: Blue Chameleon is a platformer where you avoid one-eyed monsters while collecting gold coins. Grabbing hearts along the way helps restore your health, so choose your pickups carefully as you move through each stage. The levels are full of tricky moments, and the bright, colorful setting adds to the fun.
See how long you can keep going in this lively world filled with bold obstacles. Every run tests your timing and your ability to stay alive while picking up treasure.
nest-quest: Guide a wandering bird back to its nest in this gentle puzzle journey. Your task is to push blocks around so the path opens up, and every choice you make calls for a bit of careful thinking. The graphics are calm and easy on the eye, and the controls are simple to pick up, so you can jump in right away.

Whether you have a spare minute or want to settle in for a longer stretch, the game suits both. It is meant to feel soothing and enjoyable from start to finish, giving you a relaxing way to spend your time.
squicky: In Squicky, you take on the role of a clever little mouse moving through a platform game with a distinctive art style. Success depends on both sly thinking and fast reactions, since you need to get past much larger cats. Along the way, you can grab shiny coins while working through a variety of levels full of obstacles.
Movement feels smooth and responsive, yet the challenge is real, so every leap matters. Your goal is to build up as much wealth as you can for your mouse while keeping it safe from harm.
rageroll-io: RageRoll.io puts you in a battle arena where giant rolling spheres clash in multiplayer matches. Sophisticated AI keeps the action running nonstop. You can pick DeathMatch, where the goal is to rack up the most kills before the clock runs out, or Elimination, where you must outlast every rival to claim the win.

Your roller moves with WASD, and the mouse lets you look around. Left click fires bullets at enemies, while right click launches missiles. Press Q to shield yourself and E to use your use function. Hold F to activate the attractor, tap Shift to dash, and hold Shift to brake. Finally, press Space to float upward with anti-gravity.
plug-man-race: Plug Man Race is a single-player collecting arcade game built around battery pickups. Your goal is to cross the finish line ahead of everyone else to clear a level. Every platform calls for a good number of red batteries. Gather them and spend them to get past the switch in front of you. If rivals are stronger than you, steer clear of them and focus only on grabbing red batteries.
Once you have collected enough gold coins, you can purchase skins to change your look. Controls are simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to play.
money-chaser-parkour-game: Money Chaser Parkour is an endless running game where you sprint forward and grab as many coins as you can. Your path is full of traps, and you also need to knock rival runners off the track. Sliding into an enemy that is directly ahead of you will kick them out of the way.

Once you have gathered enough money, you can take on the Boss. Your coins become your ammunition in this fight, so the more you have, the better your chances. Keep an eye on your cash, because without money you have no life. Just keep running.
game-factory: Game Factory gives you a complete game studio that runs in your browser. You can build a game from scratch in any of six styles: platformer, clicker, shooter, match-3, runner, or tower defense. Sketch your own pixel sprites or choose from ready-made ones, reshape your levels, and select a music track for your project. Adjust details such as speed, gravity, and how many enemies appear.

When your creation is ready, you can test it right away and see how it plays. Publishing it earns you coins and experience points, which you can spend to grow your studio, open new genres, and unlock extra sprite packs. You can also hand your work to friends with a share code so they can try it for themselves.
animal-shape-puzzle: Animal Shape Puzzle is a relaxed, free online game for children. Your task is to match the little pieces shown below with the right spots, and the board uses simple animal shapes. The game is built with HTML5 and is also listed for Android devices, so it can be opened in a browser or on a compatible device.

You can gather your schoolmates and friends for a battle against one another. Playing is simple: use your mouse or tap the screen to move the pieces. The game sits in the Boys category and is tagged with block and matching gameplay, so it suits players who enjoy puzzles of this kind.
gun-shooter: Gun Shooter drops you into fast-paced action where quick reactions and steady aim matter most. The settings change around you, so you always have to stay alert. Controls are simple to pick up, and you can choose between solo missions or matches against friends in multiplayer. Several difficulty levels let you build your skills step by step, and you'll practice hitting targets that never stop moving. It's a good fit for players who enjoy testing their sharpshooting against others.
obby-car-keyboard-parkour: Hop into a car and tackle a parkour course with a keyboard theme. Race along challenging tracks, dodge dangerous obstacles, and cross the finish line to open new areas. Each new car you earn raises your speed, which helps you handle tougher levels. Collect rewards and powerful boosts, and unlock rare supercars as your performance improves.

Rebirth brings permanent bonuses, so every run can be faster than the last. Expect simple controls, colorful graphics, a wide range of vehicles, and progression that keeps going. Drive with WASD, hold the right mouse button while moving the mouse to steer the camera, press Space to jump, TAB to pause, and R to return to the start. On mobile, use the on-screen controls.
arrow-escape-3d: Arrow Escape 3D is a relaxed puzzle game played across the faces of a cube. Tap any colorful arrow and it will shoot off the cube in the direction it points, but only when nothing stands in its path. Drag to turn the cube so you can see all six sides, then work out which blockers to remove first so the whole cube is cleared.

The game includes 1000 small levels, each one a bite-sized challenge. Keep an eye on your hearts, since tapping an arrow that is blocked costs you one. You complete a level once every arrow has escaped.
crazy-plinko: Crazy Plinko begins with what looks like pure luck, as pieces bounce unpredictably down the pegs. Over time, though, repeating patterns start to show up. Each upgrade you pick gives you a say over gravity, angles, and timing, so the chaotic board slowly turns into something you can understand and control. It is a solo puzzle game about strategy, where you test your ideas on tricky peg layouts.

To play, drop your pieces onto the board, predict where the unpredictable will go, and aim to reach your target score. Chase higher highscores as you learn, and decorate the board to make it your own. Every decision counts, and smart choices are what carry you toward success.
misland-online: Misland is a placement and management game about turning a lonely, deserted island into a thriving paradise. You start out picking apples from trees with nothing but your bare hands. Step by step, you upgrade your skills and tools, and the island holds plenty of resources still waiting to be discovered. Trading those resources with ships helps your wealth grow.

Once you have gathered enough, a team of assistants can take over jobs like apple harvesting, tree felling, and quarrying. Watch out, though, because invading monsters try to steal your resources. Wave your sword to protect your island. Move around with the WASD keys, or click and drag with the mouse.
tictoc-urban-outfits: Favorite TicToc stars are back, ready for some playful styling in urban fashion. This girls' dress-up game brings the latest trends from the social app TicToc into a fresh new format. Four fashionable best friends are on hand to show off their hottest looks, one outfit after another.
Playing takes just a mouse click or a tap. It's a single-player experience that suits anyone who loves dressing up characters and keeping up with what's in style right now.
escape-from-the-toys-factory: In this clicker game, your goal is to finish every Poppy pop it toy so you can escape the toy factory. Speed counts, so try to clear them all as fast as you can. If you already know the scary character Poppy, the game draws on that same creepy theme.

Controls are simple. Use your mouse, or click anywhere on the screen to play. It is a 2D HTML game that suits anyone who enjoys tapping quickly and racing the clock, and it makes for a short, bold challenge.
color-lines: In Color Lines, you arrange vividly colored blocks on a grid. When you complete a line, it clears and opens up room on the board. The challenge rises as you go, so you need to look ahead and plan your next moves with care.
Every move can add unexpected complexity to the board, which keeps the puzzle engaging from start to finish. The game is built to run on all devices, so you can play on whichever screen you prefer.
dino-robot-fighting-war: Dino Robot Fighting War is an arcade action game about huge mechanical battles. You can assemble your own dinosaur robot, tweak how it looks and how it performs, and then take on a range of rival dino machines. The roster includes warriors modeled on the T-Rex, the Triceratops, and the Stegosaurus, so you can pick the fighter that suits your style.

Controls are simple: use mouse clicks or taps to play. Everything happens through those single inputs, which makes the game easy to pick up on either a computer or a touchscreen. If you enjoy clashing giant robots and experimenting with different builds, this one offers plenty of dinosaur-sized fights to try.
who-says-pigs-can-t-fly: In this physics-driven game, you fire a pig through the air using a slingshot. Its blend of tactics and humor shapes every round, giving the whole adventure a playful tone. Your goal is to outwit sneaky pirates scattered across whimsical stages.

Aim carefully, think ahead about each launch, and map out your moves before pulling back. Every level asks you to combine precision with clever thinking, so each attempt feels different. The puzzles can be tough, so careful planning pays off. It is a game that is easy to keep coming back to.
undead-and-unemployed: The town has fallen to the undead, yet the trailer park still does business as usual. You can take on jobs for the residents, plow through hordes in rampage mode, join street races, or compete in the derby. Gather whatever you find along the way and swap it with the park's traders.

WASD moves you and the mouse controls your view. Left click fires or throws, and right click aims. Shift sprints, C crouches, Space jumps, and R reloads. E handles interacting, looting, and entering or leaving a vehicle. F uses the held item or opens a car menu beside a v
fruit-samurai: Fruit Samurai is an action game centred on slicing fruit. Your goal is to cut through the sweet, delicious fruit you come across, in the style of a traditional fruit-cutting game. It is filed under the Action and Fruit tags, so the fruit-slicing theme takes centre stage.

All of the controls use the mouse. Move the pointer to carve through the fruit as it passes across the screen, and enjoy the simple, familiar fun of slicing your way through it. Whether you play for a few minutes or longer, the game is ready whenever you want a quick slicing session.
frog-byte: Frog Byte puts you in charge of a famished toad who needs to eat. Tap at the right moments to snap up tasty bugs, but keep clear of the bombs that drift into your path. The controls are kept simple, while the swamp setting buzzes with life and the challenges grow tougher as you go.
Every round is a chance to sharpen your skills. Try to climb the leaderboard with your best results, and when you post a strong score, share it with friends to see who has the sharpest tongue.
tetradice-merge-and-blast-blocks: TetraDice , Match & Build Blocks is a free puzzle game that combines Tetris and dice mechanics. You place dice-based shapes, clear lines, and put your logic to the test. Normal and Endless modes, unique levels, and engaging gameplay are all part of the package.

Your aim is to form combinations from the figures you are given. Successful combinations earn points, and so do special tasks, with bigger scores for more matches. Adventure mode has you finish levels by completing assigned tasks, while Classic mode asks you to score as many points as you can before the game ends. On PC, left-click to select, rotate, and move figures. On mobile, tap to rotate and drag with your finger to slide a figure across the field.
clock-head: Clock Head asks you to protect the clock face that sits on your unusual head by tapping at just the right moments. Your head keeps getting smaller without any pause, so your quick reactions are put to the test. Glowing orbs appear, and you need to strike each one exactly when the clock hand lines up with it. This arcade title is odd and playful, yet it mixes a sense of time pressure with the need for accuracy. Its rhythm-driven play gives it a distinctive feel from start to finish.
ride-a-bike-for-brainrots: You speed a bike through obstacle courses while working to keep your balance. Hop across stages packed with tricky challenges, and remember that a single slip sends you tumbling into the void. Overcome each obstacle, then upgrade both your bike and your base.

Gather Brainrots to boost your income and move ahead more quickly. Merge them together, and look out for secret creatures. Spending your earnings on base upgrades unlocks more slots and helps you grow stronger, so keep riding, improving, and working your way through every stage.
throw-fast: Throw Fast is a quick arcade game where precision and timing matter most. You practice your knife throws at targets that spin, and you must dodge obstacles while lining up each shot for a perfect hit. The pace is brisk, and every throw calls for focus.

As you move along, the difficulty climbs, so hitting the mark gets harder over time. The gameplay is compelling enough that one more attempt always seems tempting. If you enjoy testing your reflexes and steady aim against spinning targets, this game will hold your attention.
zodiac-runner: Zodiac Runner is an arcade running game played in a vertical view, set across 3D platforms and scattered zodiac items. The roster includes twelve zodiac signs. At the start, you pick one of two offered signs to begin with. To finish a level, you gather items that match your sign. Once enough matching pickups are collected, you upgrade and your suit changes automatically. Movement is handled entirely by dragging across the screen.
Pick a favorite sign and take your time with each run. Stay relaxed and see how far your chosen zodiac can take you through each stage.
prison-escape-online: This stickman title puts you in charge of a stick figure who has been locked in a prison cell. Your task is to help him break out using whatever skills you have. No method is ruled out as you look for a way to get free, but some routes are risky, so think carefully before you act.
Controls are simple. Use your mouse to play, or tap the screen if you are on a mobile device. It is filed under the clicker category, so clicking is the main way you interact with the game.
hexa-block-puzzle: Hexa Block Puzzle is a puzzle game built around hexagonal pieces. Your job is to fit the blocks onto the board, using your puzzle skills to decide where each one goes. Pieces cannot be turned, so you need to plan their placement carefully. Blocks already set in the grid can be moved and rearranged again.

The game is designed to sharpen logical thinking and mental focus. As you keep playing, the challenge grows harder. There is no clock to beat, so you can take your time with each move. If you get stuck, a hint is there to help.
galaxy-bricks-breaker: Galaxy Bricks Breaker is an arcade title where quick reflexes meet careful planning. Your goal is to empty the playfield by building chains of bricks that share a color. Each successful match raises the difficulty, so the challenge grows as you go.

The game is bright and lively, with fast-paced action throughout. Success depends on thinking on your feet while still planning ahead. Its steady stream of challenges makes you want to try again, all within colorful, fast-moving play.
lone-sniper: Lone Sniper challenges you to destroy every enemy within a 50-second limit. The clock pushes you to act quickly, so each shot has to count. Take your shot, then slip behind cover to avoid getting hit by return fire. This shooting title is an HTML5 arcade game with a casual feel.

Playing is as easy as a mouse click or a tap on your screen. Keep an eye on the timer and weigh every moment you spend in the open, since enemies can answer your fire. Wipe out all the targets before time runs out to finish the round.
space-rolling-balls-race: Space Rolling Balls Race is a 3D arcade game where you guide a ball along cosmic tracks set in outer space. The routes are packed with obstacles, traps, jumps, and moving platforms, so you need quick reactions and good timing to keep going. Controls are light and responsive, with physics that make the ball feel believable as it rolls. Upbeat music and sound effects give the run a steady rhythm to follow.

To play, swipe or drag your finger across the screen to steer the ball. Dodge the traps and obstacles on the track and stay on the path, because one fall ends the run. Grab power-ups to raise your score and move ahead faster. Try to beat your own best distance and sharpen your reaction speed with each attempt.
tricky-puzzle-brain-test: Tricky Puzzle - Brain Test is a vivid, colorful puzzle game built to keep things fresh from start to finish. Its visuals and animations are eye-catching, and the music, sound effects, and voice acting were produced by a professional composer. Every puzzle shares the same overarching story, so each one feels connected to the last.

Solving these brain teasers calls for unconventional thinking, which gives your mind and brain a workout as you play. Your tasks include rescuing aliens, counting bees, petting a dog, opening doors, and plenty more. To crack each puzzle, you shake, tilt, or rotate your phone.
slap-master-3d: Slap Master 3D is a hypercasual game where your aim is to become the slap king. It's a relaxed way to let off steam as you take on opponents. The key is finding the right timing and hitting until each rival flies out of the arena and gets knocked out.

The game is built in 3D and runs in your browser through HTML5. It is also listed for mobile devices. The controls are simple: tap to play. It is tagged for kids and action fans, so it's easy to jump into whenever you want a round of slapping.
my-perfect-halloween-costume: Join the Bff Girls for a Halloween adventure in this dress-up game. You can mix and match stylish outfits and accessories to build a costume that fits your taste. Try out different pairings until you land on the look you like best.
The controls are simple to pick up. Vibrant graphics keep the styling fun, making this a good choice for anyone who loves fashion and enjoys putting together outfits for the holiday.
crab-shooter: Step into a watery setting where you face off against aggressive aquatic opponents. Sharp reflexes and accurate aim are the keys to getting through it. The levels are demanding, but you can open new stages as you move forward through the game.
Enemies arrive again and again, and you need to stay one step ahead of them. Among the foes are rival crabs as well as clever humans who try to trick you. The game is seen from above, giving
superhero-adventure: Superhero Adventure lets you design your own hero or villain before you jump into fierce battles around the world. Combat moves quickly, and you rely on tactical powers and sharpen your abilities so you can outsmart and beat your rivals. The game takes place in a changing universe that keeps shifting as you play.

Every fight asks you to think on your feet while you build up your skills. Whether you prefer to play the good guy or the bad one, the action stays intense from start to finish. Expect a lively, constantly developing world full of new challenges to face.
fashion-girl-cosplay-sailor-challenge: Zoe and Iris missed the earlier Sailor Girl cosplay party, so they throw their own. The trouble is that Zoe brought far too many outfits, and the two friends can't spot the ones they're after. Your job is to dig through the pile, locate the costumes each girl wants, and then coordinate them into matching looks.

The game is played with a mouse click or a tap, so you can jump in on a computer or a phone. It's a relaxed dress-up puzzle aimed at kids, with a hidden-object twist and a makeover theme. Enjoy helping the pair get ready for their party.
spill-and-knock-down: In this puzzle game, you release balls so they strike glasses and tip them over, pouring out the liquid inside. The mechanics are simple, but the challenges are built on physics, so you need to think about where each ball will land and how it will move. In many cases you can choose the point where a ball is dropped, which gives you room to plan your approach.

Balls react to everything they touch, including the glassware, supports, and sometimes moving platforms or obstacles. Timing, angle, force, and whether a ball has enough clear space to travel all shape the outcome. You can hit a glass directly or send a ball bouncing or rolling into it. Your aim is to spill all of the liquid from the glasses.
truck-space-2: Truck Space 2 is a 3D truck driving simulator where you steer a big truck pulling a trailer. Your job is to back and park the trailer into a marked parking spot. Road signs along the way show you where the spot is and which way the trailer needs to face.

On a desktop computer, use the arrow keys or W, A, S and D to drive. The mouse lets you zoom in and out and turn the camera around the vehicle. On a phone or tablet, tap the on-screen buttons to drive, and slide your finger across the screen to rotate the view.
geometryrush: Geometry Rush is an arcade runner that keeps you hopping. You guide a cube-shaped hero racing through a colorful world built from geometric shapes. Leap over spikes, slip past obstacles, and grab coins scattered across several levels that grow harder as you go. Checkpoints save your progress so you do not have to restart from the very beginning.

Controls are simple: click or tap to jump, and hold to keep jumping without letting go. The graphics are vibrant and the movement feels smooth, so newcomers can start right away. A practice mode lets you replay each course until you know its tricky spots.
tank-arena-steel-battle: Tank Arena Steel Battle puts you behind the controls of a tank and sends you into the heart of a battle arena. This action shooter tests your skills, your strategy, and your quick reflexes. Its challenges are nerve-racking, so you will need to stay alert from the first moment to the last.

Your job is to drive your tank around the arena and fight the enemies you meet there. Aim, fire, and think ahead as the battle unfolds. The controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all it takes to play, so you can start right away.
bunge-jungle: Bunge Jungle puts gravity in charge of your movement. You climb tall, vertical scenery and steer by tilting your device, which sends you leaping from one platform to the next. The spots you land on do not follow a fixed pattern, so you need to watch each jump while dodging the obstacles along the way.

The game has no set finish line because its challenges keep going. It takes a familiar arcade formula and gives it a fresh spin, so every tilt leads you further through the jungle. Expect a steady stream of changing situations that keep each run feeling different from the last.
somewhere: Somewhere is a simple-looking adventure set in a stark, black-and-white world made of 1-bit graphics. Each of its seven levels asks you to plan your route carefully as you move past tricky obstacles. There are no enemies to fight, so the challenge comes from timing, patience, and sheer persistence.

Beyond getting through each stage, you can also search for secrets tucked away in the game. Success depends on precise moves and careful thinking rather than speed, so take your time and work through each level step by step.
flashcolor: FlashColor tests how well you remember and tell apart colors. Its bright, eye-catching graphics put your accuracy to the test. You watch a series of colors flash on screen, then rebuild that same sequence by picking shades from a palette. Each correct match earns you points, and the more precise you are, the higher your score climbs.

Beneath its artistic look sits a puzzle game that rewards planning and a methodical approach. Players who like working through problems step by step should find plenty to enjoy here, and fans of puzzles may find it hard to stop after one round.
same-room-same-day: Same Room Same Day is a horror game centered on psychological dread. You step into the shoes of Rosaline, who moves through a building packed with monstrous creatures. Along the way you face demanding challenges, gather supplies you will need, and confront the fears that haunt her. The goal is to uncover the secrets hidden within and find some calm in its unsettling digital world.

Movement uses WASD, and the mouse lets you look around. Left click fires, and right click aims. R reloads your weapon, F switches on your flashlight, and Space makes you jump. E handles interaction, while Shift lets you sprint. Full gamepad support is required, so a controller is needed to play.
skebob-gun: Skebob Gun is a first-person shooter set in a wide open world, where you choose to be a hero, a villain, or simply have fun. Team up with friends or go against them as you run, leap, fire, and roam huge maps packed with secrets, weapons, and surprises. Online multiplayer happens in real time, and your arsenal ranges from simple blasters to rocket launchers.

Beyond the fighting, you can drive cars and cause chaos in the open world. Modes include duels, survival, and fun minigames, while skins and customization help you stand out from the crowd. Physics add room for tricks like jumping and flipping, and you can make the most of the environment. On desktop, use WASD to move, Space to jump, left click to shoot, R to reload, G to throw a grenade, and C to change camera. On mobile, touch and swipe to play.
swat-cats: SWAT Cats is an online shooter where every hero is a feline soldier. Four cat operatives are available for now, and more may be added later: Private Nine-Lives, Corporal Strongpaw, Sergeant Silent-Purr, and Captain Scratch. Everyone starts as a Private, but you can switch to other fighters in later online matches. The game offers several fast-paced maps suited to action and shooting. It is multiplayer, so you can team up with friends and use the in-game chat. It works on both mobile and PC.
Movement uses W, A, S, and D for
obby-dig-it: Obby: Dig it is a digging simulator built around easy, enjoyable play. Every session brings something new, and you never really know what will turn up next. Dig through unique worlds using a deep digging system, while a dynamic economy changes how your finds are valued. Along the way, you can take on quests and work toward collections. Relaxing music and striking graphics set the mood.

On computer, move with WASD or the arrow keys, jump with Spacebar, sprint by holding Shift, and use abilities with R and T. On phone, steer with the left thumbstick, swipe the screen to rotate the camera, press the button with the person icon to jump, and press the two buttons to the right of that jump button to use abilities.
obby-break-an-egg: Smash giant floating eggs with your pickaxe across different biomes to free the animals trapped inside. Carry each one home past the guardians, hatch it on your farm, and use the cash you earn to buy stronger pickaxes. Gaining Power unlocks new biomes with tougher eggs and rarer animals, and you can play online alongside others.

Move with WASD and look around with the mouse. Click to swing at an egg until it breaks, then bring what's inside back to your farm and press E to place it. The shops let you spend cash on pickaxes and upgrades. On a phone, a joystick and on-screen buttons take over the controls. Booster pads near the spawn give x2 Speed or x2 Power for watching a short video.
universal-multiplayer-shooter: Controls can be tailored closely to your liking. You can rearrange and customize the on-screen buttons, choosing between Home Builder Pro and classic layouts. Playing stays simple thanks to a shooting assistant and auto-fire. The keyboard moves your character, the mouse looks around, aims, and shoots, and the C key changes the view.

Practice mode lets you sharpen your building, editing, and shooting skills with countless items and weapons, including the assault rifle, the gliding shotgun, and the famous pickaxe. The game is made for all audiences and is completely free. You don't need payments or a battle pass to play without limits, unlike some other Battle Royale games. Updates arrive regularly, made with players in mind.
counter-sniper-1-6-egypt: Counter Sniper 1.6 - Egypt puts you in the role of a single sharpshooter. Your job is to take out armed enemies with careful aim across busy city streets, all while making sure civilians stay safe. Your bullets are limited, so every choice about when and where to shoot counts. The game builds a tense atmosphere that pulls you in and challenges your abilities as you work to quietly stop criminal schemes.

Each mission asks you to think before you pull the trigger. Your focus and judgment decide how well you handle the pressure, and the game rewards patience and precise timing. If you enjoy arcade shooters that reward skill over speed, this one is built around that idea.
last-day-on-earth-survival: Last Day on Earth: Survival is a 2D survival simulation set in a large, ruined city with 51 locations to uncover. Collect wood and metal, then craft weapons at the Workbench to stay equipped. As you earn experience and level up, you can review your Attributes and raise your HP, ATK, Speed, or Search. Daytime is the time to head out and visit places you have never been before.
Your goal is to endure 50 days and explore all 51 locations. Every action is controlled with mouse clicks or taps, so the controls stay simple from start to finish.
portal-hop: Portal Hop is a platform puzzler built around a portal you carry above your head. You use it to tackle tricky challenges, moving through each level by warping yourself onto higher platforms. Along the way, you can grab plus and minus power-ups that raise or lower your portal's height. Careful thinking pays off here, since you need to plan your moves ahead and work out the right route to reach your destination.

Press W or the Up Arrow to warp, which also lets you move upward quickly. Use A and D, or the Left and Right Arrows, to steer in different directions. If a level goes wrong, press R at any time to restart or reset the current level.
horror-sniper-clown-ghost: Trapped deep in a forest of nightmares, you play as Sam, a marksman caught between grotesque monsters and the chance to get free. Your only tools are your cleverness and a rifle. You'll need to follow your targets, line up your aim, and fire to stay alive, all while sawing through chains. This chilling first-person shooter rewards careful thinking as much as sharp shooting.

Every bullet you fire moves you closer to escape, so each decision carries weight. Success depends on patience, precise timing, and a steady hand. Balancing accuracy with a well-planned strategy is the heart of the experience, and the eerie setting keeps you focused on every shot.
bus-n-ball-jam: Bus n Ball Jam is a colorful 3D puzzle where you clear a path by moving buses. Tap the buses at the bottom of the screen and slide them out of the way. Each bus travels in its own direction, so think about where it is heading before you move it.
As buses pull away from the track, colored balls drop onto a moving conveyor belt.
ballon-race-3d: Balloon Race 3D puts you in a playful, dreamlike land where you compete against other players. You start on the ground, and each balloon you pick up lifts you off a little more. Gathering more of them sends you higher into the air and gives you extra speed as you head for the finish line.
Your aim is to outsmart your rivals and be the first to cross the finish line in this airborne adventure. Collect coins to unlock new skins along the way. To play, click the mouse or tap the screen.
blob-twist-color-puzzle: Blob Twist is a bright, colorful puzzle game in which you spin and steer a blob past obstacles until it reaches the finish point. It rewards good timing and quick reactions as you move through a series of demanding stages. Each level asks you to think ahead, since hazards can end your run if you misjudge a turn.

You control the blob with the arrow keys or with W, A, S and D. Plan each move carefully, keep clear of danger, and finish every level to win. The game is built around logic and timing, so it suits players who enjoy steady problem solving with a bit of arcade pressure.
home-hauler-simulator: Take the wheel of heavy trucks and handle precise crane work to assemble houses from scratch. Haul floor sections, wall panels, and roof pieces across rough, uneven ground, learn how the machinery responds, and complete residential contracts that reward your progress. Over time, you grow your own construction business from the ground up.

Switch between driving and crane mode with C. In crane mode, rotate the crane with A and D, raise or lower the arm with W and S, and extend or retract the hook elbow using the Up and Down arrow keys. When you are behind the wheel, drive with WASD and brake with Space.
sink-or-float: Sink or Float is a hypercasual title that lets young players explore physics, specifically buoyancy and mass, through play. A range of different objects appears, and your job is to guess whether each one will sink or float once it is dropped into water. Every right guess earns points, so the game pairs learning with scoring.

Choosing an object works with a mouse click, or with a finger tap on a touch screen. After picking an item, you commit to a sink or float decision for what happens when it is submerged. The experience is designed to test a young person's grasp of these ideas in a lighthearted way.
capture-flag: Capture Flag blends quick-paced action with the simple thrill of games from childhood. Each match is a tactical contest where moving swiftly and choosing your moments carefully both matter. You put together your own weapons, sprint toward enemy flags to grab them, and keep your base's flag out of rivals' hands.
If you prefer going it alone, the solo missions let you take control of the battlefield and work toward winning the day. Plan each move, stay alert, and aim to come out on top.
zombie-world: Zombie World is a first-person shooter where undead enemies arrive in relentless waves. Your survival skills are pushed to their limits as you fight through them. Ammo is limited, so you must plan each shot carefully. Collect power-ups when you can, and outmaneuver the hordes to stay alive in this post-apocalyptic setting.

The core challenge is seeing how long you can hold out against the undead. Every choice about ammunition, movement, and power-ups matters. Fans of zombie shooters who enjoy strategic thinking will find plenty to test them here.
trial-xtreme: Trial Xtreme tests your balance, accuracy, and stamina in a motorcycle racer. The tracks are packed with ramps, pipes, boulders, and awkward barriers, and one misjudged move can mean either a win or a spill. Speed and control count equally here, so you cannot rely on one alone.

Your goal is to get from the starting line to the finish while handling each obstacle along the way. Use the controls to speed up, slow down, and keep your bike upright. Aim for the fastest finish you can manage, and grab as many stars as possible during each run. Every star you collect opens up more tracks to try. Winning takes quick reflexes combined with solid control.
monster-slayer-idle-clicker: Monster Slayer is an idle clicker where you battle a cast of quirky monsters and gather valuable resources along the way. Unlock powerful skills and spells to make your hero stronger, and capture monster souls to grow your collection. Flame Shards can be traded for rare relics.

Boost your abilities with Inlay Stones and potions as you face ever-stronger foes. Everything is handled with the left mouse button, which you use to interact with objects and interface elements. The game is built for mobile play and focuses on player-versus-environment combat.
pin-puzzle-save-the-sheep: Pin Puzzle: Save The Sheep is a puzzle game built around pulling pins. It gives your brain a workout as you figure out how each pin should move. Your main goal is to get the sheep fed and free them from the tricky spot they are stuck in. Other challenges ask you to pull the right pin so the dog can reach its food. Watch out, because bombs, lava and other hazards are waiting, and you must steer clear of them. The game includes a good number of levels, each with its own puzzle to solve. Mouse clicks or taps are all you need to play.
pop-it-bubble-game: Do you remember the fun of popping bubble sheets as a kid? This arcade title brings that feeling to your screen. It is a calm, casual game where you pop three-dimensional bubbles spread across boards of many different shapes. Each pop is satisfying, and you can unlock more shapes of bubble sheets for extra fun.
Taking it slow is part of the appeal. Let the gentle gameplay help you unwind and let the tension melt away. To start, just tap to play, and enjoy a quiet break from your busy day.
horizon-flight-into-the-light: You pilot a glider chasing the sun as it sinks toward the horizon. Thread your way past pale towers and pick up small triangles along the route. Blue crystals raise the sun again and launch you forward, while green ones grant extra jumps. Every 3 km a new world brings fresh hazards: ramps, rolling balls, gates, grinders, windmills, pendulums and presses.
Steering uses the arrow keys or A and D on desktop, and jumping works with Space, Up or W. On a phone, hold the left or right half of the screen to steer and swipe upward to jump. The
miner-merge: Miner Merge takes you into a mining realm where you combine minions to upgrade their abilities. Your miners work steadily, turning rocks into precious minerals. It is an idle adventure, so the digging carries on while you keep an eye on the progress.

The fast forward button speeds up your miners' pace, which helps you maximize your rewards. The game is listed under Puzzles and tagged Strategy, so you can plan your merges as you go and enjoy a title that is easy to keep coming back to.
oddly-sorted-color-sort: Sort colorful blocks into the boxes that match them, and uncover 49 original pixel-art reactions as you go. Plan the order of the front boxes, keep your slots under control, and clear each portrait. Recommended for ages 13 and up. AI tools helped with the code, procedural art and sound, localization, and promotional artwork, but no generative AI runs during gameplay.

To collect blocks, tap or click a front box and all reachable blocks of its color will be gathered. On desktop, press the queue number instead. You can clear a portrait without filling every slot. Undo, shuffle, hints, and extra slots are all free. Open Settings to pause the game or change the sound.
match-them-up: Match them up! is a calm three-dimensional puzzle where your task is to hunt down twin objects hidden among the clutter of a room. Each pair you spot and link together brings you closer to a cleared space and a faster finishing time to beat. The controls feel smooth, and the bright, cartoonish art style keeps every round lively and enjoyable.

To play, select an item with the right mouse button. Drag with the right button to slide the camera around, drag with the left button to rotate the view, and use the mouse wheel to zoom in or out. Keep going until every pair has been matched, which clears the level and lets you try for a new best time.
elemental-friends-adventure: Elemental Friends Adventure is a free platform game that runs right in your browser. It takes you on a lively journey through a digital world and can keep you entertained for hours. The game blends an enchanting, Disney-inspired feel with fun, energetic gameplay. Its tags point to levels and survival, and it sits in the hypercasual category.
Controls are simple. On a desktop, press the WASD keys to move and jump. On a touch device, use the on-screen buttons to move and jump.
architects-of-tomorrow: Take charge of a city's growth in this strategy builder. You plan out large urban areas, then work to keep the resource networks that support them in balance. Shifting environmental conditions will force you to adapt your plans as you go.

Begin with basic zoning and work your way up to towering, high-tech hubs. Your leadership gets tested as you aim for a prosperous, lasting future that people can enjoy for generations. Use the arrow keys to drive and the spacebar to brake.
bus-simulator-3d-bus-coach: In this 3D simulation, you take the driver's seat and steer your bus through busy city streets and off-road adventures. Your job is to pick up passengers, drop them off safely, and sharpen your real bus driving skills along the way. Whether you are navigating crowded roads or working through tricky off-road routes, every trip keeps you focused behind the wheel.
Getting started is simple, since a mouse click or tap is all you need to play. Filed under 3D and Simulation, this game aims for a true-to-life driving experience.
rule-out-the-dangerous-circle: Rule out - The Dangerous Circle is an arcade game about staying alive while the world around you keeps sinking lower. You move through a bright, constantly descending landscape, using quick reactions and careful planning. Obstacles can appear without warning, so you must dodge them and change direction in a hurry while staying ahead of a deadly trap.

The game has striking, colorful visuals, and its gameplay is compelling enough to keep you coming back for another run. It tests both your agility and your cleverness, rewarding fast thinking and sharp timing.
ballerina-cappuccina-loves-tung-tung-sah: This puzzle adventure follows a playful story in which Ballerina Cappuccina hopes to reach Tung Tung Sahur. Your task is to take away blocks in the right order so she can make her way across to him. Physics plays a big role, since each piece you remove changes how the scene holds together and how she moves through it.

Every stage unfolds against a cozy twilight backdrop, which gives the game a calm and gentle feel. The tone stays warm and cheerful from start to finish, making it a sweet, lighthearted choice for anyone who enjoys working through tricky setups.
mars-colony: Rob the Robot has been handed an important job: get Mars ready for people to live there. His days are spent gathering raw materials, setting up factories, and reusing what he collects so the planet can eventually support a settlement. Mars Colony is an idle game, and fans of My Little Universe will notice a similar feel.

You steer Rob with a joystick, or with WASD or the arrow keys if you are on a keyboard. Walking him onto a resource starts mining, and walking him into a production facility starts processing, which brings up an acceleration panel; rapidly tapping that panel speeds things up. Construction zones let Rob pour resources into new buildings, warehouses open a panel for moving materials around, and the transport assistant control zone opens a panel for managing your assistant.
3d-formula-racing: 3D Formula Racing puts you behind the wheel of a Formula One car in a three-dimensional racing game. Pick your machine and push yourself to beat existing records. Every new record you achieve opens up additional cars and tracks to drive, so there is always something new to reach for.

Scores are shared on worldwide rankings, so you can compare your high scores with those of your friends and prove who is the top Formula driver. Steer with W, A, S, D or the arrow keys, and press SPACE to brake.
snake-tangle: Snake Tangle is a puzzle title that blends logic with the classic snake formula. Your job is to steer a playful serpent through a knotted maze packed with barriers so it can reach its meal. The game spans several stages that grow harder over time. Every stage brings a fresh maze design, denser obstacles, and tighter corridors to squeeze through.

Later stages add moving barriers, countdown clocks, and a cap on how many swipes you can make, which keeps the pressure on. The snake slides in a straight line until it runs into an obstacle or the edge of the maze, so each turn needs thought. Consider how long the snake
obby-save-the-brainrots-online: In this reaction arcade game, a massive wave is already rolling toward the area, leaving you only a few seconds to act. Snatch up the brainrots, pull them away from the dangerous elements closing in, and haul them to a safe zone. Quicker moves give you a better shot at finding and rescuing the rarest meme characters, so keep your speed up to get them out of the area before the water swallows everything nearby.

Brainrots come in many rarities, ranging from common up to legendary. Build your collection, unlock new bonuses, and watch your progress grow. Online multiplayer lets you join friends to rescue brainrots as a team, or race them to see who gathers the most valuable finds before the wave hits. Move with WASD, jump with Space, and use E for actions. On a phone, tap the buttons shown on screen.
advance-car-parking-driver-simulator: Advance Car Parking Driver Simulator is a racing title where you practice parking and driving cars. This 2020 release lets you use parking lots and city streets as your testing ground, sharpening your steering precision as you go. Its graphics are designed to stand out from similar titles, and the gearbox aims to feel true to life. It is free to play and offers hours of parking and driving fun.

Camera control works with swipes: drag up, down, left or right on the screen to change the viewing angle, and use a double touch to zoom in or out. Keyboard controls handle the driving itself. The game also teaches you how to park properly, and repeated practice is the key to getting better at it.
spray-paint-coloring-games: Let your imagination loose as you uncover pictures that start out hidden. You pick a painting tool first, choosing between a spray painter, a paint roller, or a spray gun based on the shape and size of the area in front of you. Each layer is colored in turn, and as you finish them, the final image slowly comes into view.

Work through the highlighted section of every layer with precision, keeping your strokes within the target zone while covering it fully. Selecting the best tool for each layer helps you paint more efficiently. Once all layers are done, the finished artwork is revealed and the level is complete.
elastic-car-3d: Elastic Car 3D is an arcade driving game that tests your skill behind the wheel. You switch lanes, pass every car in front of you, and push your vehicle to super-fast speeds. Along the way, you can collect helpful props that give you a rocket-like burst of acceleration. Yellow cars speeding along the street are also worth catching, since they boost your speed and grant a short spell of invincibility.
Everything is played with taps or clicks, so it is easy to pick up. Try to beat your own high scores and see how well your driving holds up as the action gets faster.
monster-truck-crush: Monster Truck Crush is an arcade racer that rewards careful balance. You drive a 3D monster truck and try to beat a computer-controlled rival to the finish line. Land your truck evenly on each upcoming platform and it speeds up right away. Land it badly and you lose speed or the truck rolls over.

The rival is very good at managing its own speed, so you need to match it through skill. Your main tool is the angle of your truck's body, which you adjust to stay balanced and keep gaining speed. To play, click with your mouse or tap the screen.
treasure-quest: Prince Arthur sets off on a treasure hunt, determined to carry out his father's wish and bring the riches home. This casual 2D puzzle game feels smooth and easy to follow. Several treasure colours appear, and each one comes with a bowl of the same shade waiting to catch it. Your job is to pull the correct pin so the treasure drops into its matching bowl.

Pull the wrong pin, though, and the treasure lands in the wrong bowl, causing the game to restart. Matching every treasure to its bowl earns you a reward, and collecting treasure is the main goal. On Android, touch the pin to pull it free. On PC, click the pin with your mouse.
ocean-pop: Ocean Pop is an arcade blast game set beneath the waves, and it gives the genre a fresh feel. Its bubbles are true two-dimensional shapes that float, rebound off one another, and gather into clusters with lively, natural movement. Unlike grid-based blasters such as Toy Blast, nothing here sits in neat rows, so each layout feels loose and alive. Players of all ages can pop groups of matching colors, set off chain reactions, and take in the calm scenery of the ocean depths.

The controls are simple: use your mouse to pop matched bubbles and reach the target of each level. The game is easy to pick up but takes real skill to master. Save your powerups for the right moment, since well-timed use gives the best results.
rescue-skibd-rope-cut-puzzle: Rescue Skibd Rope Cut Puzzle is a simple 3D puzzle game made with Unity. Your goal is to help a man in a desperate situation by cutting the thread at the right spot. Each level depends on your timing, and you can enjoy every one of them.
Controls are easy to learn. Just click or tap to make your cut. Every level tests whether you can find the correct moment, and whether the man gets out of danger is up to you.
draw-dance-battle: Draw Dance Battle puts you in a dance competition where you shape the moves on stage. The game mixes sketching with rhythm, so every routine you create comes to life with a beat. Your job is to draw lines across the screen, and each line determines how your dancer moves during the showdown.

Filed under hypercasual, it blends battle, drawing, and rhythm into one experience. To play, use a mouse click or tap, then keep experimenting with new routines, since the game offers plenty of fun to keep you moving.
block-puzzle-cats: Block Puzzle Cats is a brain-training puzzle game starring cute cats. You drag each cat piece onto the board and work to fit them all together. The puzzle shapes are unusual, and the challenges keep changing, so you have to think about problems in new ways. Your goal is to find a way to place every cat. Each time you clear a challenge, you unlock another adorable cat to add to your collection.

The game is played with a mouse click or a tap, and it is suited to a single player. If you enjoy tricky fitting puzzles with a playful feel, this one offers a fresh world of challenges to work through.
kitty-jewel-quest: Kitty Jewel Quest is a matching puzzle game made for anyone who adores cats. You connect at least three kittens of the same type in a row or column while racing against the clock. Beat each level to move forward.

Complete missions and take part in special events to collect coins. You can spend those coins on boosters, which make the levels easier to get through. The game offers hours of fun and relaxation for players of all ages.
squid-candy-game: Squid Candy Game is a tense browser title inspired by the hit series that everyone seems to be talking about. In it, you take on the Dalgona Challenge, a sweet but dangerous test of steady hands. Your job is to carefully cut away the toffee candy that surrounds a preset shape, all while making sure the shape itself stays intact. The clock is ticking, so it pays to get moving quickly.

Control is simple: you use the mouse to carve through the candy. Each attempt asks for patience and precision, since one careless move can ruin the whole piece. It is a quick, playful puzzle with a 3D look and a bit of arcade pressure, perfect for a short round whenever you have a few spare minutes.
knife-tower: Knife Tower is a 3D arcade game where you climb a bright, multicolored tower by throwing knives into its blocks. Your goal is to get to the top before your rival does. Timing matters here, since you need to throw each knife around a ball that keeps bouncing up and down, and you should steer clear of it.

Press and hold to throw. Accurate hits break blocks, string together combos, and help you move up faster. Coins you collect can be spent on new knives and on upgrades to your speed, combo range, and income.
block-puzzle-prize-mania: This falling-shape puzzle has more depth than its classic roots suggest. Three pieces appear at the bottom, and you drag them onto the grid to fill complete rows or columns. Clearing several lines in one move builds bigger combos and better rewards. A match ends once none of your remaining pieces can fit.

The real draw is a collection of 32 items, each with its own ability. Before a match, you choose up to three that complement each other, such as one to raise your score, one to blast blocks, and one to change the board's rules. Some items trigger automatically, while others you activate yourself, like bombs, lightning strikes, or an undo move. New items come from the gacha machine: spend a ticket, pull the lever, and open the capsule that rolls out. Coins earned after each match add up, though there is a daily cap.
save-king: Save King is a pin-pulling rescue puzzle where you try to save the King, keep the royal family safe, and help restore the kingdom. Every stage presents a tricky scene filled with pins, foes, traps, and loot, and you win by yanking the correct pin at the correct moment. Think carefully, plan your moves, gather rewards, and improve your castle as the story unfolds.

Start by studying the whole puzzle so you can spot the King, Queen, and Princess, along with the enemies, treasure, and hazards. Pull the pins in the right sequence to carve out a safe route and hold back danger, since a single mistaken pull can spoil the level. Use puzzle logic to keep foes at bay and steer clear of risky spots, then collect coins and treasure. Completing stages earns rewards you can spend on rebuilding and upgrading your castle to move on to later chapters.
1945-air-force-airplane: Step into the cockpit of 1945 Air Force: Airplane, an arcade game built around aerial combat. You pilot your plane through tense sky battles, firing at enemy aircraft and fighting your way forward. Every round asks you to stay sharp and keep your shots on target.

Your plane can be upgraded as you go, making it stronger for the bigger battles ahead. Each enemy you defeat and each fight you win brings you closer to becoming a top air force commander. Playing is simple: just click the mouse or tap the screen to get started.
taxi-driver-las-vegas: Taxi Driver Las Vegas is an online driving sim set in a wide open city. Its goal is to help you get better at handling a cab. You collect passengers, carry them to their destinations, and follow directions as you learn the roads. Exploring every map is part of the fun, because it lets you find streets and addresses on your own.

The game offers several modes to keep things varied. You can work through the stages in taxi mode or open mode, or freely explore the whole landscape at your own pace. Controls are simple: use WASD to move, click to move the camera, press C to switch the camera, Spacebar to jump, hold Ctrl to run, F to interact, and Es
low-poly-smash-cars: Get ready for a demolition derby packed with wild driving and plenty of smashing. Pick the super car model you like best, then head into a twisted derby arena where the goal is to bump, crash and wreck the rivals in your path. Speed up and damage any car that gets in your way. Your reckless driving and crash skills get tested here, and you need to be the last car still running to move on to the next level.

The game is single player and runs in 3D with smooth driving simulation and high quality graphics. Drive with the arrow keys, use the handbrake on spacebar, and click the left mouse button to move through menus.
squid-escape-game-2player: Two players work together to break out of a prison surrounded by iron walls and maze-like passages. Both blue characters must reach the exit, and that means gathering every geometric shape in the level and locating both keys before heading for the door. The floor is covered with spiky thorns, so each step needs care. Stay close to your partner, because if you become separated, the round is over.

Player one moves with the WASD keys, while player two uses the arrow keys. Both characters need to make it to the door safely to finish the level, and every shape in the stage has to be collected along the way.
pga3-survival: PGA3 Survival is a pixel-style shooter built around survival. Its jungle map sets the scene, and the campaign offers a large number of missions. Each campaign has its own difficulty level and a different map. Many other game modes are waiting for you to try with friends from around the world.

Chatting is built in. Press Enter to open the chat box, type your message, then press Enter again to send it. The controls are simple: use WASD to move and the mouse to shoot, aim, look around and change guns. Press SPACE to jump, SHIFT to run and TAB to open the menu.
basketball-strike: Step onto the court and get ready for some wild dunks in this 3D basketball sports game. Grab the ball, drive down the lane, and rattle the rim with each slam. Your job is to dribble, dunk, and score your way to a win.

You can choose your own path toward becoming the MVP and show what you can do along the way. The whole game is played with a mouse only, so you control every move with that one device and nothing else.
monster-truck-driving-stunt-game-sim: Take the wheel of a monster stunt truck and tackle intricate, demanding courses where about 99% of the track poses a real challenge. This racing simulator calls for sharp driving as you speed over rugged ground, pull off knockdown stunts, and launch into daring jumps. Mountain climbs add another layer, testing your control on steep slopes.

The game sits within a collection of monster car stunt titles from 2020 and offers a modern take on the genre, with high, demanding routes that push stunt driving to its limits. Use WASD to drive and press C to change the camera.
fisher-clicker: In this clicker, your main job is to click and catch fish. Every catch can be sold, and the money goes toward better equipment. You can buy new fishing rods, a float, a boat, and clothes for your fisherman. Drag a fish to connect it, and drag a fish onto the sale spot to sell it.

Competitions between fishermen let you aim for first place. Winning them earns you money, which you can spend on building your very own fishing house. Clicking the dynamite releases several fish at once. It's a fast way to grow your catch.
fighting-vehicles-arena: Fighting Vehicles Arena blends a vehicle-building puzzle with a battle game, all drawn in simple 2D cartoon blocks. Before each fight starts, you can attach extra body pieces, wheels, and weapons to your ride. During the match you may steer the action yourself or hand control over to the automatic mode. Armor pieces and attack pieces both matter, since you need each to hold up. The round is lost if your opponent still has weapons standing after you have run out. Mouse clicks or taps are all you need to play.
finger-soccer-tournament: Finger Soccer Tournament lets you choose a team and try to score more goals than your rival. You can play for free in your browser without installing anything, and the visuals look polished. Go head to head with a friend or take on the game alone, whether you're on a computer, an Android phone, or an iPhone. The goal is to climb to the top and win the title of champion.

To control your paddle, press your finger on the screen and keep it there, then drag to move. Your job is to guard your own goal while attacking the opposing one, so that you finish with more goals than your opponent.
fruit-fusion: Fruit Fusion is an arcade puzzler built around joining fruit. You release cherries, lemons, oranges, tomatoes, melons, coconuts, pumpkins and watermelons onto a board, and whenever two matching fruits make contact, they fuse into a larger one. Keep fusing to unlock every fruit type and build up your points.

Each drop needs some thought, since the board has limited room and a poor placement can leave you short of space. Think ahead about where each fruit lands so you can keep matches coming. The game ends once the board fills up, so your aim is to score as many points as you can before
fill-the-hopper: Fill the Hopper is a calm three-dimensional puzzle built around matching. Objects sit in a heap that tumbles and settles under real physics. Your task is to pull out three identical items before the tray at the bottom runs out of room. Collect the goal objects shown for each level to win it.

Tapping or clicking any object in the heap sends it to your tray, and no keyboard is needed. If the tray fills without a match, you lose the round. Four boosters can help: undo your last move, use a magnet to pull a matching set together, add an extra tray slot, or shuffle the heap. The levels never run out, and they range from easy starts to trickier challenges.
words-with-prof-wisely: Words with Prof. Wisely is a free word puzzle where you join letters to uncover hidden words. Each word you spell fills empty cells on the board, and once every cell is filled, the level is finished. You trace your path across the suggested letters without lifting your finger from the screen. Some grids are tough, so expect a real test of your vocabulary and focus.

The challenge grows as you move through colorful locations, with hundreds of levels to work through. Spotting a word that is not on the list adds it to the bonus pool, rewarding you with extra rubies and coins. When a puzzle stumps you, hints can be used for rubies. Spending about ten minutes a day on it can strengthen your word skills and keep your brain sharp.
hole-3d-color-block-game: This casual arcade game puts you in control of a hole that you slide around with a single finger or your mouse. Your job is to gobble up every 3D cube and sphere on each level to clear it. Steer clear of obstacles in various colors, since they get in your way. The game is simple to pick up but takes skill to master, making it a relaxing pick.

Each level asks you to collect all the white blocks to unlock the next stage, and you can chase high scores by eating those white pieces, finishing stages, and dodging hazards. Coins earned along the way let you unlock fresh skins for your hole. With more than 200 levels to work through, there is plenty to keep you busy. The game is free to play.
moto-bike-extra: Moto Bike Extra lets you ride a motorcycle through a set of racing challenges. You can slide your bike into drifts and perform stunts. The game offers five modes: career, free ride, battle arena, hot chase, and two player, so you can choose the style that suits you.

The controls are easy to learn. Player 1 drives with the arrow keys or WASD, activates Nitro-Shift with N, switches camera views with C, and uses the handbrake on the Space bar. Player 2 drives with WASD and has its own nitro control. Whichever mode you pick, the controls stay the same.
scale-the-wheels: Wheel size is the main idea here, and it matters a lot. Across more than 30 tracks, you use a slider to switch your wheels between small and large so you can clear obstacles and move through the levels. Small wheels help you speed up, while large wheels let you drive over tall barriers, though they slow the car down. Your aim is to reach the finish line.

Bigger wheels also help the car right itself when it is not resting on all of them. If you get stuck, a sudden large change in size can make the car bounce free. Some levels require building speed before you hit an obstacle. If the car stops and ignores wheel changes, use the level restart button and try again. Upgrading your acceleration lets you jump farther and collect more coins at the end of each level, helping you chase the highest score.
stickboy-epic-swordsman: Step into the shoes of a stick-figure fighter in this online swordsman game. Suit up in a variety of armor sets, face demanding trials, and bring down formidable bosses along the way.

Wander through a colorful world, hunt for special equipment, and discover unusual blades that sharpen your fighting style. Then climb the ranking ladder and measure yourself against other players. Move with the W, A and D keys on a computer or the on-screen buttons on a phone or tablet, and press E to punch or tap the virtual punch button.
real-cod-strike: Real COD Strike puts you in a fast modern war shooter where aim, reflexes, and tactical sense decide every fight. Frontline combat draws on realistic military operations, with hard-hitting gunfire, explosive missions, and squad-based play. Close-range firefights are frequent, and you must secure objectives while outmaneuvering enemy forces across battlefields thick with smoke, fire, and chaos.

Customize your soldier with weapons and tactical gear, then use kill-streak abilities to shift the momentum. Missions might involve storming enemy compounds, guarding key positions, or getting through ambushes deep behind hostile lines, and each one pushes you to react swiftly and fire rapidly. Controls are simple: WASD to move, Shift to run, space to jump, left mouse button to shoot, and left mouse button to zoom.
pop-tap: Pop Tap blends jigsaw puzzling with the calming pop of a fidget toy. First, drag or tap the pieces together until they form a picture of a pop-it toy. Once the image is complete, swipe or tap across the screen to pop every bubble on display.

Each win earns coins, which you can spend on color schemes and new backgrounds to personalize your creations. The game leans into a relaxing, ASMR-style feel and works as a quick antistress break whenever you have a device nearby. Along the way, you merge pieces into your own DIY fidget toys and make each one look the way you like.
king-of-crabs: King of Crabs is a battle game where you steer a crab using simple controls. First, find a shell. Then roam around, eat the fish lying on the ground to grow bigger, and go after weaker opponents. A mouse click or tap is all you need to play.

Check the Shell Gallery to compare each role's armor, speed, skill, and pelt. The Equipment shop sells five claws, five bodies, and five legs. You can claim extra claw coins through the Sign and Spin feature. For a quick fight, Quick Match sets you against 24 players. A tactics guide also offers strategies and tips for winning.
3d-air-racer: Take the controls of this three-dimensional flight simulator and guide your plane through a course of rings on each level. Pass through the rings to move on to the next challenge. As you advance, you unlock new airplanes, and each one lets you perform different tricks in the air. The game has 20 levels, and finishing all of them is the real test of whether you have the skills of a good pilot.
Steer with the mouse or the arrow keys. The 1, 2 and 3 keys trigger tricks, and the A and D keys work the rudder. Getting comfortable with these controls will help you fly cleanly through every ring.
ben-10-run: Ben 10 Run is a 3D action game where you sprint, leap, and bash through enemies, barriers, and supervillains. It is based on the Ben 10: Up to Speed storyline, so you will be racing through the same kind of chaos you see in the show. Keep moving forward and clear everything standing in your path.

Control the action with either your mouse or your keyboard, whichever feels more natural to you. Tags for this title include endless running, so the challenge is about keeping your momentum going and reacting quickly as the route unfolds. It is a fast, simple pick for anyone who enjoys running games with a Ben 10 twist.
hamster-escape-prison: A little hamster finds himself locked up behind bars even though he has done nothing wrong, and all he wants is to return to his family. Alone, he would find it very hard to break out, so the player steps in to lend a hand. This retro 2D platform adventure takes place in a dungeon and was built with HTML5.

Your job is to work through a series of puzzles and skill-based challenges, including reaction tests, that stand between the hamster and freedom. Each solved room brings him one step closer to reuniting with his loved ones. A built-in tutorial explains the basics at the start, so you won't get stuck wondering what to do.
froggy-hop: Send a frog soaring upward in this arcade platformer. Your climb takes you across lily pads, turtles, spring pads, and whales, while sneaky traps lie in your path. Grab coins and gems as you travel. You can also upgrade the frog's abilities so it leaps higher and farther, and unlock new skins to change how it looks.

Timing matters most here. Click at the right moment to land on lily pads, turtles, and spring pads, and to clear obstacles by bouncing over them. On desktop, press the left mouse button to launch the frog. On mobile, tap the screen to launch and bounce it.
holey-battle-royale: Holey Battle Royale is an arcade game with a fighting tag, where you control a hole and swallow various items along with rival holes that are smaller than you. Each thing you consume makes your hole bigger, so the more you eat, the larger you become.

Meanwhile, the map keeps shrinking, pushing everyone into a narrower space. The goal is to outlast the other players until you are the only one left standing. Controls are simple: click with your mouse or tap the screen to play.
racing-crash-jigsaw: Racing Crash Jigsaw is a free puzzle game for people who enjoy both jigsaws and supercars. Its collection includes 12 sharp pictures of car crashes, arranged from easy to hard. The simpler puzzles help you get comfortable with the game, and the tougher ones keep the challenge going.
You can play with a mouse or by tapping the screen. Each crash scene is a separate picture to rebuild, so you can work your way through the set at your own pace.
space-blast: Space Blast is a two-dimensional arcade shooter packed with fast-paced action. Your flying skill and smart planning both matter as you weave through endless streams of falling meteors. You take charge of a spaceship fitted with advanced weaponry, and your mission is to defend the galaxy from threats heading its way.

To steer your craft, simply slide your finger across the screen. Fire at enemy aircraft as they approach and upgrade your weapon as you go. Every round tests your reflexes and your ability to plan ahead, so stay alert and keep your ship in motion.
blondie-in-the-real-world: Blondie has always lived in a flawless, doll-like setting, and she felt cheerful there. One day, though, she notices that her life feels fake and overly polished, so she decides to step out into everyday life to experience something genuine.

Your job is to help her with the tasks: style her look with cosmetics, bake a cake for the guests, tidy up her new apartment, and pick a charming outfit for the celebration. Keep her favorite shades of pink, gold and white in mind. Once you finish, you can save your picture as a PNG image. Controls use a mouse click or a simple touch on touchscreens.
pixel-hero-survivor: Pixel Hero Survivor is a survival game where monsters keep coming in endless waves. You pick one of three distinct heroes and try to hold out as the crowd grows. Between attack waves, you choose from a set of powerful upgrades to help you push back harder. Each hero also has exclusive skills that no one else can use, and these abilities are key to defeating the horde.
On a computer, move your hero with the WASD keys or the mouse. On a mobile device, use the virtual joystick on the screen with touch controls. To cast your character's ability, tap its skill icon.
rainbow-s-doctor: You run your own dental office in this simulation game, where your job is to restore patients' teeth so they can smile again. Start by looking over each patient's mouth to spot grime and damage. Then take out cavities, scrub away plaque, and repair whatever else has gone wrong, picking from a set of playful dentist instruments along the way.

Every patient arrives with a different problem, so you need to match the right tool to the right moment and handle each tooth with care. Work through every troubled tooth to wrap up a level. Finish each treatment well, and new patients and fresh challenges will open up for you.
l-y-eggs: In this hypercasual browser game, a little bird is determined to head home, but many obstacles stand in its way along the road. Your goal is to guide the bird safely through the route until it reaches home. Each attempt tests how well you handle the hazards along the path.
