Built with HTML5, this skill-focused title puts the bird theme at its center and keeps the playful spirit of hypercasual games. It asks you to think on your feet as you work toward bringing the bird home without harm.
robot-chopter-online: Robot Chopter Online is an arcade game where you guide a small flying character. Your goal is to bring it to the top of a labyrinth filled with enemies and hazardous obstacles. The map splits into many different routes, and each choice you make brings new foes and dangers. You can steer around them, or you can collide with one and destroy yourself, so you need to stay careful at every turn.

Movement uses the arrow keys, and the spacebar fires your shots. This casual game runs in a desktop browser and is free to play, which makes it an easy pick for a quick session of flying and escaping through tricky passages.
truck-parking-game: Truck Parking Game is a 3D challenge where you park a large cargo truck. Press the Up Arrow to drive forward. To back up, press T to shift into reverse, then press the Up Arrow again. Use the Left and Right Arrows to steer.

This heavy truck parking simulator for 2025 suits fans of cargo truck parking games. If you believe you have the skills of the best drivers, this game gives you a chance to prove it. Mouse click or tap to play.
bubble-mania: This arcade bubble shooter asks you to fire colored balls at matching bubbles so they pop and vanish. The colored bubbles sit in a ring around you and slowly rotate. The ball in the middle shows the color you will launch next, so check it before you act. Wait for the aiming arrow to line up with a group of the same color, then tap to fire.

Your aim is to clear the whole circle. Keep matching and popping until no colored bubbles remain to finish the level. Three power-ups can help with stubborn clusters: Bomb, Colorful Ball, and Freeze. Save them for the toughest spots. Together, these extras add plenty of variety and keep the fun going.
flick-n-goal: Flick n Goal is a soccer game built around national teams from many countries. Choose the squad you want to lead and step into the world of international football. Before each match, you position your players and set your formation, letting your tactical thinking guide how the game unfolds. Seasoned soccer fans and casual players alike should find something to enjoy, since the game is designed for every skill level.
Controls are straightforward: press and drag with the mouse, then release to hit the ball or move your players. Dynamic gameplay keeps every match moving from kickoff to final whistle.
my-cute-virtual-pet: Adopt a small digital companion in this relaxed arcade-style game and build a bond over time. Your pet depends on you for everything, so you'll track its hunger, hygiene, sleep, and happiness. Watch the status meters closely, serve snacks when hunger strikes, and scrub away mess with bubbly soap. Mini-games keep your pet entertained and earn rewards along the way.

Feed, clean, and heal your pet to keep its health and happiness meters full, and play arcade mini-games to lift its mood. Cute reactions and warm, cozy visuals make every moment feel gentle. On desktop, click the Food, Bath, or Toys icons at the bottom of the screen, then click and hold to drag items onto your pet. On mobile, tap a category button to open your items, then drag them over with your finger.
stick-new-year-in-prison: You play as a stick figure who has been locked in a prison cell on New Year's Eve. Your goal is to uncover three workable routes out of the prison. On Christmas Day, a package arrives holding ten objects, and any of them could help you break free. Expect plenty of problems along the way, each one standing between you and freedom.

Locations with a New Year's Eve theme give the adventure a festive feel and help lift your spirits. On a computer, you control everything with a mouse. On a phone or tablet, you can use a stylus or your finger instead. To progress, click on the different objects around you and work out which ones lead to a successful escape.
easy-obby-parkour: Easy Obby Parkour is a jumping challenge built around parkour courses. When you start, the nickname of the best player appears for everyone to see, and beating the game adds your own nickname to that display. You can change skins so players are easier to tell apart, choose from colorful skins and different character models, and bring pets such as cats, sheep, or dragons. Check where each portal leads before you step through.

If a section feels too hard, you can activate a boost, such as double jump, to get past it. Checkpoints are not saved, so every run starts from the beginning, which keeps speed times fair for all players. Your goal is to collect the last trophy. Move with WASD, jump with the Space bar, pause with TAB, use Shift for the cursor, and scroll the mouse wheel to zoom in or out.
cyber-city-driver: Cyber City Driver sends you into a city of the future. You can race against the clock alone or challenge a friend in the two-player mode. Your goal is to finish six different routes before time runs out, and each new level unlocks a more powerful car. If you want a laid-back drive, Free Driving offers a car trip through a futuristic city. Ramps carry your car up to building rooftops, and the roads winding around the cities give you room to show off your driving skills in super sports cars.
Player 1 moves with the arrow keys, uses Nitro on N, and looks back with B. Player 2 moves with W, A, S and D, uses Nitro on T, and looks back with C. Press R to restart the level.
loose-change-cashier-simulator: Loose Change: Cashier Simulator is a calm puzzle game about sorting coins. You line up coins by their year and their value so that each matching group comes together. Looking a few steps ahead helps you keep the board tidy and clear it in fewer moves. When you get stuck, boosters can help you get moving again.

To play, drag a coin onto any open slot. Match coins that share both the same year and value, then remove each finished group from the board. Aim to end the round with as many moves and boosters left as you can. Each run gives you another chance to beat your previous best score.
dark-boy: Dark Boy is an adventure game set in greyscale levels with carefully designed visuals. Your hero uses time-bending powers to slay dark monsters that stand in the way. Moving through this shadowy world takes courage, and every step helps light the path ahead.

Each stage asks you to complete its listed objectives before you can reach the end line. On desktop, the left and right arrow keys move your character, the up arrow or space bar makes him jump, and the A key attacks. Press W to toggle bullet time and Q to switch between the boys. On mobile, simply tap the on-screen buttons to perform actions.
drift-idle-drift-earn-upgrade: In this relaxed arcade drift game, your car steers itself, so you only need to lean into the corners. Drag the steering wheel at the bottom of the screen left or right, and the sharper the angle, the bigger your payout. Sliding sideways builds your combo, and switching sides without breaking the slide raises your multiplier from x2 up to x10. Hold the drift longer for a larger bonus when it ends.

Spend your earnings on three upgrade lanes, Income, Speed, and Drift, by tapping the cards on the left. Save enough and you can trade up to Boss, Blacklist, Fallout, Cairo, or the elusive Midnight, each drifting harder and paying more than the last. Open the garage to swap cars or customise your paint, smoke colour, and skid trails.
mini-farm: Mini Farm lets you lay out your farm exactly the way you like it. You play as a farmer who plants a variety of crops and runs the whole operation yourself. Raising the adorable animals on the land adds more farming activities to the mix. The game recreates the real planting cycle: you sow seeds, water the plants, and bring in the harvest once it is ready. Ripe fruit trees are also scattered around, and you can pick their fruit.
Everything is controlled with the mouse. Click to work the land, tend your crops, and gather what you have grown.
castel-wars-middle-ages: This sequel, subtitled Middle Ages, brings a fresh round of castle combat. Medieval gear takes center stage, and cannons now replace the catapults from before. Cannons hit much harder and are more deadly. You can also grab fire arrows, swords, and new armor. Wings are the standout pickup: a wing bonus lets you descend slowly from above. Two game modes and freshly drawn themes are included, just like the earlier game.

You can play alone or with a friend in two player mode. Blue uses W, A, S and D to move, S to create a block, E to hit, and Q to change weapons. Red uses the arrow keys to move, the down arrow to block, and space to hit. Holding the hit key down makes the character throw the weapon.
flip-shoot-control: Flip Shoot Control is an arcade action game that sends you on a journey to face enemies who never let up. Your main task is gunplay. You take control of a powerful gun and hold your ground against waves of tough foes. Along the way, you get the chance to sharpen your shooting skills.

It is a 3D title, filed under Action and tagged with Unity3D. The controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need to start playing, so you can jump straight into the fight on a computer or a touchscreen.
tidy-bot: Guide a small robot vacuum through snug 3D rooms in this calm cleaning title. Your job is to gobble up every bit of grime, grab the coins scattered about, and steer back to the charging dock before power drains. There are 30 hand-built stages set in living rooms, kitchens, bedrooms and dining rooms. When you want something different, Endless mode generates a fresh room each round.
Coins can be spent on upgrades for battery life, speed and the side brush. Pick Easy, Medium or Hard to set the challenge. Your progress is kept autom
bike-stunt-racing-legend: Bike Stunt Racing Legend blends motorcycle racing with a stunt simulation that still feels well balanced. It runs on a 3D game engine, and your job is to guide your bike across the finish line before anyone else. Holding up your speed is the key, because the computer-controlled rivals tend to slip up and fall behind you. Rolling ramps may look intimidating, but you can take them head on. Green arrows give you an easier boost in speed when you drive over them. Controls are simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to start playing.
baby-hazel-bed-time: The night sky is full of twinkling stars, and the moonlight makes the evening feel calm. Baby Hazel is ready to go to bed, but first she has to brush her teeth and take a shower. Your job is to guide her through each part of her nighttime routine.

Once she is ready, you can make a bed for her and tell her interesting stories. If a bad dream frightens her, you can comfort her with kisses and play soothing lullabies. Click or tap to start playing.
ash-and-silver: Step into the boots of a monster hunter in this 3D story adventure. You explore forests and ruins, fighting the creatures that cross your path. Each fight earns gold, which you can spend in shops on better gear. The tale is dark fantasy, and you choose the path you take through it.

Movement, combat, and shop visits are all handled with on-screen prompts and buttons, so you always know what to press next. Mouse and keyboard work on desktop, and touch controls work on phones. Your goal is to follow the hunter's story, defeat the monsters you meet, and gather enough gold to upgrade your gear. The whole story is told in your own language.
bubble-tower: Bubble Tower 3D is a calm 3D puzzle where you pop bubbles by matching their colors. A tower of colored bubbles stands in front of you, and you spin it around its vertical axis to line up the shades you need. A shooter holds the next bubble, so you aim it with a tap or drag, let go, and send it flying toward the structure.

Hit three or more bubbles of one color and they pop off the tower, while any bubbles left hanging with nothing holding them will drop away too. Some stages hide diamonds or special gems inside the cluster, and you clear the bubbles around them to free them. The game has many levels that grow harder over time, with extra colors, trickier layouts, and a limited number of shots. Collected gems can unlock shiny shapes and other cosmetic extras. The clean, simple visuals keep the mood relaxed while the puzzle keeps your mind busy.
chaos-road-combat-car-racing: Chaos Road: Combat Car Racing is an arcade shooter that plays like a shoot-em-up featuring cars. Its 3D vehicles sit on the ground, and you shoot them down while collecting upgrade items. Your car fires automatically, so you can focus on the action. Grab the magnet to pick up all kinds of items with ease.
Your mission is to defeat the final boss. Avoid its bullets and keep shooting until it falls. This is a single-player game, and you start it with a mouse click or a tap.
drift-city-racing-3d: Drift City Racing 3D is a browser racing game in the spirit of Need for Speed, where the goal is to win street power. Build your own driving style with a range of cars and custom parts, then shift between chaos and control as you hit the gas and enter underground road races. Each win unlocks more races, more modifications, and more cars. Every choice sticks, so there is no going back.

Speed through the streets of Blackridge, leaping fences, weaving past rubble and traffic, bouncing off walls, and blasting through high-speed nitro zones. Hit the nitrous and carry it into intense drifting. Every corner hides a new race against local crews, with police in pursuit. The city is full of wild drivers, so stay ahead and earn respect. Eight environments and smart, fast AI cars test your skill, and only the best driver takes the win. Earn XP to upgrade, buy new colors, and unlock more power
hide-and-seek-transform-props: Step into this 3D arcade hide-and-seek title, where you pick either the Hunter or the Hider role. Hiders take the shape of ordinary objects and move through the level in search of a clever place to conceal themselves. The timer keeps counting down, and once it runs out, hiders can no longer move, so they must stay put and remain out of sight.

Hunters have a different job. They study every corner of the level, look for objects that seem out of place, and try to catch all the disguised players before the round ends. Whichever side you choose, the goal is similar: either fool the Hunter or find every hidden player before time runs out.
rally-point-3: Rally Point 3 is a three-dimensional racing title where your aim is to cross the finish line ahead of every rival. Progress works through a series of missions, and each one opens up only after you win the race before it. You start with ForceZ, Vulcan, and Bison. Once the first three races are behind you, stronger machines become available for the rest of the events. Keep an eye on your engine's temperature, since letting it overheat will cause a blowup and end your run.
Drive with the arrow keys on a PC. Winning the race is the core goal, so push hard, stay focused, and show everyone what a rally driver can do.
merge-royal-2048: Merge Royale combines solitaire-style planning with the number-merging action of 2048. You work through card puzzles by pairing cards that show the same number and joining them into higher values. The game tests your logic, speed, and focus, and it suits anyone who enjoys calm but demanding merge puzzles. As you progress, you unlock new visuals and chain together satisfying combos.

Each level has a target score, and you earn points by merging identical cards into one higher-level card. Keep merging with care to clear the board, reach the goal, and advance to the next level. On desktop, hold a card with the left mouse button, drag it across the board, and release it onto a matching item. On mobile, touch and hold an item, slide your finger to move it, and lift to drop it on a match.
warlock-king-castle-defense: Warlock King - Castle Defense puts you in charge of a castle under attack from waves of many different foes. You can take on enemies one at a time, or cast spells that wipe out huge numbers at once. To damage an enemy, simply swipe across it. For spells, tap the ability you want, then tap the spot where it should land. Along the way, you can upgrade your spells and build towers to defend your castle.

This tower defense title focuses on strategy and has a war theme with player-versus-environment battles. Deciding when to fight by hand and when to rely on magic is a key part of the game. Balancing direct attacks, upgraded spells, and well-placed towers is how you keep your castle standing.
junkyard-keeper: Junkyard Keeper puts you in charge of your own scrapyard. Your job is to turn old, discarded items into brand-new machines. You gather abandoned cars and loose parts, then put them together to build fresh mechanical equipment. It's a creative simulation where imagination matters as much as the tools you have.

Hop behind the wheel and cruise across the junkyard to pick up useful pieces. Once your vehicle is loaded, haul the salvage back to your base so you can start building. The game is controlled entirely with mouse clicks or taps, so it's easy to pick up and play on most devices.
looper-fruit-hit: Looper Fruit Hit casts you as an archer whose skill depends on timing and precision. Your job is to strike fruits that spin around, using your bow and arrow. The core idea is easy to pick up, but it keeps pulling you back, since each stage asks you to fire at the right instant and the levels grow harder as you move forward.
Controls are as simple as it gets: tap the screen to release an arrow. Aim for the moment when the target lines up, and clear every level by landing your shots cleanly.
figher-stick-hero: Figher Stick Hero is a two-dimensional stickman game built around duels. Your skill gets tested as you take on rival stickmen in intense battles. You can choose arcade mode or survival mode, and both keep the fights coming against your opponents.
Before you head into a match, you can customize your stickman with a range of weapons, different colors, and decorations. Attacking while you move can give you an edge over your foe. Each stickman
runner-coaster-race: Runner Coaster Race blends the speed of a roller coaster ride with the moves of free running parkour. The game feels like a realistic simulation as you run along a circular track to pick up passengers. Grab coins along the way, dodge hazards such as bombs, and keep pushing yourself to earn the crown of track champion.
Play is simple: just click the mouse or tap the screen to control your runner.
merge-to-agi: Merge to AGI is a relaxed puzzle game set around a small garage startup building artificial intelligence. You combine hardware, code, data, and coffee to create stronger gear, then complete requests from a lineup of comical customers. As your lab expands, you move through ten districts and work toward building an AGI empire, all while eight competing labs chase you up the leaderboard.

To play, tap a generator to produce items, then drag two matching items onto each other to combine them into the next level. Hand over whatever customers are asking for to collect coins and experience points. Coins can be spent in the Empire on projects and on opening new districts. The game works with either a mouse or a touchscreen.
wild-animal-hospital-vet-doctor: Doctors are among the many professions that people rely on every day. In this game, you take on that role yourself, running a clinic where you treat sick wild animals that need both regular treatment and urgent medical care. The clinic always has room for another patient, so new animals keep arriving.

Your task is to draw on everything you know, along with your skills, effort, and care, to heal each one. The animals may be suffering from a chill, bruises, or other wounds. Everything is controlled with a mouse click or a tap.
card-quest: Card Quest is a card battle game that uses the Triple Triad rules and is set in a richly fantasy-styled world. You move across a campaign map and face a series of foes, each with their own battle rules and a deck of cards unlike any other. Winning means beating every opponent, and also filling your collection book with the uniquely designed fairy monsters.

Each match starts when you select a card and tap a spot on the board to place it. Bigger numbers on a card beat the cards beside it and turn them around. Build combinations that let you sweep across the board with your strongest cards. Be careful, though, because your opponents can flip your cards too and steal them for themselves.
click-kitty-idle: Click Kitty Idle is a clicker game about feeding a hungry cat against the clock. Every tap earns coins, and you have 32 seconds to gather as many as you can before time runs out. Spend them on cat food like tuna, milk, and cheese, then level up your kitty and climb the leaderboard. Watch your spending, because each new food costs more than the last, starting at 100 and jumping to 860 and beyond.

Boost your Click Value to +1, +2, and higher to speed up your taps. You can also try boosters like Auto Click, Time Extension, and Massive Click Power. Unlock cute cat characters such as Miss Pawlina and Captain Purrbeard, chase achievements, and aim for high scores. Use the left mouse button to interact with the in-game buttons.
russian-drift-overtaking-in-the-city: Russian Drift: Overtaking in the City is a 3D street racing game built around realistic physics and polished visuals. You speed through city roads, sliding into drifts that demand precise control. Your goal is to pass rival drivers, sharpen your skills, and dominate the competition on your way to becoming a racing legend.
Driving is simple to learn. Press W to accelerate, use A and D to turn the car, and press S to brake. On a mobile phone, you control the car with the buttons on the screen instead.
baby-taylor-puppy-daycare: This simulation title follows Taylor, a girl whose beloved puppy went missing a month earlier. She longed for him every day, and it seems the little dog sensed her sadness, because he has finally come home. He arrives dirty and dusty, so Taylor scrubs him clean and treats his injuries.

Once he has rested and recovered, you can dress him in lovely outfits, serve him tasty meals, and build a cozy doghouse where he can stay warm. If you want him to look even more stylish, you can also give him a manicure. Everything is controlled with a mouse click or a tap.
police-stunt-cars: Police Stunt Cars is a 3D racing game that lets you drive several different police cars. Its main draw is the stunts, so you can attempt daring moves while behind the wheel. Every car you take out is ready for trick-filled driving, and the game is built with WebGL to run in your web browser.

Your car is controlled entirely with the WASD keys. The game is set in three dimensions, which gives the stunts and the driving a fuller look. If you enjoy cars, police themes or stunt-focused driving, this one is built around those ideas.
fun-race-car-3d: Fun Race Car 3D is a 3D car stunt racing arcade game for Android and mobile. You need to reach the finish line before the other two drivers, and the goal is to win the championship. Finish a level without crashing and you earn three yellow stars. If you hit an obstacle, you respawn at the start of the current obstacle, so you can try that section again.
Steering is simple: tap the screen to move. The game is built around obstacles, so each section calls for quick taps and careful timing. Every crash sends you back to the start of that obstacle.
room-45: Room 45 is a horror escape game in which you wake up locked inside a room that seems to be aware of your presence. Nobody explains how things work, so you have to figure everything out on your own. Your task is to crack tricky puzzles, search for concealed clues, and reconstruct the events that led to your situation while the clock keeps ticking. Almost any object you come across could matter, so pay close attention to your surroundings.
Interaction works with the E key or the left mouse button, while X closes whatever you have open. Crouching is handled with C. Can you find your way out before the room starts to remember you?
merge-number-cube-3d-run-game: Merge Number Cube 3D Run is a racing title that mixes a three-dimensional running course with merge-style upgrades. You dash across a series of platforms while gathering extra cubes that tag along behind you. Your task is to steer the group past each obstacle and pick the correct gate so that one of your team members moves up to a higher level.
Along the route you will meet huge swinging pendulums, sharp spikes, and cutters, so timing your moves carefully matters. Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all the game asks for.
ramp-truck-mayhem: Rev up Bandit, a monster truck built for big air. Each launch off the massive wooden ramps sends you soaring over wide arenas, where stunt jumps follow one after another. Flames burst from the exhaust as you race at high speed, and your aim is to fly past the checkered flag to take the win.
Steer with the arrow keys and hold Space to brake. Press C to switch camera angles, and click to interact with the game. This arcade racer runs in your browser and was built with Unity3D and WebGL.
biking-extreme-3d: Biking Extreme 3D puts you on a mountain bike for multiplayer races across mountain tracks. If you crash into other riders, they get launched into the sky. Keep your distance from trees and rocks, though, because getting too close to these obstacles ends your run immediately.
Coins you collect along the way go toward upgrading your bike. You can also try out five more characters. Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need to play.
merge-the-coins-ussr: Merge the Coins: USSR! takes place in a setting you won't see every day. Coins drop into a play area, and whenever two matching coins touch, they join into a larger one. Your aim is to keep combining them so you can reach the biggest coin possible while racking up points. Climb to the top of the leaderboard and challenge friends or coworkers who want the same spot.

At the start, pairing coins is simple, but the longer you play, the more coins pile up on the board. When you finally merge the largest coin, it vanishes and earns you the highest point bonus. It's a laid-back puzzle game, so take your time and enjoy the process.
wiggle-escape-snake-puzzle: Wiggle Escape: Snake Puzzle is a clever logic game built around snakes. Each level begins with the snakes knotted into one shape, and you need to tap them in the right sequence until the whole figure comes loose. Only a snake with a clear path can slide away, so the order of your taps decides everything. The puzzles look simple at first, but they demand patience, focus, and some forward planning.

The main mode includes a large set of handmade levels, and they grow harder over time with longer snakes, tighter tangles, and trickier layouts. Sandbox mode lets you pick from preset shapes, test different mechanics, or draw entirely new levels of your own. You can try out your ideas and build puzzles to share with others, which keeps the game going for a long time.
real-mtb-downhill-3d: Real MTB Downhill 3D is a simulation-style adventure that takes you down a variety of mountain trails. Your goal is to finish five different roads before the clock runs out. You will ride through changing weather and rough, demanding ground, so every run calls for careful riding.

Rewards you earn along the way let you change your bike's color, and new riding clothes become available too. The controls use the arrow keys, with the space bar, C and V keys also in play. It is a single-player game centered on the bike ride itself.
shop-cashier-simulator-3d: Step into the shoes of a skilled checkout worker inside a store you run yourself. This three-dimensional simulator recreates the feel of a busy supermarket or shop. Behind the register, quick hands and careful focus matter most, since keeping shoppers pleased is what helps your store grow.

Your daily routine covers ringing up goods, collecting money, and making sure every sale adds up correctly. Shoppers may settle up with cash or credit, and each one arrives with a different situation to handle. Slip up by charging for the wrong product or handing back the wrong amount of change, and customers grow frustrated while your earnings take a hit.
lovely-virtual-cat: Bubbu is a little cat waiting to become your digital companion. He is a sweet, sensitive, and charming feline who enjoys munching on delicious meals, snapping photos of himself, dropping by to see pals, and busting a move on the dance floor. Spend time in Bubbu's house and uncover the hidden details of his daily routine. He is sure to throw a few surprises your way.

Bubbu's bright, playful world is packed with lively adventures and plenty of fun kitty-themed games. Everything is controlled with taps or clicks. Each visit reveals something new about this lovable pet.
strike-force-action-platformer: Leap, fire, and grab power-ups in this platformer full of bright, colorful stages and enemies. Keep moving along the route while dodging bullets from foes who charge at you, drop in on parachutes, or shoot from cover. Ammo pickups keep you in the fight, and blasting enemy drones earns stronger weapons. Every battle makes your hero tougher.

The visuals are vibrant and eye-catching, and you will face a wide mix of enemies in intense shootouts. You can also unlock a lineup of characters, each with a different look. On mobile, a virtual joystick on the left moves your hero, while buttons on the right handle jumping, shooting, and throwing grenades. On desktop, use W, A, S, D or the arrow keys to move, the spacebar to jump, J to shoot, and K to throw a grenade.
hex-triple-match: Hex Triple Match combines puzzle challenges with strategic matching and merging on a hex-based playing field. It asks you to solve clever puzzles and make logical moves, so it suits anyone looking for a brain workout. Think carefully about where each piece goes, because smart placement helps you eliminate them faster. Each colour represents a different item. The graphics are attractive and easy on the eye. This is a 1 player game, and you play it with a mouse click or tap.
onet-puzzle-tile-match-game: Onet Puzzle is a tile matching game made for relaxing in your spare time. It includes more than twenty detailed themes, each with its own music, so there is plenty of variety. As you hunt for matching pairs and connect them before time runs out, you exercise your memory and focus.

To clear a pair, draw a polyline between two identical tiles. That line can bend no more than three times. Higher levels bring more grids and new types of pairs, so the challenge grows. Four helpful tools are available when you need a hand. Winning earns more points and raises your level, and once you collect enough points, you get a treasure box.
baby-panda-train-driver: Ever wondered how a train is put together? You might have snapped one together with blocks, but do you know what parts it actually needs? In this game, you build a little train from a handsome front engine, long carriages, and cargo boxes. Then you set off on a trip with Baby Panda at the controls. Along the way, passengers climb aboard, and you help the young animals check tickets, spot unsafe items hidden in suitcases, and guide everyone into a neat line.
Remember to switch on the engine and load every piece of cargo onto the train before you leave. Play with a mouse click or a tap, and enjoy starting a fresh journey with Baby Panda.
stickman-street-fighting: Push through a series of street stages and take on rival stick fighters one after another. Grab whatever you can find along the way, including melee weapons, a machine gun, a pistol, and a saw, to gain the upper hand. Nobody seems to know how the brawling on these streets got started, but you are set to rise as the strongest stickman brawler.
The game runs offline, so no internet connection is needed, and it supports gamepads and joysticks. Over 100 st
blockstorm-block-puzzle: Blockstorm: Block Puzzle invites you to chase a high score in a bright, colorful grid game. Drag shapes from the tray onto the board, filling empty cells. When you complete a horizontal or vertical line, it clears and you earn points.

Plan a few moves ahead so there is always room for the next set of shapes. Once every piece in the tray is placed, a fresh set appears. Set against a cheerful fantasy backdrop, each line clear feels rewarding, and your results can earn you a place on the leaderboard. Undo and continue options are there when a round gets tight.
all-golf: Step up to the tee in All Golf!, a game that tests your skill as you work through challenging courses in pursuit of the elusive hole-in-one. Controls are easy to pick up, and the visuals look sharp, so every swing feels true to life. You can compete against friends or try solo challenges to sharpen your game. As you progress, new courses unlock, and you can customize your equipment.
Whether you are a seasoned golfer or just starting out, the game offers plenty of fun for players of every level. To play, simply use a mouse click or a tap.
airport-controller: In this free simulation, you step into the role of an airport manager and keep everything orderly. Your job covers the full flow of air traffic: bringing planes in to land, sending them off on takeoff, and guiding each one to its proper destination. You move planes by dragging them with the mouse to wherever they need to go.
car-stunts-driving: Climb behind the wheel of a true-to-life car and steer it along routes suspended high in the sky. Each track is lined with obstacles to get past, and a single slip can send you plunging into the abyss below. The game offers many different levels and a wide selection of tracks built for car stunts, all driven with realistic car physics.

On a PC, press W to move forward, S to reverse, A or D to steer left or right, and Space to stop. On mobile, the same actions are handled by the matching on-screen buttons. Whether you are tackling a tricky obstacle or simply trying to stay on the track, the controls put you in charge of every move.
voxelbomb: Plant sticks of dynamite on blocky voxel structures and set off chain reactions that bring them down. Your goal is to push every structure below the red line. Use fewer charges to earn more stars, and unlock and upgrade ten demolition tools along the way. Once a level is finished, sandbox mode lets you keep smashing.

On desktop, move with WASD and look around with the mouse. Left click places dynamite or uses your selected tool, and right click retrieves a charge. Press E to detonate, Space to jump, Shift to sprint, C to change the camera, and R to rebuild. Number keys or the mouse wheel switch tools. On mobile, drag to orbit, pinch to zoom, tap a wall to place dynamite, and tap BOOM to detonate. Switch to WALK if you want joystick movement.
children-doctor-dentist-2-surgery-game: Take charge of a real dental hospital in this game. Every day you meet many patients, all of them funny animals, and each one has the same problem: their teeth hurt. They must agree to treatment, and you provide the medical care. Using modern medical tools, you can help these little patients feel better.
The controls are simple: tap or click. Each day brings a new group of animal visitors to look after, so there is always someone waiting for your care. Keep going and help every patient you receive.
bubble-shooter-classic-online: Bubble Shooter Classic Online is a hypercasual arcade game where you blast colorful balloons off the screen. As you go, you sharpen your strategy and logic skills by working through a set of fun puzzles.
Getting started takes almost no effort, since a single mouse click or tap is all the controls require. The puzzles reward careful thinking, so every move gives you a
classic-number-puzzle: This browser game is a number slide puzzle built on math, and it gives your brain a steady workout. The board holds numbered tiles along with one empty space. Tap that space to slide a neighboring tile into it, moving one tile at a time, until every number sits in ascending order. The rules are simple enough to pick up in seconds, yet reaching a clean finish takes real practice.

Your goal is to solve each board using the fewest moves and the shortest time possible. Every slide counts, so it pays to think a few moves ahead before you tap. This title suits anyone who enjoys logic puzzles and number games, especially players who like to test their thinking.
drawer-sort: Drawer Sort is a puzzle game about bringing order to cluttered spaces. Your job is to act as a tidying champion, clearing away mess one drawer at a time. Plan your moves carefully, because a rushed approach can leave your hands fuller and your drawers in worse shape than before. Each brain-teasing challenge asks you to slot different items into their correct spots.
Accuracy matters here. Items need to sit neatly and snugly in their places to reach a tidy win at the end of each round. You play by clicking the mouse or tapping the screen.
puzzle-box-brain-fun: Puzzle Box - Brain Fun is a thinking game built around several modes for a solo player. As you advance, new difficulty tiers and different styles of play open up, giving you more to work through. It is designed as a relaxed pastime that still pushes your reasoning and sharpens your wits, and it can help you measure your IQ along the way.
Playing is simple: click with your mouse or tap the screen. Begin whenever you feel ready and show what you can do.
pet-card-sort: Pet Card Sort is a puzzle game built around sorting cards that show cute animals. The board has two sides, and your goal is to group identical pet cards in sets of three so they vanish. Your collection grows as you meet dozens of creatures, such as owls, bunnies, and rainbow sloths.

To play, tap a card from the row at the bottom of the screen to pick it up, then tap an empty slot on the board to set it down. Three matching cards anywhere on the board will clear away. Finish a level by removing every card from both sides. Because slots are limited, you'll need to think ahead. The game feels calm and simple to pick up, yet mastering it takes some planning.
bullet-man-3d-online: Bullet Man 3D Online is an arcade shooter where you aim a gun at an enemy and try to destroy it. Your bullet travels through the spot the foe occupies, leaving them no room to escape. Enemies keep moving, so you need to judge carefully whether they can dodge your shots while the bullets are already on their way.

Controls are simple: tap to start playing. This 3D arcade game rewards careful aiming and quick reading of where targets will go next, making it a good pick for anyone who enjoys fast target practice with a gun.
mx-offroad-mountain-bike: MX OffRoad Mountain Bike is a game about fast downhill biking over demanding ground. You ride through a large, wild world filled with bumpy paths, tall jumps, steep cliff edges, and thick fog. Your aim is to reach each checkpoint and finish the levels. Play alone or invite a friend to join in two-player mode.
Player 1 steers with W, A, S, and D, while Player 2 uses the arrow keys. If your bike gets stuck somewhere along the route, press the re-spawn button to get back on track.
obby-throw-an-egg: Hurl your egg as far as you can across ten biomes, since the farther it lands, the rarer it becomes. Carry it home before the biome boss catches you, then place it on your farm with E and hatch it. The creatures you collect there earn cash. Along the way you can train Strength, unlock auras and trails, and play online with others.

Steer with WASD and look around with the mouse. Click or press R to throw, and release inside the white zone for a perfect toss. Hit Space in the green zone to lift the dumbbell and build Strength. Ph
crashdown-voxel-destruction: CrashDown Voxel Destruction is a voxel sandbox that gives you full freedom to act. Several locations are packed with structures, and each one can be wrecked completely using a variety of methods. The physics behave in a way that feels close to real life, so every collapse looks believable. Pick any location, then grab whatever you need from the arsenal, which ranges from a simple hammer up to a heavy bazooka.

Once you're ready, start tearing down whatever catches your eye, since you can destroy literally anything. Move with WASD, jump with Space, and run by holding Left Shift. Use the mouse to look around and the left mouse button to shoot or throw. Press I to open your inventory, M for the map, and Esc to pause.
flex-escape: Flex Escape 3D asks you to bend and stretch your way out of trouble. Rather than sprinting down a path, you stay on a mat while furniture and appliances come flying your way. You slide left or right using straightforward controls to weave around each hazard. Gems picked up along the way open up new objects to unlock, which adds a fresh twist as you keep playing.
Your aim is to reach the finish without bumping into anything, so concentration and nimble movement matter the whole way. To begin, click with the mouse or tap.
chess-free: Chess against a strong computer opponent offers 18 skill levels, from Beginner up to World Champion. When you select a piece, the board shows every square it can move to, and interactive tips appear during the game to help you improve. If you make a slip, you can take the move back. After a match, the analysis highlights your mistakes and shows how you could have played better. You can also replay the game from any point you choose, and handicaps can be set to even out the contest.

If you would rather face people, the online mode pits you against real live players and saves your rating as you go. It includes the same post-game analysis, so you can find your errors and grow stronger. For local games, two players can share one screen and pick a time control of bullet, blitz, or rapid. Everything works with a simple mouse click or tap.
monsters-wheels-special: Monsters' Wheels Special puts you behind the wheel of a huge, powerful car that tears across a variety of tracks. Expect hills, steep drops and different obstacles that you can jump over. You can race against tough opponents and very powerful cars, or enter demolition derby, where you ram and crush rivals and win by any means necessary.

Earn money as you play and use it to unlock new cars or upgrade engine power, durability, nitro and more. The controls are simple: the up arrow gives gas, the down arrow brakes, and the left and right arrows balance your vehicle. Press space or X to use nitro.
offroad-truck-animal-transporter: Offroad Truck Animal Transporter puts you behind the wheel of a truck hauling livestock through a lifelike woodland setting. Your job is to carry a variety of farm animals to their destinations. The journey covers ten demanding levels, each with rough ground, shifting weather, and obstacles in your path. Every level tests your driving ability and precision.

Controls are simple. Use W, A, S, and D to drive the truck. Press C to change the camera view, and click anywhere on the screen to look around in different directions. Work through all ten levels and see how well you handle the animal transport job from start to finish.
help-me-tricky-puzzle-games: Help Me: Tricky Puzzle Games is a playful brain teaser built on clever thinking and silly humor. Each scenario throws you into a strange, comedic mess, and your job is to pull a character out of trouble. You can interact directly with people and objects on screen, and the answers often come from places you would not expect. The text at the top of the screen tells you what the goal is for each scene.

To act, look for the green markers and tap them, drag them, or pull on them. Every move is a chance to test an idea, so experiment and think outside the box. The game asks for logic and imagination in equal measure, which makes it a good fit for anyone who enjoys puzzles with a comical twist.
the-pirate-sea-the-smuggler-s-way: You play as a smuggler sailing the open seas. Your job is to search for treasure, complete a variety of tasks, and destroy enemy ships. You can also capture islands, upgrade your vessel, and watch out for sea monsters. The goal is to become the most famous smuggler on the water.

On a computer, the arrow keys steer your ship forward, backward, left, and right, while D and A fire from the right and left sides. Holding Left Shift speeds you up. On mobile devices, on-screen arrow buttons handle steering, two cannon buttons fire to each side, and a red-and-white button provides acceleration. Speed costs food, which is used up while you sail, so keep an eye on your supplies. To set a course, open the map and tap the compass icon near your destination.
finnie-escape: Finnie Escape is a puzzle game set under the sea, where you steer a small fish through twisting underwater mazes. You travel along paths laid out on a grid, dodge hostile creatures, and work with things in the environment. Special abilities can help you stay alive when the way forward gets risky. As you advance, every stage brings fresh hazards and harder problems that call for careful thinking, planning, and good timing. Your job is to pick the safest route and guide Finnie out of the deep ocean.
Movement is simple: use the arrow keys or W, A, S, and D to get around.
fire-truck-rescue-driving: Take on the role of a firefighter in this driving title. Your mission is to steer a fire engine to a blaze that needs emergency rescue. The fire scenes and rapid driving create a strong sense of urgency, pushing you to reach the flames and put them out. Stay sharp, because you must keep the truck moving quickly while carefully avoiding other vehicles on the road.
Playing is simple, since a single mouse click or tap is all you need. Every trip to a fire scene asks you to balance speed with care behind the wheel.
obby-skateboard-race: Skate through a series of obby-style courses that blend parkour with racing. Each run asks you to pull off tricks and race against others, and every stage plays differently. Clearing a level opens up fresh areas, each packed with its own original obstacles. Some stages test precise jumps, while others make you squeeze through tight gaps between obstacles. Unlock new skateboard skins and trails as you go, then climb the leaderboard against friends and other players.

On a computer, use WASD or the arrow keys to move, Space to jump, and the right mouse button to control the camera. On a phone, a virtual joystick handles movement, a virtual button makes you jump, and touching the center of the screen adjusts the camera.
relaxing-games-30-in-1: If you want a laid-back way to unwind, this set of 30 small games fits the bill. Each one is built to bring calm and entertainment, whether you have a few spare minutes or you are stuck on a long journey. The collection is meant to lift you away from everyday routine and help you find a sense of balance, and you can enjoy it wherever and whenever suits you.

After the game loads, pick any one of the 30 to begin. The rules are simple, so there is no training to sit through. If a level feels too tricky or simply isn't holding your interest, you can skip it and move on. There are no ratings or points to chase, just addictive mini-games to dip into.
cute-shapes: Cute Shapes is a relaxed observation puzzle that suits the whole family. Your task is to pick out the odd one among a group of shapes that have eyes. Each round offers a handful of small challenges, and the difference might appear in a shape's form, size, expression, sound, or another feature. Working through them is a good way to sharpen your powers of observation.

To play, first read the task written at the top of the screen so you know what to look for. Then scan the shapes and find the single one that doesn't match the rest. Click it with your mouse or tap it with your finger, and the game moves you on to the next level.
god-of-entropy: God Of Entropy is a falling-sand simulation that blends a story campaign with open sandbox play. You can test dozens of different elements, set off chain reactions, and either shape something new or tear it apart. Achievements are waiting for those who keep experimenting.

In Story Mode, each level asks you to reach its goal using the elements you have on hand, and finishing them moves the narrative forward. Sandbox Mode removes those limits, letting you build your own scenes and chase achievements at your own pace. Pick an element by clicking its icon in the left toolbar, then left-click and drag to paint with it. Hold Shift while dragging to draw a straight line. Adjust the brush size with the mouse wheel or the on-screen slider, and the ESC key pauses the game or opens the menu.
block-team-deathmatch: Block Team Deathmatch is a first-person shooter simulation. Every part of the game, including the scenes, characters, and weapons, is built from pixel blocks. You can choose from three modes: a 4v4 Team Mode, an Individual Mode, and a Sniper Mode.

For the best start, try Team Mode first to earn better equipment. Once your rank goes up, you can move on to the other two modes. If you are new to shooters, consider purchasing an auto-rifle, which lets you fight at any distance. Stay calm and make sure you shoot first. To play, click the mouse or tap the screen.
helifight: Two small pixel helicopters face off in this retro arcade duel. One is blue and one is red, and you pilot one while a friend handles the other. Rocket symbols drift through the air, so grab them to load up and fire at the rival chopper. First player to land five hits takes the win. Touch the screen to steer on a phone or tablet, or press W or the up arrow key on a keyboard.
popdify: Popdify is a fast-paced skill game where accuracy is everything. Hold to release popcorn, then aim so the cup fills perfectly. If even one kernel misses, the game ends right away. The controls are simple, but the challenge comes from staying precise throughout.

It is listed under puzzle, arcade, and casual games, and it puts the focus on skill. The gameplay moves quickly and offers endless fun for anyone who wants to keep improving. The goal is easy to state: pop carefully and fill the cup without dropping a single piece.
build-levels-earn-money: Tap the screen to send balls rolling toward the holes at the start of every round. Between rounds, you can head to the store and pick up stronger upgrades or handy items to help you get further. Finishing levels rewards you with diamonds, and those diamonds pay for permanent upgrades that speed up your progress over time.

This clicker mixes idle, card, and arcade elements, so each run feels a little different. The deeper you get into the levels, the more generous the rewards become. Keep building your skills and see how far you can push your score.
machine-eater: Machine Eater is a management game where you gather resources and turn them into building blocks. As your ship grows, you decide where each block goes and which structures to fit onto it, since every structure has its own features. Once your setup is ready, you pick a target from the radar and work to wipe out the foes it shows you.
Structures you take from defeated enemies give you more options to plan around, which adds depth to your strategy. You move your character with WASD, the arrow keys, or the mouse.
draw-tattoo: Draw Tattoo is a hypercasual drawing game in which your artwork turns into real tattoos. It is built with HTML5 and tagged as casual, so it runs right in your browser. Expect a relaxed pace as you watch each design come to life.

Your main job is to use your precision to point and aim the needle, filling in the shapes you have drawn. Steady hands and patience matter here, since every stroke shapes the finished piece. Take your time, stay focused, and enjoy seeing your art transform into an actual tattoo.
blocky-challenges: Blocky Challenges is an arcade game where you guide a red block with funny eyes on a journey through a course full of obstacles. The little hero cannot hop over even a tiny bump on his own, let alone a tall barrier. Still, his friends will come to his aid when you call them, so he is never completely alone on the trip.

Clicking or tapping is all you need to play. Each press forms the required number of blocks beneath him, raising him to the height he needs to clear the next hazard. Every challenge tests how well you judge the right amount, so the game rewards careful, steady play. It works with a mouse on a computer or with touch on a phone.
break-the-wall-prison-escape: You start in a prison cell with only your bare fists and a single wall between you and freedom. Every block you smash earns cash, and rare ores like gold, rubies and amethysts are worth even more. Spend your earnings on tools and upgrades that raise your power, speed and income, then tackle tougher walls in the kitchen, the laundry, the sewers, the guard room and finally the prison yard.

This voxel clicker is built around a simple loop of tapping, earning and upgrading. Its blocky 3D world keeps the action easy to follow, and the idle elements keep your progress moving even when you step away. Each wall you break brings you one step closer to getting out.
hide-the-monster-choose-pose: Cute monsters must hide from an invisible enemy's watchful gaze. Each creature has its own concealment stance, and you choose the one that lets it blend into the crowd and avoid danger. As stages progress, they grow harder and the clock allows less time to finish them. Expect a mix of shelters and settings, plus puzzles that test both logic and focus.
To play, tap a monster to cycle through its poses. Then drag the figure onto the matching cover silhouette to check whether the pose fits. Once it matches, that monster is
supercar-stunts-2023: SuperCar Stunts 2023 is a free 3D racing game where you pick your car and head into spectacular ramp stunt racing. You can choose from a wide range of powerful automobiles. The game also features Mega Ramp Car, which you can only play after accessing it through Big Ramp Car.

Controls are simple. On a computer, use the W, A, S and D keys to drive. On a mobile device, use the button inside the game instead. The title runs in HTML5 and also supports Android, so car and stunt fans can enjoy it on the go.
sorting-cute-animals: Sorting Cute Animals is a new sorting game built around adorable creatures. Your task is to arrange the animals within the grid cells, placing them right next to each other. When three identical animals sit side by side, they connect. It is a calm, relaxing experience designed for players of every age and gender, and its cozy feel makes it a good fit for kids too.

The gameplay stays simple. First, find animals that match. Next, place them together on the same shelf. Keep going until the field is completely free of animals. Once it is empty, the level is passed and you have finished it. It is a gentle matching puzzle for anyone who enjoys slow, peaceful challenges.
pig-bros-adventure: Two pig brothers who have been close friends since childhood set off to wander the countryside. Their journey leads them to plenty of gems, and your task is to help them gather as many as you can. It is a 2D adventure you can enjoy alone or with others, since it supports two players.

Controls are simple. Player 1 moves left and right with A and D and jumps with W. Player 2 has its own move and jump keys, and Player 3 steers with J and L and jumps with I. Team up with your sibling and see how many gems you can pick up along the way.
kick-and-run: Kick & Run is a fast-paced action game where you run, fight, and try to stay on your feet. You sprint through brightly colored obstacle courses, slip past hazards, and knock rivals away with punches and kicks. Speed matters, but so does choosing a route that keeps you out of harm's way. Every level is packed with traps and foes, so you need to keep your wits about you.

Controls are simple on either device. On a computer, use the arrow keys or WASD to move, and click and drag with the mouse to attack. The Right arrow key also works for attacking. On a phone or tablet, swipe across the screen to move and touch the screen to attack. Your goal is to reach the finish line and complete each level.
zombie-incursion-world: Step into Zombie Incursion World, a first-person action battle game where you play a survivor fighting on the front line to stay alive. Stock up on ammunition and combat weapons, then take on monstrous zombies. You can also hunt them as an elite sniper armed with some of the best guns and rifles in this dead zombie shooter.

Your single goal in this lethal war is to stop the zombie apocalypse and save the frontier. Move with the arrow keys or WASD, and fire with a left mouse click. Press C to crouch, Space to jump, and G to throw a bomb. Use the L key to lock or unlock your cursor.
besties-on-wednesday: Two girls who could hardly be more different end up sharing a room at a school of magic. One of them, a young bestie, arrives with a personal sense of style that leans toward black clothing and a gothic look. Her roommate prefers bright colors, so the two find it tough to understand each other at first. Yet the cheerful girl turns out to hide more than meets the eye, with a few secrets of her own.

Your job is to dress each student in an image that suits her perfectly. Choose makeup, hairstyles, outfits and accessories that match each character. Along the way, the pair may slowly grow into best friends. When you are happy with the result, you can save it as a PNG image. The game works with a mouse click on a computer or a simple tap on a touch screen.
scale-kid-run-and-jump-up: Scale Kid Run and Jump Up is a never-ending run through a lively setting full of nonstop hurdles. You guide Scale Man, whose journey depends on careful timing and nimble movement. His special ability is shrinking and growing, which lets him get past barriers and squeeze through narrow gaps.

Expect plenty of obstacles and brain-teasing puzzles that call for smart resizing and fast decisions. Speed boosts and shields can give Scale Man a hand as he keeps racing forward, and customizable skins let you change his look for a personal touch. Controls are simple: click the mouse and look around, press SPACE to jump, and use WASD to walk.
african-cheetah-hunting-simulator: Take on the role of a cheetah searching the open grassland for zebras to chase down. The game is split into a series of stages, and each one asks you to catch a set number of animals before you can move on. Your surroundings resemble an African savanna, with scattered trees, tall grass, and large, dangerous neighbors such as rhinoceroses that you will need to watch closely.

Movement is handled with the W, A, S, and D keys. Running, jumping, and attacking are triggered by on-screen buttons, so you can tap them directly during play. Keep an eye on the bigger animals, since they can be a real threat as you hunt your way through each level.
ragdoll-duel-2p: Ragdoll Duel is a silly duel game that works for one or two players. In this ragdoll shooter, you need to choose your moments carefully, timing each shot so you can aim well and bring down your rival. Coins collected in 1 Player mode can be spent to boost your health bar and the power of your weapon.
Player 1 fires with the W key, while Player 2 uses the UP ARROW key. Solo players can also aim and shoot with the mouse.
colorful-greedy-snake: Colorful Greedy Snake is a casual competitive game where quick hands matter, but so does thinking ahead. You guide a snake that keeps running, and the challenge tests your strategy as well as your speed. The snake running experience keeps transforming as you play, which makes for plenty of fun.

You control everything with a mouse or with touch input, so the controls stay simple however you prefer to play. The game is tagged as clicker, 2D, action, casual, puzzle, and snake, which reflects its blend of fast reactions and clever planning.
number-merge-run: Imagine a shiny, jelly-textured digit sliding along a floating 3D course high in the sky. Drag left or right to steer, or on a computer use the mouse, the A and D keys, or the arrow keys, while your number moves forward on its own. Absorb smaller blue digits to grow, and steer around bigger red ones and spiked balls. Hitting a red digit, a spike, a hole, or a gap without a jump pad ends the run.

Minus walls make you pick the better side, multiply gates are worth passing through, and divide gates are best avoided. Jump pads carry you over gaps. At the finish, your number smashes every candy block it is big enough to break. There are 120 designed levels, followed by endless random ones. Coins buy upgrades for your starting number and income, plus cosmetic items in the shop, and a daily gift and a lucky wheel add extra rewards.
knots-jam-thread-puzzle-3d: Calm puzzles center on pairing up colorful wool balls and freeing up snarled thread. Each level asks you to unravel tangled strands, line them up, and build a finished embroidered picture. The title is a 3D take on match-three play, with a cozy, logic-focused feel.

Your job is to gather threads into sets of three and fill the marked spaces on a virtual fabric canvas. Every thread you line up in the right spot solves part of the puzzle and brings more of the stitched image to life. Success depends on planning ahead and choosing a smart order for placing each spool, so the board gets fully cleared.
moto-3d-racing-challenge: Moto 3D Racing Challenge is an arcade game about stunt racing on a motorbike, presented with three-dimensional animated graphics. As you race along the track, you can grab gold coins. Finishing higher in the standings helps you collect more of them. Tapping the screen speeds your bike up or performs stunt moves, while sliding your finger moves you from side to side.
This HTML5 title is tagged for 3D, bike, collecting, driving, and kid-friendly play. It is a light, fun pick for anyone who enjoys racing and grabbing coins along the way.
uphill-racer2: Take the wheel in this physics-based racer, where your car tackles bumpy, hilly ground. The aim is to climb as far as you can without tipping over, so you'll need to manage your speed with care. Gather coins along the way, unlock new vehicles, and upgrade your current ride to push even further. The road gets tougher the longer you keep going.

Steering works with the left and right arrow keys or the on-screen buttons. Press right to speed up and left to brake or reverse. Stay balanced on both uphill and downhill stretches, avoid crashing, and pick up coins as you drive. Your goal is to cover the longest distance you can and beat your best score.
slide-the-blocks-build-the-pictures: Slide the Blocks: Build the Pictures! is a logic puzzle that asks you to think about space and find smart solutions. Your task is to slide the shapes around the board until they form a complete image. Shapes cannot pass through one another, so every move needs some planning, and you must work out the right order of steps to reach your goal. Each finished picture unlocks a new one, featuring cute animals and other characters.

To move a piece, tap it and drag it into an empty cell. Clearing a level means filling in the entire picture, and the game keeps going with endless levels to solve. It works well as brain training, helps build logical reasoning, and is a relaxed way to spend some spare time.
dop-puzzle-erase-master: Dop Puzzle Erase Master is a single-player brain game in the puzzle category. Your job is to work out which part of a picture to rub away so the level can be cleared. Each stage asks you to think ahead and use your imagination to figure out the right move. As you use the eraser on the image, a hidden object or scene slowly appears.
The rules are simple to pick up, but the stages get tricky, and you will need to plan your strokes carefully to beat them. Control is handled with a mouse click or a tap on a touchscreen.
shoot-your-nightmare-double-trouble: You are trapped in a frightening dream in this first-person horror shooter, where you roam through spooky woods, a city block, and damp sewers. Blast your way through new foes and make use of the large arsenal of firearms you can find. The nightmare has only grown worse, and you must defeat two separate nightmares before you can finally wake up. A bonus level is also included for those who push through.

Movement uses W, A, S, and D, with the mouse to look around. Left click fires, right click aims, and the mouse wheel switches weapons. Press G to toss grenades, R to reload, and F to pick up items. Left Shift lets you run, Left Ctrl makes you crouch, X drops you prone, V handles melee attacks, and Space makes you jump.
zombie-mission-5: Zombie Mission 5 is the fifth installment in the series, a shooter where you rescue captives from the undead. Coins gathered during play can be spent in the UPGRADES area to purchase new weapons and extra lives. A new menu lets you pick Normal, Hard, or Extreme difficulty. Two players can team up on the same screen.

To finish the mission, you must defeat the BOSS waiting in the final level. Player one moves with W, A, S and D, hits with F, throws grenades with G, jumps with W, and switches weapons with Q. Player two uses the arrow keys to move, L to hit, K for grenades, the up arrow to jump, and P to switch weapons. Both players can walk on walls. Every hostage
bird-sort-puzzles: Bird Sort Puzzles asks you to organize brightly colored birds so that each one lands in a nest of the same shade. Many color and nest mixes appear across the game, so you need to plan your moves carefully to finish every stage. When a level gets tough, you can add extra branches to help you out. Overall it feels calm but still keeps your mind busy, and it suits people of any age. To play, just click with your mouse or tap the screen.
world-war-camp-company: In this idle clicker, you build up your camp and push back invaders. At base, you can upgrade troops, buy military gear, and improve weapons, including jeeps, tanks, and squads of fighters. Lead your blue forces against the red side across several locations. Press the BATTLE button beside the gate to send allies out to hunt enemies. You clear a level by destroying every foe and capturing the enemy flag.

Expect many upgrades, varied equipment, and interesting enemies. Bosses appear every few levels as big, tough foes that close out each stretch of play. Gold and silver helmets pay for upgrades, and collecting more of them improves your soldiers' and vehicles' looks and stats. Action movie references appear throughout, and your player's skin can be customized. Sound is optional. On PC, use WASD, the arrow keys, or hold the left mouse button and drag. On mobile, press your finger to the screen and drag
tennis-hero: Pick a hero and step onto the court for a tennis event against three opponents. Good timing decides every rally, so watch the ball closely and strike at the right moment. To serve, hold and then release once the power bar is full, but avoid overpowering the shot. Your goal is to win a Gold Medal across all of your opponents.
Controls are simple: tap the screen, touch, click with the mouse, or use the cursor keys to swing. The game is one-button play, so the challenge comes down to timing.
crazy-breakout-mobile: Crazy Breakout Mobile is a refreshed version of the earlier Crazy Breakout, built for phones. You steer with simple touch controls, or with a mouse on a computer. The setup looks easy at first, but it takes some time to get the hang of it.
Your aim is to beat the existing high score and earn a spot on the list. The game sits in the hypercasual category and is tagged as arcade, ball, and casual.
paint-tiles-puzzle: Paint Tiles Puzzle blends artistic flair with clever thinking in a cheerful puzzle experience. It is a calm game that mixes drawing with puzzle solving. Every stage shows a grid of tiles, and your goal is to fill the blank squares with the correct hues. Pick up the brush and tap to lay down matching shades.

Each stage brings its own pattern and combination of colors, so you need to use both your eye for design and your reasoning to finish it. The challenges grow steadily harder as you move forward, keeping things interesting from start to finish. You control everything with a mouse click or a tap.
tidywhim-clearroom: TidyWhim: ClearRoom invites you to tidy up rooms full of scattered household items in this cozy sorting puzzle. Your job is to gather everyday objects and drop each one into its matching collection box. The game has 30 levels, and each one asks you to clear a room.

Tap or click any uncovered item to pick it up. If its box is open, the item goes straight in. If not, it waits in one of the limited temporary slots, and every item takes up valuable room there. Think ahead and avoid filling every slot. When things get messy, boosters can unlock an extra box, add more temporary slots, or remove an item. Fill all the boxes and clear the room to finish the level.
pin-rescue: Your friend has been trapped, and only you can help them break free from a dangerous room. Your goal is to meet up with them and escape together. Along the way, keep an eye out for dangerous animals and hidden devices, because contact with either one can leave you hurt. Stay alert and move carefully if you want to reach safety.

This arcade title is tagged as casual and aimed at kids and boys. Getting started is easy: tap to play. Its simple tap controls make it a light choice for a quick session, and the challenge comes from staying clear of every threat as you work toward the escape.
drifty-master: Drifty Master puts you behind the wheel of a roadster in a racing and driving simulator with three-dimensional animated artwork. It suits players who already have a steady hand on the wheel. Across 200 levels, you can tackle a variety of tracks at different difficulty settings. Upgrading the car you already own and unlocking new models both help you get more out of your time on the road.
Controls are simple. On a computer, use the A and D keys or the arrow keys to steer. On a phone or tablet, tap the on-screen buttons.
brain-find-can-you-find-it-2: Brain Find Can You Find It 2 is a puzzle game built around fresh brainteasers. It mixes sharp thinking with curiosity, and its challenges often work differently from what you might expect. Your target item can be reached by thinking backwards, so each problem calls for an unusual angle. Passing levels can be done in unexpected ways, and that can bring plenty of laughs.

The game puts your logical thinking, reflexes, memory, and creativity to the test. Everything is played with a simple mouse click or tap, so there are no complicated controls to learn first. It is also a chance to show how smart you really are.
mordecai-and-rigby-easter-holiday: Get ready for the Easter special episode starring Mordecai and Rigby, played as a two-player adventure. Your goal is to collect the special Easter eggs, then reach the door and jump through it. Ten chapters are waiting for you, and you need to complete each one.

Two people can play on the same screen. One player moves with the WASD keys, while the other uses the arrow keys, and the R key is also part of the control setup. If you are on a phone or tablet, touch controls are available instead. Team up, share the fun, and work through the chapters together.
number-merge-10: Number Merge 10 is a math puzzle game that challenges you to combine numbers in a clever way. Choose a rectangular area on the board. If the numbers inside it add up to exactly 10, every number in that area gets eliminated.

The game belongs to the Puzzles category and is tagged with puzzle, math, logic, merge, and number, so it suits players who enjoy logic and arithmetic. Each move comes down to finding the right rectangle to clear. The focus stays on simple addition with one clear target: a sum of 10.
zombie-parade-defense-2: This second entry continues the first Zombie Parade Defense. The undead are tougher here, and they grow stronger with every wave. One person can play alone, or up to three players can team up. Your job is to keep the horde away from your building. Use guns, turret towers, mines, a shield, and bonus pickups to hold them off. Survive ten waves to win.

Each player has their own controls. Player one moves with W, A, S, and D, switches guns with Q, and enters or leaves the base with E. Player two moves with the arrow keys, also switches guns, and uses L to enter or leave the base. Player three moves with Y, G, H, and L, switches guns with T, and uses U to go in or out of the base.
tornado-fury-of-the-elements: You step into the role of a tornado lord and unleash a storm on a busy city. Your job is to build powerful whirlwinds that tear through buildings and infrastructure, all while steering clear of defenses and other obstacles. As you play, you can refine how precisely you handle your twister and boost its destructive force.

Controls are simple to pick up, so newcomers can start quickly. On a computer, press W to move forward, A to turn left, S to head backward, and D to go right. On a phone or tablet, an on-screen joystick handles the steering. The game suits fans of arcade action and simulators, and it gives you the feeling of truly commanding the elements.
sushi-bros: Sushi Bros is a puzzle game about guiding little sushi pieces to safety. The two Sushi Brothers are taking on an ancient rite of passage that every young sushi must complete. Before they can land on the plates of happy customers at the hibachi, they have to practice touching down safely in some very tough conditions.

Your job is to steer them through the obstacles in their path and make sure they arrive in one piece. The puzzles put your problem-solving skills to the test as you guide the sushi to its destination. You can play with a mouse click or a tap.
formula-1-driver: Formula 1 Driver is a racing game where you can tune up your own car and steer it toward the front of the pack. You will go up against computer-controlled rivals, and your aim is to cross the line in first place. The full challenge spans 30 levels, so there is plenty of racing to get through.

Driving is handled with the arrow keys, which let you steer and control your speed as you push through each course. Keep your eyes on the track and your rivals, because every level asks you to outperform the AI cars to move on.
bump-bandit: Bump Bandit is a clever puzzle game viewed from above, wrapped in a retro mood with a jazzy flavour. You control a small, eccentric burglar who is set on pocketing every diamond scattered around the city. His story runs until the final job is done, and it takes an unexpected turn along the way that is worth seeing through.

Your objective on each board is to collect all the gems. On a computer, use the arrow keys or W, A, S, and D to move, press R to restart a level, and press Z to undo your last move. On a phone or tablet, swipe up, down, left, or right to move your thief around the board.
stickman-team-return: Three small stick figures join forces to stop a gang of robbers threatening the city of Detroit. The fun comes from watching these cartoon fighters in action as you take out enemy stickmen. You can use any of the three playable characters, and each one has unique abilities and weapons built for its particular role.

The game supports two players. Player 1 moves with WASD, shoots with the Spacebar, and uses a special move with E. Player 2 moves with the arrow keys, shoots with J, and uses a special move with K. Either player can press C to change characters.
ball-attack: Shoot your way through a never-ending stream of bouncing balls in this arcade shooter. Slide your finger or mouse left and right to steer your cannon, which fires on its own, so you can focus on lining up shots and avoiding danger. Each ball carries a number, and hitting it enough times brings that count down to zero, causing it to burst apart. Dodge the obstacles heading your way, because a single touch with a ball ends the run.

Coins you collect along the way can be spent on firepower, speed, and special abilities, helping you hold out longer. The further you progress, the harder the challenge becomes, but the rewards grow as well. This classic-style game is built for quick, skill-based sessions on mobile and desktop alike.
traffic-jam-escape-car-puzzle: Your goal in this puzzle game is to guide your car out of a crowded jam without crashing into the vehicles around it. Each move needs planning, so you can work through congested roads and untangle the mess one step at a time. The challenges are built to keep you hooked, and the lifelike 3D visuals make every street feel believable.

Getting started is easy: just tap to play. Since every move affects the cars nearby, think before you act and watch how each choice opens or blocks a path. Whether you like car games, traffic puzzles or 3D graphics, this title combines all three in one experience.
cat-escape: In this 3D arcade game, you control a cat that has accidentally wandered into a villain's house. Getting back out will be anything but easy, as the cat faces many difficulties along the way. The room's decorations are not the real concern. The biggest challenge is avoiding the guards who are searching the place, so keep out of their sight at all times.
This casual title is controlled entirely by dragging, so it is easy to pick up. Stay alert as you move through the house and try to slip away unnoticed.
12-minutes-to-survive: You play as a skilled spellcaster who must last twelve full minutes against waves of relentless foes. Your mage levels up during the battle itself, unlocking new skills and abilities as the fight goes on. Souls dropped by defeated enemies can be collected and used to boost your magical power. As time passes, the challenge grows harder, so your strategic decisions and spellwork will determine whether you can withstand the chaos.

On a computer, you move with the arrow keys on your keyboard. On a phone or tablet, you use the touch button on the screen to get around. Either way, the aim is the same: survive the full twelve minutes.
motorcycle-stunts-drive: Motorcycle Stunts Drive puts you on a stunt superbike for head-to-head racing against a friend or a random opponent online. You stay in full command of your motorbike the whole way, watching for stunts and giant ramps ahead while rivals try to slip past you in the fight for the top rider spot.

Speed alone won't always win. Some tricks call for patience, careful timing, and a clear plan. Besides multiplayer, the game offers several other modes, and playing through them unlocks more superbikes and helps you hold your own against very quick riders. Use WASD to drive and C to change the camera. Good luck, and enjoy the ride.
obby-sword-hero-adventure: Sharpen your combat skills in this sword-focused adventure. Raise your attack power and find rarer blades to equip and use. Gather a team of companions, defeat foes, and take on bosses as you roam the game's worlds in search of adventure.

Along the way, you earn trophies and skill points to boost your hero's abilities, and you can unlock every world on the map.
