basketball-life-3d: Basketball Life 3D is a hypercasual sports game centered on shooting hoops. It tests both your skill and your sense of timing, so every attempt feels like a small challenge. Levels range from classic hoop challenges to unusual trick shots, and each stage is full of fun to discover. Its creative approach to basketball keeps things lively from start to finish.

Controls are simple, since a mouse click or a tap is all you need to play. The core idea of shooting at a hoop feels familiar right away, while the mix of standard and trick-based levels adds plenty of variety.
neon-goal: Neon Goal drops you into a glowing arena where your accuracy is put to the test through physics-based puzzles. Your task is straightforward: get the ball into the net. You have only a limited number of throws, and obstacles stand in the way, so each shot needs careful planning. Every level is a new puzzle that asks you to think, line up your angle, and throw with precision.

Aiming is done by touching and dragging across the screen, and releasing your finger sends the ball flying. Once it's in the air, the ball bounces and moves according to physics, so you need to account for every rebound. The short levels and neon style make it a good choice for a quick session.
axe-run: Axe Run has you smash through obstacles with an axe as you run forward. Along the way, you gather wood, pass through gates that boost your speed, and spend what you collect to improve your character. That wood also helps you build a city. Each level tests your skills in its own way.

The game is free and works on mobile and desktop. On desktop, press and hold the right mouse button, then swipe in the direction you want to go. On mobile, hold your finger on the screen and swipe to move. It suits players who enjoy action mixed with a bit of strategy.
assassin-commando-car-driving: Assassin Commando Car Driving is an arcade car battle game shown in a vertical view, with cartoon-style 3D vehicles. Your car carries a mechanical arm, a machine gun, and a baffle. You can crash into enemy vehicles, punch them from the side, and fire the machine gun once its skill is ready.
A good first step is to upgrade your baffle before anything else. Hitting an opponent from behind is easier than going after its side. To play, just click the mouse or tap the screen.
girl-hair-salon-and-dress-up: Step into a hair salon where you decide how each client looks. You can style hair in many ways, from fashionable cuts and bright colors to graceful updos. Next, pick from a broad selection of makeup products and looks to finish the style. Your wardrobe of clothing and accessories includes hundreds of options, so every client can leave feeling their best.

As you play, you earn stickers as rewards, which open new services for your salon and help you grow as a stylist. Snap pictures of each client before and after the makeover, then share your favorite results with friends and other players.
merge-rockets-obby: Step into this three-dimensional puzzle game, which takes its cue from 2048. Combining two matching rockets gives you a stronger one from the next tier, and those upgraded rockets can be fired straight at rival players. Pick your moment and your target, then go after other players' bases. Raise a shield at just the right time to absorb incoming strikes, then hit back at whoever tried.

Damage you deal brings in in-game currency, which you can spend on upgrades to grow stronger. Blow up buildings, sink ships, and watch the whole city become a field of rocket fire. On a computer, use WASD to move your character and Space to jump. On mobile, move your character with the joystick.
mr-reckless-car-chase-simulator: Speed is the name of the game in this car chase title, where crashes are part of the fun. You weave through a blocky, low-poly metropolis while police cruisers, everyday traffic, and piles of wreckage try to bring you down. When things look hopeless, you can grab Slow-Mo, Freeze, or Nitro boosts to slip out of tight spots.

The core idea is simple: keep moving at all times, because stopping is not an option. Steer with WASD or the arrow keys, and tap the Spacebar to pull the handbrake when you need a tight corner or a sudden halt. The real challenge is seeing how long you can remain on the run without getting caught.
ultimate-pk: Climb the rankings over the course of the year by knocking off the top teams. Your job is to score goals while also keeping opponents from finding the net. Attacking and defending both matter, so keep an eye on each end of the pitch.

Shooting is done with a swipe, and you stop shots by tapping or clicking the keeper's gloves. If you would rather compete with someone you know, you can challenge a friend on the same device. Solo or head-to-head, the match is yours to win.
rocket-rush: Pilot a rocket through a 3D arcade flying challenge built from 20 handcrafted levels. Dodge obstacles and manage your fuel as you fly through forests, buildings, and industrial tunnels. Hit your target, earn stars, and unlock new rockets and equipment for routes that grow steadily more demanding.

Each run is a race against your fuel, so you must reach the target before it runs out. Collect fuel cans along the way and beat your earlier times to earn more stars. Credits can be spent on rockets and gear. On keyboard, press Enter to launch, steer with WASD or ZQSD, look with the mouse, and hold Space to boost or E for a parachute. Controllers use the sticks, RT/R2 to boost, and
cat-puzzle-draw-to-kitten: This casual puzzle asks you to guide each cat back to its kittens. Sketch a path that keeps the felines safe so they can reach their little ones and head home. If two cats bump into each other, they become dizzy and the round is lost. The game is engaging and simple to pick up.

On the way, you will face a range of enemies and obstacles that call for careful planning. Cats and kittens come in many different skins, and the graphics are bright and cute. Levels grow harder as you progress. To play, press your finger on a cat and drag to draw a line toward its kittens. Avoid hazards along the path, and make sure every cat gets its kittens home safely.
checkmate: Checkmate is a strategy game inspired by chess, with over 500 maps and 24 challenging achievements. Every board is different and calls for its own approach. You play as Black against White, aiming to deliver checkmate. The interface is accessible, so both chess pros and newcomers can enjoy it at any level.

Unlock achievements and explore the many maps to test your ability to outwit your opponent. Standard chess rules apply, with a few changes. As Black, you must always checkmate the White king. Your own king may or may not be on the board. Black moves from bottom to top, while White moves from top to bottom, which matters for the pawns.
duck-hunter: Your goal in this game is to take aim and shoot down ducks. Each round presents 10 ducks, and you need to hit at least 6 of them to move on. Clear that bar and you advance to the following round.

Because the game is tagged for mobile, it suits quick sessions on a phone or tablet, and it also rewards steady accuracy and good timing. Action and shooting fans who enjoy testing their skill will find the core loop easy to pick up but satisfying to master.
hair-challenge-online: Hair Challenge Online is a 3D arcade runner built around a character with extremely long, regal hair. As you move down the catwalk, gather strands in any color you come across. Dodge scissors, blades, and other sharp obstacles so your locks stay intact. For a fresh style, pick up a colorful hair dye, put on your high heels, and keep running, even across the rooftops.

If a bad cut happens, you can return to the hair salon shop and carry on. There you can choose from several characters, hair dyes, and hair accessories, unlocking each one as you go. It is a challenging runner that rewards careful movement. Follow the game tutorials to learn how everything works before you begin.
monster-truck-offroad-2: Pick a powerful monster truck from the garage and head out onto rugged mountain trails in this 3D racing game. Your job is to climb steep slopes and roll across rocky paths and obstacles, all while racing the clock to reach each checkpoint before time runs out.

Every off-road stage asks you to manage your speed and keep damage low so you can aim for a clean finish. The controls are simple: W or Up Arrow accelerates, and S or Down Arrow brakes or reverses. A or Left Arrow steers left, D or Right Arrow steers right, and Space pulls the handbrake. On touch screens, use the on-screen driving controls instead.
cowboy-survival-zombie: You play as a cowboy in the Old West, where the land is crawling with zombies. Your days revolve around sowing and harvesting crops, eating, and gathering resources. You can build a shelter for yourself and shoot the undead when they approach. The whole world can be destroyed, so every structure and piece of terrain is open to damage.

Your aim is to survive as many days as possible while killing as many zombies as you can. Use the left and right arrow keys or A and D to move, and press W to jump or climb a ladder. Press S to climb down a ladder. The Space bar and Shift cover picking up items, opening doors, using the well, and using the bed. Left-click to shoot or use an item, and right-click to change figure or build.
gun-and-roll: In this shooting game, you roll a roller object through each level and can change it into other shapes. Along the way, you press cards to improve your gun, then use that gun to shoot objects. Picking the correct doors helps you upgrade yourself as you go, and your goal is to pass each level.
Controls are simple: a mouse or your finger handles both the roller object and the gun. Steer carefully to avoid obstacles, collect upgrades, and make sure you pick the correct doors.
tank-stormy: Tank Stormy drops you into a relentless battle of tanks. Face off against your friends in two-player mode, or pick survival mode to fight computer-controlled AI opponents instead.

Labyrinth walls can serve as your cover, so use them to shield your tank and plan your next move. In two-player mode, bonuses scattered across the map can help you destroy your rival faster. Player 1 drives with W, A, S and D and fires with Q, while Player 2 uses the arrow keys and the SPACE bar.
archer-defense: Archer Defense is an arcade tower defense game where you play as a bowman guarding a castle. You fire arrows at incoming foes with your mouse or finger, while the archers also strike nearby enemies on their own. Each monster you bring down rewards gold, which you can spend in the shop on stronger damage, quicker shots, and new abilities.

The waves never end, so your goal is to hold out as long as you can and reach the highest score. To clear a wave, you must eliminate every enemy in it. Your progress is saved to the cloud, you can unlock achievements, and you can compete with friends on the leaderboards. The game is simple to pick up but takes practice to master, so it suits casual players and tower defense fans alike.
princess-eye-art-salon: Ariel is a clever girl who adores makeup and is deeply drawn to makeup art. Lately she has been especially fond of eye art, and she regularly dreams up inventive eye looks. In this game, you find out which design she will paint next, then help her complete the makeup. Your job is to build imaginative eye makeup alongside her.

Playing is simple: just mouse click or tap. Follow along as Ariel shows her next eye design, and let your imagination guide every detail you add to the look. Whether you enjoy makeup or simply like creative art, there is plenty to explore around her eyes.
car-stunt-racing-game-3d-car-games: Car Stunt Racing Game 3D lets you drive offline across sky tracks built around demanding ramps. Your aim is to get through tricky stunt courses, perform daring maneuvers, and reach the finish line without crashing. Along the way you will dodge obstacles, keep your balance during jumps and mid-air tricks, and avoid falling off the track. Each level has a time limit. A car racing mode and a range of cars add more variety.

On desktop, the arrow keys handle driving and steering: Up accelerates, Down reverses, Left and Right steer, and the Spacebar brakes. On mobile, use the left and right buttons to steer, then work the accelerator and brake pedals to move forward or slow down. Customisation options let you tune your ramp stunts, so you can polish your skills and master the car.
car-evolution-driving: Car Evolution Driving mixes a running and collecting arcade style with car parts management. Its stickman characters and cartoon vehicles are rendered in 3D, and as you gather items along the way, your car grows steadily more advanced. Each part you pick up adds to the build, so the machine you're assembling changes over time.
dream-room: Dream Room lets you design six different spaces: a cozy bedroom, a stylish living room, a magical nursery, a charming kitchen, an atmospheric café, and a sunny balcony. You get full creative control over where everything sits in each room. The catalog holds more than 250 pieces, including beds, sofas, wardrobes, side tables, lamps, plants, rugs, curtains, toys, paintings, and windows that show different scenery.

Every piece can be recolored and moved to any spot you pick. You can also dress up walls and floors with dozens of styles, from soft stripes and hearts to starry skies and flower prints. Windows can look out over the sea, the mountains, a night city, or an enchanted garden. As you go, earn coins, open new rooms, and collect rare finds. To build your collection, pick a room, choose a category along the bottom of the screen, tap an item, then tap the spot where it should appear and drag it wherever you like. Save your layout, spend coins in the shop, and finish themed challenges for extra rewards.
draw-the-car-path: Draw The Car Path mixes parking and puzzle play. Your job is to sketch a route for each car so it reaches its parking space. The only control you need is swiping: drag your finger across the screen to draw the path.
Each level asks you to think ahead about where a car should travel before it gets to its spot. The game suits kids and anyone who likes cars, and it works well on mobile devices.
avatar-make-up: Avatar Make Up is a browser game for girls that lets you explore the world of beauty in a fresh way. You can bring out your artistic side and create makeup looks, choosing from a wide range of eyeshadow tones and lipstick colors. Each design is a chance to try out different styles and let your imagination lead the way.

The game is for one player and is easy to pick up. On a computer, use your mouse to play. On a phone or tablet, simply tap the screen to get started. It is a cute, fashion-focused makeover experience that puts style right in your hands.
slope-city: Slope City is an endless runner in the hypercasual genre. Your job is to guide a rolling ball down a path made of connected slopes, gaining speed as you go. The rules are easy to pick up, but the run asks for sharp reflexes, since the ball keeps moving and you must respond quickly to stay in control.
Steering is handled with the A and D keys, or with the left and right arrow keys. Use them to steer the ball left or right and keep it rolling along the slopes for as long as you can.
purrfect-match: Purrfect Match is a relaxed match-three puzzle about rescuing shelter cats. Each level is a room full of kittens waiting for a home. Swap neighbouring cats to line up three of a kind and they're yours. Four in a row creates a rocket, a bent five makes a bomb, and five in a straight line forms a Paw that sweeps away every cat of one colour. Six in a line gives you a glowing Paw with double points and a wider sweep.

Sixty hand-drawn levels set different goals: gather one kind of cat, open crates, free kittens from ice, or chip away at stones that only blasts can break. Each chapter brings one new idea to think about. Spend milk bottles on boosters before a hard level, and take on daily tasks, achievements and the leaderboard. Most levels have no timer. The game is available in twelve languages and works on phone or desktop.
impossible-jeep-driver: Take the wheel of a four-wheel-drive jeep and head into rugged off-road courses. Your route takes you up rocky climbs, along narrow mountain paths and past tricky obstacles. Each stage ends with a finish that you must reach before time runs out. Choose your own line, decide how fast to go and work to keep the jeep steady through the most challenging sections.

You can play with the keyboard: W or the Up Arrow accelerates, S or the Down Arrow brakes and reverses, A or the Left Arrow steers left, and D or the Right Arrow steers right. Press Space to pull the handbrake. If you would rather use touch, the on-screen driving controls cover the same actions.
card-quest-10-minute-adventure: Card Quest: 10 Minute Adventure is a short strategy card battler with a playful streak and plenty of creative touches. Over turn-based fights, you gather armies, call in creatures, cast spells, and raise buildings across different terrains. Each battlefield zone favors a certain card style, such as attackers, healers, or defenders, while special units can be placed anywhere.

Before a match, you build a deck from the cards you have collected, shaping it toward heavy attacks, healing, or strong spells. At the start, you choose which terrains sit on your side of the board, and each one accepts only certain creatures. Rainbow Creatures are the flexible exception. On your turn, you draw cards, spend Magic Points, and deploy units, buildings, or spells. Unlock new cards, upgrade favorite heroes, and outwit your rivals to win.
ugi-bugi: Meet Ugi Bugi, a charming blue plush teddy bear who is ready for a single-player 2D adventure. His mission is to reach the flag, but many obstacles stand in his way, so he will need to stay alert. Along the journey, he can also gather gold, and collecting it is part of the challenge before he reaches the finish line.

This cartoon arcade game works with the WASD keys on a computer and with touch controls on a mobile device. Guide the little bear carefully, avoid the hazards in his path, and grab the gold as you go. Every move brings him closer to that flag.
angela-all-season-fashion: Angela All Season Fashion is a dress-up game aimed at girls, with summer and winter themes. The original text describes a summer picnic scene: four Rainbow High students, Skyler, Sunny, Ruby, and Violet, are getting ready for a day out after their vacation plans. Your job is to help each of them dress and prepare before they set off. Everything is controlled with the left mouse button, so a simple click is all you need.

Think of it as a styling session where the four friends need a little help getting their look right for the trip. The game is meant to be light and fun, letting you pick outfits and touches for each character as the picnic approaches. It suits anyone who enjoys fashion and makeover play in a relaxed, easy-to-follow format.
jeep-drive-prisoner-transport-sim: This browser title works on both Android phones and iPhones, and it can also be played on a computer. Everything is set up around moving captives for the United States Army, so you get to drive a genuine military prisoner vehicle. The laws of physics shape how the heavy truck handles every bend and bump, which makes each trip feel weighty.

You are signed up for US Army service and must complete driver training for its prisoner and freight transport units. Prior experience handling a range of military trucks is strongly recommended. On a phone, use the on-screen buttons, and on a PC, use the keyboard.
online-strike-assault: Step into this third-person shooter, where the Red and Blue teams face off across a large city map. Each side has six players, and winning depends on planning, quick reflexes, and teammates who work well together. The first team to reach 60 eliminations takes the match, and the pace stays fast from the opening moment to the final shot.

Move with WASD, sprint with Shift, jump with Space, and crouch with Q. Aim and fire with the mouse, reload with R, and throw a grenade with G. After you earn 2 kills, press E to use your skill. Chat with everyone using T, or message only your team with Y. Hold Tab to check the score, and press P to pause the game.
snake-train-zone: Snake Train Zone is a shooting battle game built around the classic Snake formula, so fans of that series should feel right at home. The goal is straightforward: step into the arena and gather the colored balls scattered around. Each time your counter bar fills up, a soldier joins your line and trails behind you. Blasting your way forward is only part of the fun, since breaking through obstacles and leveling up your squad add plenty of variety. Control is handled entirely with your mouse, clicking or tapping to move through the action.
hoop-kings: Hoop Kings is a relaxed puzzle title centered on basketball. Your goal is to rack up points by working through hoop-based brain teasers. The bright, colorful visuals and blend of planning and enjoyment make it a fine pick for a brief break or a longer stretch of play.
Controls are simple. On a keyboard, press the arrow keys to swipe the ball left, right, up, or down. On a touch screen, make the same four swipes with your finger to guide the basketball's movement.
bird-game-clicker: In this clicker game, the birds never give a straight answer. Ask them anything and you get shrugs, half-answers, and plenty of noncommittal lines. Tap the bird on screen to gather feathers, then spend them in the upgrade menu to speed up your progress. Each new bird you unlock adds to a set of very unsure creatures you can work toward completing.

Grain is the rarer currency, saved for special boosts and one-of-a-kind improvements. Expect many upgrades whose effects are surprising. Climb the leaderboards to see who is the most doubtful grain holder, or chat with other players who feel the same way. Accuracy isn't required here, since hesitation is the whole point.
gungame-paintball-wars: Paintball GunGame Wars is a pixel-style shooter built around paintball combat. You can join multiplayer matches or work through the campaign, and both put your skill to the test. Enemies include AI opponents and zombies that you need to destroy.

The game offers several modes. You can play team versus team, free for all, or gun game, and you can also play as a zombie and destroy every soldier. A survival wave mode lets you team up with friends to face waves of zombies and complete all the levels. Controls are simple: use WASD to move, the mouse to look around and fire, and Tab to open the menu. Press Space to jump.
obby-upgrade-your-jump: Obby Upgrade Your Jump is a clicker where you build your height one tap at a time. Each tap earns Jump Points, and the more points you collect, the farther your character can leap. Along the way, you can unlock pets that make your taps stronger, awarding either 2 or 3 points per tap depending on the pet. Tapping also raises your character's characteristics.

Moving around uses WASD or the arrow keys, and holding the right mouse button lets you turn the camera. Press Space to jump. On a phone, use the joystick to move and make small swipes on the screen to rotate the view. Keep leveling up and chasing your personal bests to see how high you can go.
hill-climber: Hill Climber is a casual driving game built on physics. Your aim is to cover as much ground as you can while avoiding crashes and keeping your fuel from running dry. The controls are pared down to just two actions, yet getting the timing of brake and throttle right is what decides how well you do, particularly when the terrain rises and falls.

On a computer, the arrow keys handle both jobs: one key pushes the car forward and another applies the brakes. On a phone or tablet, you tap the on-screen paddles to accelerate or brake. Both setups let you speed up and slow down as the road demands.
animal-transform-race: Animal Transform Race is a reaction-based arcade game where different kinds of animals compete against each other. Each animal has its own abilities, so it moves quickly on some stretches of the course and slows down badly on others. Your goal is to take the lead by making smart choices at the right moments. The faster you switch animals, the more advantages you gain. Coins earned from races can be spent in the market section to unlock new animals.
To change animals, use the mouse or touch controls. In two-player mode, the A, S, D and J, K, L keys work as shortcuts for switching animals.
square-bird: Square Bird is a new adventure game starring a bird with a square body. Your job is to smash through a variety of obstacles and traps until you make it to the goal. Along the way, pick up coins, which you can spend on new skins for your bird. A few stages are tough, so expect to retry them, but persistence pays off.
Controls are simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to play.
snake-color-race: Guide a colorful snake through a lively arena using your mouse. Only balls matching your snake's color are worth collecting, because each one helps it grow longer. As the snake gets bigger, the challenges grow along with it.

When you reach the bridge, you shoot the balls you have gathered to smash through blocks, which takes planning and careful aim as well as size. You also compete against other players in real time, and winning depends on outthinking and outmaneuvering your rivals. Simple to pick up yet difficult to master, the game offers an engaging experience.
lift-defender-zombie-carnage: In this browser game, you take on the job of an elevator guard in a world where the living are fighting to survive a zombie outbreak. After the apocalypse, people have gathered in massive skyscraper shelters, and the only way between floors is by elevator. Your task is to stop the monsters from slipping through and reaching the last safe havens.
Clear each floor of the undead, rescue the survivors you find, and collect cash along the way
mister-bullet-arcade-shooter: You play as Mr. Bullet, a special agent who gets sent on some of the most dangerous missions around. He is the only one who handles every kind of weapon with real skill, and the only one who can slip into an enemy base without being spotted. This time the Balloon Villains are the threat. They have brought gear, soldiers, weapons, and even boss monsters.

Choose from a huge arsenal that includes pistols, shotguns, machine guns, grenade launchers, and much more. Move across wide areas and stay hidden in the shadows, or go in loud with a grenade launcher, since each level can be finished in different ways. The game offers many levels and many types of enemies. To win, eliminate every opponent on the level. On PC, move the mouse to control the camera. On mobile, use your finger to do the same. Shooting fires automatically once your sight is aimed at an enemy.
screw-jam-puzzle: Screw Jam Puzzle is a colorful logic game about unscrewing wooden boards and sorting the screws, pins, and nuts that hold them. Each board has to be unscrewed and dropped one by one, which clears your path through the level. Your job is to match screws by color and fill every screw box with the matching shade. Fill them all to win.

There is no clock, so you can take as long as you like over each move. The game offers unlimited levels, with hundreds of puzzles designed to test your logic and strategy. As you progress, you unlock new levels, sharpen your skills, and earn rewards along the way. When a puzzle gets tough, boosters can help you out of a tight spot. New mechanics arrive with updates, so there is always something new to discover.
neon-square-rush: Neon Square Rush is a fast running game set in a glowing, futuristic world. You guide a small neon square as it sprints across a landscape made of geometric shapes that seems to stretch on forever. Obstacles and other challenges appear along the way, so you need quick reactions to keep moving.

The look of the game is bright and colorful, with a sleek, minimalist design that keeps the focus on the action. Dynamic lighting effects shift around you as you run, drawing you deeper into the scene. Controls are simple: click the mouse to jump.
gun-craft-and-fight: Gun Craft and Fight puts you in first person, where you battle hostile enemies, gather materials, and build new firearms to finish combat missions. You can look around, move through each map, and aim your shots at the right moment. Foes may strike from several directions, so staying alert matters. Quick reactions and smart tactics count, and choosing the weapon that suits each encounter helps you clear stages faster.

Between fights, craft or improve your gear, unlock fresh options, and assemble a stronger arsenal. Explore different locations, defeat opponents, and grow tougher with every battle. As you advance, enemies become more dangerous, so better weapons are needed. Your goal is to survive, eliminate every enemy, and complete the mission. Mixing classic shooter action with crafting and upgrades, it suits
christmas-sledge-rider-3d: Christmas Sledge Rider 3D puts you on a sled for a wintry run that suits players of every age. Hop aboard and race down snowy slopes decorated with holiday cheer. Detailed visuals bring the frozen scenery to life as you glide over icy hills. Your job is to dodge obstacles while the game keeps going with no set end point.

Controls are simple. On a computer, press the A and D keys or the left and right arrow keys to steer. On a phone or tablet, press and hold your finger on the screen, then slide it left or right to change direction.
intercity-bus-driver-3d: Intercity Bus Driver 3D puts you behind the wheel of a coach on long freeways. Your job is to complete traffic-filled bus missions, and speed matters because waiting passengers are counting on you. Head quickly to each pick-up spot, collect your riders, and carry them to the bus station of a different city.

Driving uses the WASD keys or the arrow keys, while the mouse handles interactions. Beyond the missions, you can enjoy a free world ride. The game sits in the racing category and is tagged with bus and driving.
round-rush-jam: Round Rush Jam is a bright, relaxed puzzle game where each piece can only slide in the direction its arrows point. You need to work out the best sequence for sending pieces away, opening routes as you go, and clearing every hexagon-shaped board before your moves run out. Each stage adds something new to consider, including obstacles, linked pieces, rotating paths, and useful boosters.

To play, click or tap a colored piece and it will travel along the white arrows on it. A piece only leaves the board once its route is clear, so remove the pieces blocking it first. When a puzzle gets tricky, a booster can help you out. Clear every colored piece before the move counter reaches zero to win the level. Desktop players use the left mouse button, while phones and tablets use taps. No keyboard controls are needed.
magic-block-sort: Magic Block Sort is a playful, sticky puzzle that can hold your attention for hours. If you enjoy classic sorting games but would like a new, enchanted spin with 3D blocks, this one is made for you. Your task is straightforward yet tricky: gather every magic block that shares a color and symbol and place each group into its own tube. Planning ahead matters most. Later stages bring more blocks, hidden mystery symbols, and additional tubes that will put your wits to the test.

To play, tap a tube to lift its top block, then tap another tube to set it down there. A block can only rest on another block of the same color and symbol, or in a tube that is completely empty. Keep going until every tube holds just one kind of block. When you get stuck, the Undo button reverts your last move, and Restart gives you a clean slate to try a different approach. There is no clock running, so take your time and enjoy the calm rhythm of sorting.
fun-draw-race-3d: Fun Draw Race 3D lets you sketch the legs your robot will run on. Your aim is to win every race. Each track has its own set of obstacles, so you'll need to draw a different shape for each challenge you meet along the way.

Controls are simple: slide across the screen to draw. Your legs aren't fixed once the race starts, because you can change and improve them at any moment while your robot is running. It's a 3D arcade game with a hypercasual feel, designed for kids and mobile players.
nuts-and-bolts-game-wood-puzzle: Nuts & Bolts Game: Wood Puzzle is a free online brain teaser that rewards careful planning. Your goal is to unscrew pieces in a smart order to solve each puzzle. It runs right in your browser and suits anyone who enjoys strategy and logical thinking, offering hours of absorbing fun.

Tapping a nut or bolt removes it, and the wooden plates pinned to the board then fall in ways that depend on one another. Following those connections closely pushes you to think critically. Each puzzle arranges its wood, nuts, and bolts in its own way, so every move needs thought and precision. Plan your approach before you act, and you can unscrew everything skillfully and claim victory.
melodys-adventure: Join Melody on a journey through 32 levels, each filled with bright, lively scenery and tricky obstacles. Her well-known headphones keep the adventure in step as you travel onward. Gather power-ups along the way and find clever ways to outwit the enemies you meet.

This platform adventure combines jumping and flying with item collecting and enemy encounters, so every stage calls for quick thinking. Move Melody with the WASD keys or the arrow keys, and guide her through each stage.
scary-house-clown-evil: Scary House Clown Evil is a 3D thriller horror game inspired by horror films about notorious serial killers and their eerie mansions. You wake up trapped inside a gloomy house soaked in blood and heavy dread. Deadly silence hangs over every room, and a clown murderer roams the halls, searching for his next victim.

Your goal is to sneak through the mansion with stealth, explore its rooms, and find every key needed to open each door and escape. Stay alert, because the creepy clown is always suspicious of intruders. Nobody has escaped this dark pursuer before. Move with W, S, Q and D, sprint with Left Shift, use the virtual joystick on mobile, and touch the screen to look around.
special-strike-zombies: You step into the boots of a special forces soldier facing waves of undead and hired guns. A large arsenal is at your disposal, and each new wave calls for a different weapon, so choosing well is the key to surviving and clearing every level. This is a single-player 3D action shooter.
Move with WASD and fire with the left mouse button. Scroll the mouse wheel to switch weapons, press R to reload, Space to jump, and C to crouch. Press P to pause the game.
survival-for-100-dollars: You begin with a fortune of 100 dollars, which, sadly, is everything you own. This survival simulator drops you into a harsh reality where every purchase matters. Plan your budget carefully and decide whether Doshirak is a treat or simply a daily staple. Hunt for jobs in the urban-type settlement, from unloading train cars to running shady errands, and keep an eye on your hunger, health, and mood, since happiness gets tough when your pockets are empty.

Your empire kicks off with a single hundred-ruble note. Show everyone that you have a knack for economics and can last where others fall apart. Controls are simple: left-click the abilities you want to use, and make sure your character's health never drops to zero.
escaping-blockov: This blocky, top-down extraction shooter has you choose a loadout before dropping into a raid. Hunt scavs and raiders for whatever they carry, then reach an extract before everything goes sideways. Fall in the field and you forfeit the gear you brought, but get out alive and all your finds are yours. Each level hides a hatch leading deeper, where enemies grow tougher and the loot grows richer.

Between runs, sell your haul, tackle quests, upgrade your bunker, and rank up your favorite weapons. On desktop, WASD moves, the mouse aims, and clicking fires. E interacts, R reloads, H heals, and G throws a grenade. On mobile, the left stick moves, and tapping the fire button auto-aims, while dragging it lets you aim and keep firing.
color-fall: Color Fall is a free puzzle game about lining up colors with care. You slide pins in different directions to open a path for each liquid so it reaches the truck that matches its shade. As the difficulty rises, each level asks for more careful planning, and the black liquid is the element you have to watch closely.

Black liquid must never flow into a colored one, because the mixture evaporates. The game offers 30 levels, and the goal is to clear every one of them. It works on Android devices as well as desktop computers, so you can play on whichever screen is closest to hand.
newbie-s-escape-from-blogger-prison: Newbie's Escape from Blogger Prison is a platforming adventure where you jump, climb, and dodge your way toward a breakout. You explore the prison and work through a series of tough levels while avoiding traps and slipping past guards who are determined to stop you. Keep an eye out for patrolling guards, laser grids, security cameras, and other hazards. Hidden routes and surprise challenges turn up along the way, and you will meet famous blogger inmates during your run.

Controls are straightforward on a computer. Use W, A, S, and D or the arrow keys to move, press the spacebar to jump, and move the mouse to control the camera. On mobile, a joystick on the left handles movement, a button on the right makes you jump, and swiping the right side of the screen adjusts the camera.
aqua-fish-dental-care: Sea creatures need a dentist too, and you are the expert they can count on. In Aqua Fish Dental Care, you explore a bright underwater world and look after many kinds of aquatic animals with careful, gentle treatment. Each level brings a different set of species, so you must use every piece of equipment available to finish the job for each one.

Playing is simple: a left mouse button click or a tap is all it takes. This hypercasual, casual title lets you enjoy treating cute sea friends from start to finish. Every new patient gives you another chance to explore the ocean while you work.
math-playground: Math Playground is an online learning game that gives young players a way to build their number skills. Kids can sharpen their arithmetic while enjoying themselves, since the experience is designed to feel like play. Lessons cover the basics of addition and subtraction, along with multiplication, division, and geometry.

A wide assortment of challenges and activities keeps things fresh from one session to the next. The whole thing costs nothing to enjoy, so anyone can jump in whenever they like. To start, just tap to play.
weapons-merge-hero: Weapons Merge Hero is a 2D merge action title where precision and strategy both matter. Your hero has only knives to fight with, so every throw counts. Drag two weapons of the same level onto each other to forge a stronger knife, then hurl it at round, planet-shaped enemies. Keep striking the same target until it bursts. Each hit moves you closer to victory, but good timing and smart upgrades decide how far you get.

Combining identical weapons makes your knives hit harder, fly faster, and carry more power. Enemies grow tougher as you advance, so only the strongest merged weapons will hold up. The controls are simple, the explosions are satisfying, and the action keeps going, which makes the game easy to pick up and hard to put down.
leaf-blower-autumn-yard: Autumn has arrived, and yards everywhere are buried under bright, colorful leaves. Steer your leaf blower by dragging anywhere on screen, or use WASD or the arrow keys. Leaves near you get sucked into your bag, and once it fills up, walk to the compost crate to empty it and collect coins.

Spend those coins on bigger suction, a larger bag, faster movement, or small robot helpers that clean on their own, until the whole yard is spotless. Dig through the leaf piles to find hidden treasures. At night, spooky Halloween yards need tidying too, and you can collect funny hats like a pumpkin head, a witch hat, and a crown. The whole experience feels calm, satisfying, and never-ending.
off-road-overdrive: Off Road Overdrive is a side-scrolling racer where the main task is keeping your car balanced. The vehicles have a 2D cartoon look, and the action plays out across a 2D platform that will put your driving and balance skills to the test. Challenge mode is the place to start. It takes you through several terrains, including snow, beach, field, desert, and dark night, and you can tackle each one again and again if you want to earn a perfect record.

The controls follow the style of a traditional car racing game. You operate the vehicle with just two buttons, using them to keep it steady on the platform. It is a one-player game, so every run depends on your own handling of the car.
family-squid-challenge: Grab a friend and tackle this squid-themed journey together. Enemies in black and red masks roam every corner, so keep your wits about you and stay alert. Run from them while gathering the keys needed to finish the level. Remember that you both have to make it through, so look out for each other as you go.
Controls are simple: use WASD or the arrow keys to get around, and leap onto foes to defeat them. Your targets are the blue key and the red key, which you must collect to clear the level.
ben-10-alien: Ben 10 Alien is a jump-and-run platformer built around Ben, the young hero who wears the Omnitrix. Ben can transform into alien forms such as Heatblast, Humungousaur, Ghostfreak, Four Arms, Swampfire, Big Chill, Diamondhead, Shocksquatch, and XLR8, and the Omniverse form is also part of the game. Your job is to keep Ben moving through each stage and complete the platformer levels.

Along the way you climb large bridges, dodge falling bricks, and swim through dangerous seas. Enemies include fire fly ninjas, bats, skeletons, toys, sharks, and many other monsters, and you will also meet characters like Vilgax, Dr. Animo, Cannonbolt, Rook Blonko, Kevin Levin, and Wildmutt. You can search for hidden blocks and levels, collect coins, and explore many challenging lands. The aim is to defeat all the enemies you face.
adventure-home: Adventure Home is a casual 2D platform game built around running, jumping, and collecting treasure. It suits fans of adventure, action, RPG, platform, and quest games, as well as anyone who simply wants to have a good time.

The artwork is detailed and polished, yet the game stays small in size without losing that look, which is easy on your device. The controls are very simple, so you can start playing almost right away. On Android, on-screen touch buttons move the player. On PC, the Left and Right arrow keys move your character, and the Up arrow key makes it jump. Interes
racing-island: Racing Island is a 3D driving game built around exploration and competition. You set off on an adventurous trip in a range of distinctive vehicles, including monster trucks, and put your skills to the test in race, freeride, and stand modes. Each level brings new vehicles and fresh things to discover, so there is always something new to find on the road.

Controls are simple. Use WASD or the arrow keys to move, with W or the up arrow to increase speed and S or the down arrow to brake. A and D, or the left and right arrows, control the car's steering. Press Shift to unleash your nitro boost. See whether you have what it takes to lead the way.
alien-wreckage: A solitary explorer drifts through deep space in search of the oldest artifacts in the universe. No danger will turn him back, not even the many kinds of alien menace he meets along the way. He explores abandoned alien wrecks hunting for precious treasures, and he feels no sympathy for the creatures living among them. His only ambition is to become the most famous explorer in the universe.

Alien Wreckage is a fast-paced 2D multidirectional shooter with a retro pixel-art style. Exploration, combat, and risk-taking go hand in hand throughout. The controls are available in-game, so you can check them once you start.
sweet-solve: Sweet Solve challenges you to get strawberries into a bucket by working out a route through every level. Its physics-based puzzles ask you to smash blocks and clear a path so the fruit can reach the bucket with ease. Plan each move carefully, since letting a strawberry drop or destroying one ends the round. Don't overlook the stars hidden along the way.

Fans of puzzles and physics-based games, or anyone simply looking for a good time, should find plenty to enjoy here. The game offers high quality graphics, a small file size, and super simple controls, along with interesting quests. On Android, you play by touching or tapping the screen, and on PC, you use a left mouse click.
2048-checkers: This game blends the familiar 2048 puzzle with the strategy of checkers. Each piece carries a number, and you move these numbered pieces across the board. A checker can only capture another piece that shows the same value. When a capture succeeds, the capturing piece's number doubles, and your aim is to build one checker up to 2048.

Every successful move earns coins. You can spend those coins to double a checker's number, remove a piece from the board, or shuffle all the pieces around. Reaching 2048 wins the game and puts you at the top of the player leaderboard.
dig-and-flow-save-water: In this puzzle game, you dig through sand and steer flowing materials through winding labyrinths. Your goal is to gather every star in each stage. Element physics shapes how everything moves, so you must plan your route and control the streams with care. Along the way, you can activate mechanisms and open new paths.

The controls are simple enough to grasp within seconds. Hold the left mouse button and drag to dig, or swipe across the screen on touch devices to create paths for the elements. Each level asks for more logic and precision than the last. Water, lava, and hot steam all appear, and each behaves differently, opening its own ways to solve the puzzles.
mega-ramp-car: Mega Ramp Car puts you behind the wheel of fast, powerful machines that race over enormous ramps. Each run is filled with high-flying leaps, massive jumps, and bold stunts, and you can perform tricks while soaring through the air. The game offers a range of levels that keep testing how far your driving skills can go.

Realistic physics and sound effects give every jump a convincing feel. You can pick from a wide selection of vehicles, and plenty of missions keep each attempt fun and challenging. Complete events and unlock new cars to take on bigger, more intense races. Earn rewards along the way and use them to buy new vehicles for even greater challenges. Keep your speed under control, land your jumps, and aim to finish each level as successfully as you can.
from-zombie-to-glam-a-spooky: Ellie is the heroine of this Halloween game, which follows her as she leaves her zombie look behind and moves toward a regular, everyday life. Your job is to guide her through the makeover one stage at a time. You clean her hands, apply makeup, decorate her nails, and finish with dress-up. Each change happens through simple clicks and interactions, so you control every step.

Watch her shift from creepy to glamorous as you complete each level. The result blends spooky and chic touches that fit the season. It suits fans of dress-up and makeover games who want a Halloween twist.
funny-hair-salon: George has a serious hair crisis on his hands. His scalp is crawling with mites and covered in pimples, and a quick fix won't do. The only real solution is a trip to the salon, where you cure his scalp and plant new hair so he can finally reveal his true beauty.

Playing works on any device. On a desktop, click items, tools, and buttons to interact with the game. On a phone or tablet, tap the screen to select and apply your choices. The game is responsive, so it adapts to whichever device you use.
mother-simulator-husband-wife-games: Mother Simulator Husband Wife Games lets you take on the role of a mom in a 3D family life simulator. You look after your digital household, keep up with chores, finish everyday jobs, and get behind the wheel to cruise the city. Shopping trips and fun activities with the family are also part of the day.

On a computer, move with W, A, S and D, and steer your view with the mouse. Hold Left Shift to sprint, press F to act, and use P to pause. Press I to see the controls, N to skip a level, and Ctrl to open settings. On a phone or tablet, use the joystick to move your character.
bus-out-bus-away-traffic-jam: Bus Out is a traffic jam puzzle where buses, cars, vans, and trucks are packed onto the road together. Your job is to slide each vehicle in the right direction so the bus can get through. You need to clear every car and remove any obstacles in the way. Some levels are set in layouts inspired by cities around the world, and each one brings a new problem to solve. Since a single bad move can lock the whole road, you should plan ahead and think through your options.

The game also has a challenge mode where you can race friends to see who clears the hardest jam first. Its smooth animations and calm pace make it a relaxing puzzle to play. Beat a level to unlock tougher jams, and keep going until you have mastered every bus escape. Puzzle fans who enjoy sorting and logic games should find plenty to work with here.
dino-egg-shooter: Dino Egg Shooter is a puzzle game set in a bright prehistoric world filled with colorful dinosaur eggs. It includes 100 levels, and the difficulty climbs as you progress. Your task is to aim and fire colored eggs until the board is cleared. Some stages present tricky egg arrangements, while others give you only a limited number of shots.

Controls are simple: aim left or right, then shoot. The cheerful visuals and easy gameplay make it suitable for players of all ages. It is labeled as a bubble shooter, so fans of that style will feel at home. The whole experience is framed as a playful trip through time.
nut-and-bolt: Nut and Bolt is a puzzle game where your job is to sort bolts by color and fit each group onto the matching nut. The idea is simple to grasp, yet every stage asks for more thought and planning than the one before. As you move forward, new bolt colors appear, so the puzzles grow harder and demand sharper focus.

Every bolt carries a color code, so you slot each one into the nuts and arrange them with care. The level is finished as soon as all bolts sharing a color sit correctly together. The game is filed under Puzzles, Number, and .io Games.
offroad-muddy-trucks: Offroad Muddy Trucks puts you behind the wheel of oversized trucks with massive tires and wide bodies. You can work through a career mode alone or with a friend, in either one-player or two-player form. A sprawling free map gives you room to roam together, and the surprises and varied terrain keep things interesting. The muddy ground sets the tone for this monster truck simulator.

Player one drives with W, A, S, and D, uses L-Shift for NOS, and restarts with R. Stand near a vehicle and press F to switch cars. Player two steers with the arrow keys, uses R-Shift for NOS, restarts with M, and presses N to switch cars when nearby. Your task is to explore the different grounds scattered across the map and try each one.
easter-funny-makeup: Eliza and her niece are getting ready for the Easter holiday in an unusual way, by designing decorations for their faces. The artwork uses seasonal motifs such as decorated eggs, rabbits, blossoms, butterflies, and rainbows to create a vivid, cheerful spring appearance.

Your job is to pick whichever decorations you like best and place them on the character's face. You can combine different motifs to come up with your own one-of-a-kind look. Once your design is finished, you can export it as a PNG file to keep.
roll-sky-ball-3d: Roll Sky Ball 3D is a quick arcade game where you guide a ball along routes that keep changing and catching you off guard. Obstacles pop up along the way, so you'll need to stay alert to make it to the finish. Your job is to see whether you can reach the goal every single time.
Controls are simple: swipe across the screen to push the ball in the direction you want it to go. Keep your eyes on the path ahead and you should have a great time testing your reflexes.
stickman-night-survive: Halloween has arrived, bringing the gloomiest day of the year with it. This time the brave white stickman returns, a hero skilled at beating back monsters. Stickman Night Survive is a free online game you can enjoy on your preferred mobile device. When Halloween night comes, monsters crawl out of their underground hideouts and leave every living creature terrified.
Your job is to time your shots carefully so the stickman hits monsters located on different mobile platforms. Use the mouse to aim and shoot. On touch screens, touch and drag to aim and shoot.
taxi-driver-simulator: Taxi Driver Simulator puts you in the driver's seat of a cab and lets you feel the city from behind the wheel. In Work Mode, you need to clear 80 levels and collect 3 yellow stars to earn your place as a licensed taxi driver. Follow the blue arrows to find passengers, carry them to where they want to go, and do it quickly. Ease off the gas before you turn to save time. As your earnings grow, you can buy any of the other 9 cars waiting in the garage.

Free Mode is a looser option: go further across the map, stop at gas stations to pay for fuel, and keep taking riders without moving on to new levels. To play on PC, use the arrow keys to steer and tap the on-screen buttons for other actions. On mobile, everything is handled by tapping the buttons on screen. Remember to stop for red lights.
bffs-golden-hour: BFFs Golden Hour is a single-player dress-up game built around Fall Aesthetics, a fashion-focused adventure. You join a stylish group of friends as they tour the world, putting together looks inspired by the busy streets of New York, the warm, sun-soaked evenings of Tuscany, lively festivals, the time-honored beauty of Japan, and the charm of Scotland.

Dressing up never runs out of possibilities, and the playful humor keeps the mood light. The game can hold your attention for hours as you experiment with different styles. Controls are simple: use your mouse on a desktop, or tap the screen on a mobile device.
the-warlock-s-prisoner: You wake up locked in a cell deep within a warlock's secret lair, surrounded by darkness, traps, and a horde of zombies. To get out, you must explore dangerous corridors, hunt for items, collect clues, solve puzzles, and fight to stay alive. Your fate is open: you can escape, or remain a captive of the shadows forever.

This dark adventure blends horror, survival, and puzzles, with a mysterious looking glass and a tense, story-driven atmosphere. On mobile, swipe the right side of the screen to rotate, drag the joystick on the left to move, and tap the central icon to interact, with menus operated by tapping buttons. On desktop, move the mouse to turn, use WASD to walk, press E or left-click to interact, press H for a hint, and TAB for your inventory.
ink-streak: Ink Streak is an arcade game that rewards quick thinking and sharp reflexes. You guide a group of characters as they dash forward, each one painting a bright trail behind it. Your job is to pick the right moments to act so no runner crashes into another. As the game goes on, the pace picks up and more characters join the chase, so the challenge keeps growing.

Success depends on feeling the rhythm of the action and staying calm under pressure. Every choice matters, since one slip can send a runner into a collision. Everything is controlled with the mouse, so stay focused and guide the whole colorful crew safely through this lively reflex test.
icing-on-doll-cake-creative-bakery: Take a calm break with this bakery-themed title, where you design lovely gowns full of flair and fashion. Your creation spins in front of you, and your only job is to coat its outside in a range of shades. The controls are as simple as it gets: tap or click.

Use this 2D decorating game to show off your sense of style and test your dress styling skills. There is no pressure here, so you can enjoy every step at your own pace and let your inner designer lead the way.
find-visitors-99-nights: Find Visitors - 99 Nights puts you in charge of a forest refuge, where your job is to decide who gets in. Woodland creatures are welcome to stay, while the visitors must be sent away. The atmosphere is eerie, and you need to study each arrival closely for clues that reveal a hidden monster in disguise.

Everything can be controlled with a mouse or a finger. Check the Rules button often, since it helps you get more out of the experience. In short, welcome the forest dwellers and turn the visitors away. Watch for perfectly white teeth, blood on the teeth, a red-white eye, a pupil that darts around quickly, a red spot on the aura photo, or a body that does not move at all.
the-depth-of-the-limbo: You guide a girl in limbo, who must complete every level before she can wake up. The view is from above, and the game offers 13 levels. Each one is a one-minute test, but the camera keeps rotating around the heroine, changing the orientation of the space. Left can suddenly feel like right, and up like down, so simple routes become puzzles.

Paths that look familiar keep turning around as the view shifts, forcing you to rethink each goal. Your aim is to reach the end of every route, overcome the inner noise of fear, and wake up refreshed and free. On a computer, use the D, A, W and S keys or the arrow keys to move right, left, up or down. On a phone or tablet, press the matching arrow buttons on screen.
clownfish-pin-out: Clownfish Pin Out is a charming puzzle game where your goal is to guide a small fish out of a risky spot. Your job is to tap the pins so that water pours down toward the fish while keeping it clear of the lava. Each move matters, so take a moment to plan before you act, because one wrong choice ends the attempt. The game is played with taps alone, making it easy to pick up and start solving right away.

It suits anyone who enjoys thoughtful logic and strategy, and it is especially fun for kids who like cute characters and brain teasers. Each pin you pull changes the path of the water, so careful thinking is the key to saving the little fish.
brain-tricks-brain-games: Brain Tricks is a puzzle game built around riddles and brain teasers that put your thinking to work. Each stage brings its own twist, and sometimes the obvious answer is not the right one, so look closely at every scene. Hidden clues are scattered throughout, and your logic, memory, and creativity will all be tested. Solutions can be surprising, since things are not always what they seem.
pirate-cannon-a-mega-battle: Pirate Cannon A Mega Battle is a bubble shooter puzzle set on the high seas. A large cannon sits at the bottom of the screen, and you load it with numbered cannonballs. Your shots must hit matching numbers on hexagonal enemy pirate boats bobbing above the water, so that clusters of identical ships break apart and sink.

Aiming is simple. Drag to angle the cannon, then let go to fire. Mouse controls work on a computer, and touch controls work on a phone or tablet. To win a level, sink every ship before your cannonballs run out. Each stage presents a tough sea fight that rewards careful aim and planning.
hard-flap: In this puzzle game, a bouncing ball rolls along the ground while you steer its path. Obstacles lie scattered across the route, and your task is to hop from one to the next without ever brushing against them. Watch out, because the barriers do not all travel at the same pace, which makes the challenge trickier than it first appears. You are also limited to six consecutive jumps, so every bounce needs careful timing.

Controls are simple: use your mouse or tap the screen to make the ball jump. It also works on mobile devices, so you can play on a touchscreen. It is a skill-based game that tests your timing from start to finish.
fidget-trading-card-toy: Fidget Trading Card Toy brings the thrill of collecting toy cards into a fidget trading game. You flip cards against opponents, and a slap feature can spark a fierce trading duel. Battles and cards form the core of the game, which is built around hands-on fun. It is a hypercasual title, so it is easy to pick up.
Your aim is to gather as many rare cards as possible, grow your collection, and gain more advantages in trading. Controls are simple: click with your mouse or tap the screen to play.
idle-warrior-tales: IDLE Warrior Tales is a clicker RPG where your heroes fight on their own while you relax. Level up your party over time, choose from a wide range of skills, and face wild monsters through an endless adventure filled with boss battles, gold, rewards, and new gear. The game runs fully offline, so no internet connection is needed, which suits fans of AFK play.

Your heroes pick their own spells in the moment, whether that means healing an ally or cursing a monster. You don't have to watch every battle to keep moving forward. After each level-up, you decide which skill to improve, and the best choice depends on the enemies ahead. Visit the forge to upgrade equipment and push toward the end-game for a special reward. Everything is controlled with on-screen buttons, so no keyboard is needed. Hire new heroes, upgrade their gear, and defeat the monsters.
block-blast-mania: Your goal in this puzzle game is to fit multicolored pieces of many different shapes onto the board so that lines fill up completely. Any row or column with no empty squares clears away, opening space for fresh pieces. Clearing several lines in a single move brings a bigger point reward.

Two play styles are available. Classic mode carries on until none of the three offered shapes can fit anywhere on the grid. Level mode asks you to meet targets, such as gathering pigs, before moving forward. Boosters are there to assist you as you work through the levels. To play, grab a piece from the bottom area and drag it onto the grid. Pieces cannot be turned, but you may position them wherever and in whatever order you like.
geometry-vibes-3d: Geometry Vibes 3D brings the feel of the original Geometry Vibes into a bright, lively three-dimensional world. Its levels have been completely redesigned, and the visuals are new as well. The game puts your reflexes and sense of rhythm to the test as you move through each stage.

Controls are easy to pick up. On a computer, click the left mouse button or press W or the spacebar to jump, and a click or tap also starts the game. In two-player mode, Player 2 uses the Up Arrow key. On phones and tablets, tap anywhere on the screen to jump, since touch controls are fully supported.
off-road-hill-climbing-race: Off-Road Hill Climbing Race is less about simply driving a car and more about changing shape in a fast arcade racer. You take on AI rivals while switching between several military units. Each terrain favors one particular form, so only the right one lets you pull ahead there. The shop holds 15 characters and a wide selection of vehicles: 6 bikes, 6 Jeeps, 6 jets, 6 helicopters, 6 trucks, and 6 hang gliders, all waiting to be unlocked. The vehicles offer no extra boosts, but the aim is to finish first on every level.
Controls are handled with taps. Press the transform buttons to switch forms during a race and match your vehicle to the ground ahead.
demolition-car-rope-and-hook: Demolition Car - Rope and Hook invites you to unwind while tearing down buildings with a rope and grappling hook. If you enjoy laid-back smash games built around rope play and lifelike wreckage, this one is made for you. The controls are easy to pick up, and the way objects break apart looks convincing. You can play on a phone or a computer, wherever you happen to be.

Your job is to bring down abandoned structures. Wrap the hook around a building as neatly as you can, then floor the gas to pull it apart. Spend your earnings in the garage to upgrade your car or purchase a new one, and upgrade your winch too. Judge your pulls carefully so you can flatten a whole building and rack up more points. A leaderboard tracks the top scores, so you can see how you stack up against other players.
cartoon-cat-naughty-kitten: Step into Cartoon Cat: Mischievous Kitten, an action-stealth game where you control a nimble kitten who collects tasty sausages while escaping many dangers. Roaring robot vacuum cleaners are noisy, so keep away from them and hide in quiet corners. Inside people's apartments you can cause mischief by throwing objects and distracting residents, but you must avoid getting caught. Use furniture, boxes, and shadows to hide from your enemies.

Chases and traps add more pressure. Escape vicious dogs, dash through the streets, and watch out for cars. Your goal is to collect as many sausages as possible, weaving between enemies and traps while keeping all your lives safe. Every level ends with an exit you must find. On a phone, a joystick moves the cat and a button lets it strike. On a computer, use W, A, S, and D or the arrow keys to move, and click the left or right mouse button to kick.
hill-climb-2022: Hill Climb 2022 is a physics-based driving game where you race up steep slopes in a 2D world. It can be played offline, so no internet connection is needed. You follow Newton Bill, a young hopeful who competes in uphill races and sets off for unexplored places where no vehicle has gone before. He sees every setting, from Asgard to a Nuclear Plant, as a possible track, and he keeps going until he conquers the tallest hills on the moon.

This entry is a sequel to the original Hill Climb Racing and offers hundreds of courses, cars, and options for customizing your character. The view is from the first-person perspective. Press A and D to move left and right.
mr-noob-jailbreak: In Mr noob Jailbreak, a brave little noob sets out to break free from prison by sprinting across rooftops. Guards and enemies wait ahead, and slow reactions will get you caught. Your goal is to travel as far as you can and earn the highest score possible, using jumps, slides and gunfire to deal with the threats in your path. This casual title blends adventure, action and shooting, and its world is built in a Minecraft style.

Controls are easy to pick up. Right-click to shoot, press W to jump and S to slide, and hold the spacebar to activate slow motion, which helps you aim more accurately. The game runs on PC, tablets and phones, and mobile and tablet players can
percys-froggy-frenzy: Percy is a brave frog caught in a nonstop adventure. He fires bubbles on his own, and each shot bounces across the screen to pop the bubbles that fall from above. Use A and D, or the arrow keys, to slide him left or right and line up his attacks.

Between bubble battles, Percy leaps across shifting platforming stages. Collecting coins along the way upgrades his shooting speed, shot power, and health. Be careful, though: if Percy takes hits, you may need to restart the level. The game offers endless progression and a range of challenges, so it suits anyone who enjoys fast, action-packed platformers.
hungry-crab: In this puzzle game, your goal is to steer a piece of candy into a hungry crab's mouth. Slice through ropes to set things in motion, and gather the stars you pass along the way. A quick swipe of your finger across the screen cuts a rope and sends the candy drifting toward the crab. Be careful, though, because the candy can float away if you are not paying attention.

The graphics are high quality, and the game stays small in size without losing visual detail, which is easy on your device. The controls are super simple, so getting started takes no time at all. Interesting quests keep things from getting dull. On Android, use on-screen touch to cut the rope. On PC, use a left mouse click to cut the rope.
mortal-brothers-survival-friends: This newly released title draws on the Mortal Kombat storyline and follows two rivals who must set their differences aside. Banished to dungeons by Shang Tsung, Scorpion and Subzero have to cooperate to find their way out. Each level is a set of puzzles the pair must solve together, and the game is free to play on whichever device you prefer.

Collect the flames that match each fighter to finish a level, but be careful: stepping onto fire meant for the other character ends your attempt immediately. Don't worry too much, since you can restart a level as many times as you like. Your goal is to solve the puzzles and guide both characters into their portals while they're still alive. Use WASD or the arrow keys to move, the space bar to switch characters, and the E key to move platforms. On phones and tablets, tap the on-screen buttons instead.
hobo-speedster: Hobo Speedster is a 2D platform game that mixes motorcycle and BMX-style riding, drawn in a cartoon look. Your goal is simple: keep your bike steady and make it all the way to the finish line. Along the way you collect coins and diamonds, which you can spend on upgrades for your current ride at the motorcycle settlement.

Beyond that, the Shop lets you buy three additional motorcycles, and the Decorate section unlocks four more riders to choose from. Travel through several different maps and work through seven tasks to earn bonus rewards. On a PC, press A or the Left arrow to move back and D or the Right arrow to move forward. On mobile, press and hold the accelerator buttons on the screen.
ragdoll-football-online: Kick a ball with limp, floppy ragdoll athletes in this soccer game, where any strike may send your player toppling. You can train solo, take on computer opponents one-on-one or in teams of two, or challenge a real person online. Aim each push, net goals, and rewatch key moments in replay mode. Collecting cards lets you restyle your player's uniform.

Pick a mode to begin. Press on the field, pull toward the direction you want to go, and let go to shove your character. Pulling farther creates a harder shove. On a keyboard, hold WASD or an arrow key, then release it to move. Your objective is to outscore the opposing side.
blocks-move-n-hit: Attention, puzzle fans! You play as a block with a mission, yet the route keeps changing beneath you. Your path winds through a labyrinth of immovable stone blocks, and every bump knocks you off course in a new direction. Sometimes you glide along a 45-degree slant, and other times you swing around in a sharp 90-degree corner. Learn how each bounce behaves, untangle the puzzle as its layout shifts, and steer your block toward the target.

This is a single-player game, so the whole challenge is yours alone. The goal is simple: move your block and hit the target. Keep an eye on every rebound, because one wrong bounce can send you off the path you planned.
happy-orange-glass: Happy Orange Glass is a puzzle game where you sketch a line to guide the juice safely into the glass. Each level asks you to plan your route carefully, steer clear of obstacles, and figure out the best way to finish. Success depends on both your creativity and your logic. You begin by tracing a path from the juice source to the glass, and you should think before each stroke, since the juice moves along whatever line you have drawn.
Everything in the game is handled with the mouse, so you only need that single device to draw your path and play through each challenge.
cosplay-gamer-girls: Two close friends are getting ready for a summer cosplay festival, and both love computer games. Your job is to dress them as favorite heroes and princesses from those games. A good cosplay covers the whole picture, so you will work on makeup, hair, and outfit together. Plenty of unusual and beautiful costume options are available to try.

Bright makeup is part of every look, along with clothes, shoes, accessories, and jewelry that suit the game's theme. The hairstyle or wig is a key choice, so take your time with it. When the look is finished, you can save it
funny-bone-surgery: Leah was skateboarding down the street when a moment of distraction sent her straight into a car. The crash left her with a broken arm and a badly hurt foot, so it's up to you to patch her up and set those broken bones. Each injury is yours to treat, using the tools and options laid out before you.

The game is responsive, so it adapts to whatever screen you're using, whether that's a desktop computer or a phone. With a mouse, you click items, tools, and buttons to get things done. On a touchscreen, you tap to select your options and apply them. Either way, you use the same kind of input to help Leah get back on her feet.
fish-and-trip: You guide a small, brave fish that dives into the deepest part of the sea to search for food and find others of its kind. Along the way, gather as many seedlings as you can, lead your new friends across the ocean, and steer clear of predators and dangerous objects lurking in the water. Each attempt lets you beat your previous score, and coins you collect can be spent to unlock new skins for your fish.

This casual, multi-level survival game is free and works on PC, tablets, and mobile devices. On a computer, move your fish with the mouse. On a tablet or phone, touch the screen and slide your finger to guide the character.
find-the-rule: Find the Rule is a stripped-back puzzle game that sharpens your logic and number sense. Study the sequence on screen, work out the mathematical rule behind it, and choose the number that replaces the question mark from four plausible options. With thousands of procedurally generated levels, new challenges never run out.

Level Mode moves through endless stages that grow harder over time, and you can use hints or skip tricky ones. Daily Challenge asks you to finish 10 puzzles, beat your average time, and see your speed percentile against players worldwide. Your streak is tracked, and global leaderboards let you see how quickly you solve compared with others. On phones and tablets, tap an answer button. On a PC, click an option or press keys 1 to 4, and use Esc to close menus.
zen-garden-match: Zen Garden Match is a match-3 puzzle game for anyone looking to step away from everyday pressure. Its quiet, soothing mood comes from lush flower scenery, butterflies drifting by, leaves drifting down, birdsong in the background, and dandelions floating through the air.

Play with your mouse by picking out cubes and sending them to the dock area. Line up three identical flowers to make them vanish. Your aim is to clear every cube from the board without letting the dock area fill up.
madness-driver-vertigo-city: Madness Driver Vertigo City drops you into a city where reckless motorists gather behind the wheels of high-end sport supercars. The streets are packed with races and plenty of other activities. Fly off ramps and grab gems scattered around the map. Amusement park attractions add extra fun to the mix. You can play alone or with a friend, challenging each other in races or cruising in free drive mode. You can also customize your rides and design your own unique looks.

Player 1 steers with W, A, S, D or the arrow keys, uses L-Shift for nitro, presses R to restart, and T to look back. Player 2 uses the arrow keys, R-Shift for nitro, O to restart, and P to look back. Single-player play runs through the 1P mode.
cosmic-dash: Cosmic Dash is an endless space runner where you fly across the solar system, collecting tokens and dodging or smashing obstacles. Jumping, shrinking, and speed boosts keep you moving, while mission objectives and planetary backdrops add a fresh twist to the classic runner format.

Shrinking lets you slip through space junk, and boosting lets you smash glowing asteroids. Small tokens raise your score, and big tokens pull in the smaller ones, chaining into massive rewards. On a keyboard, use the arrow keys to jump, shrink, and move, and press Space to boost. On touchscreens, swipe up to jump, down to shrink, and left or right to move, then tap to boost. The farther you travel, the tougher
run-from-67: Explore a pitch-black school from a first-person view in this hide-and-seek chase with a creature called Sixseven. Each floor hides six backpacks, and once you gather them all, the seventh door opens as your exit. Sixseven hunts purely by sound. Sprinting carries 20 metres, walking 10, and crouching 4, while standing perfectly still makes no noise at all. Jumping is quiet, but the landing can give you away.

Your flashlight helps and hurts. Without it you see nothing, yet aiming it at Sixseven sends him charging from across the floor. The battery lasts about a minute, so hold E at a wall panel to refill it. Press Q to throw a coin, which clinks and draws him away while you slip past. The minimap shows how far you can be heard, the light cone as a second danger zone, and the coin's own hearing radius. Seven floors each
ping-pong-battle-table-tennis: Ping Pong Battle - Table Tennis puts you across the table from rivals in a tough match of table tennis. Your goal is to rise up as a skilled player and beat every opponent you face. The game pairs lifelike paddle handling with match play that feels like a real contest. To play, just click the mouse or tap the screen.

This arcade sport title falls under the Sport and Tennis categories, so fans of ping pong and racket games will feel right at home. Each rally tests your timing and control as you work to win the point and the match.
mindblow: Mindblow is a word-guessing puzzle where each picture hides one word for you to uncover. Rather than relying on stock images, every level's picture was carefully made to stretch your thinking. The word surfaces through a concept shown creatively in the scene, so simply looking is not enough. You must grasp the clever idea behind it.

Levels range from easy to brain-busters, so players of every skill level have something to try. You earn coins for correct guesses and can spend them on hints when you get stuck. The game can be played on your phone or other device. New levels are added every month, so there is always something new to tackle
catch-the-bear: Catch the Bear is a puzzle game built around sliding blocks and adorable bears. You push blocks across the board to guide each bear into the hole that matches its color. Early stages are gentle, but new obstacles, paths, and surprises gradually appear, so every stage asks you to think a little harder and plan your moves.

The game is meant to feel calm while keeping your mind busy. You can take your time on each stage, or add a countdown for extra rewards. Avoid blockers, map out routes, and work through the puzzles at whatever pace suits you. It fits fans of matching, logic, and block puzzles, and it is simple to pick up yet takes real skill to fully master.
sky-track-racing: Sky Track Racing mixes car driving with stunt simulation, all set across 3D sky platform stages. You steer a Jeep toward the final area of each level, and every stage presents its own route to tackle. Working through the full set of levels is a satisfying way to keep yourself entertained.
