Across eight challenging levels, each with its own hurdles, you guide a frog past obstacles, battle foes, and gather coins on the way to the finish. Dynamic gameplay and colorful graphics keep every run engaging. Both newcomers and seasoned players can enjoy it, since several difficulty levels and interesting mechanics are included.

On a computer, use the Left and Right arrow keys or the A and D keys to move, and press the Up arrow or W key to jump. On a phone or tablet, touch screen buttons handle movement and jumping, and pressing jump while in the air performs a double jump. Collect every fruit in a level to pass it.
squishy-sheep: In Squishy Sheep, your job is to steer a woolly little sheep through each level until it has collected every balloon. The trick is to clear away the right platform or obstacle at exactly the right instant, then let gravity and physics do the rest. Each stage is built to be finished with only a handful of clicks, and the sheep hops from ledge to ledge, picking up balloons in surprising ways.

Smooth animations and a cute, friendly art style make the game pleasant to play, and each level pulls you onward until it is fully complete. On a touchscreen, tap to remove a platform or obstacle. On a computer, click with the left mouse button. Timing matters most, so choose the moment carefully and let the sheep bounce off ledges and use gravity to reach every balloon.
stacky-dash: Stacky Dash is a relaxed arcade title where your job is to steer a character while picking up bricks along the way. Your goal is to reach the last platform. Gathering as many bricks as you can is key, and the game suggests grabbing every single one, since doing so earns you more diamonds.
Every platform must be crossed, and the
sneaker-factory: You run your own sneaker factory and have to outdo rival factories to climb to the top of the city ranking. Fill customer orders by making sneakers to spec: pick the colors, add labels, and pack the batches. In the warehouse, sort identical sneakers onto the right shelves. For deliveries, switch to driver mode, steer around obstacles, and carry the goods to the warehouse. A leaderboard tracks how your factory stacks up against others as you build reputation and aim for the number one spot. Your level rises with your reputation, which you earn through upgrades, sorting, order fulfillment, and shipping.

Controls differ by device. On PC, manage the factory by clicking buttons; during deliveries, use the Left and Right Arrow keys to brake, reverse, or accelerate, and press Space Bar to jump. On mobile, management is also done with taps on buttons, and during deliveries the on-screen left, right, and up arrow buttons handle braking/reversing, gas, and jumping.
super-fruit-runner-hyper-casual: Super Fruit Runner is a fast-paced arcade runner in the hyper casual style. You guide a speedy fruit forward, weaving past obstacles on the way to the finish line. The game includes 15 levels and 12 achievements to earn. Seven languages are available: English, Russian, French, Turkish, Spanish, German, and Italian.
Hitting a knife destroys your fruit, but it also rewards you with
draw-and-pass: Draw and Pass is a drawing puzzle title with 50 separate pictures, each showing unfinished parts. Your job is to sketch those gaps on the screen with accurate lines so the image looks complete, then move ahead to the next level. Every picture asks you to think about shape and detail, which keeps the challenge fresh as you progress.

Controls are simple: use your mouse and left click to draw. On a phone or tablet, just touch the screen and trace your lines with your finger. The game rewards imagination as much as problem-solving, so it suits players who like to be creative while working through a series of brain teasers.
rich-mom-family-simulator-luxury-life: Step into the role of a wealthy mother who runs a successful company and lives a life of luxury in this adventure game. You balance work and home, look after your household, and tackle a range of missions while enjoying the perks of belonging to a rich family. Cars, a city setting, and a helicopter all feature along the way.

The controls are straightforward. On desktop, use W, A, S, and D to move, the mouse to turn the camera, and Left Shift to sprint. Press F to take actions, P to pause, and N to skip a level. Ctrl opens the settings, and I shows the controls list. On mobile, a joystick handles movement.
time-of-adventure-finno-and-jacky: Step into this familiar adventure set in a snowy land, where every move needs care. The soldiers of the Snow King are posted almost everywhere, so you must stay alert. Collect the crystals you find and keep going until you reach the end of the game.

You play as Jacky, joined by his friendly dog, Finno. The journey is made up of 15 challenging chapters. Instructions on how to play are available in the game. Mobile controls are supported, and on a keyboard you can use WASD or the arrow keys, with Shift included in the controls.
bullet-loop: Bullet Loop is an action shooter where each run leaves you stronger than the last. Your hero falls back toward a bunker while you fend off waves of foes. Line up headshots and gather coins to boost your damage, how quickly you shoot, and your income.

The adventure spans 10 themed zones, from ancient Egyptian sites and Viking fjords to neon-lit streets and a hidden laboratory. When a fight gets too tough, spend your coins on gear upgrades, return to the battle, and advance further. Hold the left mouse button and drag to aim, while shooting and movement happen automatically. Press Space or the FIGHT button to begin a run, and press R to restart. On mobile, drag your finger to aim and tap the on-screen buttons to start and buy upgrades.
web-swing-obby-aqualand: Web Swing Obby: Aqualand is a 3D parkour adventure built around swinging on a web. You fire a line, gather speed as you swing, and let go at just the right instant to clear a gap and land on the next platform. Each obstacle asks for accurate aiming, well-timed releases, and steady control of your movement.

Along the way you collect rewards, upgrade your character, and unlock new costumes. Rebirth is available for permanent bonuses, so every attempt can carry you a little further than the last. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, look and aim with the mouse, hold the left button to shoot your web and swing, release it to let go, and press Space to jump or to leap off mid-swing.
shoot-and-sprint-warfare: Shoot & Sprint: Warfare puts you in the boots of a fearless soldier who never stops moving forward. You don't have to steer, since your character charges ahead on his own, so your attention can stay on the fight. Enemies pour in from every direction, and you need to react fast to take them down and stay alive in this quick-paced action title.

To aim and fire, tap the screen or press the mouse button, and aim in whichever direction the threat appears. Be precise with your shots so you don't burn through ammunition. Keep an eye out on each level for first-aid kits, extra ammo, and temporary weapon boosts. Once a level is cleared, you can unlock new guns and upgrade them to deal more damage.
launch-jack: Launch Jack is a physics-driven puzzler in which a pumpkin named Jack is flung across the screen to smash zombie heads and keep Halloween night from falling into chaos. He hurls himself through gloomy, haunted scenery, and each shot is aimed at wiping out the zombie heads that block the way. Careful planning matters here, since you must get past stubborn obstacles and chain together strong combos to finish each stage.

As the rounds go on, the challenges grow harder and the settings become increasingly creepy. Special power-ups can give you an edge when a level gets tough. Your job is to take out every zombie head and rescue the
adventure-time-finn-love: In this single-player 2D arcade adventure, a yellow dog sets out to find his favorite human friend. He must work his way through 20 different levels before he reaches him. Along the way, he gathers gold wherever he can find it, and each stage brings him one step closer to his goal.

That gold can be spent on a flower, which he then hands over to his human pal. Controlling the dog takes only one action: jumping. Touch the screen or click the mouse to leap over obstacles and keep moving forward through the adventure.
clash-to-survival: In this Adventure title, waves of enemies keep appearing without pause, so you have to stay on your toes. You carry powerful guns and unique special powers that help you fight in your own way. Moving through varied surroundings, you will face tough bosses and need to plan how to outlast them. Upgrade your weapons, master your abilities, and prove your skills, because humanity's future hangs in the balance.

Controls are straightforward. Move with W, A, S and D, and look around with the mouse, which also handles using your weapons. Trigger skills with 1, Q, E and Left Shift, and press Tab to change weapons.
crowd-runner-3d: Crowd Runner 3D is a new arcade game designed to give players a good amount of entertainment and fun. Tagged as 3D, hypercasual, and running, it puts you in a 3D running challenge where the goal is to get past the enemy crowd and reach the finish line to complete the level.

Everything is controlled with a single left mouse button click, so there is little to learn before you can start playing. Keep pushing toward the finish line while dealing with the enemy crowd along the way, and each level is complete once you cross it.
home-rush: Home Rush is a drawing puzzle game where you save as many children as you can. It's a relaxing experience. Each little one is crying, and your job is to guide every child back to the mom or dad who is searching for them, so they can get home together.

Controls are easy to pick up. Click a parent to start drawing, then draw a line over to the baby of the same color. Walls, dogs, cars, and thieves stand in the way, so plan a route that avoids them. Keep the two parents from running into each other. The puzzle is solved once every child has made it home safely.
pop-it-pig-jigsaw: Pop It Pig Jigsaw is a free browser game built around jigsaw puzzles. It offers six pictures, and each one can be played in any of three modes. Pick the mode you want, then start it. Your task is to drag and drop the scattered pieces into place until the full image appears.
Everything is controlled with the mouse, so you click, hold, and move each piece to where it belongs. As the pieces settle into position, the picture gradually takes shape.
madness-ward-number-6: You play as a patient confined to a psychiatric hospital, and your character grows stronger as you gain levels. Each new level brings points you can spend to improve your abilities. Progress comes from clashing with other inmates and facing bosses, which you start by tapping or clicking the on-screen buttons. After a handful of battles, you reach a new level and collect fresh points to spend.

Between fights, you can test your fortune in the rat race or purchase weapons, skins and pets to change how your patient looks and fights. In battles, critical damage strikes at random, and its power depends on your Madness characteristic, so that stat matters when those lucky hits land.
assault-on-squid-island: Government troops have stormed a mysterious island, and you are caught in a deadly fight to stay alive. Your aim is to destroy every enemy you meet and find a way off this sinister place. Battles feel tense thanks to a realistic combat system, and each location has its own distinct atmosphere. A gripping story keeps you guessing right up to the end. In this world, a single careless step can be your last, and every decision matters in the fight for survival.

On a computer, WASD moves your character, Left Shift switches to running, and Space jumps. The left mouse button fires, the right mouse button aims, T inspects your weapon, R reloads, and P pauses the game. On a phone, you control the action with the mobile control functions.
tank-mayhem: Tank Mayhem puts you in a tank battle against a friend or the computer. Make good use of the bonuses that support you during the fight. One of the strongest is the Drone Mini Tank, which attacks the enemy quickly. If the drone cannot hit its target, it switches to a kamikaze attack. Other bonuses also boost your firing power.
Each player has its own set of controls. The blue tank moves with W, A, S and D and fires with V. The red tank moves with the arrow keys and fires with M.
black-sphere: Black Sphere is a puzzle game played on a field of round cells. A white ball sits on one of the cells, and a single cell is marked with a specific color. A black ball appears at the top of the field, and your job is to choose which cell it should move toward. The move has to be planned so that the black ball knocks the white one along the way and comes to rest on the marked cell. Each success earns you points and takes you on to the next level.
Playing is simple: click with the mouse or tap the screen to make your choice. The game suits anyone who enjoys logic and brain teasers, and it works well on mobile devices as well as on a computer.
boxes-wizard-2: This sequel to a 2D pixel art platformer puts you in the role of a wizard who can teleport and push boxes. Across 40 levels packed with puzzles, you'll need to think carefully. Swap places with boxes to open new routes and get past obstacles in your way. The retro-style visuals give the game a classic feel, and the gameplay draws you deeper with every stage.
As you go, you'll master new mechanics and face tougher challenges. Use your magical skills to find your way forward and come out on top. Move with WAD or the arrow keys.
stick-archer-champion: Stick Archer Champion is an action game where you take on rival stick figures and prove you are the best bowman. You travel through a world of stick people while digging up the hidden meanings behind them. You can equip stronger bows, arrows, quivers and shields, and pick up new talents and effects that unlock more arrows.
Dress up your stickman with different caps, masks, hairstyles, beards and anim
movie-star-daily-routine: Spend a full day alongside a well-known actress from a TV series. Her morning starts with cosmetic procedures and skincare, and you can watch her skin shine. Next comes a sports session to keep her in excellent shape. Before heading to the gym, she packs a bag with water, a yoga mat and other accessories, then chooses a stylish tracksuit.

Once her workout ends, it's time for makeup and a screen test. She goes through a casting and tries on the looks of heroines from films and series. Finally, she gathers her essentials into a small clutch and steps onto the red carpet in original outfits meant to impress. Everything is controlled with a mouse click or a simple touch on touchscreens, and you can save your result as a PNG image.
car-escape-parking: Gridlock fills every lot here, and both your moves and their timing count. Cars are jammed together, and your job is to slide them into the right order so the trapped vehicle can get out. You drag each car forward or backward, and you need to plan ahead, since a single misstep can leave the exit blocked. Be careful not to bump into other vehicles or obstacles along the way.

As you advance, the lots grow crowded with more cars, tighter gaps, and clever layouts that push your logic and planning to their limits. Each stage brings a fresh arrangement as the challenge grows. Expect to think hard, but the process feels calm and satisfying, and it works your brain as you go. Clear every jam and you can earn the title of Parking Master.
counter-craft-3-zombies: Step into a blocky, Minecraft-style world where zombies are waiting for you. Your task is to shoot a set number of them on each stage, while keeping an eye out for enemy soldiers and explosives that could stop you from surviving. You have three types of weapons to choose from, so picking the right one for the moment matters. Finishing each level is the goal.

Controls are simple. Use W, A, S and D to move, and hold the left mouse button to shoot. The right mouse button lets you aim, while the scroll wheel switches between weapons. Press R to reload, Space to jump, and Tab to pause whenever you need a short break.
valentine-nail-salon: Step into a stylish nail salon where you run the show. Clients come in often for manicures, and today is Valentine's Day, so your current customer wants a sweet, romantic look that makes her hands stand out. Prove your talent by giving her nails a glamorous finish.

Start by picking the length and shape you like best, then get to painting. Choose whichever polish shade suits your vision and decorate each nail as elaborately as you can. You can go with a trendy french manicure or a classic one, and you can stick to a single color or mix several together. Play with a left mouse click or a tap.
dress-up-anime-girl: In this online title, you dress up an anime-style princess however you like. Mix and match clothing, hairstyles, and makeup to express your imagination and fashion sense. Every look you build can feel one-of-a-kind, helping your princess stand out as a stylish figure in her own kingdom.

The artwork uses an anime style, and the game offers 10,692,000 possible appearance combinations along with many unusual items to discover. It also includes cute cats. Once you have designed your perfect anime character, take a screenshot and use it as your avatar. A random button can also generate a surprise look for you.
needfor-race: Need For Race puts you behind the wheel in a 3D arcade racer with plenty of cars to choose from. There is no limit on how many races you can join, and three separate free maps give you new routes to explore. Each win earns you money, which you can spend on upgrades or on a different car to suit your style.

Steer with WASD or the arrow keys. Hit left Shift for a nitro boost, press C to switch camera views, and tap Space to use the handbrake for sharp turns. It is a solo game with a crazy streak, so expect plenty of fast action.
speed-per-click-obby: Speed per Click: Obby blends clicker gameplay with obby-style parkour, in the spirit of blocky games. Every click adds to your speed, so you build it up over time. Parkour courses demand careful jumping and precise movement. Collect wins to unlock new locations and upgrade your skills. Pets raise the speed you earn per click and help you beat levels faster. Performing a rebirth grants bonuses that let you speed up again.

On a computer, WASD moves your character and Space makes it jump. On mobile, a joystick steers the character, a button in the lower right corner triggers jumps, and swiping the screen rotates the camera.
mechangelion-robot-fight: Mechangelion Robot Fight invites you to battle machines inside a metal arena. This is a three-dimensional action game with plenty of gore. You step into the shoes of a powerful mechanical warrior and aim to reach the very top of the fight.

As a super robot, you face off against enemies in heated bouts. Controls are simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to play. It fits right into the arcade category and suits anyone who enjoys fighting games with a robot theme.
happy-valentines-day-coloring: Happy Valentine's Day Coloring lets you prepare a lovely gift for your boyfriend or girlfriend. The idea is to show how much you care by filling a charming picture with your own colors. It is listed under Girls, and its tags also include Boys, Arcade, Fun, Coloring, and Holiday. It runs in the browser and is also available on Android.
Controls are simple: use your mouse or tap the screen to color. When your picture is finished, you can print it out and share it as a Valentine's gift.
squid-7-challenge: Squid 7 Challenge is an Android arcade game themed around Squid Game. You take part in seven rounds of short survival contests, and you win by getting through them all. The rounds include Red Light, Green Light, Sugar Honey Combs, Tug of War, Marbles, and Glass Stepping Stones, followed by more Squid Game challenges.

The game begins with an invitation and a short wait while other players gather. Once the contests are ready to start, you can also think about which of the show's characters you resemble most, and whether you might be the frontman. It sits in the action and arcade categories.
321-diferent-patch: This quick, casual puzzle asks you to spot the one figure that differs from a group of near-identical shapes. You get three seconds to find it, so you need to act fast. Small details can make all the difference, so study every shape closely. The challenge grows with each step. Watch out, too: a figure that was wrong last time might be the correct answer the next time you see it.

If you'd rather take your time, Relax mode works like Normal mode but gives you plenty of time to examine the figures. Once you feel ready, you can try Extreme mode for a tougher test. Everything is controlled with a mouse click or a tap.
hero-sheep: Hero Sheep is a pin-pulling puzzle game where you help a sheep get away from danger. Wild animals, fire, water, and traps all stand in its way, so you need to work out which pin to pull and in what order. Every level brings a new puzzle, which keeps your mind busy from start to finish. A wrong pull can mean the sheep loses, so it pays to think before you act.

To play, tap the screen to pull a pin and make the right moves that let the sheep escape. Water or lava can be used to take out the monsters in the way. Plan your moves carefully and you can rescue the sheep one level at a time.
bubble-smash: Bubble Smash offers a calm but hard-to-put-down take on bubble merging. You pull back to aim, let go to fire a bubble onto the board, and set it beside bubbles of the same color so they combine and burst. Each level asks you to hit its goals before your moves run out. Set off long runs of pops to unlock big combos, and if you get boxed in, call on a power-up to get moving again. Your progress carries you across a bright, colorful level map.
It's simple to learn, but mastering it takes practice, and you'll keep telling yourself just one more round.
corona-virus-crazy-doctor-simulator: In this 2D adventure, you play as a doctor who simulates how a virus spreads. Your job is to help the AI-controlled people avoid dying while you collect syringes. It's a single-player action game built in Unity3D, with running, avoiding, and a bit of skill.

Move with WASD and jump with Space. The game was made around 2021 to show how staying close to others can pass on the virus, so it encourages players to keep their distance from anyone who might be sick. It has just one button that leads to more games, and it won't push you off the page to find them. Have fun and stay safe.
driverz-ed: Driverz Ed puts you behind the wheel with your instructor, Ed, on his scenic island. You can work through the challenges he sets up or simply cruise around and hunt for the many secrets hidden across the land. Your aim is to track down the concealed Puzzle Pieces and open every car in the game.

Move with WASD or the arrow keys, and steer your view with the mouse. Press G to fast travel to the start of races, M to see all available missions along with your current records, and P to pause and open the settings.
foxy-eco-sort: Foxy and Raccoon set off on an eco-mission to tidy up polluted spots. You sort waste into glass, plastic, paper and organics by dragging each item to its matching category, such as cardboard onto cardboard. You can also clear the field by lining up three identical elements, or flip cards to find eco-themed pairs and give your memory a workout. Every cleaned area looks lovelier, and the animals living there are delighted
romantic-match-tactics: Step into a sweet, whimsical place where affection and tactics go hand in hand. This puzzle adventure asks you to empty the board one careful move at a time while conserving your turns. The trick is to weigh shifting pieces around against freeing the items that are sealed off, since both matter for winning. Across 48 stages, every level brings something fresh to figure out as you group romantic sets together.
You can play with a mouse or by touch. T
smash-yard: Tear off doors, shatter windows, and send wheels bouncing across the lot in this clicker. You can wreck 31 vehicles, from city cars and motorcycles to tanks, helicopters, and a flying saucer. The cash you collect pays for upgrades, which you'll need to take on tougher targets.

Release your charge inside the green zone to land a 20-hit Super Smash, then watch the wreck fold up in slow motion. Pick Endless, race the clock, or face four heavyweights in Boss Rush. On desktop, click or hold a part to smash it, press Space for a quick smash, or hold E and let go in the green zone. Press P or Esc to pause. On mobile, tap or hold the vehicle, hold CHARGE SMASH, then release in the green zone.
construction-set-3d-builder: In this creative building puzzler, you take on the role of a master builder. Piece by piece, you plan and assemble detailed 3D structures, turning simple parts into impressive builds. It challenges your skills and gives your imagination room to roam. It suits aspiring architects and anyone who enjoys watching their creations take shape.

Choose from many themes and settings, from leafy forests to busy cities, each with its own structures to build. You might raise a towering skyscraper or a cozy cabin. Realistic physics keep your creations stable as well as good-looking. Soothing music and a relaxing pace offer a calm break from everyday life. Controls: on PC, left-click chooses a piece and right-click zooms; on mobile, tap to choose a piece and double-tap and hold to zoom.
princesses-at-horror-school: Meet Laura and Frankie, two likable young monsters who attend a school made for their kind. Each morning, the pair plans their looks by blending classic princess elegance with spooky monster touches. Their tastes in fashion differ, so each one adds a personal flair to her outfit. When they walk into class, their schoolmates keep turning to watch, since these two are genuine monsters whose frightening style can leave even the boldest students uneasy.
You style the characters with a mouse click on a computer or a simple tap on a touch screen. Once you are happy with the result, you can save the picture as a PNG file.
hair-salon-3d: Hair Salon 3D is a bright, three-dimensional salon game where you run your own hairdressing shop. Customers arrive with different wishes, such as bob cuts, mohawks, undercuts, and long layers. You grab scissors, clippers, a razor, or a color brush to cut, style, and dye hair so it matches the request as closely as you can. Better results bring in more stars and tips, which you can spend on new tools and dyes or on harder haircuts. VIP clients also visit. The game includes 23 distinct hairstyles, five tools, a rating system, and daily challenges to keep things fresh.

To begin, look at the card on the right to see what the client wants, and tap it for a 3D preview. Choose scissors for precise work, clippers for even trims, or the razor for fine detail. Swipe across the head to cut, and use two fingers to pinch and rotate the camera. If color is needed, pick the brush and select a shade. When the style looks finished, tap "Done" to receive your rating.
girl-bike-accident-love: Zoe is running in the park when a bike suddenly crashes into her and hurts her knee. Its owner, Zack, tends to her wound right away.

Once Zack gets home, Zoe keeps popping into his thoughts, and he slowly realizes he has fallen in love with her. The story then moves forward from there, and it's up to you to follow along. The game sits in the Girls category, and its tags include doctor, dress up, fashion, makeover, kids, and love. Controls are simple: click or tap with your mouse to play.
the-island-of-momo: Your night began in your bedroom, just as you were about to drift off to sleep, when something awful happened. You now find yourself on a strange place called the Island of Momo. Your task is to search the land for ammunition, then take on Momo and its sidekicks while staying alive for as long as you can.

Left-click fires your weapon, and right-click is used for aiming, with blocking also part of the controls. Move with W, A, S and D, sprint with Left Shift, and crouch with Left Ctrl. Press X to go prone and Space to jump. F uses an item, R reloads, H holsters your weapon, and G throws a grenade.
kitchen-sorting: Kitchen Sorting borrows the familiar rules of ball and water sorting puzzles. Your job is to arrange cooking ingredients into glass jars in a comfortable kitchen. Once each jar holds only one kind of ingredient, you pour the contents into a pot and cook a meal.

To move items, tap a jar to lift one or several matching ingredients from its top layer, then tap a second jar to drop them in. Ingredients can only land on the same kind or into an empty jar. If you prefer, swiping from the starting jar to the target jar does the same job.
animal-pair-card-match: Animal Pair Card Match is a puzzle game built around adorable animal cards and a calm, elimination-style pace. Your job is to hunt down matching animal pictures by flipping over two cards on each turn. Every time you find a pair, you gather one of the target animals and take steps toward emptying the board. If a round starts to feel difficult, you can lean on helpful tools that offer extra assistance and point you in the right direction.
Controls are simple: click and drag to play. The game sits in the Puzzles category and is tagged Casual and Relaxation, so it suits players looking for an easygoing experience.
truck-loader-5: Truck Loader 5 takes you back to the warehouse, where a number of crates need to be hauled out the door. Thanks to your earlier work there, the warehouse owner has come back with another job. All thirty cargo crates must be moved onto the truck without any problems, and he is counting on you to get it done. Your tool is a magnetic arm that grabs any metal crate, letting you carry it around and drop it into the truck. Some crates tend to explode, which can help you get past the many obstacles the game throws in your way.
Controls are simple: move the arm with the mouse, or use W, A, S and D on the keyboard. On mobile devices, on-screen buttons take
nubik-dungeon: Nubik Dungeon sends you into a series of underground rooms packed with snares and brain teasers. Your goal is to survive each dungeon and reach the exit, clearing every hazard that stands in your path. The pixel-style 2D world is split into levels, and every dungeon brings its own mix of traps and puzzles, so you can never quite predict what waits around the next corner. Quick thinking and fast reactions both matter here.

Controls are simple: press A to move left, D to move right, and W to jump. Mobile controls can be enabled in the settings. This Android arcade title is built around jumping and levels, with a playful look that suits young players.
none-shall-get-through-save-cappuccina: None Shall Get Through: Save Cappuccina! is a 3D physics puzzle game built around a gravity gun. You move blocks and open doors to rescue Cappuccina, a ballerina held captive by an evil AI. Logic and brain-teasing challenges run through the adventure.

On PC, WASD moves you in four directions, Left Shift lets you walk, and Space jumps and climbs boxes. E uses or releases objects, Tab opens the menu, and keys 1, 2, and 3 switch between jumping without a gun, the gravity gun, and the rifle. Left click fires your guns, Q hides or shows the controls, and Z toggles the mouse. On mobile, a left joystick handles movement, with buttons for jumping, using, pulling with the gravity gun, and shooting. Unstuck returns you to the start of the level, and Restart resets the puzzles in the current level.
stack-master: Stack Master is an endless arcade game where you try to build the tallest tower you can by lining up sliding blocks. Its graphics are plain and tidy, so nothing pulls your focus away from the smooth action. Scores are based on tower height, and you can compare yours with other players around the world on global leaderboards.

A block slides across the screen above the stack. Tap the screen or a control to drop it onto the block beneath. A close match keeps most of the block, while any overhang is cut off and the next block becomes smaller. If your drop is badly off and almost nothing overlaps, you lose the block and the game ends. Each successful drop extends the tower upward, and as it grows, the blocks may move faster or demand more precision.
shawarma-kiosk-anomaly-game: Step into a late-hours takeaway stand in Night Shift Zombie Shawarma, where you are a cook who must also stay alive. Once midnight arrives, undead visitors pour in, and any order you fill could be your last. You'll make burgers, shawarmas and drinks for hungry zombies who have no patience, so speed matters, and a single slip-up can prove fatal.

Stock management is just as important. Accept food deliveries, tidy the racks, and keep the stand running smoothly, because a cluttered kitchen during the night can cost you your life. Move with W, A, S and D, press E to interact with objects, and use the mouse to look around the kiosk.
spider-bubu: Guide Spider-Bubu as he hops between the walls of a city during Halloween. Your job is to gather every candy scattered around, and be sure to grab the giant pumpkin too. Watch out, because spinning blades and spikes can be found all over the city, and one wrong move can end your run.

To travel from one wall to the next, tap and let go on a phone, or click and release the mouse on a computer. Collect all three pumpkins, then head for the portal that appears in the city. The game can be played on both mobile devices and PC.
sawblade-fest-run: Sawblade Fest Run is a racing game with an arcade feel that puts your reflexes to the test from the first moment. The theme of cutting things into many pieces runs through the fun, but your main job is much simpler. You keep moving forward while steering clear of deadly hazards, including iron sheets, walls, and giant fruit monsters.

The game carries arcade, fruit, and jigsaw tags, so those themes shape what you see as you play. Controls are simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need to get started. Each run comes down to staying sharp, keeping your timing tight, and never stopping until the obstacles catch you.
car-modding-contest: Build the car of your dreams in this arcade driving game, then take it into a direct contest. You can swap out the rims, change the styling, and fine-tune small details until your ride looks just right. Every choice you make shapes how your car stands out on the road.

Once your build is ready, your goal is to outshine the competition and prove your design is the best. Showing off your own creative setups is a big part of the fun, and a win comes from the track itself. To pick any change, just click the modification you want.
sort-games-challenge: Sort Games Challenge is a puzzle game where you can test yourself across several modes, not just one. Each level asks you to finish your mission before the time runs out, and only then can you move on. Although it may look simple at first, it remains very difficult to get through, so expect a real test of patience and focus.

To play on a computer, click the mouse to make your selections. On a phone or tablet, tap the screen with your finger to select items. Both controls work in a similar way, so you can use whichever device suits you best. Keep an eye on the clock as you go.
moto-x3m-pool-party: Moto X3M is an online bike racing game made for people who enjoy extreme sports. Its challenge levels differ from one to the next, and the high speeds are dangerous yet hard to resist. Packed with engaging features, it offers a relaxing way to pass the time while still keeping the pulse racing.

This is the special Pool Party edition of the bike stunt game, called Moto X3M 5 Pool Party. Control your rider with the arrow keys as you move through the different challenges and levels. It is a lively take on the racing formula that stunt fans will recognise.
merge-furry-monsters: This puzzle game introduces adorable little creatures, each with its own name, moods, and feelings. Every furball seems to have a distinct personality, and behind its emotions there may be a happy or sad tale that players could one day uncover.

Gameplay is straightforward: drop the monsters from above so they land and merge with others of their own kind. Each merge creates a new monster that is just as fluffy and lovable, though the process costs them a piece of their soul. Keep them from fading away by collecting them, and you might earn the title of main Guardian of fluffy souls.
monster-dinosaur-rampage-city-attack: Step into a rampage adventure that takes you back to the age of dinosaurs. Unlike other rampage games, this one sends you on a trip into the Jurassic world, where you become a fearsome prehistoric predator. Your missions then carry you into the modern world, where the chaos begins.

The story starts with wicked scientists who ran experiments on certain dinosaur species. Now you control one of those test subjects, and your goal is to tear through the city in revenge. Soldiers will open fire on you, so you must dodge their bullets and destroy them. Move with WASD and attack with J.
parkout-traffic-escape: ParkOut: Traffic Escape is a colorful 3D puzzler in which a parking lot has become totally jammed and needs untangling. Using careful thought and planning, you shift cars to open a route and steer each one safely to the exit. Early layouts look simple, but the challenges sharpen as you advance. Bright, smooth visuals keep things satisfying, and the game is easy to learn yet hard to stop playing.

Tap a car and swipe to drive it forward or backward. Vehicles can only travel in straight lines, so work out which one must leave first to free the others. Avoid bumping into other cars, walls, or obstacles. A level is won once every car has left the lot. With hundreds of parking lots to clear and no timers or penalties, you can solve at whatever pace suits you.
johnny-trigger-3d-online: Johnny Trigger 3D Online is a 3D shooting game that you can handle with just one hand. As you move through the adventure, you take aim with the guns and weapons you are carrying and fire at foes with precision. Taking down an enemy with a single bullet is the smart approach, since it leaves you with more ammo to bring down a larger number of opponents.
The game runs in your browser and is played entirely with mouse clicks or taps on the screen. Enjoy the action and have a good time with it.
only-up-parkour-2: Only Up Parkour 2 is an arcade title where your goal is to clear hurdles and reach the 500M mark. Your character moves through a tall, maze-like structure packed with all sorts of barriers. Timing matters here. You need quick reactions, precise leaps, and nimble climbing so you neither smash into a barrier nor tumble back to the bottom.

As you advance through the stages, the challenge ramps up and fresh hazards appear, including bouncing platforms and new kinds of obstacles. Steer with W, A, S and D, and press Space to jump. Keep your footing and keep climbing toward the top.
bubble-shooter-island-quest: Set on a tropical island, this bubble shooter puzzle challenges you to clear the clusters hanging from the jungle canopy before they sink to the bottom. Aim and fire colorful bubbles, including reds, blues, yellows, eggs, and coins, from a red parrot pirate's cannon. Match three or more of the same color to pop them, and chain reactions can take down large groups. Gather gems and coins for upgrades, and work toward the star and trophy goals set for each level.
Power-up barrels offer rainbow, lightning, and ice effects that you can click when they are available. Vines and barrels
cooking-fever-happy-chef: Cooking Fever: Happy Chef is a simulation game about the joy of preparing food, serving it, and running your own restaurant. Its colorful graphics bring the kitchen to life, and its special gameplay gives every round a fresh feel. You step into the food world and work toward becoming a top chef.

The controls are simple: use a mouse click or a tap to play. This hypercasual title is easy to pick up, so you can start cooking, serving, and managing your restaurant right away. Keep your kitchen running well and see how far your culinary path can take you.
limo-city-taxi-driver: Slide into the seat of a city limo and handle a series of taxi jobs. Your task is to collect riders, travel along the city route, and bring each one to where they want to go. Every ride has to be finished while you weave through the busy streets of this 3D driving game.
Steering, speeding up, and braking all happen through the on-screen driving controls. Use them to keep your limo moving smoothly and to make sure your passengers arrive safely at every stop.
find-the-correct-shadow: Find The Correct Shadow is a puzzle game that tests how well you notice visual details. Each round shows a picture alongside three possible shadows, and only one of them is an exact match. Your job is to spot that single correct silhouette among the choices.

The game includes three modes. Streak Mode tracks how long you can keep a run of right answers going without a miss. Timed Mode puts you against the clock, where the goal is to pick out as many correct shadows as you can before time runs out. Learning Mode offers a calmer pace, built to help you practice and sharpen your visual recognition. Everything is played with a mouse click or a tap.
ink-shop-dress-and-tattoo-games: Ink Shop: Dress & Tattoo mixes two creative jobs into one game. First, you craft detailed ink tattoos and apply them to a range of characters. Your artistic side gets plenty of room to shine before the fashion part begins.

Once the body art is done, the focus moves to style. You can choose outfits that follow the latest trends and add accessories to give each character a complete makeover. Fashion and tattoos meet here, so your talents can show off in more than one way. Whether you enjoy inking or dressing, both sides of the game ask you to think like an artist.
color-dash-chameleon-runner: Chameleon Runner: Color Dash is a fast arcade endless runner where you run, jump, and switch colors to stay alive. Your chameleon must blend into each vibrant world, since obstacles match their surroundings. Quick reflexes are everything. As you go, the speed rises, the colors shift, and platforms test your timing.

The arrow keys move you forward or backward and turn you left or right. Tap to change colors, collect coins to raise your score, and grab gems to unlock chameleon skins and effects. Reach the finish line to complete a level, and finish with plenty of coins for bonus rewards. Explore the jungle, neon city, and crystal cave, avoid enemies, and climb the global high-score leaderboard. It is simple to learn, tough to master, and suited to players of all ages.
smashers-io: Smashers.io drops you into a battle arena with a gigantic hammer in your hands. Your job is to smash every enemy you can reach. Each victory opens the door to the next round, where the fights grow harder and the opponents grow stronger. The rules are refreshingly straightforward: land hits on other fighters and avoid being struck yourself. As an online .io title, it crowns the last player still standing as the winner.

Movement works by sliding across the screen to guide your fighter. Keep an eye on the crowd around you, since one careless step can leave you open to a blow. Stay mobile, pick your moments, and aim to be the final survivor when the dust settles.
koenigsegg-jesko-absolut-slide: Rearrange the tiles of a Koenigsegg Jesko Absolut picture in this sliding puzzle. The game includes three different images of the car, so you can pick the one you like most. Each image comes in three modes, with 3x3, 4x4, or 5x5 pieces, so you can choose how big the grid is.

Everything is played with the mouse. Slide the pieces into their correct places to finish the picture. Built with HTML5, the browser game is grouped under Puzzles and tagged for mobile, along with the Car and Cars labels.
gt-cars-super-racing: GT Cars Super Racing pays tribute to the classic arcade racers of the 1980s. Its car handling is precise, so every turn and drift responds well to your inputs. You race across 21 varied circuits, and surprises are waiting for you to uncover. The graphics are vibrant and detailed, and the car control system adds to the immersive feel.

Listen to the engine sounds as you work to keep your speed at its best. Timing your turbo gives you a crucial boost when you need it most. Steer with the Left and Right keys, press P to pause, and use the mouse to make selections. It is a top-tier rally arcade racer with a top-down view and plenty of supercars.
good-slice: Good Slice is a relaxed puzzle game built around slicing fruit. It is designed to put your cutting skills to the test. Swipe across the screen to slash each fruit so its pieces drop into the juicer below. Accuracy counts: the cleaner and more exact your slice, the more juice you collect.

Getting started is simple, since a mouse click or a tap is all you need to play. Take your time with every swipe, because precision is what earns you the most juice. The game asks for a steady hand and a bit of focus, which makes it a pleasant choice for a calm, casual session.
cut-it-all-3d: This 3D puzzler asks you to slice objects apart while following the rules set for each challenge. Every task calls for planning ahead, so you need to think through shapes and space to decide where each cut should go. Levels range from easy, straightforward setups to advanced stages that demand a high level of skill.

You can choose which type of object to slice and pick the cutting style you want to use, such as a standard slice or cuts made in a straight line. The controls are simple: left-click or tap your phone screen to start cutting.
mega-car-stunts: Mega Car Stunts puts you behind the wheel on tracks built around daring stunts, where skill, speed, and handling all count. You'll launch off large ramps, clear gaps with bold jumps, and weave past dangerous obstacles on your way to the finish. Winning takes more than raw speed, since each course calls for careful timing and steady control. Crashes follow the physics of your car, so every mishap plays out differently.

You earn money by completing events, and you can grow your collection with faster, more powerful vehicles. Several modes and demanding tracks keep each run fresh, and the challenges get tougher as you go. React quickly to what lies ahead, and work on your performance until you have mastered every course.
your-obby-labyrinth: Your Obby Labyrinth is a multiplayer maze game where you can team up with friends to work through twisty mazes packed with hidden routes, silly messages, and rewards. You can customize your character with different skins and bring along adorable pets. Watch out for goofy AI monsters and quirky NPCs along the way. Your aim is to reach the end of each maze. Doors, levers, buttons, and keys help you find your way out, and each maze has bright areas, tricky traps, and puzzles to solve. Step through magical portals to reach new mazes, and chat with other players as you go.
Controls use WASD to move and the spacebar to jump. Press E to interact, Shift for the cursor, and Tab to pause. The mouse wheel zooms in and out. On a phone, use the on-screen interface to play.
dress-up-bean: Dress Up Bean lets you design your own avatar from the ground up. The game offers hundreds of fashion items to mix and match, so you can shape the look exactly as you like. Try the latest clothes, change the hairstyles, experiment with makeup, and dress your character in beautiful suits that move.
The game sits in the Girls category and is tagged Boys, Dress Up, Girls and Hypercasual. To begin, just click to play and start building your look.
city-tuk-tuk-simulator-racing-game-3d: Take the wheel of a brightly painted tuk tuk and weave through crowded city roads in this 3D racing game. Your job is to carry passengers, handle three-wheeled driving at high speed, and slide around sharp bends while keeping clear of heavy traffic. The streets are built to feel like real urban surroundings, so every turn calls for care.

As you earn rewards, you can improve your vehicle and open fresh stages packed with challenges and stunts. Steering is done with the arrow keys: left and right to shift sideways, up to accelerate forward, and down to reverse. Practice these inputs so you can glide through obstacles and finish demanding routes.
darling-doll-diy-paper-doll: Darling Doll is a paper doll dress-up game with a wide choice of well-known model figures, from classic princesses to anime girls. Once you pick one, you can test out different outfits, hairstyles, facial expressions, and skin tones. A large range of accessories is also available to complete each look.

With over 1000 pieces to mix and match, you can customize your doll and build an anime character or your own avatar. To dress her, touch and drag the clothes, hairstyles, and accessories you like from the wardrobe onto your princess. When she is fully styled, you can save your creation and share it on social media with friends and family.
car-driving-simulator-3d: Take the wheel of a BMW City Car Rider 2021 and put your racing skills to the test on busy city streets. This free 3D driving simulator puts you behind the wheel of a realistic sports car, so you can cruise through the streets at your own pace. Buckle up, weave past the many traffic vehicles filling the city, and see how far your driving talent can carry you.

Routes in this game are full of challenges, so every drive asks something new from you. Supercar handling and open city roads make it a fitting pick for anyone who loves car games. Steer with the keyboard and work toward the goal of becoming the best BMW city driver out there.
tank-sniper-3d: Tank Sniper 3D is a shooting game where you take the seat of a sniper tank driver. Your job is to eliminate enemies with a single well-placed shot. You start out hidden behind cover, waiting for the right moment to surprise the opposition. After you fire, you must steer clear of incoming shells while you look for new targets. The aim is to land as many hits as possible and survive as long as you can.

Controls are simple. Press and hold to aim, then let go to fire. Timing matters, since patience keeps you concealed and steady aim makes every shot count. Whether you enjoy careful planning or quick reactions, this 3D battle game tests your skills.
daily-bento-organizer: Daily Bento Organizer is a hypercasual game where you aim to become a bento box master. Your creativity drives every choice as you build a lunch box that is as tasty as it is pleasing to look at. The game mixes two challenges: the art of arranging food and the task of managing storage so everything fits.
Controls are simple, and you only need a mouse click or a tap to play. Filed under collection and puzzle, it offers a light, casual experience built around planning how each box comes together.
sniper-clash-3d: You play as a covert sniper sent to infiltrate the desert and take back a trophy relic from hostile nomads. Lining up precise shots and eliminating targets is the heart of the action. Many concealed items and secret weapons are hidden across the level, and finding every one of them can turn the fight in your favor. Watch out for the storm that sweeps through the desert, where green palm trees stand against a sky glowing with sunset.
Movement uses W, A, S and D, C makes your character crouch, and SPACE makes it jump.
tennis-master: Tennis Master puts you on the court, where your goal is to beat your rivals and show off your competitive talent. You can face the computer, or invite a friend to play head to head in two-player mode. Along the way, you can collect power-ups and enjoy funny transformations that add a playful twist to each match.
Player 1 moves around the court with the arrow keys. Press X to hit the ball and Z to smash it. Use these two shots to take on each opponent.
hexfall-io: HexFall.io is an arcade survival game built around hexagonal tiles. The floor gives way as you move, and every step breaks the ground beneath you, so each landing needs careful thought. One misstep sends you into the void. The goal is to outlast the other players and be the final one still standing.

Getting started is simple. On a computer, you can steer with the arrow keys or with WASD. On a phone, an on-screen joystick handles the movement. Keep an eye on the tiles that remain and try to stay above the void for as long as possible.
fill-the-lines: Fill The Lines is a puzzle game that rewards careful thinking. Each stage shows a shape full of empty gaps, and your job is to cover every one of them. Colorful pieces, built from line segments or other shapes, wait to be moved. Grab a piece with your finger or hold the left mouse button, then slide it into the outline so it fits snugly, leaving no holes behind.

There is no clock and no way to lose, so you can take things at your own pace. The game includes hundreds of distinct levels and runs on both computers and mobile devices. It offers a relaxed, stress-free experience for anyone who enjoys puzzles that make them think.
ancient-dragons-princess: Step into a world of magic where Rennie, a dragon princess, values grace above all else. Her wardrobe ranges from soft velvet gowns to riding clothes made for flying on dragonback. You can also design a one-of-a-kind dragon to keep her company, arrange her hair in different styles, and add fine jewelry to complete her look.

Tap any character to pick their outfit, then keep your favourite snapshots by saving them to your device. Jewelry choices add a lot of sparkle to each look. Throughout, you travel with the dragon princess on an adventure through her magical realm.
stickman-merge-2: Stickman Merge 2 is a fighting game where you mix weapons together to build stronger guns. Once your arsenal is ready, you head to the shooting range to face enemy stickmen. Along the way, you can upgrade your pistol and pick up bonuses, all with the aim of becoming the top shooter in the city. Each new combination shows how powerful a weapon you can create for battling your foes.
Controls work with the mouse on a computer and with taps on touch screens. The core idea is to combine different weapon types into more powerful cannons.
memorya: Memorya is a calm puzzle game that tests your memory. At the start, you study where each card sits on the table, then you flip two at a time to look for matching pairs. The goal is to finish with as few slips as you can manage. As you progress, new levels open up, giving you a chance to beat your earlier scores.

To play, pick the atmosphere you like best and begin a round. Once you have studied the cards, reveal them two by two and clear the board before time runs out. Hints are there when you get stuck, and you earn stars and points as you go.
mind-games-for-2-3-4-player: Mind Games is a large collection of 27 titles that groups can enjoy together. You'll find skill games, brain games, matching games, pop-it games, mancala, ludo, and tic tac toe, all in one place. Each title is fun, made with kids in mind, and safe to play. Most of the games support two, three, or four players at the same time.

Each player gets their own set of controls. Player 1 uses W, A, S, D and E. Player 2 uses the arrow keys and Backspace. Player 3 uses I, J, K, L and O, while Player 4 uses T, F, G, H and Y. Alternatively, everyone can take turns sharing a single mouse and clicking with the left button.
squid-stacky-maze: Squid Stacky Maze asks you to gather every stack scattered around an island where frightening games from Squid Game are held, then find a way off it. Pick the correct route and leap over the stacks you have collected to reach the exit. This puzzle-style hypercasual title offers thirty levels full of action and thrills, and your aim is to be the first player to survive the island.
The 3D maze adventure is casual in feel and suits kids who enjoy jumping challenges. You control everything with a mouse or touchpad.
noob-legends-dungeon-adventures: Noob Legends Dungeon Adventures is a 2D arcade game built around fast-paced fights. You battle zombies and drones, upgrade your weapons, and finish missions that aim to rescue your friends. Hidden secrets are scattered through the dungeons for those who like to look around.
The game runs in your web browser and works across different devices, so there is nothing to install and no account to make. Pick it up whenever you have a few minutes free.
bus-and-subway-rush: Ride the route of buses and subway trains through a busy city in this quick-moving runner. Your job is to sidestep hazards, change lanes at the right moments, and grab rewards as you go. The game keeps you moving down the streets, with traffic and obstacles in your path.

Steering is simple on a computer: use the W, A, S, and D keys or the arrow keys to move and turn. On phones and tablets, touch controls and swipe gestures work too. The game is listed under Racing and tagged with bus, running, subway, traffic, and transport.
change-part-in-love-story: Change Part in Love Story is an adventure puzzle game about a couple whose journey turns into a string of amusing mishaps. Early on, you will want to crack the code for a safe and find out what she is hiding. Along the way, you use your wits to solve each problem they face, working through a mix of tasks and puzzles while helping the pair make up.

To play, read the assignment for each stage, then pick one element from the options at the bottom of the screen and drag it to the right spot on the picture. Complete all the levels to help the couple escape their silly situations. The tags point to romance, story, and puzzle solving, so expect a blend of feelings and clever thinking.
water-city-racers: Water City Racers is a 3D car racing game with several game modes to pick from. You can race against other cars and collect diamonds from each race. You can also blow up vehicles in traffic, and those explosions pay out diamonds too, so the game is built around having fun. Plenty of super sports cars and enjoyable modes are ready for you to try.
Steer and accelerate with W, A, S and D, and tap SHIFT to use NOS. Press T to glance behind you, R to fix your car's position, and SPACE to apply the handbrake.
steal-memerot-zoo-tycoon: Step into a colorful zoo filled with rare brainrot animals in this management tycoon. You purchase fresh creatures, set each one onto designated spots, and watch your cash build as the collection expands. Hunt down unusual pets, widen your grounds, and boost your earnings, transforming a modest base into a wealthy zoo where each addition feels more substantial than the last.
Your aim is to gather a big group of br
color-brain-test-games: Color Brain Test is a ring puzzle game built to give your mind a workout. Its spinning circles call for careful thought, while the simple, colorful gameplay keeps the experience light. If you like puzzles that reward logic and a bit of strategy, this one is worth a look.

Controls are easy to pick up: you just click to play. Each round asks you to work through the spinning colored rings, so every choice becomes a small test of focus. It runs in your browser as an HTML game.
stick-duel-battle-hero: Stick Duel: Battle Hero throws you into an arena where stickman fighters now wear new superhero outfits. Each hero can attack with fire guns, punches, or kicks. Your aim is to reach five points by knocking out your rival. Every costume is free to wear, so you can pick whichever look you like. Weapons, shields, and health boosts appear during each match, and if a weapon doesn't suit you, you can swap it out for another.

The game is built for two players sharing one keyboard. Player 1 moves with the arrow keys, fires with L, and drops a weapon with O. Player 2 moves with WASD, fires with F, and drops a weapon with R. Challenge a friend in 2 player mode and enjoy the battle together.
two-ball-3d-dark: Two Ball 3D is playable online, and this Dark edition brings a batch of fresh additions. The view now reaches much farther ahead, which gives you more time to spot traps coming. Ramps have also been improved: when you leap off one, a pair of wings opens so your landing stays steadier. Bonus shortcuts have been added as well, so you can trigger power-ups more quickly.

Collect diamonds as you roll along, and spend them to unlock six different ball skins. Steer with A and D or the left and right arrow keys. Press 1 for armor, 2 for magnet, and 3 for double counter to use those bonuses on the fly.
rolling-balancer-ball: Rolling Balancer Ball asks you to steer a ball along slim wooden planks that stretch over open water. It is easy to pick up but tough to master, since you need to keep the ball steady the whole way. Watch for traps along the route, and remember that the physics respond to even tiny movements, so one careless swipe can send the ball plunging into the water.

Control relies on swipes and drags. Swipe left or right to shift the ball sideways. Drag forward to roll it ahead, and the way you drag sets whether it moves faster or slower. When traps appear, ease off and line the ball up straight before crossing them. Keep balancing your way forward until you reach the boat at the end of each level to finish it.
warfare-area-3: Warfare Area 3 is a 3D first-person shooter in which you infiltrate an enemy base and eliminate every guard in the area. You fire at foes, collect first aid kits to stay healthy, and earn money that you can spend on stronger armor and better guns.

On a computer, the arrow keys or W, A, S, and D move your character, while the mouse turns your view, aims, and shoots. Press L to lock the pointer, R to reload, and P to pause. On mobile, use the on-screen joystick to move, the fire button to shoot, and tap and drag on the right side of the screen to aim.
do-not-enter-this-game-at-night: This 3D puzzle game is best avoided after dark. You roll a ball through a maze while creepy screamers jump out at you along the way. It is a single-player horror adventure built around that tense mix of navigation and sudden frights.

Players who press on will find many levels, a range of puzzles, and, of course, plenty more screamers. Steer the ball with the W, A, S and D keys, and note that the P key is also part of the controls. On a phone, a joystick in the bottom left corner of the screen handles movement.
crashy-chasy: Crashy Chasy is an arcade racer built around reckless car chases. You play a bold driver who slides around corners on busy city streets, slamming into rival vehicles and weaving through traffic wherever you go. Police, taxis, and other opponents are all after you, so staying out of their path is part of the challenge. The controls are simple and the pace is fast, which keeps things moving without a break. You can drift for the thrill or crash for pure chaos, and your goal is to cause as much destruction as you can while surviving the chase.
To start, tap or click anywhere on the screen, whether on the left or the right side, and you can begin controlling your car straight away.
mercenary-keep-siege-defense: Mercenary Keep: Siege Defense is a castle defense game built around a living wall. Bandits, undead, and witches march in from the right, and you hold the line. Tap an enemy to focus your crossbow fire on it. When red-marked heavy blows approach, raise the Shield Dome (W) to hold for five seconds, then wait five seconds before using it again. Fire Pots (E) hit dense groups, and Crown's Wrath (R) is your big strike.

Every boss shows its wind-up, so read it early and press the right button. Grow the keep floor by floor, spend gold on upgrades, hire named mercenaries, and man the ballista yourself. Short hands-on expeditions add variety. Your heroes fight on their own, and your task is to survive as many waves as you can.
jewel-blocks: Jewel Blocks is a free online game built to sharpen your mind while you have fun. It blends logic puzzles with arcade-style scoring, so every decision you make matters. Your goal is to work out where each classic block shape fits best, chasing high scores and a large pile of rewards as you go. The mechanics are easy to lear
soda-sandbox: Soda Sandbox puts you in charge of a soda bottle searching for new tastes across colorful worlds. Wander the streets of Volcano Island, battle rival bottles, and drift cars through endless deserts. When you want a change of pace, build mode lets you run ragdoll physics tests.

Customize your bottle, reshape the surroundings, and experiment with ragdoll physics to see what you can create. Hunt for hidden map secrets, such as water that vanishes, in survival-style puzzles. Race through cities, jump ramps, flip your bottle mid-air, and grab guns or weapons for fast clashes with soda foes. Mix fighting, racing, survival, and creative play as you like. Move with W, A, S, and D, and use left click to shoot or select items.
hot-girl-shooter: Hot Girl Shooter is a 2D shooting game for one player. You control a female character armed with a gun and blast your enemies away. Each character has her own style and charm, so you can pick the one you like best before you start.

You can choose from different weapons and modes, which gives you plenty of ways to play. It is a casual shooter that suits anyone who loves guns and action. Move your character with the W, A, S and D keys.
rowly-word-association: Rowly is a soothing puzzle about grouping words by theme. Each tile pairs a word with a small picture, and the board is shuffled so that several hidden themes are mixed together. Your job is to swap tiles until every row holds just one theme, such as fruits, tools, sea animals, kitchen things, and many more.

There is no timer, so you can take your time. The difficulty rises gently, and the game includes color levels, bonus levels, daily goals, and support for 13 languages. When a row contains only one theme, it locks and displays that theme's name. Lock every row to complete a level. If you get stuck, a hint shows a swap that moves a row closer to being finished. On desktop, you can drag one tile onto another or click two tiles in turn, and on phones and tablets, you control everything by touch.
snowball-dash: Snowball Dash puts you in charge of a bouncy red ball rolling down a snowy mountain. Your job is to weave around trees, rocks, and other tricky obstacles and keep the ball going for as long as you can. As you descend, the ride speeds up and grows more demanding, so your timing needs to stay sharp.

Shining crystals scattered along the slope are worth collecting, since each one adds to your score and gives your reflexes a workout. Steering is simple: use A or the Left Arrow to head left and D or the Right Arrow to head right. On a touchscreen, tap the left side of the display to move left or the right side to move right.
draw-save-puzzle: Draw Save Puzzle asks you to sketch a single line that keeps a Stickman safe from danger. Threats come from swords, bullets, bombs, and many other attacks that could be deadly to him. You can shape your line into any barrier or shield you like, so the little guy stays alive. The game suits people who enjoy sketching or who simply like solving puzzles.

Each level gives you a task to finish with one unbroken stroke, and your line must never touch or harm the Stickman you are protecting. Levels can have several correct answers, so you are free to try different ideas. There are plenty of stages to work through, and the physics system responds in a simple yet convincing way. Practicing logic and creative thinking along the way is part of the fun, and the relaxed pace makes it easy to keep playing.
zombie-apocalypse-tunnel-survival: Zombie Apocalypse Tunnel Survival is a free multiplayer shooter set in a tunnel filled with the undead. You face a crowd of computer-controlled enemies, including soldiers and lifelike zombies. The game offers five modes, such as Gun Game, Survival, Team Deathmatch, and Deathmatch, along with several others. You can play with friends, and every gun can be customized with camouflage and attachments.

Here are the controls. Use W, A, S, and D to move, and use the mouse to aim, look around, and shoot. Press the spacebar to jump, hold Shift to run, and use the change gun control to swap weapons. Press Tab to open the menu.
half-life-2-beat-em-up: Half-Life 2: Beat Em Up is a 2D arcade action game with platforming and adventure elements. Your journey takes you through City 17, Route Kanal, Ravenholm, Nova Prospekt, and the Citadel, one area after another. It is a fan-made creation in the Flash-style, built with HTML5 so it runs directly in your web browser.

Getting started is easy, since the game is controlled with a mouse click or a tap. Just click or tap to begin playing. It sits in the Arcade category and is tagged 2D, Action, Adventure, Arcade, and Platform, so it suits anyone who enjoys side-on fighting and moving through a story.
mine-obby-3d-car-wash-tycoon: Start with a small car wash and grow it into a sprawling automotive business. Offer foam, brushes, rinsing, drying, and polishing, then serve cars and collect your earnings once they reach the cash register. Expand with a gas station, café, and repair shop, and upgrade each facility to raise your income. Keep traffic moving by adding cars, speeding them up, and opening gold, emerald, and diamond roads. Equip pets to boost your character's running speed.

On PC, use WASD to move, the right mouse button to rotate the camera, the left mouse button to interact, and Space to jump. On mobile, a joystick moves your character, touching the screen rotates the camera, and the action and jump buttons handle interaction and jumping. Unlock every upgrade and become the top car wash tycoon.
western-fight: This 3D fighting game is set in a western-themed world, where you can battle it out with one of eight different characters. Two people can share the screen in the two-player mode and settle things with a friend, or you can play alone against the computer-controlled opponent. Either way, the goal is to win two rounds before your rival does. The AI is tougher than it first appears, so expect a real challenge.

Player 1 moves with W, A, S and D, punches with V, and kicks with B. Player 2 uses the arrow keys to move, punches with O, and kicks with P. Learn your keys, choose your fighter, and test yourself against the AI or a friend.
boxing-gang-stars: Funny boxers step into the ring in Boxing Gang Stars, and each fighter tries to knock the others down. You can fight alone in 1 player mode or challenge a friend in 2 player mode. Super fun physics and a cast of silly characters keep every bout lively and unpredictable.

Controls are split between the two fighters. In 1 player mode only, Player 1 moves with W, A, S, D or the arrow keys, punches with F, G or T, and blocks with E. Player 2 moves with the arrow keys, punches with K, L or O, and blocks with I. Keep winning your matches to earn the title of king of the boxing ring.
mini-car-racing-master-3d: Mini Car Racing Master 3D is an endless 3D racing game set on highways and busy city streets. You weave past heavy traffic and avoid obstacles to keep your run going. Choose from a range of rides, including 4WDs, sports cars, and formula racers. Tap the screen to fire a nitro boost when you need to blast past opponents.
Coins are your reward for racing, and you can spend them to upgrade your car or un
stickman-sports-badminton: Stickman characters take to the court in Stickman Sports Badminton, a badminton game with realistic ball physics that make each rally feel natural. Power-ups include a big racket, a fireball, and a speed boost, while a slowdown penalty can work against you. You can play alone or with a friend sharing the same keyboard.

When you face the computer, you can pick either Normal or Hard difficulty. You also choose whether the match is best of 5, 7, or 9 sets. Player 1 moves with W, A, S, and D, jumps with the same keys, and swings the racket with SPACE. Player 2 uses the arrow keys to move and jump and swings with M.
solve-the-maze: Puzzle lovers should find plenty to enjoy here. The game includes 100 distinct levels, and the difficulty climbs gradually from one to the next. If a stage proves too tough, you can skip past it. Each level you finish earns crystals, which you spend on unlocking new items, and the goal is to gather the entire collection.

Your ball glides smoothly across the maze while you paint it in bright, lively colors. Controls stay simple and need only a single touch. Move the ball with swipes across the screen, or use the arrow keys on a computer. To clear a level, color every part of the maze. Leave even one square unfilled, and you will be trapped in the colored maze forever. It makes a great way to pass some time.
fallingman-io-winter-seasons: Fallingman.io - Winter Seasons is a multiplayer .io game with a 3D look that blends adventure and arcade action. Across three tracks, you race against a field of 20 people and aim to reach the finish first on the opening course. The second track tests your attention: ignore the picture on screen, because a wrong move sends you over the edge and ends your run. The third track demands patience, since once you step on a tile you cannot step on it again.

Clear all three tracks to gather crowns and claim the win. The game features 18 levels and 6 titles, climbing from Junior and Boys through Man, Father, and Boss, up to the highest God title. Control your character with the arrow keys and space bar, or use touch controls on mobile.
lows-adventures-3: Low's Adventures 3 is a 2D platformer made in pixel art, and it marks the third entry in the series. It features 32 carefully designed levels and introduces gameplay ideas that the earlier games did not have. Low moves through a world full of challenges, picking up new abilities and facing unusual enemies. Fans of retro graphics will enjoy the pixel style, which keeps the old-school feel while bringing in fresh content.

The game is designed for one player and blends action, arcade play, and collecting. Controls are simple, since a mouse click or a tap is all you need. Overall, it combines the classic charm of the series with new features.
circle-car-crash-3d: Circle Car Crash 3D is a fast racing game set on endless circular tracks full of obstacles and rival cars. Collisions play out in 3D with slow-motion moments, and the physics aim to feel realistic, bending metal and sending cars flying. You earn points for close passes, clean drifts, and big crashes.

The controls are simple: the up arrow accelerates, the down arrow brakes or reverses, and the left and right arrows steer. Collect coins to unlock new cars, and upgrade them for speed, handling, and crash power. To complete a level, survive the circle and reach the finish line, with the goal of being the last car standing. Engine sounds and visual effects add to the ride.
zombiracer-speed-on-earth: Zombiracer: Speed On Earth sends you onto a track in the middle of an undead outbreak. Your job is to pair up powerful vehicles and battle the zombies in fights that last until one side is gone. Along the way, you combine matching vehicle parts to make your machines stronger and better prepared for the chaos.

Each vehicle comes with its own set of attributes and abilities, so choosing the right one matters. Merging identical parts is the key to building up your combat power as you go. You play with a simple mouse click or t
pixel-gun-apocalypse-4-zombie-invazion: Fans of zombie hunting can choose from a wide range of weapons. Each match takes place across several maps, where you battle phantom bots in a Minecraft style, often many at the same time. Even with every weapon in your arsenal, you still have to face the undead as rival fighters. The situation is one you can never fully prepare for.

Cover is important here, so duck behind the objects scattered around each area to stay in the fight. Like most horror titles, this one leaves you with a firearm as your main way to defend yourself. Move with W, A, S, and D, and use the mouse to aim and look around. Shoot when you need to, press Tab to open the menu, and tap Space to jump.
jumping-bottle-3d: Jumping Bottle 3D is a 3D arcade game built around the fun of tossing a bottle. Its gameplay is easy to learn and hard to put down, and it also works as a relaxing way to unwind and ease stress.

Your goal is to clear every level by sending the bottle over obstacles without letting it touch the floor. You can also interact with objects around you to move through stages. With more than 200 levels, each one offers a real challenge. Collect gold caps to unlock dozens of stylish skins and unique bottles,
duck-you: Tap to send ducks onto a track that keeps moving. Your task is to spot the gaps and slide each duck into place, using good timing and quick reflexes. Keep the line of ducks flowing, pull off trickier moves, and avoid the silly crashes that follow a misstep. As the challenge ramps up, the chaos grows with it.

Along the way, you can unlock peculiar mystery ducks, grab handy bonuses, and stumble upon fun mini-games. Every tap has an impact, every duck has a part to play, and fresh surprises keep turning up. Follow the on-screen hints to learn the timing, and try to keep everything moving without a single crash.
math-driving-test: This math-themed driving challenge asks you to steer a car and grab objects until you have collected the requested number of unit cubes. Speed counts, so try to finish each collection as quickly as you can. To pass a level, you must earn a medal.

Watch out for obstacles, because hitting a tree, a building, or a fence three times fails the game. You can accelerate and steer with the arrow keys, with W, A, S, and D, or with the arrow buttons on mobile.
body-race: Body Race is an arcade game with a 3D look and gameplay that is hard to put down. Your character never stops walking along a platform, so you are always on the move. Each level asks for a different energy value, and the first one sets the target at 10,000 calories. To reach each goal, you eat high-protein, high-energy foods. The game is also pitched as a playful way to build confidence about losing weight.
The challenge is seeing how many levels you can clear by picking foods that match what each stage demands. To start, just slide to play.
monster-versus-human: Pick a team in Monster Versus Human and see the fight from either side. Humans search the darkness armed with flashlights and guns, trying to stay alive. Monsters see perfectly in the dark and stalk their targets to gather vials that make them stronger. The goal is to wipe out the other team in this tense contest of shadows and survival.

Move your character with the WASD keys or the arrow keys. Each side plays differently, so your choice shapes how you approach every encounter. Expect a lot of suspense as you creep through the gloom, weighing when to hide and when to strike.
