Afterward, you get a comparison with the original, your errors highlighted, and the inspector's harsh verdict. Each level brings bigger gaps, less time, and more absurd accidents.
pumpkin-dungeon-of-doom: Pumpkin Dungeon Of Doom is a Halloween adventure that sends you through 100 levels filled with monsters, traps, and peril. Your task is to escape all 100 dungeons, and this action puzzler asks for both sharp thinking and quick reactions. Bats will swoop in to chase you, ghosts will try to fool you, and monsters lurk in unexpected spots. Hazards such as spikes, guillotines, poison gas, and more stand in your way.

The game has a cute, colorful look paired with cool, creepy music that suits the season. It is easy to pick up and very addictive, so it's simple to lose track of time. Controls are straightforward: use a mouse click or a tap to play.
car-rush-super: Car Rush Super is a racing game where you pick your own car and line up for a race against rival drivers. Hold your finger or mouse button down to dodge other vehicles on the track so you don't crash into them. Keep weaving through the traffic until you cross the finish line.

Controls are easy to learn, since a mouse click or tap is all it takes. Choose your car, enjoy the race, and keep dodging until you reach the final line. It is filed under racing games, so you can expect a race from start to finish.
object-73-survival-clicker: You play as Object 73, a clone waking up inside the underground Jericho Complex in a post-apocalyptic world. Each death sends you back to life, and every new cycle offers another chance to uncover the truth behind the Jericho Project. This survival clicker blends idle and RPG mechanics. You click to strike mutants, rogue synthetics and combat drones, and the defeated foes leave behind materials you can use.

Search ruined laboratories, armories, archives and contaminated sectors for food, water, materials, caps and ammunition. Spend them on crafting, upgrading gear and buying items in the shop, so you can take on elite enemies and story bosses. Memory fragments, hidden logs and secret files slowly reveal the story of Colonel Dmitry Yankovsky, and your decisions shape the hero's humanity level and how the tale unfolds.
soccer-hero: Soccer Hero is a one-player football game that lets you pick from several characters. As you play, you can build up and improve each one. You move your player and strike the ball using on-screen buttons. Press the buttons to steer your character and choose how you kick.

The game is built around a single player working through football matches with characters you can grow over time. Upgrading your team members is part of the fun, and each one can be developed further as you go. Control is simple: the buttons handle both movement and the way your character kicks the ball.
arrow-pop: Arrow Pop is a quick archery game where every shot matters. You aim carefully and strike brightly colored targets across stages that grow tougher, with moving obstacles, awkward angles, and satisfying chain reactions. Unlocking new bows and arrows helps you improve your accuracy and timing. The game is simple to learn yet takes practice to master, so it suits both short breaks and longer high-score runs.

Every action uses a single tap. Tap the arrow to launch it, then tap the section that matches the required color so the shot hits the correct target and your run continues. One wrong color can end everything, so speed and accuracy both count. With hundreds of levels, colorful 3D visuals, and lively effects, each completed stage tests your reflexes and precision.
bomber-man: Bomber Man is a puzzle game where you push boxes and crates onto target spots. A stage is complete once every goal is covered, so each move needs some thought. The game includes 70 built-in levels, and their difficulty varies from one to the next.

If you want more, the Level Editor lets you extend the existing designs or build your own from scratch. Making a level is meant to be quick and easy. Everything is controlled with the mouse, so there is little to learn before you start.
egging-on: Egging On puts you in charge of a delicate egg that must climb skyward. The ground is never steady, with steep slopes, sharp edges, and awkward obstacles ready to crack your shell if you slip. Each level adds new hurdles, starting with gentle inclines and moving on to intricate platforms that demand careful timing, precision, and a calm hand on the controls.

Use W, A, S, and D to roll the egg forward, back, left, and right, and press Space to jump. Tilt and momentum play a big role, so finding the right angle before you leap is essential. Press P whenever you need to pause. As you advance, you unlock new egg skins to dress up your journey. Its colorful look and realistic physics make every move count on the way to the stars, and the goal is to reach the top without cracking.
fidget-pop-online: Fidget Pop Online lets you pop bubbles in the same way people do in the videos you've probably seen. Here you design your own fidget toy and take a calm break while you pop bubbles one at a time. Choose from a wide range of colors and shapes to make your creation look exactly how you want.
Along the way, you can merge separate parts and work through puzzles that keep you thinking. Once you pop every bubble, a new toy is ready for you to create. To pop a bubble, just tap it.
noob-big-item-sorting: Noob: Big Item Sorting is a tidy-up puzzle built around sorting and cleaning. Your job is to spot objects that look the same and bring them together so that each identical pair lines up side by side. You move items by dragging them into place, and matches are made along the bottom edge of the screen, where two matching pieces need to meet. Connect every item in a level to finish it and move on.

The mood is light and calming, a good match for anyone who loves order, regardless of age or gender. As you complete more levels, you unlock new items, avatars, and skins. The controls are simple and intuitive, so you can start sorting right away.
obby-survival-island: You wash ashore after a shipwreck on an island that offers no mercy. Your task is to survive by clearing obstacle stages filled with rising water, lava paths, broken bridges, and dangerous traps, and to reach the rescue point. Each stage is tougher than the last, and one mistake sends you back to the start, so every jump counts.

Along the way, you collect resources, craft helpful items, and lend a hand to other castaways. To win a level, you must reach its end without falling or getting eliminated. On PC, move with the Arrow Keys or W, A, S, and D. On mobile, steer with the on-screen joystick.
city-taxi-driving-simulator: Step into the driver's seat of a yellow taxi and weave through the colorful, busy city streets. Your job is to follow checkpoints, pick up passengers, and deliver them safely before time runs out. You can choose your vehicle, tackle challenging routes, avoid traffic, and collect rewards that help you unlock new driving missions.

Smooth steering, careful braking, and well-timed nitro boosts are the keys to handling your cab. Accelerate with W or the Up Arrow, brake and reverse with S or the Down Arrow, and steer with A and D or the Left and Right Arrows. Space pulls the handbrake, either Shift key fires nitro, C switches the camera view, and Escape pauses the game. Touch controls are still available on mobile devices.
village-of-colors: Village of Colors is a free online drawing game where creativity is what keeps your settlement standing. Your job is to guard the townsfolk by sketching barriers and obstacles that hold back the foes. Each villager has a distinct personality, and the enemies you face are challenging, so you will need to think ahead. When things get hectic, you can pause time and sharpen your skills so your colorful home stays safe.

Controls are simple: drag your mouse or use your finger on the screen to draw the obstacles that shield your people. Visit the store on the main menu to buy abilities that make the game easier. For a full rundown of every feature, open the Hero's Help section.
goods-master: Goods Master asks you to restore order to a cluttered storage cupboard. The idea is simple: gather matching objects in sets of three so they disappear from the shelves. The charming three-dimensional visuals make each tidy-up feel satisfying.

The game includes hundreds of stages, starting with easy sorting and building toward trickier combo challenges. When a level becomes tough, you can use boosters to get past it. This relaxing match-3 puzzler is built around clearing shelves one set at a time.
clue-hunter: Clue Hunter is a puzzle game centered on solving crimes. Anyone who enjoys detective stories or working through problems with careful reasoning should find plenty to like here. The game is split into five levels, named Help Mom, Save the Girl, Laundry Master, Loss Escape, and Strange Neighbors. Although the rules look straightforward at first, clearing each stage takes real effort. Success depends on studying small details closely and applying your analytical thinking to spot concealed objects and clues. Each case presents another tough challenge, so there is always a new mystery to work through. Control is simple: a mouse click or a tap is all it takes.
bffs-unique-halloween-costumes: Two close friends set out to find Halloween outfits that nobody else would think of. Their goal is to dig up the most imaginative and offbeat costumes they can. Along the way, you join them as they map out their ideas, pick the pieces they like, and show off the finished looks. It is a dress-up game built around Halloween, with a cute style and a focus on creating something new.

Your job is to let your imagination run wild while the pair hunts for the latest and most original styles. Each stage, from planning to choosing to presenting, is part of the fun. To play, just click with your mouse or tap the screen, and let the celebration begin.
block-party-obby-robby-mini-games: Take on other players in this multiplayer title, where every win earns you cups and coins. Spend those coins on new outfits or to boost your character's abilities. Expect a range of challenges that call for quick reflexes, clever thinking, and smart route choices. Your avatar grows sturdier and more capable with every triumph.

On a computer, move with W, A, S, D or the arrow keys, jump with the spacebar, and look around by moving the mouse. On mobile, steer with the joystick on the left, tap the right-hand button to jump, and swipe the right side of the screen to adjust the camera.
slide-to-ride: Slide To Ride puts you behind the wheel of a car seen from above, with 40 separate courses to race against the clock. Every corner is tight, so you need to guide your car carefully, and sliding through bends lets you claw back time you may have lost. Gather coins along the way to open up new cars.

On the computer, move your cursor to change direction, and press and hold the mouse button or the Space bar to engage the handbrake. On mobile, drag your finger across the screen to steer. Each track has three stars and a platinum time to aim for, and drifting well through corners is the key to lowering your final result.
guardians-of-tower: Guardians of Tower puts you in charge of protecting your castle through a quick, tactical battle. You place soldiers, towers, and powerful weapons to hold back wave after wave of attackers. Each win rewards you with coins, which you can spend on strengthening your troops and your defenses. Keep calling in reinforcements until the opposing stronghold falls. Since every improvement boosts your forces, think carefully about your approach before going for the win.
Controls rely only on your mouse. A left click sends soldiers into action, builds or upgrades towers, and activates abilities. The buttons displayed on screen help you organize your army and w
geometry-vibes-x-ball: Geometry Vibes X-Ball brings a fresh twist to the series with its X-Ball mode. It follows the first game and adds new interactive levels, a challenge section, and a brand-new store. In every level, you have to dodge obstacles, traps, and gears.

Controls are simple. Hold the left mouse button or the up arrow key to fly up, and release it to dive down. In the 2, 3, and 4 player modes, the other players are controlled with the UP ARROW, H, and L keys.
draw-joust: Draw Joust mixes the art of painting and design with combat. You join many wars, drawing your own lines to build a car in a sensible way so it can defeat its enemies. Each foe calls for a different weapon, so you will need to choose wisely as you face new opponents.
You control everything by sliding to draw and play. It suits anyone who enjoys creative design alongside 3D arena battles, and it gives you a chance to show off your talent.
backrooms-slender-horror: Backrooms Slender Horror is a casual horror game that mixes escape with hide and seek. Your task is to track down the items you need to get out of a house while outsmarting the frightening monster Slender. When he gets close, you have to hide, and you should leave the house as quickly as you can.

Movement uses the WASD keys. Press E to pick up objects and open doors, and F to drop what you are carrying. Press C to sit or stand. If you hide under the bed, you can come back out from there too. The Pause key freezes the action, and the Escape key is also part of the control set.
slime-merge-unlock-all-forms: Slime Merge: Unlock All Forms! is a relaxed idle game about merging and collecting. Across ten themed worlds, you can discover 100 different slime forms. Place slimes on a 4x5 grid that you can widen, then drag two identical ones together to create the next, stronger form. Hunt for rare Shiny slimes, which bring five times the coin income, and use Rainbow Joker slimes to upgrade any form.

Tapping slimes earns extra coins and fills the Slime Frenzy meter, while the Buy button at the bottom spawns new slimes. You can unlock up to 20 board cells. Finish customer orders at the top for bonus gems, spin the Lucky Wheel, and activate the five-minute Merge Pairs or ten-minute x2 Income boosts. Reach Form 100 to
fire-girl-and-water-boy-candy-forest: Candy Forest is a 2D platform adventure starring Fire Girl and Water Boy. You can play it alone or with a friend, and it fits into both the adventure and arcade categories. Your main task is to gather candies and push your score as high as it will go.

The game is controlled entirely from the keyboard, using the WASD keys together with the arrow keys. Whether you tackle it solo or team up with a second player, the aim stays the same: collect the candies and reach the highest score you can.
cryptograms-secret-text: Cryptograms: Secret Text asks you to crack coded sayings one at a time. Each phrase arrives with some of its letters concealed, and you work out the rest by guessing, slowly revealing the message until the whole sentence makes sense. You can pick a theme that suits your current mood, such as romance and relationships, wisdom and philosophy, films and television, or motivation and literature. Levels are played in order, so you move forward one puzzle after another.

Finishing a level earns coins, which you can spend on hints. Keep track of your mistakes and think carefully before uncovering each letter. If you get stuck, use a lightbulb or search hint and keep solving. It is a good fit for anyone who enjoys words, logic, and brain-training puzzles.
colorful-cubes: In this puzzle, you steer colorful cubes across a field of small white platforms and paint them until you have covered the required number. Along the way, you must dodge spikes, deceptive platforms that do not behave as they seem, and platforms that slow your progress down. Each move takes careful thought, since one wrong step can ruin your run.
It is a single-player game built with HTML5, so it runs right in your browser. Use the arrow keys on a computer, or touch the screen if you are playing on a phone or tablet.
unstack-tower: Take apart a stack of colored cubes in a set order in this Android puzzle. It mixes the feel of a classic board game with newer gameplay, offering hours of entertainment. Removing pieces without toppling the tower takes planning and quick reactions. Glass and wood materials add another layer of challenge to each level.

Click or tap to place or drop blocks, and rotate or shift them when you need a better fit. Three or more blocks of the same color grouped together vanish, clearing space and earning points. Place pieces unevenly or stack them too loosely, however, and the tower can collapse, ending the game.
racing-horizon: Racing Horizon is a 3D racing game set on busy highways. You weave through traffic behind the wheel of a super-powerful car. Several sports car models are available, and you can improve your ride with a range of upgrades.

You can commit to a long highway racing career or head onto an endless map instead. A police chase mission adds another kind of challenge. Multiple highway maps, a variety of cars, and several game modes keep things varied. Steer with W, A, S, D or the arrow keys, press N for NOS, and press C to change the camera view.
pimple-treatment-makeover-salon: You work as a talented makeup artist, but a business trip leaves you waking up with inflamed skin and a handful of pimples that need treating. Luckily, you already know the routine. Begin by using a popper to clear away the red patches of irritation. Next, apply a refreshing cleanser that is meant to calm inflammation.

Then buff your face with a simple scrub, and your complexion will soon look radiant. To finish, smooth on a rich moisturizer made to balance oily skin. Playing is easy: just click or tap with your mouse to get going.
cooking-lunch-at-school: Want something fun to pass the time? This cooking simulation puts a twist on school life: the school has just started offering cooking lessons, so students can make meals right on campus. Hamburgers, fresh salads, and fried chicken are the dishes your classmates like best. Press the start button, then follow the on-screen directions as you work through each step of making these foods.
You don't need any real-life kitchen experience to join in. Use your mouse or tap the screen to play, and by the end you'll feel like a skilled cook.
craft-theft-war: Craft Theft War is an open-world action-adventure sandbox game inspired by pixel voxel cube craft style online shooters. Its sprawling sandbox setting holds a wide mix of action-packed, cool, and relaxing games, so there is plenty to try. The title blends open-world adventure, sandbox play, and multiplayer action into one online experience. It sits in the Action category, with war and battle themes running through it.
Move with WASD and aim with the mouse, then press left click to shoot. Space makes you jump, Shift lets you sprint, and R reloads.
city-delivery-rider-simulator: Take on the role of a parcel courier zipping through a crowded city on two wheels. Your job is to carry packages to customers before the clock runs out. Follow the checkpoints along the way, weave around traffic, and keep an eye on your fuel. You can choose between motorcycles, and the routes become harder as you go.

The controls are easy to pick up. Press W or the Up Arrow to accelerate and S or the Down Arrow to reverse. Steer with A and D or the Left and Right Arrows, and tap Space to brake. Either Shift key adjusts your balance, C switches the camera view, and R resets your motorcycle. Touch controls are available on mobile devices.
fighter-legends-duo: Fighter Legends Duo takes you through a run of brawls set in temples, military grounds, deserts, caves, and several other locations. Every combatant is drawn from the greatest fighters of all time, so the whole game plays out like an all-star tournament. You pick your champion, step into the arena, and face opponents who are highly skilled.

Player 1 moves with W, A, S, and D, punches with F, kicks with G, and uses a special move with H. Player 2 moves with the arrow keys, punches with K, kicks with L, and uses a special with J. You can play solo or with a partner, and these controls are all you need to get into the fight.
mom-i-can-fly: Mom I Can Fly is a mobile arcade game in which you steer a kid through the air. Your job is to guide the child to the marked spot on screen. Each new level brings different obstacles and challenges, so you move forward one stage at a time. Its tags point to a lighthearted, funny tone.

The controls are simple. Tap the screen and keep holding to make the kid descend, then let go to rise again. Slide your finger across the screen to look around. Keep an eye on the energy bar, since you need to spend it carefully to get through each stage.
mad-truck: Mad Truck is a driving simulation that tests how steady you can keep your vehicle on tricky ground. You guide a monster truck across balanced platforms and ramps while trying to keep it stable. The regular Level mode focuses on that balance, while the Challenge Level mode switches to a normal view and asks you to drive over a variety of obstacles.

Every stage is a race to the finish line, so speed matters as much as control. Reach the end within the marked time and you will earn all three yellow stars. Controls are simple: just click the mouse or tap the screen to play.
posing-puzzle: In this funny puzzler, you reshape a group of anime girls so they can slip into different outlines before a persistent chaser reaches them. The clock is always running, so you must act quickly while keeping each character hidden. Every stage raises the difficulty, asking more from your reflexes and planning. The mix of puzzle solving and split-second choices keeps each level feeling fresh.

Controls are simple: tap a character to switch it into the pose that matches the shape on screen. When more than two characters need cover, you may have to pause and think about the order of your moves. Guide everyone to safety while avoiding capture, and keep an eye on the timer as the chase goes on.
pocket-universe: Pocket Universe lets you shape a small world of your own and expand it piece by piece. Begin by collecting wood, stone, metal, and crystals, then spend what you gather to open up new lands. Each area brings its own scenery, from lush meadows to frozen tundras and volcanic regions, with more kinds of biomes waiting to be discovered.

Better tools let you harvest rarer materials, so keep upgrading your gear as you progress. Along the way, you will face monsters, golems, and wild creatures guarding the parts of the map you have not explored yet. Over time, your tiny world grows into a whole universe. The controls are simple: move your character with the joystick, then mine rocks, trees, and crystals as you go.
merge-balls-shooter-2048-connect-fruits: Merge Balls Shooter 2048 Connect Fruits is a free puzzle game that mixes the number-merging idea of 2048 with the feel of billiards, all set in a colorful fruit theme. You fire fruit balls and try to match balls that show the same number. When two matching balls meet, they combine, giving you bonus balls and unlocking new fruit balls. The game has a series of tricky levels, and the sound effects are soft and satisfying to listen to. Your goal is to clear each level while chasing a high score.

Aim carefully, since every shot counts when you are trying to build up your combinations. Clearing the level is the main target, and the more smart merges you make, the better your score will climb. The game runs in your browser and is designed to keep you entertained from one round to the next.
stickman-jump: Stickman Jump is a fast-paced platform game where a small stickman sprints at full speed across a series of platforms. Your job is to leap over obstacles and complete each level, and the timing has to be precise. As you go further, the challenges grow and put your reflexes and concentration to the test.

Each level is built to be harder than the one before, so you will need to sharpen your timing and coordination as you progress. The minimalist design keeps the focus on the jumps, and the gameplay appeals to fans of skill-based jumpers. On a desktop, press the spacebar to jump. On mobile, tap the on-screen jump button. Avoid falling into gaps or bumping into obstacles.
christmas-drive: Christmas Drive is a lighthearted 2D racing game where you gather coins and use them to purchase new vehicles. Head to the shop to boost your car's engine power and improve its wheels. The game is also tagged for mobile play, so you can enjoy it on a phone or tablet.

To steer, press the A and D keys or the left and right arrow keys. Each new car you buy gives you a different ride to explore, and every upgrade helps your vehicle handle the festive tracks a little better. It is a relaxed way to pass some time while collecting rewards and tuning your machine.
my-dogy-virtual-pet: Say hello to Dogy, a cuddly little puppy who depends on you for affection and daily care. In this virtual pet simulator you look after him by serving meals when his appetite kicks in, washing him so he stays tidy, and joining in playtime to lift his mood. When he gets sleepy, you can settle him into bed for a proper nap. He responds to the way you treat him, so the more attention you give, the happier he becomes.

Whether you adore animals or simply want something sweet and calming to pass the time, this game offers a cozy little companion. You get all the pleasure of owning a pet with none of the cleanup. To interact, use your mouse or tap the screen, then follow the on-screen prompts. Icons at the top show how Dogy's needs are changing. Keep each bar filled by tending to what he needs in every room.
maze-bomber-game: Navigate your way through a maze packed with obstacles and explosive hazards. You move through the twisty corridors, drop bombs in smart spots, and blast open a route forward, all while staying clear of the blasts that could catch you. Each level ends once you find the best path, break through the blocks in your way, and reach the exit.
Play is simple: a mouse click or a tap is all you need. React quickly, step carefully, and work your way through every maze until you have mastered them all.
blast-out-battle-royale: This 3D shooter drops you into a vast battleground where you must search for weapons. Use a vehicle to travel across the land, and try to shoot every enemy to claim the win. It's a single-player experience, so you face the challenge on your own.

Movement uses W, A, S and D, while the left mouse button fires your weapon. Scroll the mouse wheel to switch between weapons, press R to reload, and press F to enter a vehicle. Space makes your character jump, and P pauses the game.
animal-merge: In Animal Merge, you combine bubbles that show animals to grow them into more developed creatures. Your goal is to keep joining matching bubbles until you have gathered a set of fully grown animals. To shoot a bubble, tap it to select it, then drag it backward to set your angle. Let go, and it flies forward in the direction opposite your pull.

When two identical bubbles touch, they fuse into an upgraded version of that animal. Combining two basic bubbles gives you a middle-level animal, and combining two middle-level ones produces the final, fully grown animal. That final animal is collected automatically and counts toward the level goal. You clear the level once you have collected the number of final animals it requires.
super-stunt-car-7: Super Stunt Car 7 is a 3D driving game built around stunts, with levels that range from relaxed to demanding. In the online multiplayer arena, you race against other players and fine-tune your vehicle along the way. The game offers customisable cars, including muscle cars and monster trucks, and each car can be upgraded from stunt-level models up to monster car levels.
Courses mix jump ramps, loops, fire rings, and obstacles across racing tracks, skill tracks, and puzzle tracks. St
sweet-baby-taylor-summer-travel: Sweet Baby Taylor Summer Travel is a simulation game set during the warm months. You spend the season at the beach alongside Taylor and her friends, but first there is tidying to do. Taylor's home is a mess, so you scrub the rooms, press wrinkled clothes, swap outfits, and get her into the bath.

Her vehicle needs attention before the trip, too. Check the tires for leaks, fill the water tank, wipe away stains, and get the truck ready to hit the road. Between chores, you can mix up juices and smoothies to keep everyone refreshed and happy all summer long. Play by clicking the mouse or tapping the screen.
war-groups: War Groups drops you into the Zone, a dangerous region where your aim is to take control of every sector and wipe out your opponents. You pick a faction, such as stalkers, bandits, military, or sectarians, from more than ten distinct groups. Gathering artifacts lets you strengthen your forces, and swapping equipment with others can help you stay ahead.

Travel across more than fifteen sectors filled with anomalies, mutants, and hostile forces. Team up with other players through alliances, or start wars against rival factions to claim power. Sharpen your tactics as you go, since a sound strategy is what carries you toward becoming the master of the Zone.
i-can-paint: I Can Paint is a relaxing, casual graffiti game with a 3D feel, listed under Arcade. You push a paint bucket around the screen to set it moving, and as it travels it begins to build a picture of stars. If you prefer to be creative, you can skip that design and draw whatever you like, which makes it a good fit for kids and anyone who wants to unwind.
Getting started is simple: just tap to play. The game is built for relaxation, so you can take your time as you go.
3d-fps-target-shooting: This first-person shooter, presented in 3D, asks you to hit various targets and build up your score. Gameplay stays straightforward: line up your weapon, fire, and aim for higher points. The gun controls feel simple and distinctive, and you can aim and shoot with just one hand.

Three weapons, the Kar98k, M24, and AWM, can be unlocked with coins you collect by passing levels. The game is completely free, and you can play it online on any device. To begin, click the mouse or tap the screen.
go-balloons: A fairground squirrel watches his balloons drift away on a sudden breeze, so he climbs the building fronts after them. Go Balloons! is an endless pixel wall-runner. Cling to a wall, tap once to leap across, and grab balloons mid-air. Higher up, the pace quickens and the hazards multiply, including ledges, signs stuck to the walls, and pig
chainsaw-3d: Chainsaw 3D is an arcade game you can play online, where your job is to slice through logs with a chainsaw. It runs free on several platforms and mixes skill with puzzle-style thinking. Each new level asks for steady focus.

You steer the saw by rotating it up and down, using your mouse or your finger. Dodge the obstacles along the way and cut right along the lines. The goal is to rise to the top as a woodcutter, so keep cutting until you stand as the best woodcutter around.
tie-dye-game: This game is about tie dye, and you will learn about it as you play. You run a shop on a beach, where a steady stream of customers arrives every day wanting to try the craft. You teach each guest how it's done, using your own skill to guide them.

You also design tie dye clothing to suit each customer's appearance. Choosing the right style for a charming lady or a handsome gentleman is one of the challenges. For extra flair, you can add cute stickers or spray patterns to their clothes. The game is played with a mouse or by tapping the screen.
noobik-arena-99-nights: Step into this quick 3D survival arena and fight waves of monsters as your hero. Along the way you collect coins and experience, unlock upgrades, and improve your weapons. Between waves, place turrets, fences, or barracks by picking one and clicking the arena. Select any building to view its stats and open its upgrades.
Your goal is to last as long as possible, mixing weapons, grenades, d
hangman-2-4-players: Hangman, the classic paper guessing game, is now available to play in your browser. Rather than competing against the computer, you can play with your friends. The game offers 2, 3, or 4 player modes. On your turn, choose a letter you think is in the hidden word, then try to guess the complete word. The player who knows the most words beats their opponents. You can pick a word pool of colors, animals, or fruits, or select the "ALL" option to include every word in the game. Controls are simple: use your mouse to select letters.
impossible-car-stunt-game: Take on a demanding driving test in Impossible Car Stunt Game. You will pull off wild stunts, speed along tough tracks, and launch your car off ramps while steering it past obstacles that are nearly impossible to clear. Your driving ability gets tested at every turn, since you must dodge hazardous traps along the way. Each stage you finish brings a fresh stunt adventure, and your goal is to clear every level and reach the finish line.

The controls are simple. Press W or the Up Arrow to move forward, S or the Down Arrow to move back, A or the Left Arrow to move left, and D or the Right Arrow to move right. Any buttons on screen are selected with your mouse.
tile-match-camp: Tile Match Camp is a calm triple-match puzzler set in an outdoor camping landscape. You wander through woodland, campsites, and other open-air trips while lining up colorful objects. Tap a tile to send it into the collection tray, then gather three identical tiles to clear them from the board. Each cleared set uncovers new challenges.

The tray holds only a limited number of tiles, so think a few moves ahead and avoid letting it fill up. Finish every tile on the board to complete a level and move further along the adventure. Charming visuals, smooth gameplay, and hundreds of puzzles make this a good pick for anyone who enjoys casual brain training and easygoing puzzle play.
box-tap-sort: Box Tap Sort is a head-to-head 3D color-sort puzzle. You take apart stacks of bright, candy-toned cubes by tapping the exposed ones that match one of the three color orders along the bottom of the screen. Each order shows how many cubes of its color you still need to remove.

Tapping a cube of the wrong color sends it to your holding bin, which has seven slots. If every slot fills up, the current puzzle resets. Clear a whole structure to finish it, and try to clear more puzzles than your rival before the 90-second timer runs out. Drag to rotate the stack, and pinch or scroll to zoom in and out.
banana-farm: Banana Farm is a business game made for cat lovers. You play as a capable feline entrepreneur who runs a market and keeps its daily operations on track. Recruit adorable cat workers to make the shop run more efficiently, and grow bananas and other products to sell. Charming cat customers will line up to be served as you build your store into a full supermarket.
Controls are simple: click with your mouse or tap the screen to play. The game is listed under hypercasual and simulation, with cat as its main theme.
ball-bounce-try-it: Ball Bounce is a casual title that blends fun with a real challenge. The ball never stops bouncing, so your job is to steer it toward the portal while it passes through the obstacles in its path. Every bounce keeps the action moving, and working your way around the barriers is what makes the game tricky.
On desktop, the left and right arrow keys move the ball left and right. On mobile, press the right side of the screen to move the ball left, and press the left side to move it right.
grand-nitro-formula: A major race is about to start, and you are invited to take your place in it. You can join the championship, run practice races, or go for time attack races. Pick the mode you prefer, purchase your formula car, and let the racing begin.

Plenty of customization choices are available so you can make your ride truly yours. Steer with W, A, S, and D or the arrow keys, and trigger your NOS boost with F. Press B to look back, and hold SPACE to use the handbrake.
11-kisses: 11 Kisses is a puzzle game where you help Angel-Girl and Demon-Boy, two lovers who are working hard to be together again. You move through varied landscapes, solving brainpower challenges that clear the way past each obstacle in their path. The game works on both mobile and desktop, so you can play on whichever device suits you.

Your job is to plan a sensible route that brings the pair back together. Place objects in smart spots to guide them along the way, and think a few steps ahead so they can reach each other. The story is a romantic tale of two people finding their way back to one another, told through each puzzle you solve.
insect-exploration: Insect Exploration is an obby that puts you in control of a bug as you meet snails, spiders, grasshoppers, and other insects. Your bug moves by hopping, flying, and bouncing, and you'll need all three to make progress in this bug simulator. Your main job is to guide the bug onto the targeted block so it can be unblocked.

The game is simple to understand but takes practice to master, so it's easy to start and rewarding to improve at. If you enjoy obbys or animal-themed games, this one offers a lively world of crawling creatures to explore.
screw-master-nuts-and-pin-jam: Screw Master: Nuts & Pin Jam is a puzzle title built around bright, cheerful screws. Your job is to sort them out and pair up the ones that share a color until the board is cleared. Every decision matters, so you will need to think a few steps ahead as you work through levels that grow more difficult over time.

To play, tap a screw to pull it into one of the trays, then keep sorting. Matching screws of the same color clears them from the board. Place them with care, since filling the trays is something you want to avoid. If you get stuck, boosters are there to help you keep going. Clear all the target screws in a level to finish it and unlock new challenges.
road-madness: Road Madness combines fast driving with gunfire, so it suits anyone who likes race cars with weapons. As you go further, you can upgrade your vehicle and unlock more destructive cars. Expect flashy visual effects and power ups along the way. You will also hunt new bosses, and you can earn achievements for taking them down.

Shoot enemy cars and upgrade your gear so you can survive the higher levels. Steer around obstacles and collect the power ups that special enemies drop once they are destroyed. Each level ends with a boss, and you must defeat it before you can progress further.
offroad-jeep-game-2026: Offroad Jeep Game 2026 seats you behind the wheel of four-wheel-drive jeeps and sends you across rugged mountains, stony trails, slippery mud, steep slopes, and demanding off-road courses. It gives you a chance to sharpen your driving and see how well you cope with the harshest landscapes.

You control powerful off-road jeeps as you travel through tough settings scattered with boulders, hills, dirt tracks, and tricky barriers. Your goal is to keep the vehicle balanced while working your way to the destination. Use W, A, S, and D or the arrow keys to drive forward, left, back, and right, and use the mouse whenever you need to click a button.
bubble-shooter-party: Bubble Shooter Party is a shooting game where you aim and fire bubbles at the ones already on screen. Your goal is to hit a bubble of the same color so the matching group can be cleared. Through these shots, you work toward freeing the chocolate candy.

Keep a close eye on the board, because you need to stop the bubbles from spreading across it. Every shot counts, so aim with care and keep going until the candy is free. This casual title is built around matching colors and clearing bubbles one shot at a time.
liverpool-vs-real-2022: Pick either Liverpool F.C. or Real Madrid and aim for the title in this soccer game. Expect to kick the ball and keep the other side from scoring, since both attacking and defending shape your route to the trophy. It is a sports arcade experience built around quick, simple actions.

When you have the ball, use your mouse or finger to choose the kick's direction, then set how high it lifts and how much it curves. On defense, watch for the keeper's gloves to appear on screen, and tap or click them to make your save.
about-a-frog: In this puzzle game, you guide a frog past a variety of obstacles. Clearing them activates the sail on a small raft, which carries you further along your journey. Each challenge calls for careful thinking, so take your time to work out your next move.

Movement uses the arrow keys or the W, A, S, and D keys, sending the frog up, down, left, or right. Press R to restart, Q to return to the menu, and M to mute the sound. On mobile, on-screen buttons handle the controls, and gamepads are supported too.
escape-wednesday: Escape Wednesday is a 3D action game where you find your way out of a maze by breaking through the monsters that block your path. The labyrinths come in many shapes, so there is always something new to figure out. Every stage brings its own obstacles, and you need both skill and careful planning to get past them. Creatures lurk around every corner, so you must think a step ahead of them to reach the exit.

Steering is simple: move your mouse to change the direction you head in. Read each layout carefully, stay sharp, and show what you can do to come out on top. Success depends on quick reactions and clever choices as you work through each twisting passage. Fans of escape and monster challenges will find plenty to keep them busy.
the-ironic-zombie: This HTML5 return of The Ironic Zombie brings more adventure and picks up the story right where the earlier game left off. A mocking zombie meets a young adventurer and urges him to fight the wicked undead. The young man barely follows what the zombie says, but he grabs his gun and sets out on his quest.

The mocking zombie is strong enough to lift rocks and hurl them, while the young hero relies on his firearm and his wits to destroy the evil zombies. The game supports two players. The zombie moves with the arrow keys, fires with L, carries and throws the box with K, and changes weapons with U. The adventurer moves with W, A, S, and D, shoots with F, tosses grenades with G, and switches weapons with Q. The outcome is up to you.
pongoal: Pongoal blends the familiar paddle play of Pong with the feel of football. You guard your goal with a paddle, read your rival's moves, and try to slot the ball past them. The pace is quick, and the mood borrows the tension of a penalty shootout, so every rally counts.

You can face computer rivals at one of three difficulty settings, or invite a friend to share the screen in local multiplayer. The first player to reach the winning score takes the match. Ball physics shift dynamically, touch controls feel responsive, and every goal is marked with a celebration. On phones and tablets, tap the UP or DOWN button to move your paddle, or hold them to keep it moving. On a keyboard, use the up and down arrow keys or W and S.
miniko-isometric-puzzle: Miniko is an isometric puzzle where you must eat all the food on the board without getting trapped. You can slide across the grid, use teleporters, push boxes, and drag tiles into place. Bombs, keys, and gears add more pieces to think about as you search for the perfect route. It is simple to pick up, but mastering every stage is a real challenge.

Controls are easy to follow. Click or tap a tile to move in a straight line or diagonally. Movable tiles can be dragged to new spots. If you make a mistake, press Undo to step back and try another route. Tagged under Puzzle and Logic, it asks you to plan each move carefully.
ball-jump-switch-the-colors: Each tap sends your ball bouncing higher, and it always shows a single color. When it meets an obstacle in that same shade, it can pass straight through. When the colors differ, you need to slip into a gap between the pieces instead. Rotating barriers keep the timing tricky, so every jump counts.

Grab stars along the way to change the ball's color on the fly and match the next section. Avoid deadly crashes as you climb as high as you can and chase a top score. On a computer, click the mouse or press the spacebar to bounce. On mobile, simply tap the screen. The game is easy to pick up and keeps you coming back for one more try.
bus-color-jam: Bus Color Jam is a mobile puzzle game about matching passengers to buses of the same color. It feels relaxed, but the colorful puzzles still require some careful thought. Each level is harder than the last, so you will need to plan ahead to send every traveler off on their dream trip.

Tap a passenger to send them toward the bus. If their color matches, they board right away. If not, they wait in the empty tiles provided. If you run out of empty tiles and a passenger with the wrong color reaches the bus, the level is lost. You must board every passenger on the correct bus to finish a level, and completing one earns you coins.
xo-with-buddy: XO With Buddy is a two-player puzzle game played on a board of open squares. To make a move, tap or click any empty spot and your symbol appears there. Take turns with your partner and keep an eye on the board. You win by lining up three of your symbols in a row, whether that line runs up and down, side to side, or on a diagonal.

The game is built with HTML5 and is listed for mobile play, so it can be opened on a phone or tablet as well as a computer. Controls are simple, and a mouse or touch pad is all you need. It falls under the Puzzles category and also carries Board and Arcade tags.
drift-master-3d: Drift Master 3D is an arcade driving game centered on drifting, where good timing matters most. You sit behind the wheel of powerful cars and slide through sharp bends on roads that grow narrower. Dodge obstacles and try to survive as long as you can.

Gather coins and chain drifts into combos to boost your score and climb the leaderboards. Coins unlock four cars with distinct styles, from the classic street racer Blaze to the fierce Phoenix. Corners are generated as you go, so no two runs match. On PC, hold the left mouse button or the spacebar to drift right, then release to drift left. On mobile, tap and hold anywhere on the screen to drift right, and lift your finger to drift left.
zombie-mission-11: Zombie Mission 11 continues the story in an underwater world. Zombies have invaded the seas, and sea creatures have turned into zombies too. This eleventh level introduces new mechanics, new characters, and vehicles, and it opens a completely new adventure. It is an action shooter with a playful tone and a two-player option.

Player 1 moves with W, A, S, and D, jumps with W, and can walk on walls and swim upward. Press C for a quick hit, or hold C and release it for a mega hit. V throws a grenade, and Q and E switch weapons. When the special bar is full, Q or E unleashes a special attack. Player 2 moves with the arrow keys.
euro-truck-driving-game: Take the wheel of powerful European trucks in this driving title. Your job is to haul valuable freight from place to place while completing tough missions along the way. The roads look true to life, and the scenery around them is lovely to take in. If you enjoy long-distance runs, demanding routes, or simply love big rigs, you will find plenty here, since every trip brings a fresh challenge. It is listed under racing and adventure.

Controls are simple. Press W or the Up arrow to move forward, and S or the Down arrow to move back. Use A or the Left arrow to move left and D or the Right arrow to move right. Any button on screen is clicked with the mouse.
foot-bomb: Foot Bomb takes soccer and swaps the ball for a live explosive. You kick the bomb along the field and sprint toward the goal before the timer runs out. It is a silly, fast take on the sport that keeps the pressure high from the first kick to the final whistle.

Move with the W, A, S and D keys, and use the mouse to look around the pitch. Your job is to get the bomb into the goal post before it goes off. Every second counts, so keep an eye on the countdown and make your kicks count.
mask-evolution-3d: Mask Evolution 3D is a parkour-style run where you guide a mask along the track. Passing it through digital gates raises its worth. Along the way, you can gather decorations and attendants, which give the mask a more artistic look. When your creation is ready, put it up for auction to sell it at a high price and earn more cash.
Watch out for hazards such as spikes lying on the road, since they lower your mask's value. If the value drops to zero, the run ends in failure. Control is simple: click or tap to play.
color-the-room: Color the Room is a relaxed 3D coloring game where you can choose settings such as a castle, a witch hut, a space station, an underwater scene, a garden, or a graffiti loft. Every object can be brought back to life with brushes, fills, and textures. Keep your favorite looks in save slots, and earn points while climbing the leaderboards.
On desktop, the left mouse button paints, the right button rotates the camera, Shift plus right
live-round: Eight cities ring a central arena, and the Core keeps firing meteors in every direction. Your goal is to steer those rocks onto rivals instead of your own city. In this eight-player arcade game, you launch blasts to alter their paths, position your deflector, and survive a battlefield that grows more frantic. After each round, you pick upgrades that reshape how you play.

Losing your city doesn't end your involvement, since you can keep sabotaging the players still alive. Matches run online, against bots, or in private rooms, across five modes: Defence, Paddle, Vault, Invaders and Belt. Where paddles appear, move your mouse to control yours. In modes that allow it, click to shoot missiles, but watch your ammo. After elimination, pick a sabotage, then click where you want to deploy it.
funny-rescue-gardener: Samantha is a skilled gardener, yet even experienced people sometimes have bad luck while working outdoors. In this simulation, your job is to rescue her after a nasty mishap and help her heal from her injuries. The game is meant to be silly and lighthearted, so expect plenty of humor along the way.

To play, click on items, tools, and buttons with your mouse on a computer, or tap the touch screen to pick and use your choices on a phone or tablet. The layout adjusts to fit whatever device you are using, so the experience stays smooth either way.
crazy-mafia-drift-car: Give your mafia-themed ride a full makeover, then take it out onto the streets of a large urban map. Almost every bend offers a chance to slide through a drift. The Drift Trial puts your driving to the test, asking you to master sliding turns and rack up points for every smoky, tyre-squealing corner you take.

The game pairs a thumping soundtrack with a gangster atmosphere, aiming to make you a known name in the city's drifting crowd. Steer with W, A, S, D or the arrow keys, and use the spacebar for the handbrake. Press R to repair your car, C to switch camera views, and Escape to open the pause menu. Press M to mute or unmute the music.
chubby-finn: Chubby Finn is a charming puzzle game in the style of Sokoban. Your job is to guide a plump, lovable seal as it nudges balls onto their matching targets. Finn can move up, down, left, or right, so every step needs some thought. Keep in mind that balls only slide when pushed and cannot be dragged back, which makes careless moves easy to regret.

Each stage presents a maze of awkward layouts that tests your reasoning, planning, and ability to work through problems. Your aim is to finish every stage without boxing yourself into a dead end. Use the arrow buttons to control Finn and see how far your logic can take the little seal.
battleground-survival-2023: In this multiplayer survival title, you land on a deserted island and must stay alive long enough to become the last player or team still standing. As a capable survivor, you will rely on quick thinking, careful planning, and fighting skill to outlast your opponents across this virtual battleground.
Here is how the controls work. Use W, A, S and D to walk, hold SHIFT to run, and use the mouse to aim and shoot. Scroll the wheel to change your gun, and press TAB to open the menu.
summer-punch-party: In this first-person action and fighting game, you throw punches at waves of foes across bright tropical islands. Silly gloves can be unlocked, and ragdoll physics send enemies tumbling when you connect. Launching troublemakers into the sea is a valid tactic too.

Walk across each island, outlast the incoming enemies, and knock out the required number to clear a level. Punch foes directly or fling nearby objects into the crowd. Finishing levels opens new islands and boxing weapons. On desktop, WASD moves you, the mouse looks and aims, left click
plane: In this puzzle game, you fly a small plane that must avoid bombs fired from a rotating cannon. Collecting stars along the way raises your score. Watch which direction the cannon turns and keep your plane on the opposite side, since that is the best way to stay protected. Now and then the cannon flips upside down without warning, so stay alert and fly like a skilled pilot.
Controls are simple: tap anywhere on the screen to change the direction your plane is moving. Good timing is essential, because staying out of harm's way while grabbing stars is the whole challenge.
fruit-drop-3d: Fruit Drop 3D is a bright puzzle game built around physics and merging. Your job is to release fruits into a container and pair up identical ones so they fuse into bigger, more valuable fruit. Your goal is to grow the biggest fruit you can. Think ahead before each release, let gravity and collisions work in your favour, and try to top your previous best score while keeping the container from spilling over.

Control is simple. Slide the fruit left or right with your mouse or finger, then click or tap to let it fall. When two matching fruits touch, they merge into a larger one and earn you points, so keep chaining merges to climb the score. If the stack rises high enough to reach the top of
sheep-sort: Sheep Sort asks you to line up a flock by color. Tap each sheep and pair it with others of the same shade. A puzzle is cleared once every sheep is sorted and matched correctly, and finishing a level unlocks the next challenge. The game is laid back and easy to pick up, with plenty of cute sheep to look at.

As you advance, the puzzles grow tougher, but grouping the sheep stays satisfying. When a stage feels too difficult, you can use boosts to sort faster and handle the trickiest arrangements. It is a relaxed color-matching puzzle where calm, cute sheep make for a pleasant session.
devil-die: Devil Die begins as a charming 2D platformer, but it soon reveals its true nature. Floors vanish without warning, spikes burst from nowhere, and a door that looks safe turns into a trap. You guide a small pixel hero to the exit door on every stage.

The controls are easy to learn. On mobile, use the left and right arrows to move and the jump button to clear gaps and hazards. On a PC or laptop, press A and D to move and the space bar to jump. Each level hides tricks such as collapsing platforms, sudden buzzsaws, sliding walls, reversed controls, and fake safe zones. Touch any trap and you die and restart the level. The game starts gently, then grows into a rage-style challenge where every step could be a trap.
mini-games-relax-collection: Mini Games Relax Collection is built to help you unwind. It bundles five activities into one game: Clean Makeup, Fix Teeth, Shave, and two versions of Left/Right, labeled 1 and 2. Nothing here demands special talent, so people of any age can pick it up and start right away.

The aim is to lift the strain of dull, repetitive work and leave you feeling calm and content. Each round is a gentle way to clear your mind and brush worries aside. Controls are simple: click with your mouse or tap the screen to play.
bts-rabbit-coloring-book: BTS Rabbit Coloring Book is a free online coloring game for babies and kids. It is so engaging that it's hard to stop once you begin, and it fits neatly into any spare moment you have.
Four pictures are ready for you to choose from, and each one features sweet rabbits. Show what you can create by filling them in and painting
zombie-mission-10: Zombie Mission 10 brings back the Prison Breakout chapter. Zombies have seized the underground prison, so your job is to free the captives while also tending to the wounded. This expanded edition offers 30 levels to battle through. Seven bosses appear at various stages, and the toughest one waits in the final level. Between stages, spend the coins you collect on new weapons and upgrades.

Play alone or with a friend in two-player mode. Player one moves with W, A, S and D, attacks with F, throws grenades with G, jumps with W, and switches weapons with Q and E. Player two uses the arrow keys to move, L to attack, K for grenades, the up arrow to jump, and O and P to swap weapons. Both players can walk along walls.
design-with-me-cute-tie-dye-tops: Three rainbow girls, Sunny, Skyler and Ruby, are getting ready for a holiday and want crop tops that look one of a kind. Your job is to help them design their outfits. Start by picking a crop top model, then select the color and pattern of the fabric. Next, add a cute inscription, and finally match the top with a skirt or shorts.

All of the actions are done with a left mouse click. The game is filed under girls, dress up, makeover, fashion and decoration, so it suits anyone who enjoys putting together looks and trying out tie dye designs.
nubik-courier-an-open-world: Nubik Courier: An Open World casts you as a skilled pizza courier racing through lively city streets. Every delivery asks you to steer around obstacles and get the food to its destination. Once a drop-off is finished, you can swap to a different vehicle before the next one begins.
The game is free to play online and run
idle-bank: Idle Bank blends management with simulation, placing 3D stickman characters inside a bank. You take control of the manager and work to develop the place step by step. Your starting money unlocks a basic Reception that can absorb customers. When people arrive and leave their savings with you, you collect that cash to open new facilities and hire assistants.
Upgrades matter too, since you can improve your character for better capacity and higher speed. The game is played with mouse clicks or taps, so you only need a click or tap to get going.
city-husle: Hit the road in this 3D arcade driving game set in a lively, colorful city. Your job is to carry packages to their destinations while staying one step ahead of the police. As you finish runs, your reputation grows across town, and the streets become the place where you make your name.

Move and drive with the on-screen controls or with the W, A, S and D keys. Follow the blue route to complete each delivery, then collect the cash you earn and use it to unlock new cars. Keep clear of the police and keep the action rolling. The game blends driving, adventure and action into one experience.
aqua-sort-water-color-puzzle: Aqua Sort: Water Color Puzzle is a relaxing game about sorting colored liquids. Your aim is to pour each shade into flasks until every flask holds only one color. With more than 1000 levels and modes called Color Fusion, Mystery, and Time Trial, the game will put your logic and patience to the test.

To move liquid, tap a flask to lift the liquid on its top, then tap another flask to pour it in. You can only pour onto a liquid of the same color or into an empty flask. If you get stuck, the Undo and Add Flask power-ups can help. New themes and achievements unlock as you progress.
paintwars-shoot: PaintWars Shoot is a first-person shooter where you can fight against real players or enemy bots. The game offers both multiplayer and single-player modes, so you can face live opponents or sharpen your skills on your own. Every round gives you a chance to see how well your aim holds up.

The controls are straightforward. Use W, A, S and D to move, and use the mouse to look around. The mouse also handles shooting, aiming and changing guns. Press Tab to open the menu whenever you need it.
snake-out: Snake Out is a bright, colorful puzzle game made for people who enjoy a bit of brainwork. Casual players and puzzle enthusiasts alike should find it fun, tough, and rewarding. Your goal is to work through every stage and escape each one.

You control snakes in different colors and lengths, guiding each one to its hole before time runs out. Movement works through simple dragging, which feels natural from the start. Every level presents its own challenge, so you will need to plan carefully and think several steps ahead.
pow: Have you ever looked after a pet of your own? In Pow, you feed, clean, and play with a creature while it grows up and levels up. It works on both web and mobile. You can care for your Pow, meet its needs, and watch it develop over time. Visit the games room to play a variety of games, earning coins that you can spend on food for your Pow or on decorations to personalize your room. Three playful minigames also let you test your skills against friends.

Use your mouse or tap the screen to interact with your Pow and the objects around it. Follow the on-screen prompts as you go. Vertical bars at the top of the screen show each room's needs progression for your Pow. Try to keep those bars full by taking care of what it needs in every room.
crazy-room-3d: Crazy Room 3D is a puzzle game where you create your own logic-based room. It offers a fresh style of play built around clever puzzle thinking, and each new room gives you another puzzle to work through. As you go, you combine objects to uncover new and intriguing items.

Playing is simple. Click with your mouse or tap the screen to begin, then hold an item, drag it to where you want it, and drop it into place. The same few gestures control everything, so the game is easy to pick up. It is tagged as Action, Casual, and House, which fits its home-style setting and light, relaxed pace.
shopping-simulator: Shopping Simulator is a clicker where you collect game money by tapping a hamster. That cash lets you raise your customer's level and buy items from store shelves stocked with anime, horror, food, pets, and household goods. Hundreds of heroes are gathered in one place, and the selection includes more than 500 unique items.

Progress runs through 200 leveling levels, with many mini-games and a wide range of emotions along the way. To earn money, play the mini-games and complete the puzzles, tapping the hamster as you go. Unlock new levels to work your way toward becoming the best.
liquid-sort: This calming puzzle asks you to sort colorful liquids into the correct containers. Pour carefully and gather each shade into its matching bottle until every bottle holds only one color, keeping in mind that each move affects what comes next.

Later stages bring fresh obstacles that test your logic, planning, and attention to detail. You get hundreds of handcrafted levels, smooth liquid animations, and a clean, modern look with a relaxed feel. The game is simple to pick up but takes practice to master, and with no clock running, you can move at whatever pace suits you. It works equally well for unwinding or for keeping your mind sharp.
crash-tower-3d: You pilot a powerful vehicle and aim it at 30 walls, towers, and houses that grow tougher as you go. Click or tap Start Engine to launch, then use Boost when the marker reaches the gold zone. The Space bar also handles launching and boosting if you prefer the keyboard. Every impact earns coins, which you can spend in the garage to unlock three vehicles, upgrade each one separately, and repair any that get damaged. If a structure survives your run, you can try again.

The destruction yard changes from daylight to sunset and then to a starry night. You can play with a mouse, keyboard, or touch controls. The game offers 20 languages, and the settings menu lets you adjust music and sound separately. Your progress is saved.
kings-defense-roguelike: Enemies are closing in on the kingdom, and your cannon is the only defense left. Kings Defense mixes a classic block-breaker with roguelike elements, so every shot matters. You fire chains of balls that bounce off walls and foes, damaging them, but monsters march toward the castle and strike back. Survive all 20 waves
alderun: Alderun mixes live strategy with hero-based RPG combat. You pick a champion, unlock powerful abilities, collect gear, and guide your forces through fantasy conflicts. Battles take many forms: you might hold off waves of foes attacking a castle, challenge opponents in arena duels, seize key points on the map, or clash directly with rival armies. Every map sets its own goals and calls for different tactical choices, so your approach will change from one battlefield to the next.
You can face the computer on your own or join online battles alongside friends.
party-stickman-4-player: Party Stickman 4 Player is a 2D adventure made for four friends playing side by side. Each person controls their own stickman with a separate set of keys: green uses the 5, 1, 2 and 3 keys, pink uses Y, G, H and J, blue uses W, A, S and D, and red uses the arrow keys. Together you work through 15 levels, and the game is tagged as action and arcade with 1 and 2 player options.

The challenge depends on teamwork. If any one of the four stickmen dies, the whole chapter goes back to the start, so everyone has to stay alive the entire way. Keep your timing sharp and watch out for each other, because a single slip sends the entire group back to square one.
javelin-battle: Javelin Battle is a physics puzzle game about throwing spears, and every character is drawn as a two-dimensional stickman. In Normal Mode, your goal on each level is to eliminate all the enemies heading your way. Breaking the shields of enemy infantry makes them rush at you quickly. A helpful tip is to take out the spearmen standing on platforms first. Pick skills to improve your abilities and power, and stay calm and aim with care.
Controls are simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to play. It is a one-player battle game, so every fight is yours to handle.
a-long-way-home: You take on the role of a wanderer who has lost their way and is desperately searching for the path home. Stranded in an uneasy landscape that keeps changing, you move through dim corridors and bizarre spots while creatures from beyond hunt you without rest. As the world begins to fall apart, ghostly visions and disturbing moments make it hard to tell terror from madness.

Controls are simple: move with the Arrow keys or WASD, and turn the camera with your mouse. Along the way, you can find hidden notes that widen the story's world, and your goal includes collecting every hidden Fox. The tale mixes survival, mystery, and dread, and it is up to you whether you uncover the truth behind this nightmare or fall to the horrors in the dark.
mahjong-solitaire-world-tour: Mahjong Solitaire: World Tour gives tile matching a fresh spin. By solving levels, you explore cities from around the globe on a journey through time. Striking graphics and smooth gameplay make it a good match for anyone who loves puzzles.

Your goal is to find pairs of matching tiles and tap them to remove them from the board. Only unblocked tiles can be picked, meaning a tile must have an open edge and no other tile sitting on top of it. Check which tiles are free before you tap, since covered tiles cannot be chosen.
deck-of-deception: Deck of Deception is an online bluffing card game for several players, where every coin counts. You aim to finish with the most coins and the fewest cards. On your turn, match the number the previous player called, then choose the number the next player must answer. Action cards let you drain, steal, or protect coins.

The Deception Showdown is the real test, since one wrong guess means instant elimination. Climb from Apprentice to Legend through ranked matches against real players or bots. Matches are quick, lasting up to 20 minutes, and everything works with a mouse click or screen tap, so no keyboard is needed.
only-up-obby-tower-climb: Climb a towering 3D structure one platform at a time in this parkour challenge. Thirty levels rise toward the summit, and each one adds fresh hazards such as sliding and vanishing platforms, whirling blades, crushers, moving belts, springs, gusts of wind and swinging hammers. Reach the flag at the top of a level to open the next one. Falling sends you back down, so every leap matters, and a double jump can rescue a short one.

Gather coins and diamonds to unlock more than 30 skins, including frogs, spiders, cats, dogs, capybaras and stickmen in various colors. Post your best height on the online leaderboard, or skip a level that proves too hard. The Training Hall lets you practice each obstacle first. Desktop players use the keyboard and mouse, while touch screens get a floating joystick, auto-run and one large jump button. The game is available in English and Russian.
word-string: Word String is a puzzle game built around chains of words. It appeals to fans of wordplay, brain teasers, and tricky challenges. You begin with a word that is already provided. Your job is to find the word that follows, and it must link to the previous one in one of two ways: by forming a compound word or by completing a familiar phrase. Each new link builds on the last, so the chain grows step by step until the whole sequence is complete.

For example, sun can lead to flower, and flower can lead to pot, since each pair forms a compound word. Orange can lead to juice, because the two words make a well-known phrase. The game is a fun way to test your vocabulary, logic, and creativity, and it is tagged as educational.
collect-leaves-faster-than-anyone: This three-dimensional game has you sweeping up fallen foliage with a vacuum cleaner and storing it in your bag. The leaves you gather are what you need to lay a bridge onto the next island. Your aim is to cross the finish line before your opponents, who are other players racing alongside you. Grab power-ups along the way to move ahead of the pack.

Begin by picking the mode that suits you, then jump into a match. Helpful hints appear on screen to point you in the right direction. In the game menu, you can buy upgrades and cosmetic extras to customize your play. Your pets can also give you a hand in claiming victory.
formula-apex-rush: Formula Apex Rush is an open-wheel racer where split seconds decide the outcome. You take on aggressive computer-controlled opponents on many kinds of tracks: technical Grand Prix circuits, quick sprint races, tricky street courses, and atmospheric night events. Success depends on precise steering, careful speed control through tight bends, and timing your ERS boost well so you can climb through the pack toward the podium. Upgrades in the garage raise your car's performance, and credits earned from races unlock stronger setups as the championship gets tougher.

The game focuses on responsive handling, shifting race positions, sharp cinematic visuals, and a range of event formats, all wrapped in fast arcade action. It runs on both desktop and mobile. On a keyboard, W or Up Arrow accelerates, S or Down Arrow brakes, and A/D or the Left/Right Arrows steer. Use ERS or Nitro on straights or while passing rivals for a short burst of speed. Stay on the asphalt, since grass and off-road sections will slow your car considerably. On mobile, on-screen steering, accelerator, brake, and boost controls handle the same jobs.
grimace-bullet-blender: Grimace Bullet Blender is a shooting game where you aim a bullet at Grimace. To set the aim, you click or tap the police officer, or any other object shown on the map, so the bullet is sent toward the character. When the bullet lines up perfectly with Grimace, a SHOOT button appears, ready for you to press and fire.
Getting the angle right adds precision and strategy to the game, making it an engaging experience for players of all ages. You play with a mouse click or a tap.
wars-ships-io: Wars Ships.io puts you on open water, where you sail across the sea and take on rival vessels in naval battles. Your job is to steer your ship with care, line up your cannon shots precisely, and get ahead of your foes to win each round. Every battle offers new challenges and openings for tactical skill.

Your goal is to dominate the high seas and earn the title of naval commander. The game is controlled with mouse clicks or taps. Stay focused in every fight and work toward taking control of the whole ocean.
chips-bakery-simulator: Chips Bakery Simulator puts you in charge of a full potato chip factory. You start by washing raw potatoes, then slice them paper-thin. Next, you fry the slices until they turn golden and finish by tossing them with tasty seasonings. Once your chips are bagged, you sell them to hungry customers.

It is a 2D cooking game with arcade and clicker elements, so each step comes down to quick, simple actions. Playing is easy: just click the mouse or tap the screen. Keep the production line running and see how far your snack business can grow.
advanced-car-parking-3d-simulator: Fans of parking games can now try the follow-up to what is often called the largest mobile parking simulator of all time. This entry pushes the genre into a fresh era, pairing dazzling visuals with demanding levels that unfold across several stages. Real-time online play is part of the package too.
You drive with the keyboard, and the game lists its key controls in a dedicated section so you know which keys do what. Work through each level one stage at a time as the parking tests grow toug
scratch-raw-stone-gem-master: Purchase raw stones, then gradually scrape them away to reveal what lies inside. Each rock might conceal vivid color, fine cracks, or nothing whatsoever. Partway through, you can accept the dealer's cash offer, or keep working so rare gems can be shaped into jewelry for larger returns, helping your gem workshop grow.
eat-donuts: Guide a sweet little penguin as it gathers tasty donuts in this match-3 puzzle game. Your board is a compact 3x3 grid filled with glowing donut rings. Drag them into new spots and turn them as needed so matching rings line up. Each level asks you to reach a target score before the clock runs out, and chaining matches together helps you clear it.

Hammers and rotators are available as power-ups that set off explosive matches and push your score higher. On a computer, click and drag rings to swap or spin them, using a left click to select and move pieces. On mobile, swipe your finger to slide and rotate the rings, then tap the hammer or rotator icons to use their special abilities. Cute visuals and simple controls make this a relaxing brain teaser.
halloween-final-episode: Halloween Final Episode is a point and click puzzle game in which you help a character named John. During his journey he has become stuck close to a Halloween party, and he needs your help to get away from that spot and reach the celebration. Every puzzle you work through brings him one step closer to the party.

All of the play is handled with the mouse, so you click on items and places in the scene to interact with them. It is an escape-style game built around this kind of point and click play. Wishing you luck with the adventure, and enjoy helping John make it to his Halloween celebration.
daddy-escape: Daddy Escape is a hyper casual puzzle game built around pulling pins. Your job is to work out the correct order of pin pulls so that Daddy can get out of a dangerous house before it's too late. The home is filled with threats such as monsters, villains, bombs, spikes, and lava, so every obstacle needs careful handling.

Success depends on logical thinking rather than speed. A single wrong pull can lose Daddy, so each move matters. Fans of escape games and pull-the-pin puzzles should feel right at home here, and the game also works as a brain workout for anyone curious about their IQ.
find-your-gender: Find Your Gender is a parkour game listed under racing and running. Picture being offered a second life and choosing whether to return as a boy, a girl, or someone genderless. Since everyone's answer is different, the game lets you shape your own path. Pick options and gather items that match your taste, and you will end up as a boy, a
animal-shifting-transform-run: Step into a fast-paced animal racer where your creature must change to match whatever terrain lies ahead. Picking the correct form at the right moment lets you speed up and pull ahead of the competition. The courses wind through everything from open grassland plains to dense tropical forest, and a single touch is all it takes to switch into a new animal.

Each level is harder than the last, so you need to think quickly and stay sharp. Choosing the right creature for each environment is the key to claiming first place. Shifting between clever animals keeps every race feeling fresh as you work through the many stages on offer.
spinner-clicker-2d: This two-dimensional clicker is built around progression, offering 34 fidget spinner designs split across four rarity tiers. Three core systems shape play. The idle and upgrade system lets you spin by hand and permanently strengthen your stats. The collection side lets you unlock visually striking spinners. Battle encounters pit your accumulated momentum and upgrades against bosses that grow stronger over time.
math-trivia: Math Trivia is a playful quiz game packed with clever math puzzles that teach the basics of problems, equations, sequences, and series. Along the way, it aims to build abstract and logical reasoning, encourage perseverance, sharpen your intellect and analytical skills, raise your IQ, and improve your memory.

The game is split into levels that begin simple and become more complicated and interesting as you move up. Each level includes three quizzes. For every question, tap the right answer from four choices before the timer runs out. Complete four levels to earn rewards. If you get stuck, a hint can remove one wrong spelling option.
stickman-temple-wars: Stickman Temple Wars keeps you busy for hours. Its story mode throws 40 chapters of tough tracks at you, and you tackle them solo. A two-player option lets you face a friend, and the bot settings let you take on the computer instead. Either way, you are in a gunfight on a set of moving tracks that shift from one section to the next. Whoever grabs the gun first and lands a hit on the other side takes the win.

Controls are simple to learn. In story mode, move with WASD or the arrow keys, aim with the mouse, and fire with a left click. For two players, Player 1 moves with the arrow keys, shoots with the L key, and raises a shield with the K key. Player 2 uses its own set of movement keys.
box-press-puzzle: Box Press Puzzle is a logic game where you activate pistons in the right order to push cyan cubes into the drop zone at the center. Planning ahead matters, since a poor sequence can block the pathways. You need to watch the routes carefully so that no cube gets in the way of another.
