As you advance, the layouts grow more intricate and call for more careful thought. Everything is controlled with the mouse, using simple clicks to activate the pistons. Keep working through the arrangements until you have completed every puzzle.
shape-jam: Shape Jam is a physics puzzle game where playful shapes tumble around the board. Your aim is to gather three identical shapes so they can be cleared away, leaving the board empty. Because your pick zone is limited, each choice matters, and the order you pick shapes in decides whether you succeed.

To play, tap a shape and it moves up into one of the small empty circles at the top of the screen. When three matching shapes fill slots together, they clear automatically. Keep an eye on how full those slots get, since filling them too soon with mismatched shapes makes the puzzle harder to solve. This match 3 style title works well on mobile and suits anyone who likes a brain-teasing challenge.
derby-racing: This horse racing game challenges you to reach the finish line as fast as you can without falling. Win each challenge with your horse to move on to the next one. The game has a retro style and is tagged with animal, arena, and racing themes.
To accelerate, tap the left and right arrow keys one after the other. Keep alternating between the two keys to build speed, and try to stay on your horse's feet all the way to the finish.
on-fire-basketball-shots: Picture a packed gym, a roaring crowd, and a team trailing on the scoreboard. You are the star player, and only sinking blazing shots can turn the game around. Pull back to launch the ball at moving hoops whose rims glow red-hot, which makes every attempt trickier. Chain successful shots into streaks, where every swish counts and perfect ones
moto-obby: Moto Obby puts your motorbike skills to the test as you tackle tricky challenges across various levels. Watch out for swinging hammers and sharp spikes standing between you and victory. Every level calls for quick reflexes, so keep your focus sharp. This online game can be played on both phones and computers.

Controls are easy to pick up. Use the up and down arrows, or W and S, to move, and the left and right arrows, or A and D, to spin your bike. Some stretches require you to slow down, while others require you to speed up, so try different tactics as you go. If your bike gets stuck, press the left or right arrow, or A or D, to hop free.
joker-ritual: Joker Ritual blends poker with card roguelike play. You assemble strong hands, gather Jokers whose special effects can work together, and push through rounds that keep getting harder. Earnings from play can be spent at the shop, where you can improve your hands and rework your deck using special cards.

Pick up to five cards by clicking or tapping them, then press Play Hand to score a poker combination. Each round has a target you must reach before running out of hands. Discard swaps out selected cards, while Rank and Suit sort your hand. Between rounds, the shop offers Jokers, upgrades and card packs. Mix their effects and change your approach to get past the boss rounds. Mouse or touch controls work throughout.
mergemma: MergeMMA is a casual puzzle game designed for portrait screens, blending quick merging with idle fighting. Pair up boxers of the same level by dragging one onto another to create a tougher fighter. Along the way, you can purchase and open new athletes, raise your speed and income, and refine your gym as your earnings climb. Each step forward feels satisfying, thanks to fast merges, steady progress, and animated MMA battles.

On a computer, click the buttons with your mouse and drag fighters where you want them. On a phone, tap the buttons and drag fighters with a single finger. Your goal is to build a team strong enough to win against opponents that grow more powerful over time. Win battles, unlock stronger boxers, and keep improving your gym to move forward.
assassin-ninja-rush: Assassin Ninja Rush puts you in charge of an assassin ninja who races forward while weaving past foes. You take out enemies with careful timing and planning to reach new levels. Finishing levels unlocks new characters and weapons, and gold coins can also be spent at the in-game store to get them.

Along the way, you need to dodge incoming bullets and smash crates to restore health. Each run helps you sharpen your ninja skills. This arcade-style 3D adventure is built to test how well you handle fast action. To play, tap and drag to a
piano-hexa-fall: In this puzzler, you place six-sided tiles on a turning cylinder, aiming to fill entire lines so they vanish. Its roots lie in classic stacking games, but every landing block sounds a musical tone that blends with the background soundtrack.

The pace picks up and challenges grow tougher as you advance, pushing you toward higher scores. Unlocking new melodies gives you more to hear along the way. Blending rhythm with spatial thinking, it offers a different angle on both puzzle solving and musical immersion. Control is simple: click or tap to play.
wars-island-management: Wars Island Management puts you in charge of a military force that you must build from nothing. Your job is to raise and train troops, reinforce your defenses, and handle your resources carefully so your forces grow stronger over time. Every spending choice matters, because the funds you gather can expand your ranks or open up new technologies.

When you feel ready, you can plan well-timed strikes against rival armies. The whole game is controlled with a mouse click or a tap, so you can start giving orders right away on a computer or a touchscreen.
ninja-arashi: Arashi is a single-player 3D action platformer with some role-playing elements mixed in. You play as Arashi, a once-legendary ninja, who fights through a corrupted world to rescue his son from Orochi, the devil who has kidnapped him.

Arashi relies on his strong acrobatic skills and deadly weapons to get through the journey. Along the way, he faces menacing traps and enemies who have sworn to protect Orochi. Use W, A, S, and D to move, J and K for two different attacks, and L to hide.
draw-the-railball-physics: In this physics puzzler, your job is to sketch rails and pipes that steer a rolling ball toward its goal. You can also add planks, springs, accelerators, and bumpers to shape a track entirely your own way. It is a light challenge that rewards both careful thinking and a creative hand, so you get to act like an engineer while drawing like an artist.

The controls are straightforward. Drag a prop from the panel onto the scene, then tap the start button to send the ball on its way. Placed pieces can be moved by dragging them, and tapping delete removes any you no longer want. There is no timer and no pressure, so it suits quick breaks as well as slower, unhurried sessions.
motor-stunt-simulator-3d: Motor Stunt Simulator 3D lets you ride a motorcycle through a set of stunt tracks. Each level offers a fresh experience and its own unique design, so no two stages feel alike. Your task is to get through every level, and each one also hides three stars in different spots that you need to find and collect.

The controls are simple. Press W to accelerate, S to go backward, A to steer left, and D to steer right. Combine these keys to guide your bike along each course. The game mixes 3D platform and simulation elements with stunt riding, collecting, and avoiding, so you will need both steady driving and a thorough search of every track.
blocky-set-3d-brick-constructions: Blocky Set is a digital recreation of hands-on brick-building play, shown in three dimensions. A finished model appears on screen, and your job is to copy it by placing each piece in its correct spot. You move pieces with the mouse, dragging each one across the scene and dropping it where it belongs.

Controls are simple. Use the on-screen buttons or the A, W, S and D keys to move the camera around your build and check it from different sides. Press R to rotate a block, which helps when a piece needs to face another direction to fit.
mr-fight: Mr Fight arrives with a different style of play this time. Instead of staying back, he has to tackle and defeat the enemies himself. Wiping out every foe at once takes a fair amount of physical effort from you, so be ready to work for it.

The controls are simple: just slide to play. The farther you drag, the farther he gets ejected, so judge each pull with care. This 2D puzzle title asks you to think about your angle and strength before every launch, and it rewards steady, patient aiming.
mini-chess: Mini Chess features 25 chess variants on boards from 4×4 up to 6×6. Classics like Gardner, Los Alamos and Petty Chess share the lineup with original layouts. Each match is a quick, tactical contest lasting a few minutes. Defeating the AI unlocks the next board, and every difficulty you clear earns a star. Collect the most stars to climb the leaderboard. Each board includes a short note on its history.

You always play White and move first. Tap a piece to see its legal moves, then tap a highlighted square to move it. Capture the enemy king or checkmate it to win. Check the Rules button on each board to learn whether pawns may double-step and what counts as a draw. Pawns promote on the last rank, and castling and en passant are not included. Undo takes back your last move. The game offers four difficulty levels and supports Korean and English.
blockapolypse-zombie-shooter: Blockapolypse: Zombie Shooter puts you in a defensive stand against blocky, three-dimensional undead. Zombies rush in from three different sides, and your job is to shoot them before they reach you. Clear out the horde and a giant undead foe appears, which you must also bring down. Your health bar is limited, so if it empties, the run is over.
Gold coins collected during the fight can be spent in the gun shop on stronger weapons. Controls are simple: click or tap to fire and keep the defense going.
cyberpunk-block-puzzle: Route glowing blocks across a neon circuit board in this stylish logic puzzle. Each block slides only along one axis, so every move needs planning, since one slide can open or block the path for another. Clear the board by guiding each block into the connector of matching color. The 70-plus levels bring walls, ice blocks, and locks on grids from 5×5 to 8×9.
Earn chips by finishing levels and climb the hacker ranks, from Noob all the way to Hack Guru. A fresh daily challenge arrives every day. If you get stu
hammer-strike: Hammer Strike is a calm 3D puzzle game for a single player. You start by clicking the shielded characters and turning them until they form the correct angle combination. Each click rotates the piece you chose, so careful adjustments lead you to the solution. The peaceful mood suits young children who want to sharpen their thinking, while older players will still find it tricky.

Once the puzzle is solved, the battle button becomes active. Press it to begin the fight and take down the enemy. When a round is over, use the hammer button to strike the foes and move on to the next level. The game is simple to pick up, yet it can keep you occupied across long play sessions.
draw-and-guess-online: Draw and Guess is a live multiplayer title where imagination and speed both count. Each player takes a turn sketching a word the game provides, using the drawing tools, while everyone else types answers into the chat as quickly as they can. Faster correct answers earn more points, and your drawing also scores based on how many people figure it out.

You can join a public room or open a private one for your own group, but at least three players are needed before a match begins. You can play with friends or with people from around the world. The game runs over a set number of rounds, and whoever has the highest total at the end wins. Some versions also include hints or drawing aids to help guessers along.
word-puzzle-connect-words-and-letters: In this word game, you link colorful letter bubbles together to spell out words that fit a set theme. The themes range from nature to technology. It is built for players of every age and aims to help you grow your vocabulary, sharpen your spelling, and give your brain a workout. Each level gets tougher as you move forward, while the controls stay simple to pick up.

To play, touch a bubble and drag your finger across neighboring letters to form a word. Once you submit it, you earn points and those bubbles disappear. If you get stuck, a hint is available. Locate all of the theme words to finish each level. Whether you have a few minutes or want a longer relaxing session, you can play it anywhere, any time.
arcuz-treasure-hunters: Arcuz Treasure Hunters is a fantasy JRPG built around the hunt for treasure. You descend into underground caves filled with winding, maze-like passages and face tough foes along the way. As you press on, you gather rare loot and recruit companions, each bringing different skills, so you can build a team that suits your style.

Progress depends on careful thinking, not just charging ahead. You will need to crack puzzles, avoid traps, inspect scenery, and uncover hidden passages, all while coordinating your party to chart every corner of a map. The main story dungeons have fixed layouts and set treasures, and alongside them the game includes classic roguelike randomness, with numerous dungeons and treasures generated at random to add variety to the fun.
my-unicorn-cat-princess-caring: Your task in this game is to help a baby cat named Twinkle hatch from her magical egg. Once she's out, you show the little unicorn cat princess around the royal palace and look after her as she grows from a tiny kitten into a sweet cat girl. She needs plenty of energy, so you'll cook yummy meals for her in the royal kitchen. When she gets tired, you can sing her to sleep.
Twinkle also gets messy, so bath time is part of the routine. You can wash her glittery fur with bubbly rainbow soap or a shimmery magical slime gel. To play, just click or tap.
unstoppableshooter: Unstoppable Shooter puts you in control of a stickman and his gear in this 2D shooting game for one player. Your job is to hold back enemies that never stop attacking. Every shot depends on how strongly you fire and the direction you aim, so you must set both carefully to resist the onslaught.

To continue, click on any blank area of the screen. The aiming angle changes dynamically during play, so you will need to keep readjusting it. The game sits in the hypercasual category and is tagged for shooting.
magic-pet-salon: Step into a little shop run by Luna, a witch who owns a salon for animals. Her clients are special pets, and she gives them makeovers using dazzling magic. Her customer list is long and every visitor is adorable, so Luna really needs a helping hand from you.
The game has many different jobs to pick from. You can act as a groomer or as a designer, making pets look pretty with their hair and nails. Everything is controlled with a simple mouse click or tap.
bottle-color-match-challenge: In this color puzzle, you sort a set of bottles until each one holds a matching shade. Pick a bottle and trade places with another to shift things around, then combine and hunt for pairs to finish each stage. The rules are easy to pick up, yet it is tough to walk away once you begin. Bright visuals and fluid motion make every move a pleasure to watch.

You can take it slow and enjoy a relaxed session, or push yourself by racing the clock. It suits players of every age, so the whole family can join in. Every level is there to be cleared, and anyone who solves them all earns the title of Bottle Master. Swap bottles until all the colors line up in a single row to win, and use a hint whenever you get stuck.
geometry-open-world: Geometry Open World is a two-dimensional action game in which you pilot a vessel across difficult landscapes. You will meet a range of hostile foes and face demanding bosses along the way. Smart use of upgrades and skills is the key to victory in this geometric adventure.

Move left with A or the left arrow key, and right with D or the right arrow key. Press Q to raise your shield and E to fire your cannons. A left mouse click lets you work with the in-game interface. The game is free to enjoy on your devices.
the-pyramid-adventure: Explore historical pyramids in this two-player adventure, where you team up to collect diamonds and work through puzzles. Complete the sculptures inside each pyramid to open the locked doors in your path. Along the way, you will face monsters and traps, and you can fight them off with your weapons. You must pass 20 levels in total to find your way out.

Player 1 moves with W, A, S and D, jumps with W, and shoots with F, while Q switches weapons. Player 2 moves with the arrow keys, jumps with the up arrow, throws grenades with L, and picks up boxes with K.
fat-or-thin: Fat or Thin is a relaxing 3D runner where you help an adorable furry bear lose extra weight after waking from winter hibernation. The game has more than 30 levels, and in each one you must get through the obstacle course and reach the end while keeping an eye on your diet.

Along the way, you decide whether to cut out burgers, pizza, and doughnuts and replace them with healthier food. Controls are simple: use a mouse click or a tap to play. It is an HTML5 arcade game tagged as casual, and it runs online in your browser.
stick-wars-3d: Stick Wars 3D is a platform game played in 3D. You fight against enemy Stickmen and use powerful weapons to beat them. Every level has a door, and you need to get past the enemies to open it.

The controls are simple. Use the left and right arrow keys to move, the up arrow key to jump, and left click to shoot. The game mixes fighting with platform play, so you will be jumping, moving, and shooting your way through each level.
obby-upgrade-your-speed: Speed is the goal in this clicker, and every tap counts. Each tap earns Run Points, and the more you collect, the faster your character runs. You can unlock pets that speed up your progress and make each tap stronger, with each pet giving either two or three points per tap. Chase higher speeds and try to top your own best scores.

Movement uses WASD or the arrow keys, and holding the right mouse button lets you turn the camera. Press Space to jump. On a phone, a joystick handles movement, and short swipes across the screen rotate the view.
gas-station-24-simulator: You run your own fuel station, and your goal is to fill up as many vehicles as you can. Pull up beside each car, pump the correct fuel type, and collect the payment. Keep the queues moving so drivers never wait too long. Every sale brings in money you can spend on new equipment, faster service, and upgrades.

As your earnings grow, you can expand the business and turn a small fuel station into a modern gas station. The quicker and more skilled your service, the bigger your profits and the happier your customers become. Controls are simple, and the visuals are attractive, so the game suits fans of management and casual simulation titles. Whether you enjoy tycoon games or relaxed simulators, there is plenty to build here.
ricochet-paint-aim: Ricochet Paint Aim asks you to line up each shot and predict how your ball will bounce. Your goal is to guide it through mazes packed with pegs, splattering paint across the targets as you go. The angles grow trickier, so every launch takes careful thought.

This physics-based arcade puzzler rewards precise planning over guesswork. To play, press and hold the mouse button to aim, then let go to shoot. Each ricochet you work out brings you closer to hitting your targets.
heroic-knight: Heroic Knight is a puzzle adventure where you guide a brave knight across dangerous landscapes in pursuit of fame and hidden riches. It is free to play in your web browser, so you can jump straight into a medieval quest with nothing to install. Along the way, you steer past obstacles, get around sneaky traps, and defeat tough enemies. The 2D world suits players who enjoy tricky brain teasers and daring adventures, and it runs smoothly on both desktops and mobile devices.

Your aim is to rescue the princess or reach the gold, and both require careful planning. Study each stage, then pull the correct levers at exactly the right moment. Mistakes are costly: trolls can attack you, and falling into the lava ends your run.
ice-slide: Ice Slide is a casual sliding puzzle that asks you to fill every empty tile on the board by moving a single block. The collection includes 1000 levels to work through. Controls are simple: one finger swipes up, down, left, or right, and the block keeps moving in a straight line until it hits a wall or obstacle. Cover every tile to solve a board, then reach the target tile to win and unlock the next
ww2-modern-war-tanks-1942: Step back in time with this browser shooter set in the Second World War. You can take control of soldiers, weapons, tanks, and aircraft from that conflict, and the game is packed with visual effects. Play with friends from around the world. The game offers 20 WW2-era guns and 5 heavy tanks that fire both shells and bullets. Explosions look impressive, and the characters are good-quality figures in German and US army uniforms.

Controls are simple. Use W, A, S, and D to drive tanks, helicopters, and cars, or to move your character. The mouse lets you look around and fire, and scrolling switches between guns. Press Tab to open the menu.
99-nights-in-the-forest-battle-squads: Battle Squads puts you in a forest full of creatures, where your job is to beat back monsters and save children who have gone missing. The game offers 30 stages, each filled with a different mix of forest monsters. You build your own group from a range of characters, and every one of them brings unique abilities to the fight.

You move through the levels in order, finishing one before opening the next. Rubies you collect let you strengthen your fighters and sharpen their skills over time. Everything is handled with a mouse, and touch screens work just as well if you prefer tapping.
my-dino-museum: Dig up sealed blocks, haul them back to your base, and scrub away the dirt to reveal what is hidden inside. Next, carry each bone to its spot and assemble a huge dinosaur skeleton that will stand in your own museum. Heavier blocks turn up less often and slow your steps, so choosing which load to take on each trip matters.

Earn coins by walking over your bones, then spend them on helpers and hatch dinosaurs you can ride. Over time your old shed grows into a proper museum. Move with WASD or the joystick, jump with Space, and press E (or the on-screen button) to pick up and place items. Hold E to brush a block clean, and press Esc to pause. Touch players get on-screen buttons alongside the joystick.
talking-veggies-meme-merge: Talking Veggies: Meme Merge is a physics-based puzzle game where you drop funny talking vegetables into a jar. When two matching veggies touch, they fuse into a bigger one, and the chain keeps climbing until you reach the Boss Watermelon. Every merge adds to your score, so you aim for a high total while keeping the jar from filling up. If the veggies spill over the top, the game is over.
slope-bike: Slope Bike is a 3D arcade game that drops you onto a bike in an endless race. It belongs to the hypercasual genre, so its rules are easy to grasp. Your task is to keep your bike moving as you drive and build speed across a network of linked slopes, and the course never really ends.

On a computer, press A and D or the left and right arrow keys to steer. On a mobile device, swipe your finger to steer left or right. The same simple idea works across both setups, so you can switch between them without relearning anything.
space-survivor: Space Survivor throws you straight into a fight with dangerous alien forces, and you'll need to pull off some daring moves to stay in the battle. The aim is to endure for as long as you can, so keeping your skills and weaponry sharp from the start matters.

Your character moves around the screen to attack and defeat enemies. Gems drop during the fight, and collecting them without taking a hit is part of the challenge. Spend what you gather to improve your weapons and abilities, and when things get desperate, activate a power-up to get back on track.
fruit-cutter-fun: Test your slicing skill with Fruit Cutter Fun by cutting as many fruits as you can. Tap or click on the fruits to slice them, but keep away from the bombs, because touching one ends the game. Focus only on the fruit. The game offers two modes to choose from, along with a set of interesting quests to work through.

Controls are simple. On Android, touch and tap the screen. On a PC, use a left click of the mouse. The graphics are high quality, and the game file is very small. If you enjoy fruit slicing games or just want a fun way to pass the time, this one is worth your attention.
red-moon: Only once every ten years does the moon turn red, and on that night the Red Samurai draw in its enormous power. Their goal is to seize the kingdom, but you play as Eivana, who sets out to topple the king. The journey covers 20 fast-paced levels and two tough boss fights. Along the way you can earn 13 medals and unlock concept art and music.

Move with the arrow keys and strike with the Z and Y keys. Jumping again while in the air gives you a double-jump. The red meter tracks your health, and the blue meter tracks your power. Special attacks drain power and are triggered with the Spacebar.
wood-builder-tycoon: Grow a timber business from the ground up in this idle management title. Cut down huge trees, improve futuristic sawmills, and move logs along automated conveyor belts. Cash arrives as gold coins you gather as you go, and you can bring on capable workers to help production climb. Your goal is to rise to the top as a forestry tycoon.
The pace is quick, and it is easy to get hooked on watching your operation grow. Controls are simple: just point and click.
viaducts: Viaducts is a calm puzzle game built around slow thinking and quiet scenery. Your task is to lay out seamless routes so that trains and other objects can travel smoothly, and you only get a limited number of attempts to get it right. Rotating bridge blocks is the main way to shape each path, and the steady rhythm of passing trains gives the game a soothing pace.

On a computer, click a block to rotate it, scroll the wheel to zoom in and out, and click and drag to move the camera around the landscape. On a phone or tablet, tap blocks to rotate them, pinch to zoom in or out, and swipe to pan the camera. Success comes through patience and careful thought, so take your time and let each solution come to you.
popcats-merge-the-cats: PopCats: Merge the cats! is a laid-back online puzzle where you join matching cats to create bigger, cuter felines. Each cat comes with its own playful story, which you can read by tapping its picture in the bottom panel. Your aim is to climb the player rankings by collecting points as you play.

Tap or click the screen to drop cats and pair up identical ones. Keep every cat below the top line, because if one reaches it, the game is over. When a cat is in the way, use yarn to clear it, and remember that accuracy matters most. You win by connecting the two biggest cats. The game runs on any device, so cat fans everywhere can enjoy it.
draw-one-line-drawing-puzzle: Draw One Line: Drawing Puzzle is a brainteaser where you connect every dot on the board with a single line. You cannot retrace any part of your path, so each stroke needs careful planning. You may start from any point you like, which gives you room to choose the route that suits you best.

This game is made for players who enjoy a good challenge and want to have fun while they think. Its puzzles are built on logic, and each one turns a simple set of dots into a mental test. It is filed under drawing, puzzles, brain, and logic, so it will appeal to anyone who likes working through problems in their web browser.
kitten-never-dies: A lost kitten needs your help finding its way home, and the journey passes through a series of interdimensional worlds. Every dimension brings its own puzzle that you must solve before you can move on. The game is charming and clever, with plenty of unexpected moments, and it asks you to think carefully about each challenge.

Controls are simple: press a key, click with the mouse, tap the screen, or use a gamepad, and the kitty will know what to do. Two people can also share one computer. Player 1 selects a button, while Player 2 chooses a different one, so you can tackle the journey together.
stick-ninja-survival: Stick Ninja Survival is a rogue-like arcade game built around simple stick figure fighters and creatures. When the Red Sun rises, the Red Moon fills the sky and the world turns into a frightening place. People have fled from the monsters that roam the land. Your job is to avoid the enemies and the bullets they fire, since your character attacks on its own.
Gems you earn can be spent to upgrade your character, along with skills and talents. You play by clicking the mouse or tapping the screen.
weaponsmith-evolution-weapon-merge: Weaponsmith Evolution - Weapon Merge is a free online game that runs on both phones and computers. You start with plain daggers and work up to crafting legendary blades. Drag two matching weapons together to combine them into a stronger one, and each new weapon you create brings in gold.

You can spend that gold on upgrades, such as unlocking new weapon types or speeding up merging. You also fight monsters and move through levels while keeping the realm safe. From time to time, a powerful boss appears, and defeating it proves your skill. Try different upgrades to make your weapons more efficient and earn more. Keep playing to unlock the legendary weapons and become a true master of the arsenal.
shooting-combat-zombie-survival: Shooting Combat Zombie Survival is a shooter where you fight off waves of zombies. You can play alone in offline mode or team up and compete with friends from around the world. The action takes place on a single winter map, and you win by reaching a set number of kills. Nine guns are available, each with detailed textures that give the scenes a polished look.

Several game modes keep the action varied, including GunGame, Survival, Free for All, and Team vs Team, along with more. Move with W, A, S, and D, and use the mouse to aim, shoot, and change your gun. Press Tab to open the menu.
underwater-bicycle-racing: Underwater Bicycle Racing takes cycling beneath the waves and claims a first for racing and simulation games set underwater. Built in 3D, it lets you ride a modern underwater bicycle with a feel close to real life. The core is racing, but the course lies under the sea, and fish swim around you as you pedal.

Your goals include chasing world records in water surfing and testing your ability to survive in the depths. Steer your bike with the WASD keys or the arrow keys. It suits anyone curious about bicycle racing with an underwater twist.
buggy-battle-royale: Buggy - Battle Royale puts you behind the wheel of a car in this 3D action adventure set across battlegrounds. Your aim is to be the last driver left, the final one to tumble off the cliff, while speeding down the road toward victory. Being first matters, but so does surviving longer than everyone else, because the player who lasts the most collects the top scores.

Control your buggy with the arrow keys and the space button, or use the touch controls on mobile. Each round is a fresh chance to finish first and outlast the field, so stay sharp and aim to claim the win.
tiny-zomby-the-barricade: A bomb went off, radiation did the rest, and now the whole town is after you. You're a kid on a watchtower with only a rifle and a wooden fence to work with. Slide to aim, tap to shoot, and keep your barricade standing.

Grab the coins the crowd drops and save up for a shotgun, or plant mines along the routes they march. The game covers six stages of six waves each, and a boss waits at the end of every stage. The airport is where things turn especially vicious. Mouse click or tap to play.
strike-bullet: Strike Bullet is a puzzle shooter built around ricochets. You aim with care, send your shot bouncing off metal walls, and try to wipe out every enemy on screen. Before each shot, you can study the trajectory and choose your angle, and the game offers 20 levels full of tricky setups.

Every bullet you fire matters. Use glass panels, explosive barrels, and portals to build the right route to your targets. On desktop, move the mouse to aim, left-click to fire, and press R to restart a level. On mobile, drag across the screen to aim, then release or tap to fire, and use the restart button in the in-game interface if you want to try again.
skate-boy: Skate Boy puts you on a board in the middle of a city. The streets may look risky at first, but the ride is yours to take. Grab your skateboard and start rolling right away. It is a single-player arcade title with a pixel art style and adventure tags.
Keep your eyes open, because obstacles are waiting almost everywhere around you. Hit one and you crash, which means you lose. Controls are simple: click or tap with your mouse to play.
dirt-bike-max-duel: Hop onto a dirt bike and tear across loose earth, hills, rocky patches, and wooded trails, or pretty much any terrain you can imagine. You can settle in for a long journey, or challenge a friend to a head-to-head race. Each race asks you to reach the finish line within the time limit or beat your rival there.

Two-player matches can be decided by the clock or by whoever wins the most rounds. After you earn a certain amount of money, you can switch to different bikes. Expect many chapters filled with enjoyable physics and cool machines. In single player mode, Player 1 steers with W, A, S, D or the arrow keys, while Player 2 uses the arrow keys in two-player matches.
asmr-obby-slicer: Swing your blade through a cheerful, three-dimensional arena filled with blocky targets. Pinatas and robots break apart when struck, but instead of gore they burst open with paint, coating the floor in vivid hues with every slash. Your hero strikes on their own once a foe comes within reach. Each chapter contains five levels and ends with a one-of-a-kind boss.

Steering is simple. On a computer, use WASD or the arrow keys. On a phone or tablet, touch anywhere and drag to use a joystick. Clear a level by wiping out every enemy, and step out of the orange danger rings on
it-lurks: You are alone in your house, and something lurks outside. A strange virus has turned animals into frightening creatures, and you must last eight nights, from 10 PM to 7 AM, while guarding your home. Keep checking the windows, use your flashlight to see what is outside, and look under the bed. If a creature is close, switch off the lights so it cannot spot you. Creatures get stronger each night.
Desktop controls: Spacebar hides under the bed or returns you to bed, Shift checks the window, Z turns on the flashlight, and X turns off the lights. Mouse clicks
real-flight-simulator: Real Flight Simulator is a driving-style flight game with 3D airplane models. Across six levels, you learn to operate a plane, from starting it up and steering it to bringing it down for a landing. The complicated instrument panels have been simplified so that new pilots can follow what they are reading.

Airplanes differ in price, and the more expensive ones give you better acceleration. Each plane's Power, Speed, Solution, and Brake can be enjoyed more fully as you move up to costlier models. The whole game is played with a mouse click or a tap.
save-the-balloon-road-to-the-stars: Save the Balloon: Road to the Stars is an arcade game set among the stars. A floating balloon needs your help to escape a series of sneaky traps, and you play as a quick protector who keeps it safe as it drifts upward. Steer the defender with your mouse or finger, knocking aside obstacles that get in the way. Along the way, grab stars for bonuses and climb higher.

The journey offers plenty of challenges, along with powerful abilities you can trigger to gain the upper hand. Earn new looks for both the balloon and its defender with bright skins. The adventure runs non-stop, so there is always another stretch of sky to fly through. Your goal is to rule the skies, collect every look you can, and show everyone you are the top champion.
fantasy-fish-world-mahjong: Slip beneath the waves in Fantasy Fish World Mahjong, a charming Mahjong Solitaire puzzle set in a bright underwater fantasy realm. Pair up identical sea creatures, such as clownfish and angelfish, to clear the board. The layouts sit among sunken pirate ships, coral, and seaweed, and the tiles feature adorable aquatic artwork.

Left-click a free tile, one open on at least one side, then click its identical twin to remove both. The question-mark button shows an available match, the shuffle button rearranges the tiles, and the color swap button changes their colors. Over 4,000 levels are waiting, and each one can earn up to three stars:
penalty-kick-target: Step up to the spot for a penalty shot in this single-player 2D soccer game. Every kick counts, so you need to place the ball on target without missing, since that is the path to becoming the best.

Controls are simple: aim and kick with your mouse, or tap the screen on a touch device. Line up each shot carefully, because one miss can stop you from earning that title. It sits in the Sports category and offers a fun way to test your accuracy.
playful-cup: Playful Cup is a puzzle game about a glass that feels down because it has no liquid inside. You help it get back to a happy state by pouring enough water into it. Each level can be solved in more than one way, so you are free to try your own ideas and approach problems from unusual angles. The game offers three different modes to explore.

To pour, press and hold your finger on the screen, and the water starts flowing toward the glass. Let go to stop the flow. Be careful, because the glass must be filled without spilling any over the top. It is a relaxing game for mobile and a good pick for anyone who enjoys funny, clever puzzles.
offroad-vehicle-explorer: Have you ever wanted to drive a souped-up buggy? In this 3D offroad racer, you can test five different 4x4 vehicles on muddy terrain and find the one you enjoy driving most. Rev powerful engines, roll on massive wheels, and steer around the trees as you race toward the finish line.

The controls are simple. Use WASD to drive, hold Space to brake, and press G to reset your car. Tab opens the menu whenever you need it. It is a single player simulator, so you can take your time and enjoy every muddy stretch at your own pace.
worm-path: Worm Path is a logic puzzler about steering a resourceful worm through twisting mazes toward the exit. You slide across tiles, shove blocks out of the way, and steer clear of hazards, so every move needs thought to avoid leaving the worm boxed in. New layouts appear as you advance, and the puzzles steadily grow harder, rewarding careful planning and clear reasoning. Your job is to find the right route, get past each barrier, and free the worm.
Controls are simple: use the W, A, S and D keys or the arrow keys to move the worm around the board.
temple-racing: Temple Racing puts you behind the wheel of a red sports car on an endless temple track. Your goal is to travel as far as you can by getting past the obstacles in your way. The game offers three difficulty levels, so you can pick the challenge that suits you.

Along the way you will travel through impressive temples, but you must stay careful, since crashing into anything ends the game right away. Movement uses the arrow keys. It is a 3D racing game where avoiding obstacles and keeping your car on the road are the main priorities.
diy-slime-art: If you enjoy do-it-yourself games, this simulation title is worth a look. You shape a slime model into round, heart, or star forms. Small animals are also on the menu, including peacocks, hedgehogs, and mergansers. Other options include models themed around lovely girls, sugarplums, and trees, so you can pick the one you like best before you begin.

Once a model is chosen, you start building it and can add decorations of your liking. When the decorations are set, you may knead the slime for as long as you wish. The visuals are attractive and pleasant to look at, and the game gives you a good dose of hands-on creative enjoyment. Control is simple: use a mouse click or a tap to
knight-legend: In Knight Legend, you set out on a long journey filled with monsters to battle. Along the way, you can strengthen your gear and open up new levels. As you advance, you collect gold that buys sturdier armour and loyal pets, which fight alongside you.

Moving your knight is simple. On a computer, use the arrow keys or W, A, S, D (or Z, Q, S, D) to get around, press ENTER to accept or submit, and press ESC to pause or close menus. On a phone or tablet, drag the on-screen joystick in any direction to move, and tap the accept button to confirm your choices.
candy-nail-art-fashion: You have just opened your very own nail salon, and it is all about candy. Your job is to keep each customer happy by giving them the sweetest and most beautiful nails they have ever seen. It is your chance to show off your candy nail art skills from start to finish.
Design your own candy nail jewelry to add to every set, and enjoy yourself while you work. Everything is controlled with a mouse click or a tap, so getting started is simple.
brain-draw-line: Brain Draw Line: Link Dots is a puzzle game that puts your logic and creativity to work. Your job is to trace one unbroken path through a set of dots, never lifting your finger and never doubling back, until the full design is complete. Each shape asks you to connect every dot in a specific pattern without any lines overlapping.

As you move forward, the puzzles grow harder, so careful planning pays off. Think through your route before you start, since retracing a step is not allowed. Once you solve a shape, the next and more challenging level opens up, and the difficulty keeps building from there.
forcez-io: ForceZ.io is a 3D shooter where you can roam across five arenas, either alone or against other players in multiplayer. You will find more than ten weapons to pick from, which helps you take down opponents more effectively. Room options such as double speed, double jump, and double HP let you change how each match plays, and an armor shop lets you buy protection.

Move with WASD or the arrow keys, and jump with Space. Left click fires your weapon, while right click aims down the sights. Press R to reload, and use keys 1, 2, 3, and 9 or the mouse wheel to switch between weapons. Tab opens the pause menu whenever you need it.
fillblox: Fillblox is a logic puzzle in which you cover an entire board with pieces. Several blocks of varying shapes sit ready, and your task is to set each one into a spot where it leaves no open squares behind. The challenge grows as you advance: each new level brings a bigger grid, along with more pieces that have trickier outlines.

The game also keeps pace with you. When you move through stages quickly, it responds with a harder layout to test your thinking. If you get stuck, a hint will drop one piece into its correct place for you. Pieces are dragged from the panel on the right onto the grid, and they cannot be turned or mirrored, so each one needs its own correct position. Clear every cell to finish the level.
grimace-vs-giant-clown-shoes: Grimace is trying to get away from an enormous clown shoe in this arcade platformer. Along the way, you gather coins that show his face, and each one you grab smashes through the platforms beneath him. The hamburgers you come across can be used to shove the big shoe back, giving Grimace more room to run.

Small shoes are also around, so keep an eye out for them, because a collision leaves Grimace moving more slowly. Controls are simple: tap or click the left or right half of the screen, or press the left and right arrow keys on your keyboard. Its tags mark it as a classic arcade title for kids.
subway-surfer-bali: Subway Surfers Bali takes you on a fresh adventure through the underground. Your task is to head down into the subway and keep moving so the grumpy inspector never manages to catch you. This 3D action adventure leans heavily on jumping, and it runs right in your browser thanks to HTML5.
Stay focused while the inspector keeps chasing you, and do your best to slip out of his reach. Good luck on your run.
mushroom-fight-for-the-kingdom: This 2D single-player Android adventure asks you to guide a mushroom fighter through a fantasy world, where the goal is to protect and widen your magical mushroom realm. You must push back waves of foes, claim new lands, and build up a kingdom. Blending tactics with action, it offers a strategic mobile experience.

Press the left and right buttons to move your mushroom character in either direction. The jump button makes it leap, and holding that button down longer produces a higher jump. A pause button stops the game and opens the pause menu.
bouncy-ball: Bouncy Ball is an arcade platformer where good timing decides everything. You guide a cheerful ball across floating platforms while steering clear of sharp spikes. Each new level brings trickier jumps, so precise landings matter more as you progress. Tapping the screen pushes the ball downward and shapes its bounce, and your goal is to keep it in play for as long as you can.

Collect combo chains to earn extra rewards and push your score higher. The controls stay simple, while smooth animations and bright neon graphics give every attempt a lively look. One wrong move ends the run, so stay sharp and see whether you can beat your best score.
super-sergeant: In this 3D action shooter for one player, you step into the boots of a super sergeant. Your job is to wipe out every enemy force you meet, and you can switch between several kinds of weapons to get it done. Each level has an exit that you must track down before you can move on.

Moving around uses the W, A, S and D keys, while the left mouse button fires your weapon. Scroll the mouse wheel to swap guns, press R to reload, and press F to use. Space makes you jump, and P pauses the game whenever you need a break.
recoil: Recoil is a point-and-shoot platformer where your gun doubles as your way of moving. Each shot kicks you through handcrafted levels packed with traps, precise jumps, and tough timing tests, and a single mistake can end your run. Levels restart instantly, so deaths come often as you wrestle with momentum, physics, and your own reflexes. It can be maddening, yet beating a tricky stage feels rewarding.

Moving the mouse turns your character and aims the weapon, while a left click fires. Every blast throws you in the direction opposite to the bullet, so you use that recoil to cross the stage, dodge hazards, and reach the goal. Accurate aim and careful control of your momentum matter most, because one poor shot can send you straight to your death. Accept the failures and keep trying.
chicken-shooting: Chicken Shooting is a shooting game where you test your aim against chickens that dash across the screen. Their quick movement means you need to lock onto each target carefully before you fire. The game is played in 3D and runs in the browser through WebGL, and it was built with Unity3D.

Aiming is handled with the mouse: move it to line up your shot, hold the right button to aim more precisely, and press the left button to shoot. If you need a break, the Escape key pauses the action so you can return whenever you are ready.
euro-champ-2024: Euro Champ 2024 is a 3D football game that can keep you busy for a good while. Your goal is to get through four elimination matches and finish as the new European champion. You score from free kicks and volleys, since the ball is passed to you from the side of the pitch.

Aiming works with the mouse. Move the pointer to position yourself, then drop it lower around the players' legs if you want the shot to rise. On phones and tablets, use touch controls to move, and tap the boot-and-ball icon on the right side of the screen to kick.
canyon-drifter: Canyon Drifter is a 2D moto-trial game where you ride a dirt bike over demanding tracks. You set up your machine for the dirt and the terrain, then clear steep hills and jumps by leaning to keep your balance. Fighting for the best time on the leaderboard is part of the challenge. If a track keeps stopping you, the garage lets you retune your bike so it becomes rideable.

On the keyboard, the Up arrow or W accelerates, and the Down arrow or S brakes or reverses. Left or A lifts the front wheel, while Right or D drops the nose. Esc or P pauses, and R restarts. On a phone, four on-screen buttons appear after your first touch: throttle and brake sit at the top right and left, with lean controls along the bottom. Pause and restart are in the top-right corner.
bicycle-stunts-racing-2023: Bicycle Stunts Racing blends careful timing with bold risk-taking. Players take control of riders who push their balance and skill to the edge, pulling off eye-catching flips and tricks on two wheels. Backflips and wheelies are part of the show, and the whole thing is built to keep your pulse racing.

Protective equipment is essential, since these athletes race against the clock while defying gravity in ways that leave onlookers amazed. Courses take place on dirt tracks or through city streets, and the game highlights the impressive athleticism of its participants. Drive using the W, A, S and D keys.
puppy-pet-vet-care: Puppy Pet Vet Care is a hypercasual game with a cute, caring theme. You look after stray cats and dogs that have been roaming outside. Start by giving each one a bath, since wandering animals have no chance to keep their fur and appearance tidy. Then give every kitten and puppy a full body check. Out in the wild they will inevitably meet fierce animals and bad people, which can leave them with diseases.

Once the checkups are done, choose suitable clothes and dress each animal up. The game is played with a mouse click or a tap. It is tagged with cat and cute, so the focus stays on gentle care and playful styling.
solitaire-spider-and-klondike: Solitaire: Spider and Klondike lets you play two well-known card games that reward careful planning and sharp reasoning. Spider comes in three versions, using one, two, or four suits. The aim in Spider is to stack cards in order from low to high within each suit, and you should try to finish with as few moves as you can. Klondike is the classic setup played with one standard deck, where the goal is to empty the table by building runs that go from King down to Ace and switch between red and black.
Controls are simple: just click or tap with your mouse or finger to move cards and take each turn.
cat-block-puzzle: Cat Block Puzzle is a calm sliding game with a charming cat theme. You push pieces around a board and fit them into the picture you are aiming for. Each stage offers a fresh arrangement to solve, and each slide matters. The start is easy to pick up, yet the challenge grows as the stages progress.

Every level shows a grid packed with blocks in assorted shapes and sizes. Blocks move in straight lines whenever there is empty space. Your task is to put every piece in its proper spot so the board matches the preview image or silhouette. Because room is limited, a single poor move can trap another block, so think ahead. Clear routes, make space, and work through your moves in the right order. Early levels are straightforward, while later ones call for deeper planning and clever logic.
we-are-in-a-simulation-simulator: This arcade game is a head-scrambling test of imitation, where your goal is to mirror everyone around you. Staying alive depends on blending in, since any move that stands out will be punished. Its Simon Says spirit means you must obey or pay the price.

Someone out of sight is working the strings, and the key is to copy the crowd precisely without challenging anything you see. Move with W, A, S and D, crouch by pressing C, leap with the Space bar, and press P whenever you want to pause. The title is filed under both simulation and arcade.
revoxel-3d-voxel-rpg-shooter: Revoxel 3D is a voxel-style RPG shooter set in a gloomy cyberpunk future. A murderous tech corporation has taken over a dark city, and you fight through swarms of robots and monsters to stop it. Race through the metropolis, uncover the conspiracy, and defeat the bosses guarding the entrances to new cities.

Along the way, you mine resources, craft gear, and build your base while surviving and leveling up by defeating enemies. Crates hold bonuses and upgrades, and money unlocks territories, improves your character, and buys new clothing. Built-in mini-games add variety. On mobile, a touchpad handles movement and on-screen buttons handle actions
alpha-balls: Alpha Balls is a word puzzle that works both your brain and your spelling skills. You build words out of a set of letters, and every correct answer helps widen your vocabulary. The game is free to play online on any device, so you can pick it up on whatever screen you have. It suits players of all ages who want something both fun and educational.

Each puzzle rewards you with coins when you solve it. You can use those coins to buy hints, which reveal the opening letters of the answer you are hunting for. Extra letters that mislead you can be cleared away by pressing the bin. When you have a word ready, press the ball marked with a tick to lock in your answer and collect your coins.
arrows-edge: In this archery game, you help aim your shots at skeletons along curved, arcing paths. The story opens with an archer who receives a challenge from a trainer and sets out to take down the skeletons. You guide the aim, but be careful, because the arrows can also harm the player, and if that happens the game is over.

The visuals are detailed and polished, yet the game stays small in size without losing quality, which is gentle on your device. The controls are very simple, so you can start playing right away, and engaging quests keep things interesting. On Android, touch the screen to aim and tap to shoot. On PC, use the mouse: left click to aim and shoot.
twist-hit: Twist Hit is an action title centered on filling rings so you can plant trees and rescue a whole forest. Your central challenge is figuring out how many trees you can grow. Holding your mouse button fills each ring, and you need to keep holding until it is full. Watch out for obstacles that stand in your way.
Everything in this game runs with the mouse alone, so you only need that single control. Stay patient with each ring, pace yourself, and aim for a bigger forest than before.
football-heads: Football Heads puts you on the pitch for a soccer match with a playful twist. You take the field and wear down your rival with a range of strong kicks, plus quirky power-ups that shake up the action. The emote system lets you show your rival who is in charge.

The arrow keys move your player sideways and make him jump, while the ball buttons trigger the different kicks. Score more goals than your opponent before time runs out to win the match. Climb through the divisions to unlock every reward. Random power-ups and player emotes show up during matches.
jelly-drop-merge-and-sell: Jelly Drop: Merge & Sell is a colorful puzzle game where every jelly earns you points. New jellies drop from the top into a jar. When two identical jellies touch, they combine into a more valuable form. Keep an eye on how full the jar gets, then sell its contents once it is nearly or completely full to turn them into money.

Controls are simple, and the physics feel satisfying, which makes the game well suited to short sessions or relaxed play. Higher jelly levels pay out more points, and each sale pushes your score up. Use your earnings to upgrade jelly level, sale income, jar capacity, and progress speed. Every upgrade boosts your profits and unlocks new jelly tiers, so your jelly setup can grow into a record-breaking machine.
bloxorz-color-block-roll: Roll the painted block across the board toward the exit, but it can only come to rest on tiles that match the side touching the floor. Across 60 levels, the paths shift as platforms turn, slide, and teleport you elsewhere, so you need to picture each move in space before making it. Fans of Bloxorz should feel at home right away.

You can steer with WASD or the arrow keys. With a mouse, hold the left button, drag in a direction, and release. On touch screens, swipe in the direction you want. Each move covers one step, so you choose up, down, left, or right one tile at a time until the cube reaches the goal.
kaiju-run-dzilla-enemies: Kaiju Run: Dzilla Enemies is a 3D arcade runner that plays like a typical running game, but it follows vertical-version rules. Pick up the green items as you go, and beat the final dinosaur boss at every level. The stronger you grow, the farther you can punch the monster, and the more points you can win.

Diamonds you collect can be spent in the Shop to unlock more skins. The DIY map adds 6 challenges to try, and you can also play as different animals. It is a one-player game, and everything is controlled with a mouse click or a tap.
supra-drift-2: Supra Drift 2 puts you behind the wheel of a Toyota Supra and lets you slide your way through four different settings. You can race through a busy big city, head off-road onto rougher terrain, or drift around a port and a dockyard. Each location has its own look, so the scenery stays fresh as you practice your drifts.

The controls are simple. Use WASD or the arrow keys to drive, hold Space to pull the handbrake, and press F to use nitro. Press P to pause the game, or press G to slow down time when you need extra control over a tricky corner.
real-airplane-simulator: Step into this 3D airplane-driving simulation, where you steer a range of different aircraft. The garage holds many planes to unlock and choose from. Parking and timing challenges are part of the mix, and the game also works on mobile devices.
A green arrow and a set of lines guide your route, and you adjust your
push-the-box: Push The Box is a puzzle game where you solve brain teasers by sliding pieces around and pressing buttons. Each stage is a mission, and you can try harder levels as your skills grow. Reset and undo keep play smooth, and replays show how you cleared a stage. Clean, stylish graphics, achievements, and a leaderboard for comparing scores add to the experience. It is built for smart pads and tablets.
Each colored box must be pushed onto the square with a star of
neon-racer: Neon Racer is a two-dimensional driving game built around levels that are both challenging and enjoyable. It falls under the racing category and is tagged with moto and motorcycle, so it will appeal to anyone who likes riding bikes. Each level asks you to keep your motorcycle under control as you work your way through the course.
Controlling your ride is straightforward. Use the A and D keys, or the left and right arrow keys, to move your moto. To jump, press W or the up arrow. These are the controls you need to get started.
castel-wars-new-era: Episode 3 of Castel Wars has arrived with a fresh set of modern weapons, new maps, and a brand-new Mayhem mode. You can also test out weapons and gear from the industrial revolution and experiment with new tactics. In Mayhem, you fight through harsh conditions and try to last as long as you can. Zombie Mode has a redesigned look, and the zombies now charge in from one direction.

Take on the challenge alone or team up with a friend in two-player matches, and aim to beat your best scores. Blue players move with W, A, S, and D, block with S, hit with E, and switch weapons with Q. Red players move with the arrow keys, block with the down arrow, and hit with SPACE. Hold down either hit key and your character throws its weapon.
quick-draw-cowboys: Quick Draw Cowboys is a fast western duel where success depends on split-second reactions. Watch the screen, wait for the draw cue, and pick the right direction before your rival does. Each shot relies on timing and focus, and simple one-touch controls keep the tension high. Power-up shots and upgrades add variety to every showdown.

Play solo through a campaign of escalating cowboy duels, earning coins from each win to unlock stronger guns and new gunslingers. You can also enter Online PvP for real-time quick draw battles against other players, or use Local PvP for two people sharing one keyboard. On desktop, W, A, S and D shoot up, left, down and right, while Player 2 uses the arrow keys in local play. Mobile players tap the on-screen arrows and menu buttons.
ragdoll-teleport-arena: Ragdoll Teleport Arena blends action with puzzle-style thinking. You fire a projectile at enemies to deal damage. While it is still in the air, tap again to instantly teleport to where it is traveling, so you can reposition on the fly. Success depends on precise aiming, rapid teleportation, and strategic movement, which help you outsmart opponents and claim dominance among the clouds.

The game is controlled entirely with a mouse click or a tap. Every shot and every teleport uses that one input, so you can start playing right away. Each round rewards careful planning over random shooting, since you must we
potion-siege: Potion Siege is a tower defense puzzler in which living potion bottles hold a castle wall against a clockwork army. Brew potions onto the wall, merge matching pairs into stronger ones, and choose from three skill cards at each upgrade. Fire, ice, lightning and more each fight in their own way, and a clockwork boss closes every chapter.

Stop the machines before they breach the wall, and survive each wave to win. Clear story stages for stars, unlock harder modes, or test your endurance in endless mode. Controls are mouse only: click Summon, drag to merge, and click the alchemist once he is charged. On touch devices, tap instead. Phones should stay upright, and if turned sideways the game asks you to
draw-and-guess: Draw And Guess has players taking turns at drawing. One person sketches a word or phrase while the others try to work out what it is. The game puts both creativity and guessing skills to the test. Quick sketches and doodles are often enough to get the idea across, and the time limit adds urgency and excitement to every round.

Teamwork is at the heart of the experience. Players talk through their guesses and combine their ideas to decode each drawing, then move on through the rounds together. To play, just click the mouse or tap the screen.
color-ring-sort: Color Ring Sort is a casual puzzle game that is easy to pick up and enjoy. The gameplay is very simple and the controls are easy to use, which makes it suitable for children. Your goal is to arrange the numbers in order and bring them together. The whole experience feels light and relaxed from start to finish.

The game includes a large number of checkpoints for you to work through and challenge. You can play with a mouse or by tapping the screen. Its easygoing pace makes it a good choice when you want something calm to play.
racing-online: Step into live multiplayer racing that runs right in your web browser. Take on drivers from around the world and work your way up the leaderboards. Drift mechanics reward skillful driving, and you can collect a range of distinct cars. Limited-time events bring exclusive vehicles, and daily quests give you goals to chase each day.

Create a lobby, chat with others, and race alongside friends, or share one device for local co-op and challenge someone in person. On mobile, use the on-screen buttons to steer your car. On desktop, Player 1 uses W and S to accelerate and brake, A and D to steer, and Space for the handbrake or drift. Player 2 uses the arrow keys, with Right Shift for the handbrake or drift. All controls can be customized in the game settings.
potato-shooter: A cursed potato is the hero of this roguelike survivor, facing a steady stream of relentless foes. You upgrade your arsenal, dodge incoming projectiles, and hunt for artifacts that can break the game itself. You only get one life, so when the potato falls, you start over and try again.

Move with the arrow keys or WASD, and hit SPACE to dash out of trouble. Your weapons fire on their own at nearby enemies, and you must clear every foe in a room to open its exit door. Coins dropped by defeated enemies are collected along the way. Pedestals offer new weapons and artifacts, anvils boost damage and attack speed, and hearts restore health. Doors lead you between rooms, which grow harder the deeper you venture. Quick kills earn coins faster.
kid-ball-adventure: Step into a whimsical realm of bouncing balls and enchanted castles in this 2D platform game, where danger and reward go hand in hand. You control Kid Ball as he chases the villains who snatched his loved one through perilous castle dungeons. Along the way, you'll face many tough stages packed with traps and deadly foes, and you can bounce across spikes or use booster cannons to get ahead.
Each chamber brings new hazards, and you must find the key before the exit unlocks and carries you on to the next one. On a computer, steer with the arrow keys. On mobile, use the on-screen buttons.
merge-beasts: Merge Beasts is a bright puzzle game built around joining creatures that look alike. Each time two matching beasts meet, they fuse into a stronger one, and your aim is to uncover tougher monsters along the way. You will need to think a few steps ahead, keep the board from getting crowded, and hit the goal set for every level.
Controls are straightforward. On a computer, press and hold the left mouse button on a beast, drag it over a matching one, and let go to merge them. On a phone or tablet, touch the screen
ninja-survival-simulator: Step into the shoes of a quick, agile ninja as you journey through a long series of stages packed with snares, foes, and brain-teasing puzzles. Each area is bright and built in three dimensions, and you must dodge lethal contraptions while battling undead creatures and tough bosses. Success depends on quick movement, sharp timing, and careful planning, since every stage asks for concentration and skill.

Along the way, you can improve your fighter, acquire new blades and weapons, and gather eye-catching outfits. These upgrades help you handle tougher obstacles as the game goes on. Control the ninja with the WASD keys on a keyboard, or drag your finger across the screen to steer on a touch device.
teeth-runner: Teeth are vital organs, and the condition of your mouth can shape the health of your entire body. When oral diseases set in, they can wear down the hard parts of a tooth as well as the tissues that support it. Certain microbes that live in the mouth for long periods may trigger or worsen some whole-body illnesses, and overall wellness plays a big part in how well someone lives day to day.
In Teeth Runner, a 3D title, your job is to clean the teeth of people dealing with oral conditions while dodging the awful pollutants along the way. You control everything with a tap or a click.
block-builder-jam: Block Builder Jam is a puzzle game designed to challenge your logic and creativity. Its physics simulation shapes how every piece moves and settles, so each move you make affects what happens next. Blocks hover on the screen until you choose the right moment, and a single tap sends one falling.

Your job is to build the shape a stage calls for, using only the blocks you have dropped. Once you finish a stage, you can move on to new challenges. Experiment, adjust your approach, and see how far your building skills can take you.
moto-racer: Moto Racer puts you on a motorcycle and sets you against computer-controlled rivals. Pick the bike you want to ride, then head to the garage in the main menu to make upgrades. Scooping up coins along each course is part of the challenge, and the winner is whoever crosses the finish line ahead of everyone else.

Steering your motorbike uses the arrow keys on a keyboard. On a phone or tablet, the on-screen buttons handle the same controls. Race through the levels, gather coins as you go, and aim to be the rider who gets to the end first.
slime-knight: Slime Knight is an arcade platformer that sends a small yet fearless knight through an old castle. Your job is to clear the foes standing on each floor by swinging your sword at them, which opens the way up to the next level.

Jumping works with X, Space, the Up Arrow, or a right click. Throwing swords is handled by S, C, or a left click. On mobile, the controls are set up within the game itself. Pixel graphics and a retro look give the platform and action elements a classic feel.
bullet-storm: In this shooter, the story begins with an event hosted by the Princess, where the goal is to shoot down a group of troublesome skeletons by aiming at their heads. You help a gunman aim and fire while also collecting coins along the way. Your bullets are limited, so each shot matters. Once your ammunition runs out, the gun sits empty and the game ends.

Action and shooting fans, or anyone who just wants a relaxed good time, should find plenty to enjoy here. The graphics are high quality, the file is small without losing visual detail, and the controls are easy to pick up. Interesting quests add variety to the play. On Android, tap the on-screen touch buttons to aim. On PC, use a left mouse click to aim.
masha-and-bear-cooking-dash: Hungry animals are roaming the forest, and someone has to feed them. In this cooking dash, Masha, the restless little girl from the cartoon Masha and the Bear, takes on the job with some help from kids. Every character from the show wants something different, so you must find the right ingredients for each one. Your big goal is to make the best oatmeal you can.

The game is controlled entirely with taps or mouse clicks. Keep an eye on what each animal wants, collect those ingredients, and cook your way through the forest. Each new dish gives you another chance to show off your skills in the kitchen.
ant-picnic: Help a busy ant colony work out a clever plan. Pick a team from the front card of any of three queues, and its ants will collect the reachable blocks that match their own color. Every team needs room, so plan ahead. A blocked color leaves ants waiting, and once all five slots fill, it is time to try another approach.

Solve 1,002 mosaic puzzles and rescue ladybugs, butterflies and beetles along the way. Spend earned nectar to decorate your garden. Opening lessons teach the basics, new chapters unlock as you advance, and you can pick up where you left off. On desktop, click a front card or press 1, 2 or 3 to send a team, Space changes ant speed, and Escape opens or closes the pause menu. On mobile, tap a front card and use the on-screen buttons for hints, speed, the level map and settings.
cartoon-traffic-racing-paper-derby: Paper Derby puts you behind the wheel of tiny cardboard cars racing on busy roads inside a cartoon world made of paper. Every race is a battle for first place, so you weave between traffic, avoid collisions, and push past obstacles. Oversized stationery, ramps, and other interactive elements turn each map into a playground for overtaking, colliding with, and defeating rivals.

Win races and earn rewards to unlock new cars with unique designs and strong performance, then customize them to fit your playstyle. Later maps bring more intense traffic and tougher challenges across colorful arenas. Controls: W or Up Arrow accelerates, S or Down Arrow brakes, A and D or the Left and Right Arrows steer, Space is the handbrake, F activates nitro, C changes the camera, and B looks back.
beat-shooter-game: Beat Shooter blends music with target practice in a puzzle-style game. Nothing here is left to chance, because you shape the tracks and build your own tunes as you play. Before you begin, you choose your favorite gun from a large selection, then aim at the squares that fall down the screen. Try hard not to let a single block get past you.

Each square you hit earns you a bonus, so skilled sniping can pay off well. The controls are simple: click the mouse or tap the screen to play. It is aimed at boys, girls, and kids who enjoy rhythm and aiming challenges.
dead-city-zombie-shooter: Dead City: Zombie Shooter is a first-person shooter with a strong focus on long-range sniper action. The story takes place in a ruined wasteland called Last Hope, where the apocalypse has left the land overrun. Zombies, raiders, and other dangerous foes roam the area, so you will need to fight your way through. Along the way you can rescue survivors, but killing enemies is also how you keep yourself alive. The game is story driven, and it is up to you to save the world.
Move with W, A, S, D or the arrow keys. Move the mouse to look around, and left-click to fire. Scroll the mouse wheel to switch between weapons.
popsortica: PopSortica continues Poppy's story in a fresh installment set beneath the waves. You sort colored cubes across a set of columns, with levels that feel both demanding and calm. Each stage keeps the basic rules easy to grasp, yet the puzzles grow tougher as you progress. Watch for unusual hazards and special conditions that test your focus, and make use of helpful boosters when you want to reach better scores more quickly. Mermaid Poppy is at the center of this undersea sorting journey.
To play, pick up a cube by selecting it from one column, then click another column to drop it there, but only when the colors line up. Keep moving cubes until every column is empty.
merge-monsters-army: Merge Monsters Army puts you in charge of a band of monsters that battle rival forces. Your goal is to strengthen your army so it can take on the enemies you face. Gold coins collected along the way can be used to unlock new monsters. A useful trick is merging two identical monsters, which combines them into a stronger one.
Tapping is the only control you need, since a tap starts each fight. The game is listed under puzzles and tagged for kids, skills, and mobile play, so it suits short sessions on a phone.
zoological-zeppelin: Your goal in this 2D casual adventure is to get out of a cave. The path to freedom is packed with obstacles, and the journey spans three levels. Each level has its own environment and surprises, so you need to watch out for unexpected hazards and flying monsters. If your character falls off a platform, the game ends, so think ahead and control each move carefully.

The controls are easy to learn. On Android, touch and pull the character, then release with careful aim at the next pin. On PC, click and pull with the mouse, then let go with precise aim toward the next pin. If you enjoy adventure, survival, or quest games, this hypercasual title should suit you well.
emoji-math-quiz: Emoji Math mixes number puzzles with a playful emoji twist. There are six equations to work through, and every emoji stands in for a number. Your job is to crack the emoji code and figure out what each symbol is worth so the equation adds up correctly. Each puzzle gives you a chance to build your reasoning one step at a time.

To answer, click the empty box and type in your solution. If you get stuck, a hint is available to nudge you forward. You can switch between dark and light themes depending on your preference. Check the leaderboards to see how you compare, and share your progress with friends.
extreme-car-driving-simulator: Extreme Car Driving Simulator is a hardcore driving sim powered by a realistic 3D engine. It offers four different game modes that put your driving skills to the test.

Open World Mode sends you out on the road with missions to transport passengers. In Parking Mode, you manoeuvre your car into spots in extremely demanding environments. If you feel confident, take on these challenges and purchase six more, better cars. Everything runs on simple mouse clicks or taps.
mountain-climb-racing: Mountain Climb Racing sends you over hills and peaks, where you have to get past various obstacles on the way. You can take on a friend in a head-to-head race, or choose to compete against the computer instead. The first racer to reach the finish line wins the match.

Player 1 steers with the W, A, S and D keys, while Player 2 uses the arrow keys. Both players share the same keyboard, so grab a partner and see who can make it across the mountains first. The game is built with HTML5 and fits the racing and platform genres, with a playful, funny feel that suits younger players too.
summer-aesthetics: Board a flight and head off on a summer break that takes you around the world alongside some of your favorite Disney princesses. Along the way, you'll see lovely landscapes and get to play fashion advisor, choosing what each princess should wear for the day. It's a dress-up game made with girls in mind, so it's a fun way to sharpen your eye for fashion.
Play with your mouse on a desktop computer, or tap on a mobile device. Enjoy the scenery, try different looks, and see which combinations work best for each princess on her journey.
stickman-army-resistance: Renegade stickmen have pushed into the jungle and are attacking local residents. Your region's final line of defense is its top fighting unit. You control a pair of highly trained soldiers who command a range of heavy firepower meant to halt the rebels. The conflict will be intense, so holding your position is essential, no matter what comes.

Control works with the mouse or by tapping the touchscreen, and an in-game tutorial walks you through the basics. Your task is to fend off the revolutionaries and renegades and guide your squad to a final win. A large selection of weapons is available, including a gun, machine gun, bazooka, and rifle.
ball-path-through-obstacles: You roll a ball through a 3D obstacle course filled with traps. Dodge the hazards and collect coins, which unlock new skins for your ball. The course is challenging, and the game also works on mobile devices.

On a computer, press W to roll forward, S to move backward, A and D to turn left and right, and the space bar to jump. Click the improvement icon on the left side of the screen to use improvements, and open the store icon in the menu to buy skins. On a phone or tablet, a virtual joystick in the lower left part of the screen controls movement when you slide your finger across it, and a button in the lower right part jumps. The improvement icon is still on the left side, and the store is still found in the menu.
crash-rampage: Crash Rampage is an arcade driving game built around destruction. You launch off ramps, smash buildings and escape the police, collecting gold that you can spend to upgrade your car. City mode is all about causing chaos, but the clock is ticking. In Arena, enemies keep coming at you, so you pick upgrade cards and stack their abilities into strong combinations.

Steer with WASD or the arrow keys. Hold Shift to activate Nitro, press Space to brake, and tap R to reset your car. Mobile players get a joystick and on-screen buttons instead. Visit the garage to improve your vehicle, then head into Arena to defeat enemies and survive for as long as you can.
